title: Phoneme-Level Feature Discrepancies: A Key to Detecting Sophisticated Speech Deepfakes
title_ch: 音素级特征差异：检测高级语音换脸的关键
authors: Kuiyuan Zhang;Zhongyun Hua;Rushi Lan;Yushu Zhang;Yifang Guo;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Guilin University of Electronic Technology;Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics;Alibaba Group;
abstract: Recent advancements in text-to-speech and speech conversion technologies have enabled the creation of highly convincing synthetic speech. While these innovations offer numerous practical benefits, they also cause significant security challenges when maliciously misused. Therefore, there is an urgent need to detect these synthetic speech signals. Phoneme features provide a powerful speech representation for deepfake detection. However, previous phoneme-based detection approaches typically focused on specific phonemes, overlooking temporal inconsistencies across the entire phoneme sequence. In this paper, we develop a new mechanism for detecting speech deepfakes by identifying the inconsistencies of phoneme-level speech features. We design an adaptive phoneme pooling technique that extracts sample-specific phoneme-level features from frame-level speech data. By applying this technique to features extracted by pre-trained audio models on previously unseen deepfake datasets, we demonstrate that deepfake samples often exhibit phoneme-level inconsistencies when compared to genuine speech. To further enhance detection accuracy, we propose a deepfake detector that uses a graph attention network to model the temporal dependencies of phoneme-level features. Additionally, we introduce a random phoneme substitution augmentation technique to increase feature diversity during training. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method over existing state-of-the-art detection methods.
abstract_ch: 近年来，文本转语音和语音转换技术的发展使得生成高度逼真的合成语音成为可能。虽然这些创新提供了诸多实用优势，但当被恶意利用时，也会引发重大的安全挑战。因此，迫切需要检测这些合成语音信号。音素特征为深度伪造语音检测提供了一种强大的语音表示方法。然而，以往基于音素的检测方法通常专注于特定的音素，而忽视了整个音素序列中的时间一致性问题。在本文中，我们开发了一种新的机制来检测语音深度伪造，通过识别音素级语音特征的一致性问题来进行。我们设计了一种自适应音素池化技术，从帧级语音数据中提取样本特异性音素级特征。将该技术应用于预训练音频模型在先前未见过的深度伪造数据集上提取的特征，我们证明了与真实语音相比，深度伪造样本往往表现出音素级的一致性问题。为了进一步提高检测准确性，我们提出了一种使用图注意力网络建模音素级特征的时间依赖性的深度伪造检测器。此外，我们引入了一种随机音素替换增强技术，在训练过程中增加特征多样性。在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在检测性能方面优于现有的最先进的检测方法。

title: Real-Time Calibration Model for Low-Cost Sensor in Fine-Grained Time Series
title_ch: 低成本传感器的细粒度时间序列实时校准模型
authors: Seokho Ahn;Hyungjin Kim;Sungbok Shin;Young-Duk Seo;
affiliations: Inha University;INRIA;University of Maryland;
abstract: Precise measurements from sensors are crucial, but data is usually collected from low-cost, low-tech systems, which are often inaccurate. Thus, they require further calibrations. To that end, we first identify three requirements for effective calibration under practical low-tech sensor conditions. Based on the requirements, we develop a model called TESLA, Transformer for effective sensor calibration utilizing logarithmic-binned attention. TESLA uses a high-performance deep learning model, Transformers, to calibrate and capture non-linear components. At its core, it employs logarithmic binning to minimize attention complexity. TESLA achieves consistent real-time calibration, even with longer sequences and finer-grained time series in hardware-constrained systems. Experiments show that TESLA outperforms existing novel deep learning and newly crafted linear models in accuracy, calibration speed, and energy efficiency.
abstract_ch: 精确的传感器测量至关重要，但数据通常是从低成本、低技术含量的系统中收集的，这些系统往往不够准确。因此，它们需要进一步校准。为此，我们首先确定了在实际低技术含量传感器条件下有效校准的三个要求。基于这些要求，我们开发了一个名为TESLA（Transformer for effective sensor calibration utilizing logarithmic-binned attention）的模型。TESLA 使用高性能的深度学习模型——变压器，来校准并捕捉非线性成分。其核心采用了对数分箱注意力机制，以最小化注意力复杂度。即使在硬件受限的系统中处理较长序列和更高分辨率的时间序列，TESLA 也能实现一致的实时校准。实验表明，TESLA 在精度、校准速度和能效方面优于现有的新型深度学习模型和新设计的线性模型。

title: Relation-Aware Equivariant Graph Networks for Epitope-Unknown Antibody Design and Specificity Optimization
title_ch: 基于关系感知的等变图网络在 epitope 未知抗体设计和特异性优化中的应用
authors: Lirong Wu;Haitao Lin;Yufei Huang;Zhangyang Gao;Cheng Tan;Yunfan Liu;Tailin Wu;Stan Z. Li;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Westlake University;
abstract: Antibodies are Y-shaped proteins that protect the host by binding to specific antigens, and their binding is mainly determined by the Complementary Determining Regions (CDRs) in the antibody. Despite the great progress made in CDR design, existing computational methods still encounter several challenges: 1) poor capability of modeling complex CDRs with long sequences due to insufficient contextual information; 2) conditioned on pre-given antigenic epitopes and their static interaction with the target antibody; 3) neglect of specificity during antibody optimization leads to non-specific antibodies. In this paper, we take into account a variety of node features, edge features, and edge relations to include more contextual and geometric information. We propose a novel Relation-Aware Antibody Design (RAAD) framework, which dynamically models antigen-antibody interactions for co-designing the sequences and structures of antigen-specific CDRs. Furthermore, we propose a new evaluation metric to better measure antibody specificity and develop a contrasting specificity-enhancing constraint to optimize the specificity of antibodies. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superior capability of RAAD in terms of antibody modeling, generation, and optimization across different CDR types, sequence lengths, pre-training strategies, and input contexts.
abstract_ch: 抗体是Y形蛋白质，它们通过与特定抗原结合来保护宿主，而这种结合主要由抗体中的互补决定区（CDRs）决定。尽管在CDR设计方面取得了巨大进展，现有的计算方法仍面临几个挑战：1）由于缺乏足够的上下文信息，难以建模具有长序列的复杂CDR；2）基于预先给定的抗原表位及其静态与目标抗体的相互作用；3）在抗体优化过程中忽视特异性导致产生非特异性抗体。本文中，我们考虑了各种节点特征、边特征和边关系，以包含更多的上下文和几何信息。我们提出了一种新的关系感知抗体设计（RAAD）框架，该框架动态建模抗原-抗体相互作用，用于协同设计抗原特异性CDR的序列和结构。此外，我们提出了一种新的评估指标来更好地衡量抗体的特异性，并开发了一种对比增强特异性的约束条件来优化抗体的特异性。广泛的实验表明，RAAD在不同类型的CDR、序列长度、预训练策略和输入上下文中，在抗体建模、生成和优化方面具有优越的能力。

title: SCALM: Detecting Bad Practices in Smart Contracts Through LLMs
title_ch: SCALM：通过大规模语言模型检测智能合约中的不良实践
authors: Zongwei Li;Xiaoqi Li;Wenkai Li;Xin Wang;
affiliations: Hainan University;
abstract: As the Ethereum platform continues to mature and gain widespread usage, it is crucial to maintain high standards of smart contract writing practices. While bad practices in smart contracts may not directly lead to security issues, they do elevate the risk of encountering problems. Therefore, to understand and avoid these bad practices, this paper introduces the first systematic study of bad practices in smart contracts, delving into over 35 specific issues. Specifically, we propose a large language models (LLMs)-based framework, SCALM. It combines Step-Back Prompting and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to identify and address various bad practices effectively. Our extensive experiments using multiple LLMs and datasets have shown that SCALM outperforms existing tools in detecting bad practices in smart contracts.
abstract_ch: 随着以太坊平台的不断成熟和广泛应用，保持高标准的智能合约编写实践至关重要。虽然不良的智能合约编写实践可能不会直接导致安全问题，但它们确实会增加遇到问题的风险。因此，为了理解和避免这些不良实践，本文介绍了首个系统性研究智能合约不良实践的研究，深入探讨了超过35个具体问题。具体而言，我们提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLMs）的框架SCALM。该框架结合了Step-Back Prompting和检索增强生成（RAG），能够有效识别并解决各种不良实践。我们的大量实验使用了多种LLMs和数据集，结果显示SCALM在检测智能合约中的不良实践方面优于现有工具。

title: Selective Forgetting: Advancing Machine Unlearning Techniques and Evaluation in Language Models
title_ch: 选择性遗忘：推进语言模型中的机器遗忘技术与评估方法
authors: Lingzhi Wang;Xingshan Zeng;Jinsong Guo;Kam-Fai Wong;Georg Gottlob;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Huawei;Unlimidata Ltd;Chinese University of Hong Kong;MoE Key Laboratory of High Confidence Software Technologies;University of Calabria;
abstract: This paper explores Machine Unlearning (MU), an emerging field that is gaining increased attention due to concerns about neural models unintentionally remembering personal or sensitive information. We present SeUL, a novel method that enables selective and fine-grained unlearning for language models. Unlike previous work that employs a fully reversed training objective in unlearning, SeUL minimizes the negative impact on the capability of language models, particularly in terms of generation. Furthermore, we introduce two innovative evaluation metrics, sensitive extraction likelihood (S-EL) and sensitive memorization accuracy (S-MA), specifically designed to assess the effectiveness of forgetting sensitive information. In support of the unlearning framework, we propose efficient automatic online and offline sensitive span annotation methods. The online selection method, based on language probability scores, ensures computational efficiency, while the offline annotation involves a two-stage LLM-based process for robust verification. In summary, this paper contributes a novel selective unlearning method (SeUL), introduces specialized evaluation metrics (S-EL and S-MA) for assessing sensitive information forgetting, and proposes automatic online and offline sensitive span annotation methods to support the overall unlearning framework and evaluation process.
abstract_ch: 本文探讨了机器反学习（MU），这是一个由于对神经网络模型无意中记住个人或敏感信息的担忧而日益受到关注的研究领域。我们提出了SeUL，一种新颖的方法，使语言模型能够实现选择性和精细粒度的反学习。与以往通过完全反转训练目标来进行反学习的工作不同，SeUL旨在最小化对语言模型生成能力的负面影响。此外，我们引入了两种创新的评估指标，即敏感提取可能性（S-EL）和敏感记忆准确性（S-MA），专门用于评估忘记敏感信息的有效性。为了支持反学习框架，我们还提出了一种高效的自动在线和离线敏感跨度注释方法。基于语言概率得分的在线选择方法确保了计算效率，而离线注释则涉及一个基于LLM的两阶段过程，以实现稳健验证。总之，本文贡献了一种新颖的选择性反学习方法（SeUL）、引入了专门用于评估敏感信息遗忘的评估指标（S-EL和S-MA），并提出了自动在线和离线敏感跨度注释方法，以支持整体反学习框架和评估过程。

title: Simulate and Eliminate: Revoke Backdoors for Generative Large Language Models
title_ch: 模拟与消除：撤销生成型大语言模型的后门
authors: Haoran Li;Yulin Chen;Zihao Zheng;Qi Hu;Chunkit Chan;Heshan Liu;Yangqiu Song;
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;National University of Singapore;Harbin Institute of Technology;Independent Researcher;
abstract: With rapid advances, generative large language models (LLMs) dominate various Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks from understanding to reasoning. Yet, language models' inherent vulnerabilities may be exacerbated due to increased accessibility and unrestricted model training on massive data. A malicious adversary may publish poisoned data online and conduct backdoor attacks on the victim LLMs pre-trained on the poisoned data. Backdoored LLMs behave innocuously for normal queries and generate harmful responses when the backdoor trigger is activated. Despite significant efforts paid to LLMs' safety issues, LLMs are still struggling against backdoor attacks. As Anthropic recently revealed, existing safety training strategies, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), fail to revoke the backdoors once the LLM is backdoored during the pre-training stage. In this paper, we present Simulate and Eliminate (SANDE) to erase the undesired backdoored mappings for generative LLMs. We initially propose Overwrite Supervised Fine-tuning (OSFT) for effective backdoor removal when the trigger is known. Then, to handle scenarios where trigger patterns are unknown, we integrate OSFT into our two-stage framework, SANDE. Unlike other works that assume access to cleanly trained models, our safety-enhanced LLMs are able to revoke backdoors without any reference. Consequently, our safety-enhanced LLMs no longer produce targeted responses when the backdoor triggers are activated. We conduct comprehensive experiments to show that our proposed SANDE is effective against backdoor attacks while bringing minimal harm to LLMs' powerful capability.
abstract_ch: 随着快速的进步，生成型大规模语言模型（LLMs）在各种自然语言处理（NLP）任务中占据了主导地位，从理解到推理。然而，由于模型训练变得更加容易获取，并且不受限制地在大量数据上进行训练，语言模型固有的漏洞可能会被放大。恶意攻击者可能在网上发布受污染的数据，并对基于受污染数据预训练的语言模型发起后门攻击。带有后门的语言模型在正常查询时表现无辜，但在后门触发器激活时会产生有害的响应。尽管付出了大量的努力来解决语言模型的安全问题，但语言模型仍然难以抵御后门攻击。正如Anthropic最近揭示的那样，现有的安全训练策略，包括监督微调（SFT）和人类反馈强化学习（RLHF），一旦LLM在预训练阶段被植入后门，就无法撤销这些后门。在这篇论文中，我们提出了Simulate and Eliminate（SANDE）框架，以消除生成型语言模型中的不 desired 后门映射。我们最初提出了一种称为Overwrite Supervised Fine-tuning（OSFT）的有效后门移除方法，适用于已知触发器的情况。然后，为了应对未知触发模式的场景，我们将OSFT整合到我们的两阶段框架SANDE中。与其他假设可以访问干净训练模型的工作不同，我们的安全增强型语言模型能够在没有任何参考的情况下撤销后门。因此，当后门触发器激活时，我们的安全增强型语言模型不再产生针对性的响应。我们进行了全面的实验，证明了我们提出的SANDE在有效对抗后门攻击的同时，对语言模型的强大能力带来的损害最小。

title: SpeHeaTal: A Cluster-Enhanced Segmentation Method for Sperm Morphology Analysis
title_ch: SpeHeaTal：一种增强分割法的精子形态分析方法
authors: Yi Shi;Yun-Kai Wang;Xu-Peng Tian;Tie-Yi Zhang;Bing Yao;Hui Wang;Yong Shao;Cen-Cen Wang;Rong Zeng;
affiliations: Nanjing University;Jiangsu Provincial Medical Key Discipline Cultivation Unit;
abstract: The accurate assessment of sperm morphology is crucial in andrological diagnostics, where the segmentation of sperm images presents significant challenges. Existing approaches frequently rely on large annotated datasets and often struggle with the segmentation of overlapping sperm and the presence of dye impurities. To address these challenges, this paper first analyzes the issue of overlapping sperm tails from a geometric perspective and introduces a novel clustering algorithm, Con2Dis, which effectively segments overlapping tails by considering three essential factors: CONnectivity, CONformity, and DIStance. Building on this foundation, we propose an unsupervised method, SpeHeatal, designed for the comprehensive segmentation of the SPErm HEAd and TAiL. SpeHeatal employs the Segment Anything Model(SAM) to generate masks for sperm heads while filtering out dye impurities, utilizes Con2Dis to segment tails, and then applies a tailored mask splicing technique to produce complete sperm masks. Experimental results underscore the superior performance of SpeHeatal, particularly in handling images with overlapping sperm.
abstract_ch: 准确评估精子形态在男性生殖学诊断中至关重要，而精子图像的分割则面临显著挑战。现有方法通常依赖于大量标注的数据集，并且经常难以处理重叠精子和染料杂质的存在问题。为应对这些挑战，本文首先从几何角度分析了重叠精子尾部的问题，并提出了一种新的聚类算法Con2Dis，该算法通过考虑三个关键因素：CONnectivity（连接性）、CONformity（形态一致性）和DIStance（距离），有效地分割重叠的尾部。在此基础上，我们提出了一种无监督方法SpeHeatal，专门用于精子头部和尾部的全面分割。SpeHeatal 使用Segment Anything Model (SAM) 生成精子头部的掩码，同时过滤掉染料杂质，利用Con2Dis进行尾部分割，并然后应用定制的掩码拼接技术以产生完整的精子掩码。实验结果证明了SpeHeatal 的优越性能，特别是在处理重叠精子的图像方面表现出色。

title: SQLFixAgent: Towards Semantic-Accurate Text-to-SQL Parsing via Consistency-Enhanced Multi-Agent Collaboration
title_ch: SQLFixAgent：通过一致性增强的多智能体协作实现语义准确的文本到SQL解析
authors: Jipeng Cen;Jiaxin Liu;Zhixu Li;Jingjing Wang;
affiliations: Soochow University;iFLYTEK Research;Renmin University of China;
abstract: While fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) excel in generating grammatically valid SQL in Text-to-SQL parsing, they often struggle to ensure semantic accuracy in queries, leading to user confusion and diminished system usability. To tackle this challenge, we introduce SQLFixAgent, a new consistency-enhanced multi-agent collaborative framework designed for detecting and repairing erroneous SQL. Our framework comprises a core agent, SQLRefiner, alongside two auxiliary agents: SQLReviewer and QueryCrafter. The SQLReviewer agent employs the rubber duck debugging method to identify potential semantic mismatches between SQL and user query. If the error is detected, the QueryCrafter agent generates multiple SQL as candidate repairs using a fine-tuned SQLTool. Subsequently, leveraging similar repair retrieval and failure memory reflection, the SQLRefiner agent selects the most fitting SQL statement from the candidates as the final repair. We evaluated our proposed framework on five Text-to-SQL benchmarks. The experimental results show that our method consistently enhances the performance of the baseline model, specifically achieving an execution accuracy improvement of over 3% on the Bird benchmark. Our framework also has a higher token efficiency compared to other advanced methods, making it more competitive.
abstract_ch: 尽管微调后的大型语言模型（LLMs）在文本到SQL解析中生成语法正确的SQL方面表现出色，但在确保查询语义准确性方面往往存在困难，这导致用户困惑并降低了系统的可用性。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了SQLFixAgent，这是一种新的增强一致性的多智能体协作框架，旨在检测和修复错误的SQL。该框架包括一个核心智能体SQLRefiner，以及两个辅助智能体：SQLReviewer和QueryCrafter。SQLReviewer智能体采用橡胶鸭调试法来识别SQL与用户查询之间潜在的语义不匹配。如果检测到错误，QueryCrafter智能体将使用微调后的SQLTool生成多个候选的SQL修复语句。随后，SQLRefiner智能体利用类似修复检索和失败记忆反思的方法，从这些候选修复语句中选择最合适的作为最终修复。我们在五个文本到SQL基准上评估了我们提出的框架。实验结果显示，我们的方法能够持续提升基线模型的性能，特别是在Bird基准上实现了超过3%的执行准确率提升。此外，与其它先进方法相比，我们的框架具有更高的标记效率，使其更具竞争力。

title: StressPrompt: Does Stress Impact Large Language Models and Human Performance Similarly?
title_ch: 压力提示：压力对大型语言模型和人类性能的影响是否相似？
authors: Guobin Shen;Dongcheng Zhao;Aorigele Bao;Xiang He;Yiting Dong;Yi Zeng;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;Beijing Institute of AI Safety and Governance;Beijing Key Laboratory of AI Safety and Superalignment;Center for Long-term Artificial Intelligence;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: Human beings often experience stress, which can significantly influence their performance. This study explores whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit stress responses similar to those of humans and whether their performance fluctuates under different stress-inducing prompts. To investigate this, we developed a novel set of prompts, termed StressPrompt, designed to induce varying levels of stress. These prompts were derived from established psychological frameworks and carefully calibrated based on ratings from human participants. We then applied these prompts to several LLMs to assess their responses across a range of tasks, including instruction-following, complex reasoning, and emotional intelligence. The findings suggest that LLMs, like humans, perform optimally under moderate stress, consistent with the Yerkes-Dodson law. Notably, their performance declines under both low and high-stress conditions. Our analysis further revealed that these StressPrompts significantly alter the internal states of LLMs, leading to changes in their neural representations that mirror human responses to stress. This research provides critical insights into the operational robustness and flexibility of LLMs, demonstrating the importance of designing AI systems capable of maintaining high performance in real-world scenarios where stress is prevalent, such as in customer service, healthcare, and emergency response contexts. Moreover, this study contributes to the broader AI research community by offering a new perspective on how LLMs handle different scenarios and their similarities to human cognition.
abstract_ch: 人类往往会经历压力，这会对他们的表现产生显著影响。本研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否会展现出与人类相似的压力反应，并且在不同的压力诱导提示下，其表现是否会波动。为了进行这项研究，我们开发了一套新的提示，称为StressPrompt，旨在诱导不同水平的压力。这些提示源自已建立的心理学框架，并根据人类参与者给出的评分进行了精细校准。然后，我们将这些提示应用于多个LLMs，以评估它们在包括指令遵循、复杂推理和情感智能等一系列任务中的响应情况。研究发现表明，LLMs在适度压力下表现出色，与耶克斯-多德森定律一致。值得注意的是，在低压力和高压力条件下，它们的表现都会下降。我们的分析进一步揭示，这些StressPrompt显著改变了LLMs的内部状态，导致其神经表示发生变化，类似于人类对压力的反应。这项研究为LLMs的操作稳健性和灵活性提供了关键见解，展示了在客户服务、医疗保健和紧急响应等常见存在压力的现实场景中设计能够保持高性能的AI系统的必要性。此外，这项研究还为更广泛的AI研究社区提供了一个新的视角，探讨了LLMs如何处理不同情境以及它们与人类认知的相似之处。

title: SUMI-IFL: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Image Forgery Localization with Sufficiency and Minimality Constraints
title_ch: SUMI-IFL：一种基于信息论框架的图像伪造定位方法，包含充分性和最小性约束
authors: Ziqi Sheng;Wei Lu;Xiangyang Luo;Jiantao Zhou;Xiaochun Cao;
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University;State Key Laboratory of Mathematical Engineering and Advanced Computing;University of Macau;
abstract: Image forgery localization (IFL) is a crucial technique for preventing tampered image misuse and protecting social safety. However, due to the rapid development of image tampering technologies, extracting more comprehensive and accurate forgery clues remains an urgent challenge. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel information-theoretic IFL framework named SUMI-IFL that imposes sufficiency-view and minimality-view constraints on forgery feature representation. First, grounded in the theoretical analysis of mutual information, the sufficiency-view constraint is enforced on the feature extraction network to ensure that the latent forgery feature contains comprehensive forgery clues. Considering that forgery clues obtained from a single aspect alone may be incomplete, we construct the latent forgery feature by integrating several individual forgery features from multiple perspectives. Second, based on the information bottleneck, the minimality-view constraint is imposed on the feature reasoning network to achieve an accurate and concise forgery feature representation that counters the interference of task-unrelated features. Extensive experiments show the superior performance of SUMI-IFL to existing state-of-the-art methods, not only on in-dataset comparisons but also on cross-dataset comparisons.
abstract_ch: 图像伪造定位（Image Forgery Localization，IFL）是一项关键的技术，用于防止篡改图像的不当使用并保护社会安全。然而，由于图像篡改技术的快速发展，提取更全面和准确的伪造线索仍然是一个迫切的挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为SUMI-IFL的新颖信息论IFL框架，该框架在伪造特征表示上施加了充分性和最小性约束。首先，在互信息理论分析的基础上，对特征提取网络施加充分性约束，以确保潜在的伪造特征包含全面的伪造线索。考虑到单独从一个方面获取的伪造线索可能是不完整的，我们通过多角度整合多个独立的伪造特征来构建潜在的伪造特征。其次，基于信息瓶颈原理，对特征推理网络施加最小性约束，以实现对抗与任务无关特征干扰的精确且简洁的伪造特征表示。广泛的实验表明，SUMI-IFL在现有最先进的方法中表现出优越的性能，不仅在同数据集比较中表现突出，也在跨数据集比较中表现出色。

title_ch: 特洛伊检测：在自我监督学习中无数据检测特洛伊输入
authors: Yupei Liu;Yanting Wang;Jinyuan Jia;
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University;
abstract: An image encoder pre-trained by self-supervised learning can be used as a general-purpose feature extractor to build downstream classifiers for various downstream tasks. However, many studies showed that an attacker can embed a trojan into an encoder such that multiple downstream classifiers built based on the trojaned encoder simultaneously inherit the trojan behavior. In this work, we propose TrojanDec, the first data-free method to identify and recover a test input embedded with a trigger. Given a (trojaned or clean) encoder and a test input, TrojanDec first predicts whether the test input is trojaned. If not, the test input is processed in a normal way to maintain the utility. Otherwise, the test input will be further restored to remove the trigger. Our extensive evaluation shows that TrojanDec can effectively identify the trojan (if any) from a given test input and recover it under state-of-the-art trojan attacks. We further demonstrate by experiments that our TrojanDec outperforms the state-of-the-art defenses.
abstract_ch: 通过自我监督学习预训练的图像编码器可以作为通用特征提取器来构建各种下游任务的分类器。然而，许多研究显示，攻击者可以通过在编码器中嵌入木马，使得基于该被篡改编码器构建的多个下游分类器同时继承木马行为。在本工作中，我们提出了TrojanDec，这是一种首个无需数据的方法，用于识别并恢复包含触发器的测试输入。给定一个（被篡改或干净的）编码器和一个测试输入，TrojanDec 首先预测该测试输入是否被篡改。如果没有被篡改，则以正常方式处理测试输入以保持其实用性。如果被篡改，则进一步恢复测试输入以移除触发器。我们的广泛评估表明，TrojanDec 可以有效识别给定测试输入中的木马（如果有），并在最先进的木马攻击下对其进行恢复。此外，通过实验我们进一步证明，我们的TrojanDec 在性能上优于现有的最佳防御方法。

title: Uncovering LLM-Generated Code: A Zero-Shot Synthetic Code Detector via Code Rewriting
title_ch: 揭开LLM生成代码的面纱：一种基于代码重写的一次性合成代码检测器
authors: Tong Ye;Yangkai Du;Tengfei Ma;Lingfei Wu;Xuhong Zhang;Shouling Ji;Wenhai Wang;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Stony Brook University;Anytime AI;
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in generating code. However, the misuse of LLM-generated (synthetic) code has raised concerns in both educational and industrial contexts, underscoring the urgent need for synthetic code detectors. Existing methods for detecting synthetic content are primarily designed for general text and struggle with code due to the unique grammatical structure of programming languages and the presence of numerous ''low-entropy'' tokens. Building on this, our work proposes a novel zero-shot synthetic code detector based on the similarity between the original code and its LLM-rewritten variants. Our method is based on the observation that differences between LLM-rewritten and original code tend to be smaller when the original code is synthetic. We utilize self-supervised contrastive learning to train a code similarity model and evaluate our approach on two synthetic code detection benchmarks. Our results demonstrate a significant improvement over existing SOTA synthetic content detectors, with AUROC scores increasing by 20.5% on the APPS benchmark and 29.1% on the MBPP benchmark.
abstract_ch: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在生成代码方面展现出了卓越的能力。然而，在教育和工业领域中，LLM生成的（合成）代码被不当使用的问题引起了广泛关注，这凸显了迫切需要开发合成代码检测器的必要性。现有的检测合成内容的方法主要针对一般文本，但在处理代码时遇到困难，因为编程语言具有独特的语法结构，并且存在大量的“低熵”令牌。在此基础上，我们的工作提出了一种基于LLM重写前后代码相似性的新颖零样本合成代码检测器。该方法基于一个观察：当原始代码是合成代码时，LLM重写后的代码与原始代码之间的差异通常较小。我们利用自监督对比学习来训练代码相似性模型，并在两个合成代码检测基准上评估我们的方法。实验结果表明，我们的方法在APPs基准和MBPP基准上的AUROC分数分别提高了20.5%和29.1%，显著优于现有最先进的合成内容检测器。

title: VerilogCoder: Autonomous Verilog Coding Agents with Graph-based Planning and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based Waveform Tracing Tool
title_ch: 基于图规划和抽象语法树（AST）波形跟踪工具的自主Verilog编码代理
authors: Chia-Tung Ho;Haoxing Ren;Brucek Khailany;
affiliations: NVIDIA;
abstract: Due to the growing complexity of modern Integrated Circuits (ICs), automating hardware design can prevent a significant amount of human error from the engineering process and result in less errors. Verilog is a popular hardware description language for designing and modeling digital systems; thus, Verilog generation is one of the emerging areas of research to facilitate the design process. In this work, we propose VerilogCoder, a system of multiple Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents for Verilog code generation, to autonomously write Verilog code and fix syntax and functional errors using collaborative Verilog tools (i.e., syntax checker, simulator, and waveform tracer). Firstly, we propose a task planner that utilizes a novel Task and Circuit Relation Graph retrieval method to construct a holistic plan based on module descriptions. To debug and fix functional errors, we develop a novel and efficient abstract syntax tree (AST)-based waveform tracing tool, which is integrated within the autonomous Verilog completion flow. The proposed methodology successfully generates 94.2% syntactically and functionally correct Verilog code, surpassing the state-of-the-art methods by 33.9% on the VerilogEval-Human v2 benchmark.
abstract_ch: 由于现代集成电路（ICs）日益复杂，自动化硬件设计可以显著减少工程过程中的人为错误，从而降低错误率。Verilog 是一种广泛用于设计和建模数字系统的硬件描述语言；因此，Verilog 生成成为促进设计过程的研究新兴领域之一。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为 VerilogCoder 的多智能体系统，该系统旨在自主编写 Verilog 代码并使用协作的 Verilog 工具（即语法检查器、模拟器和波形追踪器）修复语法和功能错误。首先，我们提出了一种任务规划器，利用一种新颖的任务和电路关系图检索方法，基于模块描述构建一个整体计划。为了调试和修复功能错误，我们开发了一种新型且高效的基于抽象语法树（AST）的波形追踪工具，并将其集成到自主 Verilog 完成流程中。所提出的方法成功生成了 94.2% 的语法和功能正确的 Verilog 代码，在 VerilogEval-Human v2 基准测试中超越了最先进的方法 33.9%。

title: ViFactCheck: A New Benchmark Dataset and Methods for Multi-Domain News Fact-Checking In Vietnamese
title_ch: ViFactCheck：一种新的多领域越南新闻事实核查基准数据集和方法
authors: Tran Thai Hoa;Tran Quang Duy;Khanh Quoc Tran;Kiet Van Nguyen;
affiliations: University of Information Technology;Vietnam National University;
abstract: The rapid spread of information in the digital age highlights the critical need for effective fact-checking tools, particularly for languages with limited resources, such as Vietnamese. In response to this challenge, we introduce ViFactCheck, the first publicly available benchmark dataset designed specifically for Vietnamese fact-checking across multiple online news domains. This dataset contains 7,232 human-annotated pairs of claim-evidence combinations sourced from reputable Vietnamese online news, covering 12 diverse topics. It has been subjected to a meticulous annotation process to ensure high quality and reliability, achieving a Fleiss Kappa inter-annotator agreement score of 0.83. Our evaluation leverages state-of-the-art pre-trained and large language models, employing fine-tuning and prompting techniques to assess performance. Notably, the Gemma model demonstrated superior effectiveness, with an impressive macro F1 score of 89.90%, thereby establishing a new standard for fact-checking benchmarks. This result highlights the robust capabilities of Gemma in accurately identifying and verifying facts in Vietnamese. To further promote advances in fact-checking technology and improve the reliability of digital media, we have made the ViFactCheck dataset, model checkpoints, fact-checking pipelines, and source code freely available on GitHub. This initiative aims to inspire further research and enhance the accuracy of information in low-resource languages.
abstract_ch: 数字时代信息的快速传播凸显了有效事实核查工具的重要性，尤其是对于资源有限的语言，如越南语。为应对这一挑战，我们推出了ViFactCheck，这是首个专门针对多领域越南在线新闻的事实核查公开基准数据集。该数据集包含7,232个人工标注的声明-证据配对，来源自可靠的越南在线新闻网站，涵盖了12个不同的主题。它经过了细致的标注过程，以确保高质量和可靠性，Fleiss Kappa跨标注者一致性评分为0.83。我们的评估利用了最先进的预训练和大型语言模型，并采用微调和提示技术来评估性能。值得注意的是，Gemma模型表现出了卓越的效果，其宏F1分数达到了89.90%，从而为事实核查基准设立了新的标准。这一结果突显了Gemma在准确识别和验证越南语事实方面的强大能力。为了进一步促进事实核查技术的发展并提高数字媒体的可靠性，我们已将ViFactCheck数据集、模型检查点、事实核查管道和源代码免费发布在GitHub上。这项举措旨在激发进一步的研究，提升低资源语言中信息的准确性。

title: Vox-UDA: Voxel-wise Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Cryo-Electron Subtomogram Segmentation with Denoised Pseudo-Labeling
title_ch: Vox-UDA：体素级无监督领域适应在降噪伪标签辅助下的冷冻电子显微镜子明场分割
authors: Haoran Li;Xingjian Li;Jiahua Shi;Huaming Chen;Bo Du;Daisuke Kihara;Johan Barthelemy;Jun Shen;Min Xu;
affiliations: University of Wollongong;Carnegie Mellon University;University of Queensland;University of Sydney;Griffith University;Purdue University;NVIDIA;
abstract: Cryo-Electron Tomography (cryo-ET) is a 3D imaging technology facilitating the study of macromolecular structures at near-atomic resolution. Recent volumetric segmentation approaches on cryo-ET images have drawn widespread interest in biological sector. However, existing methods heavily rely on manually labeled data, which requires highly professional skills, thereby hindering the adoption of fully-supervised approaches for cryo-ET images. Some unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) approaches have been designed to enhance the segmentation network performance using unlabeled data. However, applying these methods directly to cryo-ET images segmentation tasks remains challenging due to two main issues: 1) the source data, usually obtained through simulation, contain a certain level of noise, while the target data, directly collected from raw-data from real-world scenario, have unpredictable noise levels. 2) the source data used for training typically consists of known macromoleculars, while the target domain data are often unknown, causing the model's segmenter to be biased towards these known macromolecules, leading to a domain shift problem. To address these challenges, in this work, we introduce the first voxel-wise unsupervised domain adaptation approach, termed Vox-UDA, specifically for cryo-ET subtomogram segmentation. Vox-UDA incorporates a noise generation module to simulate target-like noises in the source dataset for cross-noise level adaptation. Additionally, we propose a denoised pseudo-labeling strategy based on improved Bilateral Filter to alleviate the domain shift problem. Experimental results on both simulated and real cryo-ET subtomogram datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposed approach compared to state-of-the-art UDA methods.
abstract_ch: 冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）是一种实现近原子分辨率下大分子结构三维成像的技术。近年来，对cryo-ET图像进行体视学分割的方法引起了生物领域的广泛关注。然而，现有方法严重依赖于手动标注的数据，这需要高度专业的技能，从而阻碍了完全监督方法在cryo-ET图像中的应用。一些无监督领域适应（UDA）方法已被设计用于通过未标注数据提升分割网络性能。然而，直接将这些方法应用于cryo-ET图像分割任务仍然具有挑战性，主要由于两个原因：1）源数据通常通过模拟获得，包含一定程度的噪声，而目标数据则是从实际场景的原始数据直接收集的，其噪声水平难以预测；2）用于训练的源数据通常包含已知的大分子结构，而目标域数据往往是未知的，导致模型的分割器偏向这些已知的大分子结构，从而引发领域偏移问题。为应对这些挑战，在这项工作中，我们引入了首个针对cryo-ET子断层分割的体素级无监督领域适应方法，称为Vox-UDA。Vox-UDA集成了一个噪声生成模块，用于在源数据集中模拟目标级别的噪声，以实现跨噪声级别适应。此外，我们提出了一种基于改进双边滤波的去噪伪标签策略，以缓解领域偏移问题。实验结果表明，我们的方法在模拟和真实cryo-ET子断层数据集上均优于最先进的UDA方法。

title: Whole Genome Transformer for Gene Interaction Effects in Microbiome Habitat Specificity
title_ch: 全基因组转换器在微生物栖息地特异性中的基因互作效应
authors: Zhufeng Li;Sandeep Suresh Cranganore;Nicholas Youngblut;Niki Kilbertus;
affiliations: Technical University of Munich;Helmholtz Zentrum München;Munich Center for Machine Learning;Forschungszentrum Jülich;Technical University of Vienna;Max Planck Institute for Biology;
abstract: Leveraging the vast genetic diversity within microbiomes offers unparalleled insights into complex phenotypes, yet the task of accurately predicting and understanding such traits from genomic data remains challenging. We propose a framework taking advantage of existing large models for gene vectorization to predict habitat specificity from entire microbial genome sequences. Based on our model, we develop attribution techniques to elucidate gene interaction effects that drive microbial adaptation to diverse environments. We train and validate our approach on a large dataset of high quality microbiome genomes from different habitats. We not only demonstrate solid predictive performance, but also how sequence-level information of entire genomes allows us to identify gene associations underlying complex phenotypes. Our attribution recovers known important interaction networks and proposes new candidates for experimental follow up.
abstract_ch: 利用微生物组内巨大的遗传多样性提供了对复杂表型前所未有的见解，但从基因组数据准确预测和理解这些性状仍是一项挑战。我们提出了一种框架，利用现有的大型基因向量化模型来预测整个微生物基因组序列的栖息地特异性。基于我们的模型，我们开发了归因技术来阐明驱动微生物在不同环境中适应的基因相互作用效应。我们在来自不同栖息地的高质量微生物基因组的大数据集上训练并验证了我们的方法。我们不仅展示了强大的预测性能，还说明了整个基因组序列级别的信息如何使我们能够识别出潜在的基因关联，进而解释复杂的表型。我们的归因技术恢复了已知的重要相互作用网络，并提出了新的候选对象供实验进一步跟进。

title: WiFi CSI Based Temporal Activity Detection via Dual Pyramid Network
title_ch: 基于WiFi CSI的双金字塔网络时域活动检测
authors: Zhendong Liu;Le Zhang;Bing Li;Yingjie Zhou;Zhenghua Chen;Ce Zhu;
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;Sichuan University;Agency for Science, Technology and Research;
abstract: We address the challenge of WiFi-based temporal activity detection and propose an efficient Dual Pyramid Network that integrates Temporal Signal Semantic Encoders and Local Sensitive Response Encoders. The Temporal Signal Semantic Encoder splits feature learning into high and low-frequency components, using a novel Signed Mask-Attention mechanism to emphasize important areas and downplay unimportant ones, with the features fused using ContraNorm. The Local Sensitive Response Encoder captures fluctuations without learning. These feature pyramids are then combined using a new cross-attention fusion mechanism. We also introduce a dataset with over 2,114 activity segments across 553 WiFi CSI samples, each lasting around 85 seconds. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms challenging baselines.
abstract_ch: 我们针对基于WiFi的时间活动检测这一挑战，提出了一种高效的双金字塔网络，该网络结合了时间信号语义编码器和局部敏感响应编码器。时间信号语义编码器将特征学习划分为高频和低频成分，并采用一种新颖的带符号掩码注意机制（Signed Mask-Attention mechanism）来强调重要区域并弱化不重要区域，特征融合则使用ContraNorm机制。局部敏感响应编码器则无需学习即可捕捉波动变化。这些特征金字塔随后通过一种新的交叉注意力融合机制进行组合。我们还引入了一个包含超过2,114个活动片段的数据集，这些片段分布在553个WiFi信道状态信息（CSI）样本中，每个片段大约持续85秒。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法优于具有挑战性的基线方法。

title: Adaptive Calibration: A Unified Conversion Framework of Spiking Neural Networks
title_ch: 自适应校准：脉冲神经网络统一转换框架
authors: Ziqing Wang;Yuetong Fang;Jiahang Cao;Hongwei Ren;Renjing Xu;
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;Northwestern University;
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as a promising energy-efficient alternative to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). Despite this, bridging the performance gap with ANNs in practical scenarios remains a significant challenge. This paper focuses on addressing the dual objectives of enhancing the performance and efficiency of SNNs through the established SNN Calibration conversion framework. Inspired by the biological nervous system, we propose a novel Adaptive-Firing Neuron Model (AdaFire) that dynamically adjusts firing patterns across different layers, substantially reducing conversion errors within limited timesteps. Moreover, to meet our efficiency objectives, we propose two novel strategies: an Sensitivity Spike Compression (SSC) technique and an Input-aware Adaptive Timesteps (IAT) technique. These techniques synergistically reduce both energy consumption and latency during the conversion process, thereby enhancing the overall efficiency of SNNs. Extensive experiments demonstrate our approach outperforms state-of-the-art SNNs methods, showcasing superior performance and efficiency in 2D, 3D, and event-driven classification, as well as object detection and segmentation tasks.
abstract_ch: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）已成为一种有前景的节能替代传统人工神经网络（ANNs）的选择。尽管如此，在实际应用场景中缩小与ANNs的性能差距仍然是一个重大挑战。本文专注于通过已建立的SNN校准转换框架来同时提升SNNs的性能和效率。受到生物神经系统启发，我们提出了一种新颖的自适应放电神经元模型（AdaFire），能够在不同层动态调整放电模式，显著减少在有限时间步内的转换误差。此外，为了实现我们的效率目标，我们还提出了两种新颖策略：敏感性脉冲压缩（SSC）技术和输入感知自适应时间步长（IAT）技术。这些技术协同作用，减少了转换过程中的能耗和延迟，从而提升了SNNs的整体效率。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的SNNs方法，在2D、3D和事件驱动分类以及物体检测和分割任务中展示了更优的性能和效率。

title: Advancing Spiking Neural Networks Towards Multiscale Spatiotemporal Interaction Learning
title_ch: 推进尖峰神经网络以实现多尺度时空交互学习
authors: Yimeng Shan;Malu Zhang;Rui-jie Zhu;Xuerui Qiu;Jason K. Eshraghian;Haicheng Qu;
affiliations: Liaoning Technical University;University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;University of California, Santa Cruz;
abstract: Recent advancements in neuroscience research have propelled the development of Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), which not only have the potential to further advance neuroscience research but also serve as an energy-efficient alternative to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to their spike-driven characteristics. However, previous studies often neglected the multiscale information and its spatiotemporal correlation between event data, leading SNN models to approximate each frame of input events as static images. We hypothesize that this oversimplification significantly contributes to the performance gap between SNNs and traditional ANNs. To address this issue, we have designed a Spiking Multiscale Attention (SMA) module that captures multiscale spatiotemporal interaction information. Furthermore, we developed a regularization method named Attention ZoneOut (AZO), which utilizes spatiotemporal attention weights to reduce the model's generalization error through pseudo-ensemble training. Our approach has achieved state-of-the-art results on mainstream neural morphology datasets. Additionally, we have reached a performance of 77.1% on the Imagenet-1K dataset using a 104-layer ResNet architecture enhanced with SMA and AZO. This achievement confirms the state-of-the-art performance of SNNs with non-transformer architectures and underscores the effectiveness of our method in bridging the performance gap between SNN models and traditional ANN models.
abstract_ch: 近年来，神经科学领域的最新进展推动了脉冲神经网络（SNNs）的发展。这些网络不仅有可能进一步促进神经科学的研究，还由于其脉冲驱动的特性，成为人工神经网络（ANNs）的一种能效更高的替代方案。然而，先前的研究往往忽略了事件数据之间的多尺度信息及其时空相关性，导致SNN模型将输入事件的每一帧近似为静态图像。我们假设这种简化显著造成了SNNs与传统ANNs之间的性能差距。为了解决这一问题，我们设计了一个脉冲多尺度注意力（SMA）模块，用于捕捉多尺度的时空交互信息。此外，我们开发了一种正则化方法——注意力区外法（AZO），该方法利用时空注意力权重通过伪集成训练来减少模型的泛化误差。我们的方法在主流的神经形态学数据集上达到了最先进的性能。同时，我们在增强有SMA和AZO的104层ResNet架构后，实现了在ImageNet-1K数据集上的77.1%性能。这一成就证实了非变压器架构的SNNs的先进性能，并强调了我们方法在弥合SNN模型与传统ANN模型之间性能差距方面的有效性。

title: AFFAKT: A Hierarchical Optimal Transport Based Method for Affective Facial Knowledge Transfer in Video Deception Detection
title_ch: AFFAKT：一种基于层次最优传输的情感面部知识转移方法在视频欺骗检测中的应用
authors: Zihan Ji;Xuetao Tian;Ye Liu;
affiliations: South China University of Technology;Beijing Normal University;
abstract: The scarcity of high-quality large-scale labeled datasets poses a huge challenge for employing deep learning models in video deception detection. To address this issue, inspired by the psychological theory on the relation between deception and expressions, we propose a novel method called AFFAKT in this paper, which enhances the classification performance by transferring useful and correlated knowledge from a large facial expression dataset. Two key challenges in knowledge transfer arise: 1) \textit{how much} knowledge of facial expression data should be transferred and 2) \textit{how to} effectively leverage transferred knowledge for the deception classification model during inference. Specifically, the optimal relation mapping between facial expression classes and deception samples is firstly quantified using proposed H-OTKT module and then transfers knowledge from the facial expression dataset to deception samples. Moreover, a correlation prototype within another proposed module SRKB is well designed to retain the invariant correlations between facial expression classes and deception classes through momentum updating. During inference, the transferred knowledge is fine-tuned with the correlation prototype using a sample-specific re-weighting strategy. Experimental results on two deception detection datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed method. The interpretability study reveals high associations between deception and negative affections, which coincides with the theory in psychology.
abstract_ch: 高质量的大规模标注数据稀缺性对视频欺骗检测中应用深度学习模型构成了巨大挑战。为应对这一问题，本文受到欺骗与表情之间心理关系理论的启发，提出了一种名为AFFAKT的新方法，通过从大规模面部表情数据集转移有用且相关的知识来提升分类性能。知识转移过程中存在两个关键挑战：1）应该转移多少面部表情数据的知识；2）如何在推理过程中有效利用转移的知识来改进欺骗分类模型。具体来说，首先使用所提出的H-OTKT模块量化面部表情类别与欺骗样本之间的最优关系映射，然后将面部表情数据集的知识转移到欺骗样本上。此外，另一个所提出的SRKB模块中设计了一个相关原型，通过动量更新保留面部表情类别与欺骗类别之间的不变相关性。在推理过程中，使用样本特定的重权策略对转移的知识进行微调。实验结果表明，本文提出的方法在两个欺骗检测数据集上的性能优越。解释性研究揭示了欺骗与负面情感之间存在高度关联，这与心理学中的理论相符。

title: Bridge Then Begin Anew: Generating Target-Relevant Intermediate Model for Source-Free Visual Emotion Adaptation
title_ch: 重建桥梁：生成目标相关中间模型进行源代码免费视觉情绪适应
authors: Jiankun Zhu;Sicheng Zhao;Jing Jiang;Wenbo Tang;Zhaopan Xu;Tingting Han;Pengfei Xu;Hongxun Yao;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Tsinghua University;NavInfo;Hangzhou Dianzi University;
abstract: Visual emotion recognition (VER), which aims at understanding humans' emotional reactions toward different visual stimuli, has attracted increasing attention. Given the subjective and ambiguous characteristics of emotion, annotating a reliable large-scale dataset is hard. For reducing reliance on data labeling, domain adaptation offers an alternative solution by adapting models trained on labeled source data to unlabeled target data. Conventional domain adaptation methods require access to source data. However, due to privacy concerns, source emotional data may be inaccessible. To address this issue, we propose an unexplored task: source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for VER, which does not have access to source data during the adaptation process. To achieve this, we propose a novel framework termed Bridge then Begin Anew (BBA), which consists of two steps: domain-bridged model generation (DMG) and target-related model adaptation (TMA). First, the DMG bridges cross-domain gaps by generating an intermediate model, avoiding direct alignment between two VER datasets with significant differences. Then, the TMA begins training the target model anew to fit the target structure, avoiding the influence of source-specific knowledge. Extensive experiments are conducted on six SFDA settings for VER. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of BBA, which achieves remarkable performance gains compared with state-of-the-art SFDA methods and outperforms representative unsupervised domain adaptation approaches.
abstract_ch: 视觉情感识别（VER），旨在理解人类对不同视觉刺激的情感反应，已引起越来越多的关注。鉴于情绪的主观性和模糊性，标注可靠的大规模数据集颇具挑战。为了减少对数据标注的依赖，领域适应提供了一种替代方案，通过将基于标记源数据训练的模型调整到未标记的目标数据上。传统领域适应方法需要访问源数据。然而，由于隐私问题，源情感数据可能无法访问。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一项未被探索的任务：无源领域适应（Source-Free Domain Adaptation, SFDA）在情感识别中的应用，该任务在适应过程中不使用源数据。为此，我们提出了一种新的框架，称为“桥梁然后重新开始”（Bridge then Begin Anew, BBA），该框架包含两个步骤：跨域桥梁生成（Domain-Bridged Model Generation, DMG）和目标相关的模型适应（Target-Related Model Adaptation, TMA）。首先，DMG通过生成一个中间模型来跨越领域差距，避免直接对齐两个差异显著的情感识别数据集。然后，TMA从头开始训练目标模型以适应目标结构，从而避免源特定知识的影响。我们在六种不同的无源领域适应设置下进行了广泛实验。实验结果表明，BBA的有效性，其性能显著优于最先进的无源领域适应方法，并且超越了代表性的无监督领域适应方法。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Time-Scale Invariant Memory
title_ch: 时间尺度不变的记忆增强深度学习
authors: Md Rysul Kabir;James Mochizuki-Freeman;Zoran Tiganj;
affiliations: Unknown Institution;
abstract: The ability to estimate temporal relationships is critical for both animals and artificial agents. Cognitive science and neuroscience provide remarkable insights into behavioral and neural aspects of temporal credit assignment. In particular, scale invariance of learning dynamics, observed in behavior and supported by neural data, is one of the key principles that governs animal perception: proportional rescaling of temporal relationships does not alter the overall learning efficiency. Here we integrate a computational neuroscience model of scale invariant memory into deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents. We first provide a theoretical analysis and then demonstrate through experiments that such agents can learn robustly across a wide range of temporal scales, unlike agents built with commonly used recurrent memory architectures such as LSTM. This result illustrates that incorporating computational principles from neuroscience and cognitive science into deep neural networks can enhance adaptability to complex temporal dynamics, mirroring some of the core properties of human learning.
abstract_ch: 估计时间关系的能力对于动物和人工代理来说都是至关重要的。认知科学和神经科学提供了对时间信用分配的行为和神经方面的重要见解。特别是，在行为中观察到的学习动态的尺度不变性，由神经数据支持，是动物感知的关键原则之一：时间关系的比例缩放不会改变整体学习效率。在这里，我们将一种计算神经科学的尺度不变记忆模型整合到深度强化学习（RL）代理中。我们首先进行理论分析，然后通过实验表明，这样的代理能够在广泛的时序尺度上稳健地学习，而使用常见递归记忆架构（如LSTM）构建的代理则不能做到这一点。这一结果表明，将神经科学和认知科学中的计算原理整合到深度神经网络中可以增强其对复杂时序动态的适应能力，反映出人类学习的一些核心特性。

title: Enriching Multimodal Sentiment Analysis Through Textual Emotional Descriptions of Visual-Audio Content
title_ch: 通过视觉-音频内容的文字情感描述丰富多模态情感分析
authors: Sheng Wu;Dongxiao He;Xiaobao Wang;Longbiao Wang;Jianwu Dang;
affiliations: Tianjin University;Guangdong Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Economy;Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology;
abstract: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) stands as a critical research frontier, seeking to comprehensively unravel human emotions by amalgamating text, audio, and visual data. Yet, discerning subtle emotional nuances within audio and video expressions poses a formidable challenge, particularly when emotional polarities across various segments appear similar. In this paper, our objective is to spotlight emotion-relevant attributes of audio and visual modalities to facilitate multimodal fusion in the context of nuanced emotional shifts in visual-audio scenarios. To this end, we introduce DEVA, a progressive fusion framework founded on textual sentiment descriptions aimed at accentuating emotional features of visual-audio content. DEVA employs an Emotional Description Generator (EDG) to transmute raw audio and visual data into textualized sentiment descriptions, thereby amplifying their emotional characteristics. These descriptions are then integrated with the source data to yield richer, enhanced features. Furthermore, DEVA incorporates the Text-guided Progressive Fusion Module (TPF), leveraging varying levels of text as a core modality guide. This module progressively fuses visual-audio minor modalities to alleviate disparities between text and visual-audio modalities. Experimental results on widely used sentiment analysis benchmark datasets, including MOSI, MOSEI, and CH-SIMS, underscore significant enhancements compared to state-of-the-art models. Moreover, fine-grained emotion experiments corroborate the robust sensitivity of DEVA to subtle emotional variations.
abstract_ch: 多模态情感分析（MSA）作为一项关键的研究前沿，旨在通过结合文本、音频和视觉数据来全面解析人类情感。然而，在音频和视频表达中识别微妙的情感细微差别尤其具有挑战性，特别是在不同段落间情感极性相似的情况下。本文的目标是突出音频和视觉模态中的情感相关属性，以在细腻的情感转变情境下促进多模态融合。为此，我们引入了DEVA，这是一种基于文本情感描述的渐进式融合框架，旨在强调视觉-音频内容的情感特征。DEVA 使用情感描述生成器（EDG）将原始的音频和视觉数据转化为文本化的情感描述，从而放大它们的情感特性。这些描述随后与源数据整合，以产生更丰富、增强的特征。此外，DEVA 还集成了文本导向的渐进式融合模块（TPF），利用不同层次的文本作为核心模态指南。该模块逐步融合视觉-音频次要模态，以缓解文本与视觉-音频模态之间的差异。实验结果表明，DEVA 在广泛使用的多模态情感分析基准数据集（包括MOSI、MOSEI和CH-SIMS）上显著优于最先进的模型。此外，细粒度的情感实验还证实了DEVA 对微妙情感变化的高度敏感性。

title: EventZoom: A Progressive Approach to Event-Based Data Augmentation for Enhanced Neuromorphic Vision
title_ch: EventZoom：一种渐进式事件驱动数据增强方法，以提升神经形态视觉性能
authors: Yiting Dong;Xiang He;Guobin Shen;Dongcheng Zhao;Yang Li;Yi Zeng;
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Center for Long-term Artificial Intelligence;
abstract: Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) capture event data with high temporal resolution and low power consumption, presenting a more efficient solution for visual processing in dynamic and real-time scenarios compared to conventional video capture methods. Event data augmentation serve as an essential method for overcoming the limitation of scale and diversity in event datasets. Our comparative experiments demonstrate that the two factors, spatial integrity and temporal continuity, can significantly affect the capacity of event data augmentation, which are guarantee for maintaining the sparsity and high dynamic range characteristics unique to event data. However, existing augmentation methods often neglect the preservation of spatial integrity and temporal continuity. To address this, we developed a novel event data augmentation strategy EventZoom, which employs a temporal progressive strategy, embedding transformed samples into the original samples through progressive scaling and shifting. The scaling process avoids the spatial information loss associated with cropping, while the progressive strategy prevents interruptions or abrupt changes in temporal information. We validated EventZoom across various supervised learning frameworks. The experimental results show that EventZoom consistently outperforms existing event data augmentation methods with SOTA performance. For the first time, we have concurrently employed Semi-supervised and Unsupervised learning to verify feasibility on event augmentation algorithms, demonstrating the applicability and effectiveness of EventZoom as a powerful event-based data augmentation tool in handling real-world scenes with high dynamics and variability environments.
abstract_ch: 动态视觉传感器（DVS）以高时间分辨率和低功耗的方式捕获事件数据，相比传统的视频捕捉方法，在动态和实时场景中提供了更高效的视觉处理解决方案。事件数据增强作为克服事件数据集规模和多样性限制的重要方法。我们的对比实验表明，空间完整性和时间连续性这两个因素可以显著影响事件数据增强的能力，它们是保持事件数据独特稀疏性和高动态范围特性的保障。然而，现有的增强方法往往忽视了空间完整性和时间连续性的保存。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了一种新颖的事件数据增强策略——EventZoom，该策略采用时间渐进策略，通过渐进缩放和位移将变换后的样本嵌入到原始样本中。缩放过程避免了裁剪带来的空间信息损失，而渐进策略则防止了时间信息中断或突然变化。我们在各种监督学习框架中验证了EventZoom。实验结果表明，EventZoom在性能上始终优于现有的事件数据增强方法，并达到了当前最优水平（SOTA）。首次同时使用半监督学习和无监督学习来验证事件增强算法的可行性，展示了EventZoom作为一种强大的基于事件的数据增强工具，在处理具有高度动态性和变异性的真实世界场景中的适用性和有效性。

title: EyEar: Learning Audio Synchronized Human Gaze Trajectory Based on Physics-Informed Dynamics
title_ch: EyEar: 基于物理约束动力学的音频同步人类注视轨迹学习
authors: Xiaochuan Liu;Xin Cheng;Yuchong Sun;Xiaoxue Wu;Ruihua Song;Hao Sun;Denghao Zhang;
affiliations: Renmin University of China;
abstract: Imitating how humans move their gaze in a visual scene is a vital research problem for both visual understanding and psychology, kindling crucial applications such as building alive virtual characters. Previous studies aim to predict gaze trajectories when humans are free-viewing an image, searching for required targets, or looking for clues to answer questions in an image. While these tasks focus on visual-centric scenarios, humans move their gaze also along with audio signal inputs in more common scenarios. To fill this gap, we introduce a new task that predicts human gaze trajectories in a visual scene with synchronized audio inputs and provide a new dataset containing 20k gaze points from 8 subjects. To effectively integrate audio information and simulate the dynamic process of human gaze motion, we propose a novel learning framework called EyEar (Eye moving while Ear listening) based on physics-informed dynamics, which considers three key factors to predict gazes: eye inherent motion tendency, vision salient attraction, and audio semantic attraction. We also propose a probability density score to overcome the high individual variability of gaze trajectories, thereby improving the stabilization of optimization and the reliability of the evaluation. Experimental results show that EyEar outperforms all the baselines in the context of all evaluation metrics, thanks to the proposed components in the learning model.
abstract_ch: 模仿人类在视觉场景中移动视线的方式是视觉理解和心理学研究中的一个重要问题，激发了诸如构建生动虚拟角色等关键应用。以往的研究旨在预测人类在自由观看图像、寻找所需目标或在图像中寻找答案线索时的眼球轨迹。虽然这些任务主要集中在视觉为中心的情境下，但在更常见的场景中，人类的眼球运动还会伴随着音频信号输入。为填补这一空白，我们引入了一个新的任务，即在同步音频输入的情况下预测人类在视觉场景中的眼球轨迹，并提供了一个包含8位受试者共2万多个注视点的新数据集。为了有效整合音频信息并模拟人类视线运动的动态过程，我们基于物理驱动的动力学提出了一种新的学习框架EyEar（眼看着耳朵听），该框架考虑了三个关键因素来预测视线：眼睛固有的运动倾向、视觉显著性吸引以及音频语义吸引。此外，我们还提出了一种概率密度分数，以克服眼球轨迹高度个体差异的问题，从而提高优化的稳定性和评估的可靠性。实验结果显示，在所有评估指标的背景下，EyEar均优于所有基线模型，这得益于学习模型中提出的组件。

title: GRSN: Gated Recurrent Spiking Neurons for POMDPs and MARL
title_ch: GRSN：门控递归脉冲神经元用于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程和多智能体强化学习
authors: Lang Qin;Ziming Wang;Runhao Jiang;Rui Yan;Huajin Tang;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Zhejiang University of Technology;
abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are widely applied in various fields due to their energy-efficient and fast-inference capabilities. Applying SNNs to reinforcement learning (RL) can significantly reduce the computational resource requirements for agents and improve the algorithm's performance under resource-constrained conditions. However, in current spiking reinforcement learning (SRL) algorithms, the simulation results of multiple time steps can only correspond to a single-step decision in RL. This is quite different from the real temporal dynamics in the brain and also fails to fully exploit the capacity of SNNs to process temporal data. In order to address this temporal mismatch issue and further take advantage of the inherent temporal dynamics of spiking neurons, we propose a novel temporal alignment paradigm (TAP) that leverages the single-step update of spiking neurons to accumulate historical state information in RL and introduces gated units to enhance the memory capacity of spiking neurons. Experimental results show that our method can solve partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) and multi-agent cooperation problems with similar performance as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) but with about 50% power consumption.
abstract_ch: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）由于其节能和快速推理的能力，在各个领域得到了广泛应用。将SNNs应用于强化学习（RL）可以显著降低智能体的计算资源需求，并在资源受限条件下提高算法的性能。然而，在当前的脉冲强化学习（SRL）算法中，多个时间步的模拟结果只能对应RL中的单步决策。这与大脑的真实时间动态有很大差异，也无法充分利用SNNs处理时序数据的能力。为了解决这一时间不匹配问题并进一步利用脉冲神经元固有的时序动态特性，我们提出了一种新颖的时间对齐框架（TAP），该框架利用脉冲神经元的单步更新来累积RL中的历史状态信息，并引入门控单元以增强脉冲神经元的记忆容量。实验结果显示，我们的方法可以解决部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）和多智能体合作问题，并且在性能上与循环神经网络（RNNs）相当，但功耗降低了约50%。

title: MIDI-GPT: A Controllable Generative Model for Computer-Assisted Multitrack Music Composition
title_ch: MIDI-GPT：一种可控生成模型，用于计算机辅助多轨音乐创作
authors: Philippe Pasquier;Jeff Ens;Nathan Fradet;Paul Triana;Davide Rizzotti;Jean-Baptiste Rolland;Maryam Safi;
affiliations: Simon Fraser University;Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH;
abstract: We present and release MIDI-GPT, a generative system based on the Transformer architecture that is designed for computer-assisted music composition workflows. MIDI-GPT supports the infilling of musical material at the track and bar level, and can condition generation on attributes including: instrument type, musical style, note density, polyphony level, and note duration. In order to integrate these features, we employ an alternative representation for musical material, creating a time-ordered sequence of musical events for each track and concatenating several tracks into a single sequence, rather than using a single time-ordered sequence where the musical events corresponding to different tracks are interleaved. We also propose a variation of our representation allowing for expressiveness. We present experimental results that demonstrate that MIDI-GPT is able to consistently avoid duplicating the musical material it was trained on, generate music that is stylistically similar to the training dataset, and that attribute controls allow enforcing various constraints on the generated material. We also outline several real-world applications of MIDI-GPT, including collaborations with industry partners that explore the integration and evaluation of MIDI-GPT into commercial products, as well as several artistic works produced using it.
abstract_ch: 我们介绍了MIDI-GPT，这是一个基于Transformer架构的生成系统，旨在支持计算机辅助音乐创作工作流程。MIDI-GPT支持在轨道和小节级别填充音乐材料，并可以根据乐器类型、音乐风格、音符密度、复调水平以及音符持续时间等属性进行条件生成。为了整合这些功能，我们采用了一种替代的音乐材料表示方法，为每条轨道创建一个按时间顺序排列的音乐事件序列，并将多条轨道串联成一个单一序列，而不是使用一个混合了不同轨道对应音乐事件的单一时间序列。我们还提出了一种改进的表示方法，以增强其表现力。实验结果显示，MIDI-GPT能够一致地避免重复训练时使用的音乐材料，生成与训练数据集风格相似的音乐，并且属性控制可以施加各种约束条件以影响生成的音乐材料。此外，我们概述了MIDI-GPT的一些实际应用案例，包括与行业合作伙伴进行的合作，探索将MIDI-GPT集成并评估到商业产品中的可能性，以及使用MIDI-GPT创作的多种艺术作品。

title: Multi-View Incremental Learning with Structured Hebbian Plasticity for Enhanced Fusion Efficiency
title_ch: 基于结构化希布bian可塑性的多视图增量学习以提高融合效率
authors: Yuhong Chen;Ailin Song;Huifeng Yin;Shuai Zhong;Fuhai Chen;Qi Xu;Shiping Wang;Mingkun Xu;
affiliations: Fuzhou University;Guangdong Institute of Intelligence Science and Technology;University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;Tsinghua University;Dalian University of Technology;
abstract: The rapid evolution of multimedia technology has revolutionized human perception, paving the way for multi-view learning. However, traditional multi-view learning approaches are tailored for scenarios with fixed data views, falling short of emulating the intricate cognitive procedures of the human brain processing signals sequentially. Our cerebral architecture seamlessly integrates sequential data through intricate feed-forward and feedback mechanisms. In stark contrast, traditional methods struggle to generalize effectively when confronted with data spanning diverse domains, highlighting the need for innovative strategies that can mimic the brain's adaptability and dynamic integration capabilities. In this paper, we propose a bio-neurologically inspired multi-view incremental framework named MVIL aimed at emulating the brain's fine-grained fusion of sequentially arriving views. MVIL lies two fundamental modules: structured Hebbian plasticity and synaptic partition learning. The structured Hebbian plasticity reshapes the structure of weights to express the high correlation between view representations, facilitating a fine-grained fusion of view representations. Moreover, synaptic partition learning is efficient in alleviating drastic changes in weights and also retaining old knowledge by inhibiting partial synapses. These modules bionically play a central role in reinforcing crucial associations between newly acquired information and existing knowledge repositories, thereby enhancing the network's capacity for generalization. Experimental results on six benchmark datasets show MVIL's effectiveness over state-of-the-art methods.
abstract_ch: 多媒体技术的迅速发展革新了人类的感知方式，为多视图学习开辟了新的途径。然而，传统的多视图学习方法往往是针对固定数据视图场景设计的，无法有效模拟人类大脑处理信号时复杂的认知过程。我们的大脑架构通过复杂的前馈和反馈机制无缝地整合了序列数据。相比之下，传统方法在面对跨领域数据时难以有效泛化，突显了需要创新策略来模仿大脑的适应性和动态整合能力的需求。在本文中，我们提出了一种受生物神经启发的多视图增量框架（MVIL），旨在模拟大脑对相继到达的视图进行精细融合的过程。MVIL 包含两个基本模块：结构化的海伯学习塑性（Structured Hebbian Plasticity）和突触分区学习（Synaptic Partition Learning）。结构化的海伯学习塑性重塑权重结构以表达视图表示之间的高相关性，从而促进视图表示的精细融合。此外，突触分区学习能够有效缓解权重的剧烈变化，并通过抑制部分突触来保留旧的知识。这些模块在增强网络泛化能力方面发挥着关键作用，通过强化新获取信息与现有知识库之间的关联。在六个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，MVIL 在泛化能力上优于现有最先进的方法。

title: MuMA-ToM: Multi-modal Multi-Agent Theory of Mind
title_ch: MuMA-ToM：多模态多代理理论心智
authors: Haojun Shi;Suyu Ye;Xinyu Fang;Chuanyang Jin;Leyla Isik;Yen-Ling Kuo;Tianmin Shu;
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University;University of Virginia;
abstract: Understanding people's social interactions in complex real-world scenarios often relies on intricate mental reasoning. To truly understand how and why people interact with one another, we must infer the underlying mental states that give rise to the social interactions, i.e., Theory of Mind reasoning in multi-agent interactions. Additionally, social interactions are often multi-modal -- we can watch people's actions, hear their conversations, and/or read about their past behaviors. For AI systems to successfully and safely interact with people in real-world environments, they also need to understand people's mental states as well as their inferences about each other's mental states based on multi-modal information about their interactions. For this, we introduce MuMA-ToM, a Multi-modal Multi-Agent Theory of Mind benchmark. MuMA-ToM is the first multi-modal Theory of Mind benchmark that evaluates mental reasoning in embodied multi-agent interactions. In MuMA-ToM, we provide video and text descriptions of people's multi-modal behavior in realistic household environments. Based on the context, we then ask questions about people's goals, beliefs, and beliefs about others' goals. We validated MuMA-ToM in a human experiment and provided a human baseline. We also proposed a novel multi-modal, multi-agent ToM model, LIMP (Language model-based Inverse Multi-agent Planning). Our experimental results show that LIMP significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including large multi-modal models (e.g., GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5 Pro) and a recent multi-modal ToM model, BIP-ALM.
abstract_ch: 在复杂的真实世界场景中理解人们的社会互动往往依赖于复杂的心理推理。要真正理解人们彼此之间是如何以及为什么互动的，我们必须推断出导致这些社会互动的潜在心理状态，即多智能体互动中的心理理论推理。此外，社会互动往往是多模态的——我们可以观察人们的动作，倾听他们的对话，或者阅读他们过去的行为。为了使AI系统能够在真实环境中有成功且安全的互动，它们也需要理解人们的心理状态，以及基于他们互动的多模态信息对他们彼此心理状态的推断。为此，我们引入了MuMA-ToM基准测试，这是一个多模态多智能体心理理论基准。MuMA-ToM是第一个评估嵌入式多智能体互动中心理推理的多模态心理理论基准。在MuMA-ToM中，我们提供了在现实家庭环境中人们对多模态行为的视频和文本描述。根据上下文，我们提出问题，关于人们的动机、信念以及他们对他人动机的信念。我们在人类实验中验证了MuMA-ToM，并提供了人类基准线。我们还提出了一个新颖的基于多模态和多智能体心理理论的模型——LIMP（基于语言模型的逆多智能体规划）。我们的实验结果显示，LIMP显著优于当前最先进的方法，包括大型多模态模型（例如GPT-4o、Gemini-1.5 Pro）和一个最近的多模态心理理论模型BIP-ALM。

title: Open Models, Closed Minds? On Agents Capabilities in Mimicking Human Personalities through Open Large Language Models
title_ch: 开放模型，封闭思维？关于代理通过开放的大语言模型模仿人类个性的能力
authors: Lucio La Cava;Andrea Tagarelli;
affiliations: University of Calabria;
abstract: The emergence of unveiling human-like behaviors in Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to a closer connection between NLP and human psychology. Scholars have been studying the inherent personalities exhibited by LLMs and attempting to incorporate human traits and behaviors into them. However, these efforts have primarily focused on commercially-licensed LLMs, neglecting the widespread use and notable advancements seen in Open LLMs. This work aims to address this gap by employing a set of 12 LLM Agents based on the most representative Open models and subject them to a series of assessments concerning the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) test and the Big Five Inventory (BFI) test. Our approach involves evaluating the intrinsic personality traits of Open LLM agents and determining the extent to which these agents can mimic human personalities when conditioned by specific personalities and roles. Our findings unveil that $(i)$ each Open LLM agent showcases distinct human personalities; $(ii)$ personality-conditioned prompting produces varying effects on the agents, with only few successfully mirroring the imposed personality, while most of them being ``closed-minded'' (i.e., they retain their intrinsic traits); and $(iii)$ combining role and personality conditioning can enhance the agents' ability to mimic human personalities. Our work represents a step up in understanding the dense relationship between NLP and human psychology through the lens of Open LLMs.
abstract_ch: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出的人类行为特征的出现，使得自然语言处理（NLP）与人类心理学之间的联系更加紧密。学者们一直在研究LLMs固有的人格特质，并试图将人类的特征和行为融入其中。然而，这些努力主要集中在商业许可的LLMs上，忽视了开源LLMs的广泛应用及其显著进展。本研究旨在通过采用一套基于最具代表性的开源模型的12个LLM代理，并对它们进行一系列关于迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标（MBTI）测试和大五人格问卷（BFI）测试的评估来填补这一空白。我们的方法涉及评估开源LLM代理的内在人格特质，并确定在特定人格和角色条件下，这些代理模仿人类人格的程度。我们的发现揭示了：$(i)$ 每个开源LLM代理都表现出独特的人格特征；$(ii)$ 基于人格的提示产生了不同的效果，只有少数代理成功地反映了施加的人格特质，而大多数则保持其内在特质，显得“闭塞”（即，它们保留了自己的固有特性）；$(iii)$ 结合角色和人格条件可以增强代理模仿人类人格的能力。我们的工作代表了通过开源LLMs视角理解NLP与人类心理学之间密集关系的一大步。

title: Personalized Dynamic Music Emotion Recognition with Dual-Scale Attention-Based Meta-Learning
title_ch: 基于双尺度注意力元学习的个性化动态音乐情绪识别
authors: Dengming Zhang;Weitao You;Ziheng Liu;Lingyun Sun;Pei Chen;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;
abstract: Dynamic Music Emotion Recognition (DMER) aims to predict the emotion of different moments in music, playing a crucial role in music information retrieval. The existing DMER methods struggle to capture long-term dependencies when dealing with sequence data, which limits their performance. Furthermore, these methods often overlook the influence of individual differences on emotion perception, even though everyone has their own personalized emotional perception in the real world. Motivated by these issues, we explore more effective sequence processing methods and introduce the Personalized DMER (PDMER) problem, which requires models to predict emotions that align with personalized perception. Specifically, we propose a Dual-Scale Attention-Based Meta-Learning (DSAML) method. This method fuses features from a dual-scale feature extractor and captures both short and long-term dependencies using a dual-scale attention transformer, improving the performance in traditional DMER. To achieve PDMER, we design a novel task construction strategy that divides tasks by annotators. Samples in a task are annotated by the same annotator, ensuring consistent perception. Leveraging this strategy alongside meta-learning, DSAML can predict personalized perception of emotions with just one personalized annotation sample. Our objective and subjective experiments demonstrate that our method can achieve state-of-the-art performance in both traditional DMER and PDMER.
abstract_ch: 动态音乐情绪识别（DMER）旨在预测音乐中不同时刻的情绪，对音乐信息检索发挥着关键作用。现有的DMER方法在处理序列数据时难以捕捉长期依赖关系，这限制了它们的表现。此外，这些方法往往忽略了个体差异对情绪感知的影响，尽管每个人在现实世界中有自己独特的个性化情绪感知。受这些问题的启发，我们探索了更有效的序列处理方法，并引入了个性化DMER（PDMER）问题，要求模型预测与个性化感知相一致的情绪。具体而言，我们提出了一种基于双尺度注意力的元学习方法（Dual-Scale Attention-Based Meta-Learning, DSAML）。该方法结合了双尺度特征提取器的特征，并使用双尺度注意力变换器捕捉短期和长期依赖关系，从而在传统DMER中提高性能。为了实现PDMER，我们设计了一种新颖的任务构建策略，通过注释者来划分任务。一个任务中的样本由同一个注释者标注，确保情绪感知的一致性。借助这一策略和元学习，DSAML仅需一个个性化的标注样本即可预测情绪的个性化感知。我们的客观和主观实验表明，该方法在传统DMER和PDMER中均能实现最先进的性能。

title: Pose as a Modality: A Psychology-Inspired Network for Personality Recognition with a New Multimodal Dataset
title_ch: 作为一种模态：一种受心理学启发的用于人格识别的新多模态数据集网络
authors: Bin Tang;Ke-Qi Pan;Miao Zheng;Ning Zhou;Jia-Lu Sui;Dandan Zhu;Cheng-Long Deng;Shu-Guang Kuai;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Shanghai Center for Brain Science and Brain-Inspired Technology;New York University Shanghai;
abstract: In recent years, predicting Big Five personality traits from multimodal data has received significant attention in artificial intelligence (AI). However, existing computational models often fail to achieve satisfactory performance. Psychological research has shown a strong correlation between pose and personality traits, yet previous research has largely ignored pose data in computational models. To address this gap, we develop a novel multimodal dataset that incorporates full-body pose data. The dataset includes video recordings of 287 participants completing a virtual interview with 36 questions, along with self-reported Big Five personality scores as labels. To effectively utilize this multimodal data, we introduce the Psychology-Inspired Network (PINet), which consists of three key modules: Multimodal Feature Awareness (MFA), Multimodal Feature Interaction (MFI), and Psychology-Informed Modality Correlation Loss (PIMC Loss). The MFA module leverages the Vision Mamba Block to capture comprehensive visual features related to personality, while the MFI module efficiently fuses the multimodal features. The PIMC Loss, grounded in psychological theory, guides the model to emphasize different modalities for different personality dimensions. Experimental results show that the PINet outperforms several state-of-the-art baseline models. Furthermore, the three modules of PINet contribute almost equally to the model's overall performance. Incorporating pose data significantly enhances the model's performance, with the pose modality ranking mid-level in importance among the five modalities. These findings address the existing gap in personality-related datasets that lack full-body pose data and provide a new approach for improving the accuracy of personality prediction models, highlighting the importance of integrating psychological insights into AI frameworks.
abstract_ch: 近年来，从多模态数据预测五大人格特质在人工智能（AI）领域受到了广泛关注。然而，现有的计算模型往往难以达到令人满意的表现。心理学研究显示姿态与人格特质之间存在强烈的关联，但以往的研究在计算模型中大多忽略了姿态数据。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一个新的多模态数据集，该数据集整合了全身姿态数据。数据集包含287名参与者完成虚拟面试的视频记录，以及自我报告的五大人格特质评分作为标签。为了有效利用这些多模态数据，我们引入了心理学启发网络（PINet），该网络包括三个关键模块：多模态特征意识（MFA）、多模态特征交互（MFI）和心理学指导模态相关损失（PIMC Loss）。MFA模块利用Vision Mamba Block捕捉与人格相关的全面视觉特征，而MFI模块则高效地融合了多模态特征。PIMC Loss基于心理学理论，引导模型在不同的个性维度上强调不同的模态。实验结果显示，PINet优于几种最先进的基线模型。此外，PINet的三个模块几乎对模型的整体性能贡献相同。整合姿态数据显著提升了模型的表现，姿态模态在五个模态中的重要性排名中等。这些发现解决了现有与人格相关的数据集中缺乏全身姿态数据的问题，并提供了一种提高人格预测模型准确性的新方法，突显了将心理学洞察力融入AI框架的重要性。

title: Semi-IIN: Semi-Supervised Intra-Inter Modal Interaction Learning Network for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
title_ch: 半监督多模态交互网络：用于多模态情感分析的半监督内跨模态交互学习网络
authors: Jinhao Lin;Yifei Wang;Yanwu Xu;Qi Liu;
affiliations: South China University of Technology;
abstract: Despite multimodal sentiment analysis being a fertile research ground that merits further investigation, current approaches take up high annotation cost and suffer from label ambiguity, non-amicable to high-quality labeled data acquisition. Furthermore, choosing the right interactions is essential because the significance of intra- or inter-modal interactions can differ among various samples. To this end, we propose Semi-IIN, a Semi-supervised Intra-inter modal Interaction learning Network for multimodal sentiment analysis. Semi-IIN integrates masked attention and gating mechanisms, enabling effective dynamic selection after independently capturing intra- and inter-modal interactive information. Combined with the self-training approach, Semi-IIN fully utilizes the knowledge learned from unlabeled data. Experimental results on two public datasets, MOSI and MOSEI, demonstrate the effectiveness of Semi-IIN, establishing a new state-of-the-art on several metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/flow-ljh/Semi-IIN.
abstract_ch: 尽管多模态情感分析是一个值得进一步研究的肥沃研究领域，但当前的方法存在高注释成本和标签模糊的问题，并且不利于高质量标注数据的获取。此外，选择合适的交互方式至关重要，因为不同样本中跨模态或同一模态内的交互重要性可能有所不同。为此，我们提出了一种名为Semi-IIN（半监督内跨模态交互学习网络）的方法，用于多模态情感分析。Semi-IIN 结合了掩码注意力和门控机制，能够在独立捕获同一模态内和跨模态交互信息后实现有效的动态选择。通过结合自我训练方法，Semi-IIN 充分利用了未标注数据中学到的知识。在两个公开数据集MOSI和MOSEI上的实验结果表明，Semi-IIN 的有效性，并在多个指标上建立了新的状态最先进水平。代码可在 https://github.com/flow-ljh/Semi-IIN 获取。

title: SocialSim: Towards Socialized Simulation of Emotional Support Conversation
title_ch: 社会模拟：迈向情感支持对话的社会化模拟
authors: Zhuang Chen;Yaru Cao;Guanqun Bi;Jincenzi Wu;Jinfeng Zhou;Xiyao Xiao;Si Chen;Hongning Wang;Minlie Huang;
affiliations: Central South University;Tsinghua University;Northwest Minzu University;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Lingxin AI;
abstract: Emotional support conversation (ESC) helps reduce people's psychological stress and provide emotional value through interactive dialogues. Due to the high cost of crowdsourcing a large ESC corpus, recent attempts use large language models for dialogue augmentation. However, existing approaches largely overlook the social dynamics inherent in ESC, leading to less effective simulations. In this paper, we introduce SocialSim, a novel framework that simulates ESC by integrating key aspects of social interactions: social disclosure and social awareness. On the seeker side, we facilitate social disclosure by constructing a comprehensive persona bank that captures diverse and authentic help-seeking scenarios. On the supporter side, we enhance social awareness by eliciting cognitive reasoning to generate logical and supportive responses. Building upon SocialSim, we construct SSConv, a large-scale synthetic ESC corpus of which quality can even surpass crowdsourced ESC data. We further train a chatbot on SSConv and demonstrate its state-of-the-art performance in both automatic and human evaluations. We believe SocialSim offers a scalable way to synthesize ESC, making emotional care more accessible and practical.
abstract_ch: 情感支持对话（ESC）有助于减轻人们的心理压力并提供情感价值，通过互动对话进行。由于众包大规模ESC语料库的成本高昂，最近的努力使用大型语言模型来增强对话。然而，现有的方法大多忽视了ESC中固有的社会动态，导致模拟效果不佳。在本文中，我们介绍了SocialSim这一新型框架，通过整合社交互动的关键方面——社会披露和社会意识来模拟ESC。在寻求者一方，我们通过构建一个全面的人格银行来促进社会披露，该银行捕捉到了多样且真实的求助场景。在支持者一方，我们通过引发认知推理来增强社会意识，从而生成逻辑性和支持性的回应。基于SocialSim，我们构建了SSConv，这是一个大规模合成ESC语料库，其质量甚至可以超过众包ESC数据。我们进一步在SSConv上训练了一个聊天机器人，并在自动和人工评估中展示了其最先进的性能。我们认为，SocialSim提供了一种可扩展的方法来合成ESC，使情感关怀更加普及和实用。

title: Spike2Former: Efficient Spiking Transformer for High-performance Image Segmentation
title_ch: Spike2Former：高效尖峰变压器，用于高性能图像分割
authors: Zhenxin Lei;Man Yao;Jiakui Hu;Xinhao Luo;Yanye Lu;Bo Xu;Guoqi Li;
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Peking University;
abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have a low-power advantage but perform poorly in image segmentation tasks. The reason is that directly converting neural networks with complex architectural designs for segmentation tasks into spiking versions leads to performance degradation and non-convergence. To address this challenge, we first identify the modules in the architecture design that lead to the severe reduction in spike firing, make targeted improvements, and propose Spike2Former architecture. Second, we propose normalized integer spiking neurons to solve the training stability problem of SNNs with complex architectures. We set a new state-of-the-art for SNNs in various semantic segmentation datasets, with a significant improvement of +12.7% mIoU and 5.0 efficiency on ADE20K, +14.3% mIoU and 5.2 efficiency on VOC2012, and +9.1% mIoU and 6.6 efficiency on CityScapes.
abstract_ch: 脉冲神经网络（SNNs）具有低功耗的优势，但在图像分割任务中的表现较差。原因是直接将具有复杂架构设计的神经网络转换为用于分割任务的脉冲版本会导致性能下降和无法收敛。为解决这一挑战，我们首先识别出导致脉冲发放严重减少的架构模块，并进行针对性改进，提出了Spike2Former架构。其次，我们提出了一种归一化整数脉冲神经元来解决复杂架构SNNs在训练过程中稳定性的问题。我们在各种语义分割数据集中达到了SNNs的新最佳性能，在ADE20K数据集上实现了+12.7%的mIoU和5.0的效率提升，在VOC2012数据集上实现了+14.3%的mIoU和5.2的效率提升，在CityScapes数据集上实现了+9.1%的mIoU和6.6的效率提升。
