title: SS-GEN: A Social Story Generation Framework with Large Language Models
title_ch: SS-GEN：一种基于大型语言模型的社会故事生成框架
authors: Yi Feng;Mingyang Song;Jiaqi Wang;Zhuang Chen;Guanqun Bi;Minlie Huang;Liping Jing;Jian Yu;
affiliations: Beijing Jiao Tong University;Tencent;Central South University;Tsinghua University;
abstract: Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) often misunderstand social situations and struggle to participate in daily routines. Social Stories are traditionally crafted by psychology experts under strict constraints to address these challenges but are costly and limited in diversity. As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance, there's an opportunity to develop more automated, affordable, and accessible methods to generate Social Stories in real-time with broad coverage. However, adapting LLMs to meet the unique and strict constraints of Social Stories is a challenging issue. To this end, we propose SS-GEN, a Social Story GENeration framework with LLMs. Firstly, we develop a constraint-driven sophisticated strategy named StarSow to hierarchically prompt LLMs to generate Social Stories at scale, followed by rigorous human filtering to build a high-quality dataset. Additionally, we introduce quality assessment criteria to evaluate the effectiveness of these generated stories. Considering that powerful closed-source large models require very complex instructions and expensive API fees, we finally fine-tune smaller language models with our curated high-quality dataset, achieving comparable results at lower costs and with simpler instruction and deployment. This work marks a significant step in leveraging AI to personalize Social Stories cost-effectively for autistic children at scale, which we hope can encourage future research on special groups.
abstract_ch: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）儿童往往难以理解社交情境，并且在参与日常活动时遇到困难。传统的社会故事是由心理学专家在严格限制条件下编写的，以应对这些挑战，但这种方法成本高且缺乏多样性。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的发展，有机会开发出更加自动化、经济实惠且易于访问的方法，在实时生成广泛覆盖的社会故事方面发挥作用。然而，将LLMs适应社会故事的独特且严格的限制是一个具有挑战性的问题。为此，我们提出了SS-GEN，这是一种基于LLMs的社会故事生成框架。首先，我们开发了一种驱动约束的复杂策略，名为StarSow，用于分层次地提示LLMs大规模生成社会故事，随后通过严格的筛选来构建高质量的数据集。此外，我们引入了质量评估标准，以评估这些生成的故事的有效性。鉴于强大的封闭源大型模型需要非常复杂的指令和昂贵的API费用，最后，我们使用我们精心策划的高质量数据集对较小的语言模型进行了微调，实现了成本较低、指令更简单且部署更简便的结果。这项工作标志着利用AI以经济高效的方式为大量自闭症儿童个性化生成社会故事的重要一步，我们希望这能激发未来针对特殊群体的研究。

title: Symbolic Functional Decomposition: A Reconfiguration Approach
title_ch: 符号功能分解：一种重构方法
authors: Mateus de Oliveira Oliveira;Wim Van Den Broeck;
affiliations: Stockholm University;University of Bergen;
abstract:
Functional decomposition is the process of breaking down a function $f$ into a composition $f=g(f_1,\dots,f_k)$ of simpler functions $f_1,\dots,f_k$ belonging to some class $\mathcal{F}$. This fundamental notion can be used to model applications arising in a wide variety of contexts, ranging from machine learning to formal language theory. In this work, we study functional decomposition by leveraging on the notion of functional reconfiguration. In this setting, constraints are imposed not only on the factor functions $f_1,\dots,f_k$ but also on the intermediate functions arising during the composition process.
  We introduce a symbolic framework to address functional reconfiguration and decomposition problems. In our framework, functions arising during the reconfiguration process are represented symbolically, using ordered binary decision diagrams (OBDDs). The function $g$ used to specify the reconfiguration process is represented by a Boolean circuit $C$. Finally, the function class $\mathcal{F}$ is represented by a second-order finite automaton $\mathcal{A}$. Our main result states that functional reconfiguration, and hence functional decomposition, can be solved in fixed-parameter linear time when parameterized by the width of the input OBDD, by structural parameters associated with the reconfiguration circuit $C$, and by the size of the second-order finite automaton $\mathcal{A}$.
abstract_ch:
函数分解是将一个函数$f$分解为一些简单函数$f_1,\dots,f_k$的组合$f=g(f_1,\dots,f_k)$的过程，这些简单函数属于某个函数类$\mathcal{F}$。这一基本概念可以用于建模广泛不同背景中的应用，从机器学习到形式语言理论。在本工作中，我们通过利用函数重构的概念来研究函数分解。在这个设置中，不仅对因子函数$f_1,\dots,f_k$施加约束，还对组合过程中产生的中间函数施加约束。

我们引入了一个符号框架来解决函数重构和分解问题。在我们的框架中，在重构过程中出现的函数用有序二值决策图（OBDDs）符号表示。用于指定重构过程的函数$g$则由布尔电路$C$表示。最后，函数类$\mathcal{F}$由第二个有限自动机$\mathcal{A}$表示。我们的主要结果表明，当参数化为输入OBDD的宽度、与重构电路$C$相关的结构参数以及第二个有限自动机$\mathcal{A}$的大小时，函数重构问题，从而函数分解问题，可以在固定参数线性时间内得到解决。

title: ToMATO: Verbalizing the Mental States of Role-Playing LLMs for Benchmarking Theory of Mind
title_ch: ToMATO：角色扮演大语言模型的心理状态口头化以评估理论思维能力
authors: Kazutoshi Shinoda;Nobukatsu Hojo;Kyosuke Nishida;Saki Mizuno;Keita Suzuki;Ryo Masumura;Hiroaki Sugiyama;Kuniko Saito;
affiliations: NTT Corporation;
abstract: Existing Theory of Mind (ToM) benchmarks diverge from real-world scenarios in three aspects: 1) they assess a limited range of mental states such as beliefs, 2) false beliefs are not comprehensively explored, and 3) the diverse personality traits of characters are overlooked. To address these challenges, we introduce ToMATO, a new ToM benchmark formulated as multiple-choice QA over conversations. ToMATO is generated via LLM-LLM conversations featuring information asymmetry. By employing a prompting method that requires role-playing LLMs to verbalize their thoughts before each utterance, we capture both first- and second-order mental states across five categories: belief, intention, desire, emotion, and knowledge. These verbalized thoughts serve as answers to questions designed to assess the mental states of characters within conversations. Furthermore, the information asymmetry introduced by hiding thoughts from others induces the generation of false beliefs about various mental states. Assigning distinct personality traits to LLMs further diversifies both utterances and thoughts. ToMATO consists of 5.4k questions, 753 conversations, and 15 personality trait patterns. Our analysis shows that this dataset construction approach frequently generates false beliefs due to the information asymmetry between role-playing LLMs, and effectively reflects diverse personalities. We evaluate nine LLMs on ToMATO and find that even GPT-4o mini lags behind human performance, especially in understanding false beliefs, and lacks robustness to various personality traits.
abstract_ch: 现有的理论心智（Theory of Mind, ToM）基准在三个方面与现实世界的情景有所偏离：1）它们评估的主要是信念等有限的心理状态；2）虚假信念并未得到全面探索；3）角色的多样个性特征被忽视。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了ToMATO，这是一种新的ToM基准，以对话的多项选择问答形式呈现。ToMATO通过让语言模型（LLM）之间进行包含信息不对称性的对话来生成。通过要求扮演角色的语言模型在每次发言前表达其想法，我们捕捉到了五个类别中的第一和第二级心理状态：信念、意图、欲望、情绪和知识。这些表达的想法用作问题的答案，这些问题旨在评估对话中角色的心理状态。此外，通过隐藏语言模型的想法，引入了关于各种心理状态的虚假信念。赋予不同的语言模型独特的个性特征进一步增加了对话和想法的多样性。ToMATO包含5400个问题、753场对话和15种个性特征模式。我们的分析显示，由于扮演角色的语言模型之间的信息不对称性，这种数据集构建方法经常生成虚假信念，并能有效反映多种个性。我们在ToMATO上评估了九种语言模型，发现即使是GPT-4o mini的表现也落后于人类，尤其是在理解虚假信念方面，并且对不同个性特征缺乏鲁棒性。

title: Towards Accurate Binary Spiking Neural Networks: Learning with Adaptive Gradient Modulation Mechanism
title_ch: 基于准确性的二进制脉冲神经网络：带有自适应梯度调制机制的学习
authors: Yu Liang;Wenjie Wei;Ammar Belatreche;Honglin Cao;Zijian Zhou;Shuai Wang;Malu Zhang;Yang Yang;
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;Northumbria University;
abstract: Binary Spiking Neural Networks (BSNNs) inherit the eventdriven paradigm of SNNs, while also adopting the reduced storage burden of binarization techniques. These distinct advantages grant BSNNs lightweight and energy-efficient characteristics, rendering them ideal for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. However, due to the binary synaptic weights and non-differentiable spike function, effectively training BSNNs remains an open question. In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the challenge for BSNN learning, namely the frequent weight sign flipping problem. To mitigate this issue, we propose an Adaptive Gradient Modulation Mechanism (AGMM), which is designed to reduce the frequency of weight sign flipping by adaptively adjusting the gradients during the learning process. The proposed AGMM can enable BSNNs to achieve faster convergence speed and higher accuracy, effectively narrowing the gap between BSNNs and their full-precision equivalents. We validate AGMM on both static and neuromorphic datasets, and results indicate that it achieves state-of-the-art results among BSNNs. This work substantially reduces storage demands and enhances SNNs' inherent energy efficiency, making them highly feasible for resource-constrained environments.
abstract_ch: 二进制脉冲神经网络（Binary Spiking Neural Networks, BSNNs）继承了SNNs的事件驱动范式，同时采用了二进制化技术减少存储负担。这些独特的优势赋予了BSNNs轻量级和节能的特点，使其成为在资源受限的边缘设备上部署的理想选择。然而，由于二进制突触权重和非可微分的脉冲函数，有效训练BSNNs仍然是一个开放的问题。在这篇论文中，我们深入分析了BSNN学习面临的挑战，即频繁的权重符号翻转问题。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种自适应梯度调节机制（Adaptive Gradient Modulation Mechanism, AGMM），该机制旨在通过在学习过程中自适应调整梯度来降低权重符号翻转的频率。所提出的AGMM能够使BSNNs实现更快的收敛速度和更高的准确率，有效地缩小了BSNNs与它们的全精度等价物之间的差距。我们在静态和神经形态数据集上验证了AGMM，结果显示它在BSNNs中达到了最先进的性能。这项工作显著减少了存储需求并增强了SNNs固有的节能特性，使其在资源受限的环境中具有很高的可行性。

title: Towards More Discriminative Feature Learning in SNNs with Temporal-Self-Erasing Supervision
title_ch: 基于时间自消融监督以实现SNNs更具辨别力的特征学习
authors: Wei Liu;Li Yang;Mingxuan Zhao;Dengfeng Xue;Shuxun Wang;Boyu Cai;Jin Gao;Wenjuan Li;Bing Li;Weiming Hu;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;ShanghaiTech University;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;

title: Undermining Mental Proof: How AI Can Make Cooperation Harder by Making Thinking Easier
title_ch: 削弱心理证明：AI如何通过使思考变得更容易来使合作变得更难
authors: Zachary Wojtowicz;Simon DeDeo;
affiliations: Harvard University;Carnegie Mellon University;Santa Fe Institute;
abstract: Large language models and other highly capable AI systems ease the burdens of deciding what to say or do, but this very ease can undermine the effectiveness of our actions in social contexts. We explain this apparent tension by introducing the integrative theoretical concept of "mental proof," which occurs when observable actions are used to certify unobservable mental facts. From hiring to dating, mental proofs enable people to credibly communicate values, intentions, states of knowledge, and other private features of their minds to one another in low-trust environments where honesty cannot be easily enforced. Drawing on results from economics, theoretical biology, and computer science, we describe the core theoretical mechanisms that enable people to effect mental proofs. An analysis of these mechanisms clarifies when and how artificial intelligence can make low-trust cooperation harder despite making thinking easier.
abstract_ch: 大型语言模型和其他高度智能的AI系统可以减轻我们在决定说什么或做什么时的负担，但这种便利性可能会削弱我们在社交情境中的行动效果。我们通过引入“心理证明”这一整合性的理论概念来解释这种看似矛盾的现象，即可观察的行为被用来证明不可观察的心理事实。从招聘到恋爱，心理证明使人们能够在低信任环境中有效地相互传达价值观、意图、知识状态以及其他心智中的私人特征，即使在诚实难以强制执行的情况下也是如此。借鉴经济学、理论生物学和计算机科学的研究成果，我们描述了这些核心理论机制如何使人们能够实施心理证明。对这些机制的分析阐明了尽管AI使思考变得更容易，但它在某些情况下反而可能使低信任环境下的合作变得更加困难。

title: Understanding Emotional Body Expressions via Large Language Models
title_ch: 通过大型语言模型理解情绪身体表达
authors: Haifeng Lu;Jiuyi Chen;Feng Liang;Mingkui Tan;Runhao Zeng;Xiping Hu;
affiliations: Shenzhen MSU-BIT University;Lanzhou University;South China University of Technology;Pengcheng Laboratory;Shenzhen University;Beijing Institute of Technology;
abstract: Emotion recognition based on body movements is vital in human-computer interaction. However, existing emotion recognition methods predominantly focus on enhancing classification accuracy, often neglecting the provision of textual explanations to justify their classifications. In this paper, we propose an Emotion-Action Interpreter powered by Large Language Model (EAI-LLM), which not only recognizes emotions but also generates textual explanations by treating 3D body movement data as unique input tokens within large language models (LLMs). Specifically, we propose a multi-granularity skeleton tokenizer designed for LLMs, which separately extracts spatio-temporal tokens and semantic tokens from the skeleton data. This approach allows LLMs to generate more nuanced classification descriptions while maintaining robust classification performance. Furthermore, we treat the skeleton sequence as a specific language and propose a unified skeleton token module. This module leverages the extensive background knowledge and language processing capabilities of LLMs to address the challenges of joint training on heterogeneous datasets, thereby significantly enhancing recognition accuracy on individual datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves recognition accuracy comparable to existing methods. More importantly, with the support of background knowledge from LLMs, our model can generate detailed emotion descriptions based on classification results, even when trained on a limited amount of labeled skeleton data.
abstract_ch: 基于身体动作的情绪识别在人机交互中至关重要。然而，现有的情绪识别方法主要侧重于提高分类准确性，往往忽视了提供文本解释以证明其分类合理性的需求。在本文中，我们提出了一种由大型语言模型（EAI-LLM）驱动的情绪-动作解释器，该解释器不仅能识别情绪，还能通过将3D身体运动数据视为大型语言模型（LLMs）中的独特输入标记来生成文本解释。具体而言，我们设计了一种适用于LLMs的多粒度骨架分词器，该分词器分别从骨架数据中提取时空标记和语义标记。这种方法使LLMs能够在保持稳健分类性能的同时生成更加细腻的分类描述。此外，我们将骨架序列视为特定的语言，并提出了一种统一的骨架标记模块。该模块利用LLMs广泛的知识背景和语言处理能力，解决跨异构数据集联合训练的挑战，从而显著提升个体数据集上的识别准确性。实验结果表明，我们的模型在识别准确性方面与现有方法相当。更重要的是，在有限标注的骨架数据支持下，我们的模型能够根据分类结果生成详细的 emotion 描述。

title: Adaptive Guidance: Training-free Acceleration of Conditional Diffusion Models
title_ch: 自适应指导：无训练条件扩散模型的加速
authors: Angela Castillo;Jonas Kohler;Juan C. Pérez;Juan Pablo Pérez;Albert Pumarola;Bernard Ghanem;Pablo Arbeláez;Ali Thabet;
affiliations: Universidad de los Andes;Meta;King Abdullah University of Science and Technology;
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive study on the role of Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) in text-conditioned diffusion models from the perspective of inference efficiency. In particular, we relax the default choice of applying CFG in all diffusion steps and instead search for efficient guidance policies. We formulate the discovery of such policies in the differentiable Neural Architecture Search framework. Our findings suggest that the denoising steps proposed by CFG become increasingly aligned with simple conditional steps, which renders the extra neural network evaluation of CFG redundant, especially in the second half of the denoising process. Building upon this insight, we propose "Adaptive Guidance" (AG), an efficient variant of CFG, that adaptively omits network evaluations when the denoising process displays convergence. Our experiments demonstrate that AG preserves CFG's image quality while reducing computation by 25%. Thus, AG constitutes a plug-and-play alternative to Guidance Distillation, achieving 50% of the speed-ups of the latter while being training-free and retaining the capacity to handle negative prompts. Finally, we uncover further redundancies of CFG in the first half of the diffusion process, showing that entire neural function evaluations can be replaced by simple affine transformations of past score estimates. This method, termed LinearAG, offers even cheaper inference at the cost of deviating from the baseline model. Our findings provide insights into the efficiency of the conditional denoising process that contribute to more practical and swift deployment of text-conditioned diffusion models.
abstract_ch: 本文从推理效率的角度对文本条件扩散模型中无分类器引导（Classifier-Free Guidance，CFG）的作用进行了全面研究。特别是，我们放宽了在所有扩散步骤中使用CFG的默认选择，而是寻找高效的引导策略。我们将这种策略的发现形式化为可微神经架构搜索框架。我们的研究发现表明，CFG提出的去噪步骤越来越与简单的条件步骤对齐，这使得额外的神经网络评估变得多余，尤其是在去噪过程的后半段。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种“自适应引导”（Adaptive Guidance，AG），这是一种CFG的高效变体，在去噪过程中显示收敛时能够自适应地省略网络评估。我们的实验表明，AG在保持与CFG相同图像质量的同时，计算量减少了25%。因此，AG构成了一种无需训练且可以处理负提示的Guidance Distillation的即插即用替代方案，实现了后者一半的速度提升。最后，我们进一步揭示了CFG在扩散过程前半段中的冗余性，表明整个神经函数评估可以被过去分数估计的简单仿射变换所取代。这种方法称为LinearAG，虽然代价是从基线模型中偏离，但提供了更便宜的推理。我们的发现为条件去噪过程的效率提供了见解，有助于更加实用和迅速地部署文本条件扩散模型。

title: AGFSync: Leveraging AI-Generated Feedback for Preference Optimization in Text-to-Image Generation
title_ch: AGFSync：利用AI生成反馈进行文本到图像生成的偏好优化
authors: Jingkun An;Yinghao Zhu;Zongjian Li;Enshen Zhou;Haoran Feng;Xijie Huang;Bohua Chen;Yemin Shi;Chengwei Pan;
affiliations: Beihang University;Peking University;Tsinghua University;Huazhong University of Science and Technology;Zhongguancun Laboratory;
abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image generation. Despite their progress, challenges remain in both prompt-following ability, image quality and lack of high-quality datasets, which are essential for refining these models. As acquiring labeled data is costly, we introduce AGFSync, a framework that enhances T2I diffusion models through Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) in a fully AI-driven approach. AGFSync utilizes Vision-Language Models (VLM) to assess image quality across style, coherence, and aesthetics, generating feedback data within an AI-driven loop. By applying AGFSync to leading T2I models such as SD v1.4, v1.5, and SDXL-base, our extensive experiments on the TIFA dataset demonstrate notable improvements in VQA scores, aesthetic evaluations, and performance on the HPSv2 benchmark, consistently outperforming the base models. AGFSync's method of refining T2I diffusion models paves the way for scalable alignment techniques. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://anjingkun.github.io/AGFSync.
abstract_ch: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型在图像生成方面取得了显著的成功。尽管这些模型已经取得了进展，但在提示跟随能力、图像质量和缺乏高质量数据集方面仍然存在挑战，而这些数据集对于改进这些模型至关重要。由于获取标记数据的成本较高，我们引入了AGFSync框架，该框架通过完全由AI驱动的方法中的直接偏好优化（DPO）来增强T2I扩散模型。AGFSync利用视觉语言模型（VLM）评估图像在风格、连贯性和美学方面的质量，在一个由AI驱动的循环中生成反馈数据。通过对领先的T2I模型如SD v1.4、v1.5和SDXL-base应用AGFSync，我们在TIFA数据集上的大量实验表明，在VQA评分、美学评估以及HPSv2基准测试上的性能均有所提升，并且持续优于基线模型。AGFSync改进T2I扩散模型的方法为可扩展的对齐技术铺平了道路。我们的代码和数据集已公开发布在https://anjingkun.github.io/AGFSync。

title: AoP-SAM: Automation of Prompts for Efficient Segmentation
title_ch: AoP-SAM：自动化提示以实现高效分割
authors: Yi Chen;Muyoung Son;Chuanbo Hua;Joo-Young Kim;
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;
abstract: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) is a powerful foundation model for image segmentation, showing robust zero-shot generalization through prompt engineering. However, relying on manual prompts is impractical for real-world applications, particularly in scenarios where rapid prompt provision and resource efficiency are crucial. In this paper, we propose the Automation of Prompts for SAM (AoP-SAM), a novel approach that learns to generate essential prompts in optimal locations automatically. AoP-SAM enhances SAM's efficiency and usability by eliminating manual input, making it better suited for real-world tasks. Our approach employs a lightweight yet efficient Prompt Predictor model that detects key entities across images and identifies the optimal regions for placing prompt candidates. This method leverages SAM's image embeddings, preserving its zero-shot generalization capabilities without requiring fine-tuning. Additionally, we introduce a test-time instance-level Adaptive Sampling and Filtering mechanism that generates prompts in a coarse-to-fine manner. This notably enhances both prompt and mask generation efficiency by reducing computational overhead and minimizing redundant mask refinements. Evaluations of three datasets demonstrate that AoP-SAM substantially improves both prompt generation efficiency and mask generation accuracy, making SAM more effective for automated segmentation tasks.
abstract_ch: Segment Anything模型（SAM）是一种强大的图像分割基础模型，通过提示工程展示了稳健的零样本泛化能力。然而，在实际应用中依赖手动提示是不切实际的，特别是在需要快速提供提示和资源高效性的场景中。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为SAM提示自动化（AoP-SAM）的新方法，该方法能够自动学习生成关键提示，并将其放置在最优位置。AoP-SAM通过消除手动输入提升了SAM的效率和易用性，使其更适合于实际任务。我们的方法采用了一个轻量级但高效的提示预测器模型，能够在图像中检测关键实体并识别放置提示候选的最佳区域。这种方法利用了SAM的图像嵌入，保留了其零样本泛化能力，无需进行微调。此外，我们还引入了一种测试时实例级别的自适应采样和过滤机制，以粗到细的方式生成提示。这显著提高了提示和掩码生成的效率，减少了计算开销并最小化了冗余掩码细化。在三个数据集上的评估表明，AoP-SAM大幅提高了提示生成效率和掩码生成准确性，使SAM更加适用于自动化分割任务。

title: Attribution Analysis Meets Model Editing: Advancing Knowledge Correction in Vision Language Models with VisEdit
title_ch: 归因分析与模型编辑：通过VisEdit在视觉语言模型中推进知识修正
authors: Qizhou Chen;Taolin Zhang;Chengyu Wang;Xiaofeng He;Dakan Wang;Tingting Liu;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Alibaba Group;;Exacity Inc.;
abstract: Model editing aims to correct outdated or erroneous knowledge in large models without costly retraining. Recent research discovered that the mid-layer representation of the subject's final token in a prompt has a strong influence on factual predictions, and developed Large Language Model (LLM) editing techniques based on this observation. However, for Vision-LLMs (VLLMs), how visual representations impact the predictions from a decoder-only language model remains largely unexplored. To the best of our knowledge, model editing for VLLMs has not been extensively studied in the literature. In this work, we employ the contribution allocation and noise perturbation methods to measure the contributions of visual representations for token predictions. Our attribution analysis shows that visual representations in mid-to-later layers that are highly relevant to the prompt contribute significantly to predictions. Based on these insights, we propose VisEdit, a novel model editor for VLLMs that effectively corrects knowledge by editing intermediate visual representations in regions important to the edit prompt. We evaluated VisEdit using multiple VLLM backbones and public VLLM editing benchmark datasets. The results show the superiority of VisEdit over the strong baselines adapted from existing state-of-the-art editors for LLMs.
abstract_ch: 模型编辑旨在在无需昂贵重训练的情况下纠正大型模型中的过时或错误的知识。最近的研究发现，提示中主题最后一个标记的中间层表示对事实预测有很强的影响，并基于这一观察开发了大型语言模型（LLM）编辑技术。然而，对于视觉大型语言模型（VLLMs），视觉表示如何影响解码器仅的语言模型的预测结果仍然很大程度上未被探索。据我们所知，文献中关于VLLMs的模型编辑研究并不多见。在这项工作中，我们采用贡献分配和噪声扰动方法来衡量视觉表示对标记预测的贡献。我们的归因分析表明，与提示高度相关的中间到后期层的视觉表示对预测结果有显著影响。基于这些洞察，我们提出了VisEdit，这是一种新颖的VLLMs模型编辑器，通过编辑对编辑提示重要的中间视觉表示来有效纠正知识。我们使用多个VLLM骨干模型和公开的VLLM编辑基准数据集评估了VisEdit。结果显示，VisEdit在性能上优于现有最先进的LLM编辑器的强基线。

title: BEE: Metric-Adapted Explanations via Baseline Exploration-Exploitation
title_ch: 蜜蜂：基于度量自适应的基线探索-利用解释
authors: Oren Barkan;Yehonatan Elisha;Jonathan Weill;Noam Koenigstein;
affiliations: Open University;Tel Aviv University;
abstract: Two prominent challenges in explainability research involve 1) the nuanced evaluation of explanations and 2) the modeling of missing information through baseline representations. The existing literature introduces diverse evaluation metrics, each scrutinizing the quality of explanations through distinct lenses. Additionally, various baseline representations have been proposed, each modeling the notion of missingness differently. Yet, a consensus on the ultimate evaluation metric and baseline representation remains elusive. This work acknowledges the diversity in explanation metrics and baselines, demonstrating that different metrics exhibit preferences for distinct explanation maps resulting from the utilization of different baseline representations and distributions. To address the diversity in metrics and accommodate the variety of baseline representations in a unified manner, we propose Baseline Exploration-Exploitation (BEE) - a path-integration method that introduces randomness to the integration process by modeling the baseline as a learned random tensor. This tensor follows a learned mixture of baseline distributions optimized through a contextual exploration-exploitation procedure to enhance performance on the specific metric of interest. By resampling the baseline from the learned distribution, BEE generates a comprehensive set of explanation maps, facilitating the selection of the best-performing explanation map in this broad set for the given metric. Extensive evaluations across various model architectures showcase the superior performance of BEE in comparison to state-of-the-art explanation methods on a variety of objective evaluation metrics.
abstract_ch: 解释性研究中两个突出的挑战涉及1）解释的细腻评估，以及2）通过基准表示来建模缺失信息。现有文献引入了多种多样的评估指标，每种指标都从不同的角度审视解释的质量。此外，还提出了各种基准表示方法，每种方法以不同的方式建模缺失信息的概念。然而，关于最终的评估指标和基准表示方法仍缺乏共识。本研究承认评估指标和基准表示方法的多样性，并表明不同的指标对使用不同基准表示和分布生成的不同解释图具有偏好。为了应对这些多样化的指标并统一处理各种基准表示方法，我们提出了一种称为“基准探索-利用（BEE）”的方法——这是一种路径积分方法，在积分过程中通过将基准表示为一个学习随机张量来引入随机性。该张量通过上下文探索-利用程序遵循一个优化后的混合基准分布，以增强特定指标的性能。通过从学习分布中重新采样基准表示，BEE能够生成一系列全面的解释图，从而在这一广泛集合中选择最适合给定指标的最佳解释图。在多种模型架构上的广泛评估显示，与最先进的解释方法相比，BEE在多种客观评估指标上表现出更优的性能。

title: Can Generative Models Improve Self-Supervised Representation Learning?
title_ch: 生成模型能否提升自监督表示学习？
authors: Sana Ayromlou;Vahid Reza Khazaie;Fereshteh Forghani;Arash Afkanpour;
affiliations: Vector Institute;York University;
abstract: The rapid advancement in self-supervised representation learning has highlighted its potential to leverage unlabeled data for learning rich visual representations. However, the existing techniques, particularly those employing different augmentations of the same image, often rely on a limited set of simple transformations that cannot fully capture variations in the real world. This constrains the diversity and quality of samples, which leads to sub-optimal representations. In this paper, we introduce a framework that enriches the self-supervised learning (SSL) paradigm by utilizing generative models to produce semantically consistent image augmentations. By directly conditioning generative models on a source image, our method enables the generation of diverse augmentations while maintaining the semantics of the source image, thus offering a richer set of data for SSL. Our extensive experimental results on various joint-embedding SSL techniques demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the quality of learned visual representations by up to 10\% Top-1 accuracy in downstream tasks. This research demonstrates that incorporating generative models into the joint-embedding SSL workflow opens new avenues for exploring the potential of synthetic data. This development paves the way for more robust and versatile representation learning techniques.
abstract_ch: 自监督表示学习的迅速发展突显了其利用未标记数据来学习丰富视觉表示的潜力。然而，现有的技术，尤其是那些使用相同图像的不同增强方法的技术，往往依赖于简单的有限变换集，这些变换无法充分捕捉现实世界中的变化。这限制了样本的多样性和质量，从而导致次优的表示。在本文中，我们介绍了一种框架，通过利用生成模型来产生语义一致的图像增强，以丰富自监督学习（SSL）范式。通过直接将生成模型条件化于源图像，我们的方法能够生成多样化的增强，同时保持源图像的语义，从而为SSL提供更丰富的数据集。我们在各种联合嵌入SSL技术上的广泛实验结果表明，我们的框架显著提高了下游任务中学习到的视觉表示的质量，最高可提升10%的Top-1准确率。这项研究证明，将生成模型纳入联合嵌入SSL工作流程中，可以探索合成数据的潜力，开辟新的途径。这一发展为更稳健和多功能的表示学习技术铺平了道路。

title: Causal-Inspired Multitask Learning for Video-Based Human Pose Estimation
title_ch: 基于因果启发的多任务学习在视频人体姿态估计中的应用
authors: Haipeng Chen;Sifan Wu;Zhigang Wang;Yifang Yin;Yingying Jiao;Yingda Lyu;Zhenguang Liu;
affiliations: Jilin University;Zhejiang Gongshang University;Institute for Infocomm Research;Zhejiang University;Hangzhou High-Tech Zone Institute of Blockchain and Data Security;
abstract: Video-based human pose estimation has long been a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Previous studies focus on spatio-temporal modeling through the enhancement of architecture design and optimization strategies. However, they overlook the causal relationships in the joints, leading to models that may be overly tailored and thus estimate poorly to challenging scenes. Therefore, adequate causal reasoning capability, coupled with good interpretability of model, are both indispensable and prerequisite for achieving reliable results. In this paper, we pioneer a causal perspective on pose estimation and introduce a causal-inspired multitask learning framework, consisting of two stages. \textit{In the first stage}, we try to endow the model with causal spatio-temporal modeling ability by introducing two self-supervision auxiliary tasks. Specifically, these auxiliary tasks enable the network to infer challenging keypoints based on observed keypoint information, thereby imbuing causal reasoning capabilities into the model and making it robust to challenging scenes. \textit{In the second stage}, we argue that not all feature tokens contribute equally to pose estimation. Prioritizing causal (keypoint-relevant) tokens is crucial to achieve reliable results, which could improve the interpretability of the model. To this end, we propose a Token Causal Importance Selection module to identify the causal tokens and non-causal tokens (\textit{e.g.}, background and objects). Additionally, non-causal tokens could provide potentially beneficial cues but may be redundant. We further introduce a non-causal tokens clustering module to merge the similar non-causal tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three large-scale benchmark datasets.
abstract_ch: 基于视频的人体姿态估计一直是计算机视觉领域一个基础但具有挑战性的问题。以往的研究主要集中在通过增强架构设计和优化策略来进行时空建模。然而，这些研究忽视了关节之间的因果关系，导致模型可能过于定制化，从而在复杂场景下的估计效果不佳。因此，具备足够的因果推理能力和良好的模型可解释性都是获得可靠结果不可或缺的前提条件。在本文中，我们提出了从因果角度进行姿态估计的新视角，并引入了一个因果启发式的多任务学习框架，该框架分为两个阶段。**在第一阶段**，我们通过引入两个自监督辅助任务，试图赋予模型因果时空建模的能力。具体来说，这些辅助任务使网络能够根据观察到的关键点信息推断出困难的关键点，从而将因果推理能力注入模型，使其能够更好地应对复杂场景。**在第二阶段**，我们认为并非所有特征标记对姿态估计都同等重要。选择因果（关键点相关）标记对于获得可靠的结果至关重要，这可以提高模型的可解释性。为此，我们提出了一种标记因果重要性选择模块来识别因果标记和非因果标记（例如背景和物体）。此外，非因果标记可能提供有益的线索，但也可能是冗余的。因此，我们进一步引入了一个非因果标记聚类模块，用于合并相似的非因果标记。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在三个大规模基准数据集上优于现有最先进的方法。

title: Comprehensive Multi-Modal Prototypes Are Simple and Effective Classifiers for Vast-Vocabulary Object Detection
title_ch: 综合多模态原型是简单而有效的大量词汇物体检测分类器
authors: Yitong Chen;Wenhao Yao;Lingchen Meng;Sihong Wu;Zuxuan Wu;Yu-Gang Jiang;
affiliations: Fudan University;Shanghai Innovation Institute;
abstract: Enabling models to recognize vast open-world categories has been a longstanding pursuit in object detection. By leveraging the generalization capabilities of vision-language models, current open-world detectors can recognize a broader range of vocabularies, despite being trained on limited categories. However, when the scale of the category vocabularies during training expands to a real-world level, previous classifiers aligned with coarse class names significantly reduce the recognition performance of these detectors. In this paper, we introduce Prova, a multi-modal prototype classifier for vast-vocabulary object detection. Prova extracts comprehensive multi-modal prototypes as initialization of alignment classifiers to tackle the vast-vocabulary object recognition failure problem. On V3Det, this simple method greatly enhances the performance among one-stage, two-stage, and DETR-based detectors with only additional projection layers in both supervised and open-vocabulary settings. In particular, Prova improves Faster R-CNN, FCOS, and DINO by 3.3, 6.2, and 2.9 AP respectively in the supervised setting of V3Det. For the open-vocabulary setting, Prova achieves a new state-of-the-art performance with 32.8 base AP and 11.0 novel AP, which is of 2.6 and 4.3 gain over the previous methods.
abstract_ch: 使模型识别大量的开放世界类别一直是目标检测领域的长期追求。通过利用视觉语言模型的一般化能力，当前的开放世界检测器能够识别更广泛的词汇，尽管它们仅在有限的类别上进行训练。然而，当训练中的类别词汇量扩展到现实世界水平时，之前与粗粒度类名对齐的分类器显著降低了这些检测器的识别性能。在本文中，我们引入了Prova——一种用于大量词汇对象检测的多模态原型分类器。Prova 提取全面的多模态原型作为对齐分类器的初始化，以解决大量词汇对象识别失败的问题。在V3Det数据集上，这种方法仅通过增加投影层，在监督和开放词汇设置下极大地提升了单阶段、两阶段和DETR基检测器的性能。特别是在V3Det的监督设置下，Prova 分别将Faster R-CNN、FCOS 和 DINO 的性能提高了3.3、6.2 和2.9个AP值。对于开放词汇设置，Prova 达到了新的最佳性能，基线AP为32.8，新类别AP为11.0，相较于之前的方法分别提高了2.6和4.3个百分点。

title: Contrasting Adversarial Perturbations: The Space of Harmless Perturbations
title_ch: 对抗性扰动对比：无害扰动的空间
authors: Lu Chen;Shaofeng Li;Benhao Huang;Fan Yang;Zheng Li;Jie Li;Yuan Luo;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Southeast University;
abstract: Existing works have extensively studied adversarial examples, which are minimal perturbations that can mislead the output of deep neural networks (DNNs) while remaining imperceptible to humans. However, in this work, we reveal the existence of a harmless perturbation space, in which perturbations drawn from this space, regardless of their magnitudes, leave the network output unchanged when applied to inputs. Essentially, the harmless perturbation space emerges from the usage of non-injective functions (linear or non-linear layers) within DNNs, enabling multiple distinct inputs to be mapped to the same output. For linear layers with input dimensions exceeding output dimensions, any linear combination of the orthogonal bases of the nullspace of the parameter consistently yields no change in their output. For non-linear layers, the harmless perturbation space may expand, depending on the properties of the layers and input samples. Inspired by this property of DNNs, we solve for a family of general perturbation spaces that are redundant for the DNN's decision, and can be used to hide sensitive data and serve as a means of model identification. Our work highlights the distinctive robustness of DNNs (i.e., consistency under large magnitude perturbations) in contrast to adversarial examples (vulnerability for small imperceptible noises).
abstract_ch: 现有研究广泛探讨了对抗样本，这些对抗样本是能够误导深度神经网络（DNN）输出的最小扰动，同时对人类而言却是不可感知的。然而，在本项工作中，我们揭示了一个无害扰动空间的存在，在这个空间中，无论扰动的大小如何，当将其应用于输入时，都不会改变网络的输出。本质上，无害扰动空间源于DNN内部使用的非注入函数（线性或非线性层），使得多个不同的输入可以映射到相同的输出。对于输入维度超过输出维度的线性层，任何参数零空间的正交基的线性组合都会一致地导致其输出不变。而对于非线性层，无害扰动空间可能会扩展，这取决于层的性质和输入样本。受到DNN这一属性的启发，我们解决了对于DNN决策而言冗余的一系列通用扰动空间，并利用这些扰动空间来隐藏敏感数据以及作为模型识别的手段。我们的工作突显了DNN的独特鲁棒性（即在大尺度扰动下的一致性），与对抗样本相比，对抗样本对小尺度不可感知噪声更为脆弱。

title: CP-DETR: Concept Prompt Guide DETR Toward Stronger Universal Object Detection
title_ch: CP-DETR：概念提示指南 DETR 向更强的通用物体检测迈进
authors: Qibo Chen;Weizhong Jin;Jianyue Ge;Mengdi Liu;Yuchao Yan;Jian Jiang;Li Yu;Xuanjiang Guo;Shuchang Li;Jianzhong Chen;
affiliations: China Mobile Research & Innovation Institute;
abstract: Recent research on universal object detection aims to introduce language in a SoTA closed-set detector and then generalize the open-set concepts by constructing large-scale (text-region) datasets for training. However, these methods face two main challenges: (i) how to efficiently use the prior information in the prompts to genericise objects and (ii) how to reduce alignment bias in the downstream tasks, both leading to sub-optimal performance in some scenarios beyond pre-training. To address these challenges, we propose a strong universal detection foundation model called CP-DETR, which is competitive in almost all scenarios, with only one pre-training weight. Specifically, we design an efficient prompt visual hybrid encoder that enhances the information interaction between prompt and visual through scale-by-scale and multi-scale fusion modules. Then, the hybrid encoder is facilitated to fully utilize the prompted information by prompt multi-label loss and auxiliary detection head. In addition to text prompts, we have designed two practical concept prompt generation methods, visual prompt and optimized prompt, to extract abstract concepts through concrete visual examples and stably reduce alignment bias in downstream tasks. With these effective designs, CP-DETR demonstrates superior universal detection performance in a broad spectrum of scenarios. For example, our Swin-T backbone model achieves 47.6 zero-shot AP on LVIS, and the Swin-L backbone model achieves 32.2 zero-shot AP on ODinW35. Furthermore, our visual prompt generation method achieves 68.4 AP on COCO val by interactive detection, and the optimized prompt achieves 73.1 fully-shot AP on ODinW13.
abstract_ch: 最近关于通用物体检测的研究旨在在最先进的（SoTA）封闭集检测器中引入语言信息，然后通过构建大规模（文本-区域）数据集来训练，以推广开放集的概念。然而，这些方法面临两大主要挑战：(i) 如何有效地利用提示中的先验信息来泛化物体；(ii) 如何在下游任务中减少对齐偏差，这两个问题导致了一些预训练之外场景下的性能不佳。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种称为CP-DETR的强大通用检测基础模型，该模型几乎在所有场景下都具有竞争力，并且仅使用一个预训练权重。具体来说，我们设计了一个高效的提示视觉混合编码器，通过逐尺度和多尺度融合模块增强提示与视觉之间的信息交互。然后，通过提示多标签损失和辅助检测头，混合编码器被促进充分利用提示信息。除了文本提示外，我们还设计了两种实用的概念提示生成方法——视觉提示和优化提示，以通过具体的视觉示例提取抽象概念，并在下游任务中稳定地减少对齐偏差。凭借这些有效的设计，CP-DETR在广泛的情景下展示了卓越的通用检测性能。例如，我们的Swin-T骨干网络模型在LVIS上实现了47.6的零样本AP，而Swin-L骨干网络模型在ODinW35上实现了32.2的零样本AP。此外，我们的视觉提示生成方法通过交互式检测在COCO验证集上达到了68.4的AP，而优化提示在ODinW13上实现了73.1的全样本AP。

title: Cross-View Referring Multi-Object Tracking
title_ch: 跨视图引用多目标跟踪
authors: Sijia Chen;En Yu;Wenbing Tao;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology;
abstract: Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT) is an important topic in the current tracking field. Its task form is to guide the tracker to track objects that match the language description. Current research mainly focuses on referring multi-object tracking under single-view, which refers to a view sequence or multiple unrelated view sequences. However, in the single-view, some appearances of objects are easily invisible, resulting in incorrect matching of objects with the language description. In this work, we propose a new task, called Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking (CRMOT). It introduces the cross-view to obtain the appearances of objects from multiple views, avoiding the problem of the invisible appearances of objects in RMOT task. CRMOT is a more challenging task of accurately tracking the objects that match the language description and maintaining the identity consistency of objects in each cross-view. To advance CRMOT task, we construct a cross-view referring multi-object tracking benchmark based on CAMPUS and DIVOTrack datasets, named CRTrack. Specifically, it provides 13 different scenes and 221 language descriptions. Furthermore, we propose an end-to-end cross-view referring multi-object tracking method, named CRTracker. Extensive experiments on the CRTrack benchmark verify the effectiveness of our method. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/chen-si-jia/CRMOT.
abstract_ch: 跨视图多目标跟踪（Cross-view Referring Multi-Object Tracking，CRMOT）是当前跟踪领域的一个重要研究课题。其任务形式是引导跟踪器追踪与语言描述匹配的对象。目前的研究主要集中在单视图下的跨视图多目标跟踪，即一个视图序列或多个不相关的视图序列。然而，在单视图下，一些对象的外观容易变得不可见，导致对象与语言描述之间的错误匹配。在本工作中，我们提出了一项新的任务，称为跨视图多目标跟踪（CRMOT）。该任务引入了跨视图的概念，以从多个视角获取对象的外观，从而避免了RMOT任务中对象外观不可见的问题。CRMOT是一个更具挑战性的任务，需要准确地追踪与语言描述匹配的对象，并在每个跨视图中保持对象身份的一致性。为了推进CRMOT任务的发展，我们基于CAMPUS和DIVOTrack数据集构建了一个跨视图引用多目标跟踪基准，命名为CRTrack。具体来说，它提供了13种不同的场景和221个语言描述。此外，我们还提出了一种端到端的跨视图引用多目标跟踪方法，名为CRTracker。在CRTrack基准上的广泛实验验证了我们方法的有效性。数据集和代码可在https://github.com/chen-si-jia/CRMOT获得。

title: CustomContrast: A Multilevel Contrastive Perspective for Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Customization
title_ch: 自定义对比度：一种多级对比视角下的主题驱动文本到图像定制方法
authors: Nan Chen;Mengqi Huang;Zhuowei Chen;Yang Zheng;Lei Zhang;Zhendong Mao;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;
abstract: Subject-driven text-to-image (T2I) customization has drawn significant interest in academia and industry. This task enables pre-trained models to generate novel images based on unique subjects. Existing studies adopt a self-reconstructive perspective, focusing on capturing all details of a single image, which will misconstrue the specific image's irrelevant attributes (e.g., view, pose, and background) as the subject intrinsic attributes. This misconstruction leads to both overfitting or underfitting of irrelevant and intrinsic attributes of the subject, i.e., these attributes are over-represented or under-represented simultaneously, causing a trade-off between similarity and controllability. In this study, we argue an ideal subject representation can be achieved by a cross-differential perspective, i.e., decoupling subject intrinsic attributes from irrelevant attributes via contrastive learning, which allows the model to focus more on intrinsic attributes through intra-consistency (features of the same subject are spatially closer) and inter-distinctiveness (features of different subjects have distinguished differences). Specifically, we propose CustomContrast, a novel framework, which includes a Multilevel Contrastive Learning (MCL) paradigm and a Multimodal Feature Injection (MFI) Encoder. The MCL paradigm is used to extract intrinsic features of subjects from high-level semantics to low-level appearance through crossmodal semantic contrastive learning and multiscale appearance contrastive learning. To facilitate contrastive learning, we introduce the MFI encoder to capture cross-modal representations. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of CustomContrast in subject similarity and text controllability.
abstract_ch: 主题驱动的文字到图像（T2I）定制引起了学术界和工业界的广泛关注。这项任务使预训练模型能够基于独特的主题生成新颖的图像。现有研究采取自重构视角，专注于捕捉单张图像的所有细节，但这种做法可能会错误地将特定图像的相关属性（如视角、姿态和背景）视为主题固有的属性。这种误解会导致对主题无关属性和固有属性的过度拟合或欠拟合，即这些属性会同时被过度代表或欠代表，从而在相似性和可控性之间产生权衡。在本研究中，我们认为通过对比学习的跨差分视角可以实现理想的主题表示，即通过对比学习解耦主题固有属性与无关属性。这种方法允许模型通过内部一致性（相同主题的特征在空间上更接近）和跨差异性（不同主题的特征具有显著差异）更多地关注固有属性。具体而言，我们提出了CustomContrast这一新型框架，该框架包括多级对比学习（MCL）范式和多模态特征注入（MFI）编码器。MCL范式用于通过跨模态语义对比学习和多尺度外观对比学习从高层语义到低层外观提取主题的固有特征。为了促进对比学习，我们引入了MFI编码器来捕获跨模态表示。广泛实验表明，CustomContrast在主题相似性和文本可控性方面具有有效性。

title: CustomTTT: Motion and Appearance Customized Video Generation via Test-Time Training
title_ch: 自适应TTT：通过测试时训练实现的运动和外观定制视频生成
authors: Xiuli Bi;Jian Lu;Bo Liu;Xiaodong Cun;Yong Zhang;Weisheng Li;Bin Xiao;
affiliations: Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications;Great Bay University;Meituan;Jinan Inspur Data Technology Co., Ltd.;
abstract: Benefiting from large-scale pre-training of text-video pairs, current text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate high-quality videos from the text description. Besides, given some reference images or videos, the parameter-efficient fine-tuning method, i.e. LoRA, can generate high-quality customized concepts, e.g., the specific subject or the motions from a reference video. However, combining the trained multiple concepts from different references into a single network shows obvious artifacts. To this end, we propose CustomTTT, where we can joint custom the appearance and the motion of the given video easily. In detail, we first analyze the prompt influence in the current video diffusion model and find the LoRAs are only needed for the specific layers for appearance and motion customization. Besides, since each LoRA is trained individually, we propose a novel test-time training technique to update parameters after combination utilizing the trained customized models. We conduct detailed experiments to verify the effectiveness of the proposed methods. Our method outperforms several state-of-the-art works in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.
abstract_ch: 得益于大规模文本-视频对预训练的优势，当前的文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型可以从文本描述生成高质量的视频。此外，通过一些参考图像或视频，参数效率较高的微调方法LoRA可以生成高质量的定制化概念，例如特定主题或参考视频中的动作。然而，将不同参考来源训练得到的多个概念结合到单一网络中会明显出现伪影。为此，我们提出了CustomTTT，该方法能够方便地联合定制给定视频的外观和动作。具体而言，我们首先分析了当前视频扩散模型中的提示影响，并发现仅需在特定层使用LoRA进行外观和动作定制。由于每个LoRA都是独立训练的，我们提出了一种新颖的测试时训练技术，在结合后利用训练好的定制模型更新参数。我们进行了详细的实验来验证所提方法的有效性。在定性和定量评估中，我们的方法都优于几种最先进的工作。

title: Deep Graph Online Hashing for Multi-Label Image Retrieval

title: DGFamba: Learning Flow Factorized State Space for Visual Domain Generalization
title_ch: DGFamba: 学习流因子化的状态空间视觉领域泛化
authors: Qi Bi;Jingjun Yi;Hao Zheng;Haolan Zhan;Wei Ji;Yawen Huang;Yuexiang Li;
affiliations: Tencent;Monash University;Yale University;University of Macau;
abstract: Domain generalization aims to learn a representation from the source domain, which can be generalized to arbitrary unseen target domains. A fundamental challenge for visual domain generalization is the domain gap caused by the dramatic style variation whereas the image content is stable. The realm of selective state space, exemplified by VMamba, demonstrates its global receptive field in representing the content. However, the way exploiting the domain-invariant property for selective state space is rarely explored. In this paper, we propose a novel Flow Factorized State Space model, dubbed as DG-Famba, for visual domain generalization. To maintain domain consistency, we innovatively map the style-augmented and the original state embeddings by flow factorization. In this latent flow space, each state embedding from a certain style is specified by a latent probability path. By aligning these probability paths in the latent space, the state embeddings are able to represent the same content distribution regardless of the style differences. Extensive experiments conducted on various visual domain generalization settings show its state-of-the-art performance.
abstract_ch: 通用域学习旨在从源域中学习一个表示，该表示能够推广到任意未见过的目标域。视觉域推广中的一个基本挑战是由显著的风格变化导致的域差距，而图像内容则相对稳定。选择性状态空间的领域，以VMamba为例，展示了其在表示内容方面的全局感受野。然而，如何利用选择性状态空间的域不变特性进行探索很少被研究。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的Flow Factorized State Space模型，将其命名为DG-Famba，用于视觉域推广。为了保持域一致性，我们通过流因子化创新地映射了风格增强和原始的状态嵌入。在这种潜在流空间中，每种风格下的每个状态嵌入由一条潜在概率路径指定。通过在潜在空间对这些概率路径进行对齐，状态嵌入能够在忽略风格差异的情况下表示相同的内容分布。在各种视觉域推广设置下进行的广泛实验显示了其卓越的性能。

title: DiffDVC: Accurate Event Detection for Dense Video Captioning via Diffusion Models
title_ch: DiffDVC：通过扩散模型实现密集视频字幕的精确事件检测
authors: Wei Chen;Jianwei Niu;Xuefeng Liu;Zhendong Wang;Shaojie Tang;Guogang Zhu;
affiliations: Beihang University;Zhongguancun Laboratory;Zhengzhou University;University at Buffalo;

title: Diffusion Models for Attribution
title_ch: 扩散模型归因
authors: Xiongren Chen;Jiuyong Li;Jixue Liu;Lin Liu;Stefan Peters;Thuc Duy Le;Wentao Gao;Xiaojing Du;Anthony Walsh;
affiliations: University of South Australia;Green Triangle Forest Industries Hub;
abstract: Generative techniques for image anonymization have great potential to generate datasets that protect the privacy of those depicted in the images, while achieving high data fidelity and utility. Existing methods have focused extensively on preserving facial attributes, but failed to embrace a more comprehensive perspective that considers the scene and background into the anonymization process. This paper presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first approach to image anonymization based on Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). Every element of a scene is maintained to convey the same meaning, yet manipulated in a way that makes re-identification difficult. We propose two LDMs for this purpose: CAMOUFLaGE-Base exploits a combination of pre-trained ControlNets, and a new controlling mechanism designed to increase the distance between the real and anonymized images. CAMOFULaGE-Light is based on the Adapter technique, coupled with an encoding designed to efficiently represent the attributes of different persons in a scene. The former solution achieves superior performance on most metrics and benchmarks, while the latter cuts the inference time in half at the cost of fine-tuning a lightweight module. We show through extensive experimental comparison that the proposed method is competitive with the state-of-the-art concerning identity obfuscation whilst better preserving the original content of the image and tackling unresolved challenges that current solutions fail to address.
abstract_ch: 基于潜在扩散模型（LDMs）的图像匿名化生成技术具有很大的潜力，可以生成既保护图像中人物隐私又能保持高数据保真度和实用性的数据集。现有方法主要集中在保留面部特征上，但未能从更全面的角度考虑将场景和背景纳入匿名化过程。本文，据我们所知，首次提出了基于潜在扩散模型的图像匿名化方法。每个场景中的元素都保持其原有的意义，但在处理方式上使其重新识别变得困难。我们为此目的提出了两种LDMs：CAMOUFLaGE-Base利用预训练的ControlNets以及一种新的控制机制，以增加真实图像与匿名化图像之间的距离。CAMOFULaGE-Light则基于Adapter技术，并结合了一种高效编码方式，用于在场景中表示不同人物的属性。前者在大多数指标和基准测试中实现了更好的性能，而后者则通过微调一个轻量级模块将推理时间减半。通过广泛的实验比较，我们展示了所提出的方法在身份模糊方面与最先进的方法具有竞争力，同时更好地保留了原始图像的内容，并解决了当前解决方案未能解决的一些未决挑战。

title: Divide-and-Conquer: Tree-structured Strategy with Answer Distribution Estimator for Goal-Oriented Visual Dialogue
title_ch: 分而治之：具有答案分布估计器的树结构策略目标导向视觉对话
authors: Shuo Cai;Xinzhe Han;Shuhui Wang;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;China Academy of Aerospace Science and Innovation;Pengcheng Laboratory;
abstract: Goal-oriented visual dialogue involves multi-round interaction between artificial agents, which has been of remarkable attention due to its wide applications. Given a visual scene, this task occurs when a Questioner asks an action-oriented question and an Answerer responds with the intent of letting the Questioner know the correct action to take. The quality of questions affects the accuracy and efficiency of the target search progress. However, existing methods lack a clear strategy to guide the generation of questions, resulting in the randomness in the search process and inconvergent results. We propose a Tree-Structured Strategy with Answer Distribution Estimator (TSADE) which guides the question generation by excluding half of the current candidate objects in each round. The above process is implemented by maximizing a binary reward inspired by the ``divide-and-conquer'' paradigm. We further design a candidate-minimization reward which encourages the model to narrow down the scope of candidate objects toward the end of the dialogue. We experimentally demonstrate that our method can enable the agents to achieve high task-oriented accuracy with fewer repeating questions and rounds compared to traditional ergodic question generation approaches. Qualitative results further show that TSADE facilitates agents to generate higher-quality questions.
abstract_ch: 目标导向的视觉对话涉及人工代理之间的多轮交互，由于其广泛的应用前景，这一领域引起了显著的关注。在给定一个视觉场景的情况下，该任务发生在提问者提出行动导向的问题后，回答者通过回应来告知提问者应采取的正确行动。问题的质量影响了目标搜索过程的准确性和效率。然而，现有的方法缺乏明确的策略来指导问题生成，导致搜索过程中的随机性以及结果不一致。我们提出了一个带有答案分布估计器的树状结构策略（TSADE），该策略在每一轮中排除当前候选对象的一半，以指导问题生成。上述过程通过最大化受“分而治之”理念启发的二元奖励来实现。我们还设计了一个候选对象最小化奖励，鼓励模型在对话结束时将候选对象的范围进一步缩小。实验结果显示，我们的方法能使代理在比传统遍历式问题生成方法更少的重复问题和轮次中实现更高的任务导向准确性。进一步的定性结果表明，TSADE 有助于代理生成更高质量的问题。

title: Dr. Tongue: Sign-Oriented Multi-label Detection for Remote Tongue Diagnosis
title_ch: Tongue医生：基于符号导向的多标签检测与远程舌诊技术
authors: Yiliang Chen;Steven SC Ho;Cheng Xu;Yao Jie Xie;Wing-Fai Yeung;Shengfeng He;Jing Qin;
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University;Singapore Management University;
abstract: Tongue diagnosis is a vital tool in Western and Traditional Chinese Medicine, providing key insights into a patient's health by analyzing tongue attributes. The COVID-19 pandemic has heightened the need for accurate remote medical assessments, emphasizing the importance of precise tongue attribute recognition via telehealth. To address this, we propose a Sign-Oriented multi-label Attributes Detection framework. Our approach begins with an adaptive tongue feature extraction module that standardizes tongue images and mitigates environmental factors. This is followed by a Sign-oriented Network (SignNet) that identifies specific tongue attributes, emulating the diagnostic process of experienced practitioners and enabling comprehensive health evaluations. To validate our methodology, we developed an extensive tongue image dataset specifically designed for telemedicine. Unlike existing datasets, ours is tailored for remote diagnosis, with a comprehensive set of attribute labels. This dataset will be openly available, providing a valuable resource for research. Initial tests have shown improved accuracy in detecting various tongue attributes, highlighting our framework's potential as an essential tool for remote medical assessments.
abstract_ch: 舌诊是西方医学和传统中医的重要工具，通过分析舌的特征来提供患者健康的关键见解。COVID-19大流行进一步突出了准确远程医疗评估的需求，强调了通过远程医疗精确识别舌特征的重要性。为应对这一需求，我们提出了一种以符号为导向的多标签特征检测框架。我们的方法始于一个自适应舌特征提取模块，该模块标准化舌图像并减轻环境因素的影响。随后是一个以符号为导向的网络（SignNet），用于识别特定的舌特征，模拟有经验的临床医生的诊断过程，并实现全面的健康评估。为了验证我们的方法论，我们开发了一个广泛的眼舌图像数据集，专门设计用于远程医疗。与现有的数据集不同，我们的数据集针对远程诊断进行了定制，包含一系列全面的属性标签。该数据集将公开提供，成为研究的重要资源。初步测试显示，该框架在检测多种舌特征方面提高了准确性，突显了其作为远程医疗评估关键工具的潜力。

title: Dual Manifold Regularization Steered Robust Representation Learning for Point Cloud Analysis
title_ch: 面向点云分析的双重流形正则化导向稳健表示学习

title: Dual-Level Precision Edges Guided Multi-View Stereo with Accurate Planarization
title_ch: 双层精度边缘引导多视图立体成像与精确平面化
authors: Kehua Chen;Zhenlong Yuan;Tianlu Mao;Zhaoqi Wang;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: The reconstruction of low-textured areas is a prominent research focus in multi-view stereo (MVS). In recent years, traditional MVS methods have performed exceptionally well in reconstructing low-textured areas by constructing plane models. However, these methods often encounter issues such as crossing object boundaries and limited perception ranges, which undermine the robustness of plane model construction. Building on previous work (APD-MVS), we propose the DPE-MVS method. By introducing dual-level precision edge information, including fine and coarse edges, we enhance the robustness of plane model construction, thereby improving reconstruction accuracy in low-textured areas. Furthermore, by leveraging edge information, we refine the sampling strategy in conventional PatchMatch MVS and propose an adaptive patch size adjustment approach to optimize matching cost calculation in both stochastic and low-textured areas. This additional use of edge information allows for more precise and robust matching. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ETH3D and Tanks & Temples benchmarks. Notably, our method outperforms all published methods on the ETH3D benchmark.
abstract_ch: 低纹理区域的重建是多视图立体视觉（MVS）研究中的一个突出重点。近年来，传统的MVS方法通过构建平面模型在重建低纹理区域方面表现卓越。然而，这些方法常常遇到跨越对象边界和感知范围有限的问题，这削弱了平面模型构建的稳健性。基于先前的工作（APD-MVS），我们提出了DPE-MVS方法。通过引入双精度级别的边缘信息，包括精细边缘和粗略边缘，我们增强了平面模型构建的稳健性，从而提高了低纹理区域的重建准确性。此外，利用边缘信息改进了传统PatchMatch MVS的采样策略，并提出了一种自适应的补丁大小调整方法，以优化在随机性和低纹理区域中的匹配成本计算。这种方法额外使用边缘信息，使得匹配更加精确和稳健。我们的方法在ETH3D和Tanks & Temples基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，我们的方法在ETH3D基准测试中优于所有已发表的方法。

title: Dynamic Adapter with Semantics Disentangling for Cross-lingual Cross-modal Retrieval
title_ch: 动态语义解耦适配器在跨语言跨模态检索中的应用
authors: Rui Cai;Zhiyu Dong;Jianfeng Dong;Xun Wang;
affiliations: Zhejiang Gongshang University;Zhejiang Key Laboratory of Big Data and Future E-Commerce Technology;
abstract: Existing cross-modal retrieval methods typically rely on large-scale vision-language pair data. This makes it challenging to efficiently develop a cross-modal retrieval model for under-resourced languages of interest. Therefore, Cross-lingual Cross-modal Retrieval (CCR), which aims to align vision and the low-resource language (the target language) without using any human-labeled target-language data, has gained increasing attention. As a general parameter-efficient way, a common solution is to utilize adapter modules to transfer the vision-language alignment ability of Vision-Language Pretraining (VLP) models from a source language to a target language. However, these adapters are usually static once learned, making it difficult to adapt to target-language captions with varied expressions. To alleviate it, we propose Dynamic Adapter with Semantics Disentangling (DASD), whose parameters are dynamically generated conditioned on the characteristics of the input captions. Considering that the semantics and expression styles of the input caption largely influence how to encode it, we propose a semantic disentangling module to extract the semantic-related and semantic-agnostic features from the input, ensuring that generated adapters are well-suited to the characteristics of input caption. Extensive experiments on two image-text datasets and one video-text dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our model for cross-lingual cross-modal retrieval, as well as its good compatibility with various VLP models.
abstract_ch: 现有的跨模态检索方法通常依赖于大规模的视觉-语言配对数据。这使得为感兴趣的小资源语言开发高效的跨模态检索模型变得具有挑战性。因此，跨语言跨模态检索（CCR），旨在无需使用任何人工标注的目标语言数据的情况下，对齐视觉和低资源语言（目标语言）的能力，逐渐受到了越来越多的关注。作为一种通用的参数高效方法，一个常见的解决方案是利用适配器模块将视觉-语言预训练（VLP）模型在源语言上的跨模态对齐能力转移到目标语言上。然而，这些适配器一旦学习完成通常是静态的，难以适应表达方式多变的目标语言描述。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种动态适配器与语义分离（DASD），其参数根据输入描述的特点动态生成。鉴于输入描述的语义和表达风格对其编码方式有重大影响，我们提出了一个语义分离模块来从输入中提取与语义相关和与语义无关的特征，确保生成的适配器能够很好地适应输入描述的特点。在两个图像-文本数据集和一个视频-文本数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的模型对于跨语言跨模态检索的有效性，并且它与各种VLP模型具有良好兼容性。

title: EMPLACE: Self-Supervised Urban Scene Change Detection
title_ch: EMPLACE：自监督城市场景变化检测
authors: Tim Alpherts;Sennay Ghebreab;Nanne van Noord;
affiliations: University of Amsterdam;
abstract: Urban change is a constant process that influences the perception of neighbourhoods and the lives of the people within them. The field of Urban Scene Change Detection (USCD) aims to capture changes in street scenes using computer vision and can help raise awareness of changes that make it possible to better understand the city and its residents. Traditionally, the field of USCD has used supervised methods with small scale datasets. This constrains methods when applied to new cities, as it requires labour-intensive labeling processes and forces a priori definitions of relevant change. In this paper we introduce AC-1M the largest USCD dataset by far of over 1.1M images, together with EMPLACE, a self-supervising method to train a Vision Transformer using our adaptive triplet loss. We show EMPLACE outperforms SOTA methods both as a pre-training method for linear fine-tuning as well as a zero-shot setting. Lastly, in a case study of Amsterdam, we show that we are able to detect both small and large changes throughout the city and that changes uncovered by EMPLACE, depending on size, correlate with housing prices - which in turn is indicative of inequity.
abstract_ch: 城市变化是一个持续的过程，它影响人们对社区的认知以及居住在其中的人们的生活。城市场景变化检测（USCD）领域旨在使用计算机视觉捕捉街道场景的变化，从而提高对城市及其居民变化的认识，帮助更好地理解城市。传统上，USCD领域使用监督方法和小型数据集。这种方法在应用于新城市时受到限制，因为它需要劳动密集型的标注过程，并且强制事先定义相关的变化。在这篇论文中，我们介绍了迄今为止最大的USCD数据集AC-1M，包含超过110万张图片，同时引入了EMPLACE，这是一种自我监督的方法，用于训练Vision Transformer，借助我们自适应三元组损失。我们展示了EMPLACE在预训练方法和零样本设置下均优于当前最佳方法。最后，在阿姆斯特丹案例研究中，我们证明了能够检测整个城市中的小规模和大规模变化，并且EMPLACE发现的变化（根据规模不同）与住房价格相关——这反过来表明了不平等的存在。

title: Enhancing Adversarial Transferability with Adversarial Weight Tuning
title_ch: 通过对抗权重调整增强对抗样本的转移性
authors: Jiahao Chen;Zhou Feng;Rui Zeng;Yuwen Pu;Chunyi Zhou;Yi Jiang;Yuyou Gan;Jinbao Li;Shouling Ji;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Shandong Artificial Intelligence Institute;Qilu University of Technology;
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are vulnerable to adversarial examples (AEs) that mislead the model while appearing benign to human observers. A critical concern is the transferability of AEs, which enables black-box attacks without direct access to the target model. However, many previous attacks have failed to explain the intrinsic mechanism of adversarial transferability. In this paper, we rethink the property of transferable AEs and reformulate the formulation of transferability. Building on insights from this mechanism, we analyze the generalization of AEs across models with different architectures and prove that we can find a local perturbation to mitigate the gap between surrogate and target models. We further establish the inner connections between model smoothness and flat local maxima, both of which contribute to the transferability of AEs. Further, we propose a new adversarial attack algorithm, \textbf{A}dversarial \textbf{W}eight \textbf{T}uning (AWT), which adaptively adjusts the parameters of the surrogate model using generated AEs to optimize the flat local maxima and model smoothness simultaneously, without the need for extra data. AWT is a data-free tuning method that combines gradient-based and model-based attack methods to enhance the transferability of AEs. Extensive experiments on a variety of models with different architectures on ImageNet demonstrate that AWT yields superior performance over other attacks, with an average increase of nearly 5\% and 10\% attack success rates on CNN-based and Transformer-based models, respectively, compared to state-of-the-art attacks. Code available at https://github.com/xaddwell/AWT.
abstract_ch: 深度神经网络（DNNs）容易受到欺骗性样本（AEs）的影响，这些样本在表面上对人类观察者无害，但可以误导模型。一个关键问题是欺骗性样本的可转移性，这使得攻击者可以在不直接访问目标模型的情况下进行黑盒攻击。然而，许多之前的攻击未能解释欺骗性样本可转移性的内在机制。在本文中，我们重新思考可转移性欺骗性样本的性质，并重新制定了可转移性的公式。基于这一机制的见解，我们分析了不同架构模型之间欺骗性样本的一般化情况，并证明可以通过找到局部扰动来缩小代理模型和目标模型之间的差距。此外，我们建立了模型平滑度与平坦局部最大值之间的内在联系，这两种因素都促进了欺骗性样本的可转移性。进一步地，我们提出了一种新的对抗攻击算法——\textbf{A}dversarial \textbf{W}eight \textbf{T}uning（AWT），该算法利用生成的欺骗性样本自适应调整代理模型的参数，同时优化平坦局部最大值和平滑度，无需额外数据。AWT 是一种无数据调整方法，将基于梯度的攻击方法与基于模型的攻击方法结合，以增强欺骗性样本的可转移性。在ImageNet上具有不同架构的各种模型上的广泛实验表明，与最先进的攻击方法相比，AWT 在基于CNN的模型中的攻击成功率平均提高了近5%，在基于Transformer的模型中的攻击成功率平均提高了10%。相关代码可在 https://github.com/xaddwell/AWT 获取。

title: Enhancing Generalized Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation via Effective Knowledge Transfer
title_ch: 通过有效的知识转移增强泛化少样本语义分割
authors: Xinyue Chen;Miaojing Shi;Zijian Zhou;Lianghua He;Sophia Tsoka;
affiliations: King’s College London;Tongji University;
abstract: Generalized few-shot semantic segmentation (GFSS) aims to segment objects of both base and novel classes, using sufficient samples of base classes and few samples of novel classes. Representative GFSS approaches typically employ a two-phase training scheme, involving base class pre-training followed by novel class fine-tuning, to learn the classifiers for base and novel classes respectively. Nevertheless, distribution gap exists between base and novel classes in this process. To narrow this gap, we exploit effective knowledge transfer from base to novel classes. First, a novel prototype modulation module is designed to modulate novel class prototypes by exploiting the correlations between base and novel classes. Second, a novel classifier calibration module is proposed to calibrate the weight distribution of the novel classifier according to that of the base classifier. Furthermore, existing GFSS approaches suffer from a lack of contextual information for novel classes due to their limited samples, we thereby introduce a context consistency learning scheme to transfer the contextual knowledge from base to novel classes. Extensive experiments on PASCAL-5$^i$ and COCO-20$^i$ demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances the state of the art in the GFSS setting. The code is available at: https://github.com/HHHHedy/GFSS-EKT.
abstract_ch: 泛化的少量样本语义分割（GFSS）旨在使用足够的基类样本和少量的新类样本对基类和新类进行对象分割。代表性的GFSS方法通常采用两阶段训练方案，首先对基类进行预训练，然后对新类进行微调，以分别学习基类和新类的分类器。然而，在这个过程中，基类和新类之间存在分布差距。为了缩小这一差距，我们利用从基类有效转移的知识来影响新类。首先，设计了一个新的原型调节模块，通过利用基类和新类之间的相关性来调节新类原型。其次，提出了一种新的分类器校准模块，根据基分类器的权重分布来校准新分类器的权重分布。此外，由于现有GFSS方法因样本有限而缺乏新类的上下文信息，我们引入了一种上下文一致性学习方案，将基类的上下文知识转移到新类。在PASCAL-5$^i$和COCO-20$^i$上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在GFSS设置中显著提升了现有技术水平。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HHHHedy/GFSS-EKT。

title: FAMNet: Frequency-aware Matching Network for Cross-domain Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
title_ch: FAMNet：频率感知匹配网络在跨域少样本医疗图像分割中的应用
authors: Yuntian Bo;Yazhou Zhu;Lunbo Li;Haofeng Zhang;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology;
abstract: Existing few-shot medical image segmentation (FSMIS) models fail to address a practical issue in medical imaging: the domain shift caused by different imaging techniques, which limits the applicability to current FSMIS tasks. To overcome this limitation, we focus on the cross-domain few-shot medical image segmentation (CD-FSMIS) task, aiming to develop a generalized model capable of adapting to a broader range of medical image segmentation scenarios with limited labeled data from the novel target domain. Inspired by the characteristics of frequency domain similarity across different domains, we propose a Frequency-aware Matching Network (FAMNet), which includes two key components: a Frequency-aware Matching (FAM) module and a Multi-Spectral Fusion (MSF) module. The FAM module tackles two problems during the meta-learning phase: 1) intra-domain variance caused by the inherent support-query bias, due to the different appearances of organs and lesions, and 2) inter-domain variance caused by different medical imaging techniques. Additionally, we design an MSF module to integrate the different frequency features decoupled by the FAM module, and further mitigate the impact of inter-domain variance on the model's segmentation performance. Combining these two modules, our FAMNet surpasses existing FSMIS models and Cross-domain Few-shot Semantic Segmentation models on three cross-domain datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance in the CD-FSMIS task.
abstract_ch: 现有的少样本医疗图像分割（FSMIS）模型未能解决医疗成像中的一个实际问题：不同成像技术引起的领域转移，这限制了这些模型在当前FSMIS任务中的应用。为了克服这一局限性，我们专注于跨领域少样本医疗图像分割（CD-FSMIS）任务，旨在开发一种通用模型，能够在新型目标领域有限标注数据的情况下适应更广泛的医疗图像分割场景。受到不同领域间频率域相似性的启发，我们提出了一种频率感知匹配网络（FAMNet），该网络包含两个关键组件：频率感知匹配（FAM）模块和多光谱融合（MSF）模块。FAM模块在元学习阶段解决了两个问题：1）由于器官和病灶的不同外观导致的内在支持-查询偏差引起的数据域内变异性；2）由于不同的医疗成像技术导致的数据域间变异性。此外，我们设计了一个MSF模块来整合由FAM模块分离出的不同频率特征，并进一步减轻数据域间变异性对模型分割性能的影响。结合这两个模块，我们的FAMNet在三个跨领域数据集上超越了现有的FSMIS模型和跨领域少样本语义分割模型，在CD-FSMIS任务中实现了最先进的性能。

title: FIRM: Flexible Interactive Reflection ReMoval
title_ch: FIRM：灵活交互式反射去除
authors: Xiao Chen;Xudong Jiang;Yunkang Tao;Zhen Lei;Qing Li;Chenyang Lei;Zhaoxiang Zhang;
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University;ETH Zurich;Hong Kong Institute of Science and Technology;Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: Removing reflection from a single image is challenging due to the absence of general reflection priors. Although existing methods incorporate extensive user guidance for satisfactory performance, they often lack the flexibility to adapt user guidance in different modalities, and dense user interactions further limit their practicality. To alleviate these problems, this paper presents FIRM, a novel framework for Flexible Interactive image Reflection reMoval with various forms of guidance, where users can provide sparse visual guidance (e.g., points, boxes, or strokes) or text descriptions for better reflection removal. Firstly, we design a novel user guidance conversion module (UGC) to transform different forms of guidance into unified contrastive masks. The contrastive masks provide explicit cues for identifying reflection and transmission layers in blended images. Secondly, we devise a contrastive mask-guided reflection removal network that comprises a newly proposed contrastive guidance interaction block (CGIB). This block leverages a unique cross-attention mechanism that merges contrastive masks with image features, allowing for precise layer separation. The proposed framework requires only 10\% of the guidance time needed by previous interactive methods, which makes a step-change in flexibility. Extensive results on public real-world reflection removal datasets validate that our method demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/ShawnChenn/FlexibleReflectionRemoval.
abstract_ch: 从单张图像中去除反射是具有挑战性的，因为缺乏通用的反射先验知识。尽管现有的方法通过大量的用户指导可以实现满意的性能，但它们往往缺乏根据不同模态适应用户指导的灵活性，并且密集的用户交互进一步限制了其实用性。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了FIRM（Flexible Interactive Reflection Removal with Mask），一种灵活的交互式图像反射去除框架，能够接受多种形式的指导（如点、框或笔触）或文本描述，以更好地去除反射。首先，我们设计了一个新颖的用户指导转换模块（UGC），将不同形式的指导转化为统一的对比掩码。这些对比掩码提供了明确的线索，用于识别混合图像中的反射层和透射层。其次，我们设计了一个由新提出的对比指导交互块（CGIB）组成的对比掩码引导的反射去除网络。该块利用了一种独特的跨注意力机制，将对比掩码与图像特征结合起来，从而实现精确的分层分离。所提出的方法仅需要之前交互方法所需指导时间的10%，这在灵活性方面迈出了重要的一步。在公共现实世界反射去除数据集上的广泛实验结果验证了我们的方法展示了最先进的反射去除性能。代码可在https://github.com/ShawnChenn/FlexibleReflectionRemoval获取。

title: FreeMask: Rethinking the Importance of Attention Masks for Zero-Shot Video Editing
title_ch: FreeMask：重新思考零样本视频编辑中注意力掩码的重要性
authors: Lingling Cai;Kang Zhao;Hangjie Yuan;Yingya Zhang;Shiwei Zhang;Kejie Huang;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Tongyi Lab;
abstract: Text-to-video diffusion models have made remarkable advancements. Driven by their ability to generate temporally coherent videos, research on zero-shot video editing using these fundamental models has expanded rapidly. To enhance editing quality, structural controls are frequently employed in video editing. Among these techniques, cross-attention mask control stands out for its effectiveness and efficiency. However, when cross-attention masks are naively applied to video editing, they can introduce artifacts such as blurring and flickering. Our experiments uncover a critical factor overlooked in previous video editing research: cross-attention masks are not consistently clear but vary with model structure and denoising timestep. To address this issue, we propose the metric Mask Matching Cost (MMC) that quantifies this variability and propose FreeMask, a method for selecting optimal masks tailored to specific video editing tasks. Using MMC-selected masks, we further improve the masked fusion mechanism within comprehensive attention features, e.g., temp, cross, and self-attention modules. Our approach can be seamlessly integrated into existing zero-shot video editing frameworks with better performance, requiring no control assistance or parameter fine-tuning but enabling adaptive decoupling of unedited semantic layouts with mask precision control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FreeMask achieves superior semantic fidelity, temporal consistency, and editing quality compared to state-of-the-art methods.
abstract_ch: 文本到视频的扩散模型取得了显著的进步。得益于它们能够生成时间上连贯的视频的能力，基于这些基础模型的零样本视频编辑研究迅速扩展。为了提升编辑质量，结构控制在视频编辑中经常被采用。在这类技术中，交叉注意力掩码控制因其有效性和效率而尤为突出。然而，当交叉注意力掩码简单地应用于视频编辑时，它们可能会引入诸如模糊和闪烁等伪影。我们的实验揭示了一个先前视频编辑研究中被忽视的关键因素：交叉注意力掩码并不一致地清晰，而是随着模型结构和去噪时间步的变化而变化。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种度量标准——掩码匹配成本（MMC），用于量化这种变异性，并提出了FreeMask方法，以选择适用于特定视频编辑任务的最佳掩码。通过使用MMC选择的掩码，我们进一步改进了综合注意力特征中的掩码融合机制，例如temp、cross和self-注意力模块。我们的方法可以无缝集成到现有的零样本视频编辑框架中，并能实现更好的性能，无需控制辅助或参数微调，同时能够通过掩码精度控制实现对未编辑语义布局的自适应解耦。大量实验表明，FreeMask在语义保真度、时间一致性以及编辑质量方面均优于现有最先进的方法。

title: GIM: A Million-scale Benchmark for Generative Image Manipulation Detection and Localization
title_ch: GIM：大规模生成图像操纵检测与定位基准
authors: Yirui Chen;Xudong Huang;Quan Zhang;Wei Li;Mingjian Zhu;Qiangyu Yan;Simiao Li;Hanting Chen;Hailin Hu;Jie Yang;Wei Liu;Jie Hu;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Huawei;Tsinghua University;
abstract: The extraordinary ability of generative models emerges as a new trend in image editing and generating realistic images, posing a serious threat to the trustworthiness of multimedia data and driving the research of image manipulation detection and location (IMDL). However, the lack of a large-scale data foundation makes the IMDL task unattainable. In this paper, we build a local manipulation data generation pipeline that integrates the powerful capabilities of SAM, LLM, and generative models. Upon this basis, we propose the GIM dataset, which has the following advantages: 1) Large scale, GIM includes over one million pairs of AI-manipulated images and real images. 2) Rich image content, GIM encompasses a broad range of image classes. 3) Diverse generative manipulation, the images are manipulated images with state-of-the-art generators and various manipulation tasks. The aforementioned advantages allow for a more comprehensive evaluation of IMDL methods, extending their applicability to diverse images. We introduce the GIM benchmark with two settings to evaluate existing IMDL methods. In addition, we propose a novel IMDL framework, termed GIMFormer, which consists of a ShadowTracer, Frequency-Spatial block (FSB), and a Multi-Window Anomalous Modeling (MWAM) module. Extensive experiments on the GIM demonstrate that GIMFormer surpasses the previous state-of-the-art approach on two different benchmarks.
abstract_ch: 生成模型的非凡能力在图像编辑和生成逼真图像方面崭露头角，对多媒体数据的信任度构成了严重威胁，并推动了图像操纵检测与定位（IMDL）的研究。然而，缺乏大规模的数据基础使得IMDL任务难以实现。在本文中，我们构建了一个本地操纵数据生成管道，该管道集成了SAM、LLM和生成模型的强大功能。在此基础上，我们提出了GIM数据集，该数据集具有以下优势：1）规模庞大，GIM包含超过一百万对AI操纵图像和真实图像的配对。2）丰富的图像内容，GIM涵盖了广泛的图像类别。3）多样化的生成操纵，这些图像通过最先进的生成器和各种操作任务进行操纵。上述优势使IMDL方法的评估更加全面，扩展了其对不同图像的应用范围。我们引入了GIM基准，并提供了两种设置来评估现有的IMDL方法。此外，我们提出了一种新的IMDL框架，称为GIMFormer，该框架由ShadowTracer、频谱空间块（FSB）和多窗口异常建模（MWAM）模块组成。在GIM上的广泛实验表明，GIMFormer在两个不同的基准上超越了之前的最佳方法。

title: Grounded Multi-Hop VideoQA in Long-Form Egocentric Videos
title_ch: 基于长时第一人称视频的 grounded 多跳视频问答
authors: Qirui Chen;Shangzhe Di;Weidi Xie;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;
abstract: This paper considers the problem of Multi-Hop Video Question Answering (MH-VidQA) in long-form egocentric videos. This task not only requires to answer visual questions, but also to localize multiple relevant time intervals within the video as visual evidences. We develop an automated pipeline to create multi-hop question-answering pairs with associated temporal evidence, enabling to construct a large-scale dataset for instruction-tuning. To monitor the progress of this new task, we further curate a high-quality benchmark, MultiHop-EgoQA, with careful manual verification and refinement. Experimental results reveal that existing multi-modal systems exhibit inadequate multi-hop grounding and reasoning abilities, resulting in unsatisfactory performance. We then propose a novel architecture, termed as Grounding Scattered Evidence with Large Language Model (GeLM), that enhances multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) by incorporating a grounding module to retrieve temporal evidence from videos using flexible grounding tokens. Trained on our visual instruction data, GeLM demonstrates improved multi-hop grounding and reasoning capabilities, setting a new baseline for this challenging task. Furthermore, when trained on third-person view videos, the same architecture also achieves state-of-the-art performance on the single-hop VidQA benchmark, ActivityNet-RTL, demonstrating its effectiveness.
abstract_ch: 本文探讨了在长格式自我中心视频中的多跳视频问答（MH-VidQA）问题。这一任务不仅要求回答视觉问题，还需要在视频中定位多个相关的时序区间作为视觉证据。我们开发了一种自动化管道来创建带有关联时间证据的多跳问答对，从而能够构建一个大规模的数据集用于指令调优。为了监控这一新任务的进展，我们进一步精心策划了一个高质量基准——MultiHop-EgoQA，并通过仔细的手动验证和改进来确保其质量。实验结果表明，现有的多模态系统在多跳定位和推理方面表现不足，导致性能不佳。随后，我们提出了一种新颖的架构，称为大型语言模型增强的多跳证据定位（GeLM），该架构通过引入一个定位模块，使用灵活的定位标记从视频中检索时序证据，增强了多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的多跳定位和推理能力。在我们的视觉指令数据上训练后，GeLM展示了改进的多跳定位和推理能力，为这一具有挑战性的任务设定了新的基准。此外，当在第三人称视角视频上进行训练时，同一架构也在单跳视频问答基准ActivityNet-RTL上达到了最先进的性能，证明了其有效性。

title: H-MBA: Hierarchical MamBa Adaptation for Multi-Modal Video Understanding in Autonomous Driving
title_ch: H-MBA：层次化MamBa适应性方法在自动驾驶中的多模态视频理解
authors: Siran Chen;Yuxiao Luo;Yue Ma;Yu Qiao;Yali Wang;
affiliations: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology;University of Chinese Academy of Science;Hong Kong Polytechnic University;Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory;
abstract: With the prevalence of Multimodal Large Language Models(MLLMs), autonomous driving has encountered new opportunities and challenges. In particular, multi-modal video understanding is critical to interactively analyze what will happen in the procedure of autonomous driving. However, videos in such a dynamical scene that often contains complex spatial-temporal movements, which restricts the generalization capacity of the existing MLLMs in this field. To bridge the gap, we propose a novel Hierarchical Mamba Adaptation (H-MBA) framework to fit the complicated motion changes in autonomous driving videos. Specifically, our H-MBA consists of two distinct modules, including Context Mamba (C-Mamba) and Query Mamba (Q-Mamba). First, C-Mamba contains various types of structure state space models, which can effectively capture multi-granularity video context for different temporal resolutions. Second, Q-Mamba flexibly transforms the current frame as the learnable query, and attentively selects multi-granularity video context into query. Consequently, it can adaptively integrate all the video contexts of multi-scale temporal resolutions to enhance video understanding. Via a plug-and-play paradigm in MLLMs, our H-MBA shows the remarkable performance on multi-modal video tasks in autonomous driving, e.g., for risk object detection, it outperforms the previous SOTA method with 5.5% mIoU improvement.
abstract_ch: 随着多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的普及，自动驾驶领域迎来了新的机遇与挑战。特别是多模态视频理解对于交互式分析自动驾驶过程中可能发生的情况至关重要。然而，现有的MLLMs在处理这种动态场景时受到了限制，因为这些场景通常包含复杂的时空运动。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的分层Mamba适应（H-MBA）框架，以适应自动驾驶视频中的复杂运动变化。具体来说，我们的H-MBA由两个不同的模块组成，包括上下文Mamba（C-Mamba）和查询Mamba（Q-Mamba）。首先，C-Mamba包含各种类型的结构状态空间模型，能够有效捕捉不同时间分辨率下的多粒度视频上下文。其次，Q-Mamba灵活地将当前帧作为可学习的查询，并注意力选择多粒度视频上下文作为查询。因此，它可以自适应地整合多尺度时间分辨率的所有视频上下文，以增强视频理解。通过在MLLMs中的插件式 paradigms，我们的H-MBA在自动驾驶领域的多模态视频任务上表现出显著性能，例如，在风险对象检测方面，它比之前的最佳方法提高了5.5%的mIoU。

title: HiRED: Attention-Guided Token Dropping for Efficient Inference of High-Resolution Vision-Language Models
title_ch: HiRED：注意力引导的令牌删除，用于高效高分辨率视觉语言模型推理
authors: Kazi Hasan Ibn Arif;JinYi Yoon;Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos;Hans Vandierendonck;Deepu John;Bo Ji;
affiliations: Virginia Tech;Queen's University Belfast;University College Dublin;
abstract:
High-resolution Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely used in multimodal tasks to enhance accuracy by preserving detailed image information. However, these models often generate an excessive number of visual tokens due to the need to encode multiple partitions of a high-resolution image input. Processing such a large number of visual tokens through multiple transformer networks poses significant computational challenges, particularly for resource-constrained commodity GPUs. To address this challenge, we propose High-Resolution Early Dropping (HiRED), a plug-and-play token-dropping method designed to operate within a fixed token budget. HiRED leverages the attention of CLS token in the vision transformer (ViT) to assess the visual content of the image partitions and allocate an optimal token budget for each partition accordingly. The most informative visual tokens from each partition within the allocated budget are then selected and passed to the subsequent Large Language Model (LLM). We showed that HiRED achieves superior accuracy and performance, compared to existing token-dropping methods. Empirically, HiRED-20% (i.e., a 20% token budget) on LLaVA-Next-7B achieves a 4.7x increase in token generation throughput, reduces response latency by 78%, and saves 14% of GPU memory for single inference on an NVIDIA TESLA P40 (24 GB). For larger batch sizes (e.g., 4), HiRED-20% prevents out-of-memory errors by cutting memory usage by 30%, while preserving throughput and latency benefits.
  Code - https://github.com/hasanar1f/HiRED
abstract_ch: 高分辨率视觉-语言模型（VLMs）广泛应用于多模态任务中，通过保留详细图像信息来提高准确性。然而，这些模型往往需要编码高分辨率图像输入的多个分区，从而生成过多的视觉标记。通过多个变压器网络处理如此大量的视觉标记带来了显著的计算挑战，尤其是在资源受限的商品级GPU上。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种插即用的标记丢弃方法——高分辨率早期丢弃（HiRED），该方法旨在在固定标记预算内运行。HiRED 利用视觉变压器（ViT）中的CLS标记的注意力来评估图像分区的视觉内容，并相应地为每个分区分配最优的标记预算。在分配的预算范围内，从每个分区中选择最具信息量的视觉标记并传递给后续的大语言模型（LLM）。实验表明，HiRED 较之现有的标记丢弃方法实现了更优的准确性和性能。具体而言，在LLaVA-Next-7B上使用HiRED-20%（即20%的标记预算）能够将标记生成吞吐量提高4.7倍，响应延迟降低78%，并在单次推理时节省NVIDIA TESLA P40（24GB）上14%的GPU内存。对于更大的批量大小（例如4），HiRED-20%通过减少30%的内存使用来防止内存溢出错误，同时保持吞吐量和延迟的优势。
