title: DIDiffGes: Decoupled Semi-Implicit Diffusion Models for Real-time Gesture Generation from Speech
title_ch: 解耦半隐式扩散模型用于实时语音驱动的手势生成
authors: Yongkang Cheng;Shaoli Huang;Xuelin Chen;Jifeng Ning;Mingming Gong;
affiliations: Tencent;Northwest A&F University;University of Melbourne;Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence;
abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable synthesis quality and diversity in generating co-speech gestures. However, the computationally intensive sampling steps associated with diffusion models hinder their practicality in real-world applications. Hence, we present DIDiffGes, for a Decoupled Semi-Implicit Diffusion model-based framework, that can synthesize high-quality, expressive gestures from speech using only a few sampling steps. Our approach leverages Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to enable large-step sampling for diffusion model. We decouple gesture data into body and hands distributions and further decompose them into marginal and conditional distributions. GANs model the marginal distribution implicitly, while L2 reconstruction loss learns the conditional distributions exciplictly. This strategy enhances GAN training stability and ensures expressiveness of generated full-body gestures. Our framework also learns to denoise root noise conditioned on local body representation, guaranteeing stability and realism. DIDiffGes can generate gestures from speech with just 10 sampling steps, without compromising quality and expressiveness, reducing the number of sampling steps by a factor of 100 compared to existing methods. Our user study reveals that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in human likeness, appropriateness, and style correctness. Project is https://cyk990422.github.io/DIDiffGes.
abstract_ch: 扩散模型在生成共时手势方面展示了出色的合成质量和多样性。然而，与扩散模型相关的计算密集型采样步骤阻碍了其在实际应用中的实用性。因此，我们提出了DIDiffGes，这是一种基于解耦半隐式扩散模型框架的方法，可以仅通过少量采样步骤从语音中合成高质量、表达力强的手势。我们的方法利用生成对抗网络（GANs）实现扩散模型的大步长采样。我们将手势数据解耦为身体和手的分布，并进一步将它们分解为边缘分布和条件分布。GANs隐式地建模边缘分布，而L2重构损失则明确地学习条件分布。这种策略增强了GAN训练的稳定性，并确保生成的全身手势具有表达性。我们的框架还学习去除基于局部身体表示的根噪声，从而保证稳定性和真实性。DIDiffGes仅需10个采样步骤即可从语音生成手势，而不牺牲质量和表达性，与现有方法相比，采样步骤减少了100倍。我们的用户研究显示，该方法在人类相似度、适宜性和风格正确性方面优于现有的先进方法。项目页面为：https://cyk990422.github.io/DIDiffGes。

title: DiffCalib: Reformulating Monocular Camera Calibration as Diffusion-Based Dense Incident Map Generation
title_ch: DiffCalib：将单目相机标定重新 formulized 为基于扩散的密集入射图生成
authors: Xiankang He;Guangkai Xu;Bo Zhang;Hao Chen;Ying Cui;Dongyan Guo;
affiliations: Zhejiang University of Technology;Zhejiang University;
abstract: Monocular camera calibration is a key precondition for numerous 3D vision applications. Despite considerable advancements, existing methods often hinge on specific assumptions and struggle to generalize across varied real-world scenarios, and the performance is limited by insufficient training data. Recently, diffusion models trained on expansive datasets have been confirmed to maintain the capability to generate diverse, high-quality images. This success suggests a strong potential of the models to effectively understand varied visual information. In this work, we leverage the comprehensive visual knowledge embedded in pre-trained diffusion models to enable more robust and accurate monocular camera intrinsic estimation. Specifically, we reformulate the problem of estimating the four degrees of freedom (4-DoF) of camera intrinsic parameters as a dense incident map generation task. The map details the angle of incidence for each pixel in the RGB image, and its format aligns well with the paradigm of diffusion models. The camera intrinsic then can be derived from the incident map with a simple non-learning RANSAC algorithm during inference. Moreover, to further enhance the performance, we jointly estimate a depth map to provide extra geometric information for the incident map estimation. Extensive experiments on multiple testing datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, gaining up to a 40% reduction in prediction errors. Besides, the experiments also show that the precise camera intrinsic and depth maps estimated by our pipeline can greatly benefit practical applications such as 3D reconstruction from a single in-the-wild image.
abstract_ch: 单目相机标定是许多三维视觉应用的关键前提。尽管取得了显著进展，现有方法往往依赖于特定假设，并且难以在各种现实场景中泛化，其性能受限于训练数据不足。最近，基于大规模数据集训练的扩散模型已被证实能够生成多样且高质量的图像。这一成功表明，这些模型具有有效理解各种视觉信息的强大潜力。在这项工作中，我们利用预训练扩散模型中嵌入的全面视觉知识，以实现更稳健和准确的单目相机固有参数估计。具体而言，我们将估计相机固有参数的四个自由度（4-DoF）问题重新表述为密集入射图生成任务。该图详细记录了RGB图像中每个像素的入射角，其格式与扩散模型的范式非常契合。在推理过程中，相机固有参数可以从入射图中通过一个简单的非学习RANSAC算法推导出来。此外，为了进一步提高性能，我们还联合估计了一个深度图，以提供额外的几何信息来辅助入射图的估计。在多个测试数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的模型达到了最先进的性能，预测误差降低了多达40%。此外，实验还显示，由我们管道估计出的精确相机固有参数和深度图可以极大地促进诸如单张野外图像的三维重建等实际应用。

title: DiffCorr: Conditional Diffusion Model with Reliable Pseudo-Label Guidance for Unsupervised Point Cloud Shape Correspondence
title_ch: DiffCorr：基于可靠伪标签指导的条件扩散模型，用于无监督点云形状对应
authors: Jiacheng Deng;Jiahao Lu;Zhixin Cheng;Wenfei Yang;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;Jianghuai Advance Technology Center;

title: DiffRetouch: Using Diffusion to Retouch on the Shoulder of Experts
title_ch: DiffRetouch: 使用扩散技术进行专家肩部修复
authors: Zheng-Peng Duan;Jiawei Zhang;Zheng Lin;Xin Jin;XunDong Wang;Dongqing Zou;Chun-Le Guo;Chongyi Li;
affiliations: Nankai University;Shenzhen Futian NKIARI;SenseTime;Tsinghua University;Wuhan University of Technology;PBVR;
abstract: Image retouching aims to enhance the visual quality of photos. Considering the different aesthetic preferences of users, the target of retouching is subjective. However, current retouching methods mostly adopt deterministic models, which not only neglects the style diversity in the expert-retouched results and tends to learn an average style during training, but also lacks sample diversity during inference. In this paper, we propose a diffusion-based method, named DiffRetouch. Thanks to the excellent distribution modeling ability of diffusion, our method can capture the complex fine-retouched distribution covering various visual-pleasing styles in the training data. Moreover, four image attributes are made adjustable to provide a user-friendly editing mechanism. By adjusting these attributes in specified ranges, users are allowed to customize preferred styles within the learned fine-retouched distribution. Additionally, the affine bilateral grid and contrastive learning scheme are introduced to handle the problem of texture distortion and control insensitivity respectively. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superior performance of our method on visually appealing and sample diversity. The code will be made available to the community.
abstract_ch: 图像修正是为了提升照片的视觉质量。考虑到用户的不同审美偏好，修图的目标具有主观性。然而，当前的修图方法大多采用确定性模型，这不仅忽视了专家修图结果中的风格多样性，在训练过程中倾向于学习一种平均风格，而且在推断过程中缺乏样本多样性。本文提出了一种基于扩散的方法，名为DiffRetouch。得益于扩散模型出色的分布建模能力，我们的方法能够捕捉到复杂的精细修图分布，涵盖训练数据中各种视觉愉悦的风格。此外，我们引入了四个可调整的图像属性，提供了一个用户友好的编辑机制。通过在指定范围内调整这些属性，用户可以在学习到的精细修图分布内自定义自己喜欢的风格。另外，我们还引入了仿射双边网格和对比学习方案来分别处理纹理失真和控制不敏感的问题。大量实验已经证明了我们在视觉吸引力和样本多样性方面的优越性能。该代码将向社区开放。

title: Digging into Intrinsic Contextual Information for High-fidelity 3D Point Cloud Completion
title_ch: 探究固有上下文信息以实现高保真3D点云完成
authors: Jisheng Chu;Wenrui Li;Xingtao Wang;Kanglin Ning;Yidan Lu;Xiaopeng Fan;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Pengcheng Laboratory;
abstract: The common occurrence of occlusion-induced incompleteness in point clouds has made point cloud completion (PCC) a highly-concerned task in the field of geometric processing. Existing PCC methods typically produce complete point clouds from partial point clouds in a coarse-to-fine paradigm, with the coarse stage generating entire shapes and the fine stage improving texture details. Though diffusion models have demonstrated effectiveness in the coarse stage, the fine stage still faces challenges in producing high-fidelity results due to the ill-posed nature of PCC. The intrinsic contextual information for texture details in partial point clouds is the key to solving the challenge. In this paper, we propose a high-fidelity PCC method that digs into both short and long-range contextual information from the partial point cloud in the fine stage. Specifically, after generating the coarse point cloud via a diffusion-based coarse generator, a mixed sampling module introduces short-range contextual information from partial point clouds into the fine stage. A surface freezing modules safeguards points from noise-free partial point clouds against disruption. As for the long-range contextual information, we design a similarity modeling module to derive similarity with rigid transformation invariance between points, conducting effective matching of geometric manifold features globally. In this way, the high-quality components present in the partial point cloud serve as valuable references for refining the coarse point cloud with high fidelity. Extensive experiments have demonstrated the superiority of the proposed method over SOTA competitors. Our code is available at https://github.com/JS-CHU/ContextualCompletion.
abstract_ch: 点云中的遮挡导致不完整性是一个常见问题，在几何处理领域使得点云完成（PCC）成为一个高度关注的任务。现有的PCC方法通常采用从粗到细的范式，粗阶段生成整个形状，细阶段则改进纹理细节。尽管扩散模型在粗阶段已经显示出有效性，但在细阶段由于PCC问题的病态性质，仍然面临产生高保真结果的挑战。部分点云中固有的纹理细节上下文信息是解决这一挑战的关键。在本文中，我们提出了一种高保真PCC方法，在细阶段挖掘部分点云中的短程和远程上下文信息。具体而言，通过基于扩散的粗生成器生成粗点云后，混合采样模块将部分点云的短程上下文信息引入细阶段。表面冻结模块保护来自无噪声部分点云的点不受干扰。对于远程上下文信息，我们设计了一个相似性建模模块，该模块能够在点之间引入刚体变换不变性的相似性，并在全球范围内有效匹配几何流形特征。这样一来，部分点云中存在的高质量组件便可以作为高保真细化粗点云的重要参考。大量实验已经证明了所提出方法在与当前最佳竞争对手相比时的优越性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/JS-CHU/ContextualCompletion获取。

title: Dis²Booth: Learning Image Distribution with Disentangled Features for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_ch: Dis²Booth：学习具有解耦特征的图像分布的文本到图像扩散模型
authors: Guanqi Ding;Chengyu Yang;Shuhui Wang;Xincheng Li;Jinzhe Zhang;Xin Jin;Qingming Huang;
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Beijing Institute of Technology;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Pengcheng Laboratory;Huawei;

title: Disentangle Nighttime Lens Flares: Self-supervised Generation-based Lens Flare Removal
title_ch: 分离夜间镜头光晕：基于自监督生成的镜头光晕去除方法
authors: Yuwen He;Wei Wang;Wanyu Wu;Kui Jiang;
affiliations: Wuhan University of Science and Technology;Harbin Institute of Technology;
abstract: Lens flares arise from light reflection and refraction within sensor arrays, whose diverse types include glow, veiling glare, reflective flare and so on. Existing methods are specialized for one specific type only, and overlook the simultaneous occurrence of multiple typed lens flares, which is common in the real-world, e.g. coexistence of glow and displacement reflections from the same light source. These co-occurring lens flares cannot be effectively resolved by the simple combination of individual flare removal methods, since these coexisting flares originates from the same light source and are generated simultaneously within the same sensor array, exhibit a complex interdependence rather than simple additive relation. To model this interdependent flare relationship, our Nighttime Lens Flare Formation model is the first attempt to learn the intrinsic physical relationship between flares on the imaging plane. Building on this physical model, we introduce a solution to this joint flare removal task named Self-supervised Generation-based Lens Flare Removal Network (SGLFR-Net), which is self-supervised without pre-training. Specifically, the nighttime glow is detangled in PSF Rendering Network(PSFR-Net) based on PSF Rendering Prior, while the reflective flare is modelled in Texture Prior Based Reflection Flare Removal Network (TPRR-Net). Empirical evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in both joint and individual glare removal tasks.
abstract_ch: 镜头光晕源于传感器阵列中的光线反射和折射，其多样类型包括发光、炫目反光、反射光晕等。现有方法仅针对一种特定类型的光晕，忽略了多种类型光晕同时出现的情况，这种情况在现实世界中很常见，例如同一光源同时产生的发光和位移反射。这些并发的光晕不能通过单一光晕去除方法的简单组合得到有效解决，因为这些共存的光晕源自同一个光源，并且在同一传感器阵列中同时生成，表现出复杂的相互依赖关系而非简单的叠加关系。为了建模这种相互依赖的光晕关系，我们的夜间镜头光晕形成模型是首个尝试学习成像平面上光晕之间的内在物理关系的方法。基于这一物理模型，我们引入了一种名为自监督生成基础镜头光晕去除网络（SGLFR-Net）的解决方案，该网络无需预训练即可实现联合光晕去除任务。具体而言，夜间发光现象是在基于点扩散函数渲染先验的点扩散函数渲染网络（PSFR-Net）中解开的，而反射光晕则是在基于纹理先验的反射光晕去除网络（TPRR-Net）中建模的。实证评估表明，所提出的方法在联合和单独的炫目去除任务中均具有有效性。

title: Distribution-Level Feature Distancing for Machine Unlearning: Towards a Better Trade-off Between Model Utility and Forgetting
title_ch: 机器遗忘中的分布级特征距离化：向着更好的模型 utility 和遗忘之间的权衡
authors: Dasol Choi;Dongbin Na;
affiliations: Yonsei University;MODULABS;Pohang University of Science and Technology;
abstract: With the explosive growth of deep learning applications and increasing privacy concerns, the right to be forgotten has become a critical requirement in various AI industries. For example, given a facial recognition system, some individuals may wish to remove their personal data that might have been used in the training phase. Unfortunately, deep neural networks sometimes unexpectedly leak personal identities, making this removal challenging. While recent machine unlearning algorithms aim to enable models to forget specific data, we identify an unintended utility drop-correlation collapse-in which the essential correlations between image features and true labels weaken during the forgetting process. To address this challenge, we propose Distribution-Level Feature Distancing (DLFD), a novel method that efficiently forgets instances while preserving task-relevant feature correlations. Our method synthesizes data samples by optimizing the feature distribution to be distinctly different from that of forget samples, achieving effective results within a single training epoch. Through extensive experiments on facial recognition datasets, we demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art machine unlearning methods in both forgetting performance and model utility preservation.
abstract_ch: 随着深度学习应用的爆炸性增长和隐私担忧的增加，“被遗忘的权利”已成为各种AI行业的关键需求。例如，在面部识别系统中，一些个人可能希望删除在训练阶段可能使用过的个人数据。不幸的是，深度神经网络有时会在不经意间泄露个人信息，这使得数据删除变得困难。虽然最近的机器遗忘算法旨在使模型忘记特定的数据，但我们发现了一个意外的功能下降——相关性坍塌，在遗忘过程中，图像特征与真实标签之间的核心相关性减弱。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种名为分布级特征疏远（DLFD）的新方法，该方法能够在保持任务相关特征相关性的前提下高效地遗忘实例。我们的方法通过优化特征分布，使其与遗忘样本的分布明显不同，并在单个训练周期内取得了有效结果。通过在面部识别数据集上的广泛实验，我们证明了我们的方法在遗忘性能和模型功能保留方面显著优于当前最先进的机器遗忘方法。

title: DiT4Edit: Diffusion Transformer for Image Editing
title_ch: DiT4Edit：图像编辑的扩散变换器
authors: Kunyu Feng;Yue Ma;Bingyuan Wang;Chenyang Qi;Haozhe Chen;Qifeng Chen;Zeyu Wang;
affiliations: Peking University;Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;
abstract: Despite recent advances in UNet-based image editing, methods for shape-aware object editing in high-resolution images are still lacking. Compared to UNet, Diffusion Transformers (DiT) demonstrate superior capabilities to effectively capture the long-range dependencies among patches, leading to higher-quality image generation. In this paper, we propose DiT4Edit, the first Diffusion Transformer-based image editing framework. Specifically, DiT4Edit uses the DPM-Solver inversion algorithm to obtain the inverted latents, reducing the number of steps compared to the DDIM inversion algorithm commonly used in UNet-based frameworks. Additionally, we design unified attention control and patches merging, tailored for transformer computation streams. This integration allows our framework to generate higher-quality edited images faster. Our design leverages the advantages of DiT, enabling it to surpass UNet structures in image editing, especially in high-resolution and arbitrary-size images. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong performance of DiT4Edit across various editing scenarios, highlighting the potential of Diffusion Transformers in supporting image editing.
abstract_ch: 尽管最近在基于UNet的图像编辑方面取得了进展，但在高分辨率图像中进行形状感知对象编辑的方法仍然缺乏。与UNet相比，扩散变换器（DiT）表现出更优秀的捕获补丁之间长程依赖性的能力，从而生成更高质量的图像。在本文中，我们提出了DiT4Edit，这是第一个基于扩散变换器的图像编辑框架。具体而言，DiT4Edit 使用了DPM-Solver反演算法来获得反转潜变量，这比UNet框架中常用的标准DDIM反演算法减少了步骤数。此外，我们设计了一致的注意力控制和补丁合并方法，针对变换器计算流进行了定制。这种集成使得我们的框架能够更快地生成高质量的编辑图像。我们的设计利用了DiT的优势，使其在图像编辑领域超越了UNet结构，特别是在高分辨率和任意大小的图像上。广泛的实验表明，DiT4Edit 在各种编辑场景下表现出强大的性能，突显了扩散变换器在支持图像编辑方面的潜力。

title: DME-Driver: Integrating Human Decision Logic and 3D Scene Perception in Autonomous Driving
title_ch: DME-驾驶员：将人类决策逻辑与三维场景感知整合于自动驾驶
authors: Wencheng Han;Dongqian Guo;Cheng-Zhong Xu;Jianbing Shen;
affiliations: University of Macau;
abstract: In the field of autonomous driving, two important features of autonomous driving car systems are the explainability of decision logic and the accuracy of environmental perception. This paper introduces DME-Driver, a new autonomous driving system that enhances the performance and reliability of autonomous driving system. DME-Driver utilizes a powerful vision language model as the decision-maker and a planning-oriented perception model as the control signal generator. To ensure explainable and reliable driving decisions, the logical decision-maker is constructed based on a large vision language model. This model follows the logic employed by experienced human drivers and makes decisions in a similar manner. On the other hand, the generation of accurate control signals relies on precise and detailed environmental perception, which is where 3D scene perception models excel. Therefore, a planning oriented perception model is employed as the signal generator. It translates the logical decisions made by the decision-maker into accurate control signals for the self-driving cars. To effectively train the proposed model, a new dataset for autonomous driving was created. This dataset encompasses a diverse range of human driver behaviors and their underlying motivations. By leveraging this dataset, our model achieves high-precision planning accuracy through a logical thinking process.
abstract_ch: 在自动驾驶领域，自主驾驶汽车系统两个重要的特征是决策逻辑的可解释性和环境感知的准确性。本文介绍了DME-Driver这一新的自主驾驶系统，旨在提升自主驾驶系统的性能和可靠性。DME-Driver利用一个强大的视觉语言模型作为决策者，并采用一种以规划为导向的感知模型生成控制信号。为了确保可解释且可靠的驾驶决策，逻辑决策者基于大型视觉语言模型构建而成，遵循经验丰富的驾驶员所采用的逻辑，并以类似的方式做出决策。另一方面，生成准确的控制信号依赖于精确和详细的环境感知，而3D场景感知模型在这方面表现出色。因此，采用了一种以规划为导向的感知模型作为信号生成器，将决策者的逻辑决策转化为准确的控制信号，用于自动驾驶车辆。为了有效训练所提出的模型，创建了一个新的自动驾驶数据集，该数据集涵盖了广泛的人类驾驶员行为及其背后的动机。通过利用这个数据集，我们的模型能够通过逻辑思维过程实现高精度的规划准确性。

title: DuMo: Dual Encoder Modulation Network for Precise Concept Erasure
title_ch: DuMo：双编码器调制网络用于精确概念消除
authors: Feng Han;Kai Chen;Chao Gong;Zhipeng Wei;Jingjing Chen;Yu-Gang Jiang;
affiliations: Fudan University;Shanghai Collaborative Innovation Center on Intelligent Visual Computing;
abstract: The exceptional generative capability of text-to-image models has raised substantial safety concerns regarding the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content and potential copyright infringement. To address these concerns, previous methods safeguard the models by eliminating inappropriate concepts. Nonetheless, these models alter the parameters of the backbone network and exert considerable influences on the structural (low-frequency) components of the image, which undermines the model's ability to retain non-target concepts. In this work, we propose our Dual encoder Modulation network (DuMo), which achieves precise erasure of inappropriate target concepts with minimum impairment to non-target concepts. In contrast to previous methods, DuMo employs the Eraser with PRior Knowledge (EPR) module which modifies the skip connection features of the U-NET and primarily achieves concept erasure on details (high-frequency) components of the image. To minimize the damage to non-target concepts during erasure, the parameters of the backbone U-NET are frozen and the prior knowledge from the original skip connection features is introduced to the erasure process. Meanwhile, the phenomenon is observed that distinct erasing preferences for the image structure and details are demonstrated by the EPR at different timesteps and layers. Therefore, we adopt a novel Time-Layer MOdulation process (TLMO) that adjusts the erasure scale of EPR module's outputs across different layers and timesteps, automatically balancing the erasure effects and model's generative ability. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on Explicit Content Erasure, Cartoon Concept Removal and Artistic Style Erasure, clearly outperforming alternative methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Maplebb/DuMo
abstract_ch: 文本到图像模型的出色生成能力引发了关于生成不适合工作（NSFW）内容以及潜在版权侵权的安全担忧。为应对这些担忧，先前的方法通过消除不适当的概念来保护模型，但这会显著影响图像的结构（低频）组件，从而削弱模型保留非目标概念的能力。在本工作中，我们提出了一种双编码器调制网络（DuMo），该网络能够在最小程度上损害非目标概念的情况下精确消除不适当的靶向概念。与先前方法不同，DuMo 使用了带有先验知识擦除器（EPR）模块，该模块修改了U-NET的跳跃连接特征，并主要针对图像细节（高频）组件实现概念擦除。为了在擦除过程中尽量减少对非目标概念的损害，U-NET的骨干网络参数被冻结，并引入了原始跳跃连接特征的先验知识以指导擦除过程。同时观察到，在不同的时间步和层中，EPR 对图像结构和细节表现出不同的擦除偏好现象。因此，我们采用了新颖的时间-层调制过程（TLMO），该过程根据不同的层和时间步调整EPR模块输出的擦除比例，自动平衡擦除效果和模型的生成能力。我们的方法在明确内容擦除、卡通概念移除和艺术风格擦除方面达到了最先进的性能，明显优于其他替代方法。代码可在 https://github.com/Maplebb/DuMo 获取。

title: DynASyn: Multi-Subject Personalization Enabling Dynamic Action Synthesis
title_ch: DynASyn：多主题个性化动态动作合成
authors: Yongjin Choi;Chanhun Park;Seung Jun Baek;
affiliations: Korea University;
abstract: Recent advances in text-to-image diffusion models spurred research on personalization, i.e., a customized image synthesis, of subjects within reference images. Although existing personalization methods are able to alter the subjects' positions or to personalize multiple subjects simultaneously, they often struggle to modify the behaviors of subjects or their dynamic interactions. The difficulty is attributable to overfitting to reference images, which worsens if only a single reference image is available. We propose DynASyn, an effective multi-subject personalization from a single reference image addressing these challenges. DynASyn preserves the subject identity in the personalization process by aligning concept-based priors with subject appearances and actions. This is achieved by regularizing the attention maps between the subject token and images through concept-based priors. In addition, we propose concept-based prompt-and-image augmentation for an enhanced trade-off between identity preservation and action diversity. We adopt an SDE-based editing guided by augmented prompts to generate diverse appearances and actions while maintaining identity consistency in the augmented images. Experiments show that DynASyn is capable of synthesizing highly realistic images of subjects with novel contexts and dynamic interactions with the surroundings, and outperforms baseline methods in both quantitative and qualitative aspects.
abstract_ch: 最近在文本到图像扩散模型方面的进展激发了对参考图像中主题个性化，即定制化图像合成的研究。尽管现有的个性化方法能够改变主题的位置或同时个性化多个主题，但它们往往难以修改主题的行为或它们之间的动态互动。这种困难归因于对参考图像的过度拟合，如果仅有一个参考图像可用时，这一问题会更加严重。我们提出了一种名为DynASyn的有效方法，该方法能够在单个参考图像的情况下解决这些挑战。DynASyn通过将概念导向的先验与主题的外观和动作对齐，在个性化过程中保留主题身份。这通过利用概念导向的先验正则化主题标记与图像之间的注意力图来实现。此外，我们还提出了基于概念的提示和图像增强，以增强身份保留与行为多样性之间的权衡。我们采用基于SDE（随机微分方程）的编辑，并由增强后的提示引导，生成多样化的外观和动作，同时在增强图像中保持身份一致性。实验表明，DynASyn能够合成具有新颖上下文和周围环境动态互动的高保真主题图像，并且在定量和定性方面都优于基线方法。

title: EchoMimic: Lifelike Audio-Driven Portrait Animations through Editable Landmark Conditions
title_ch: EchoMimic：通过可编辑的特征点条件实现逼真音频驱动的人物肖像动画
authors: Zhiyuan Chen;Jiajiong Cao;Zhiquan Chen;Yuming Li;Chenguang Ma;
affiliations: Ant Group;
abstract: The area of portrait image animation, propelled by audio input, has witnessed notable progress in the generation of lifelike and dynamic portraits. Conventional methods are limited to utilizing either audios or facial key points to drive images into videos, while they can yield satisfactory results, certain issues exist. For instance, methods driven solely by audios can be unstable at times due to the relatively weaker audio signal, while methods driven exclusively by facial key points, although more stable in driving, can result in unnatural outcomes due to the excessive control of key point information. In addressing the previously mentioned challenges, in this paper, we introduce a novel approach which we named EchoMimic. EchoMimic is concurrently trained using both audios and facial landmarks. Through the implementation of a novel training strategy, EchoMimic is capable of generating portrait videos not only by audios and facial landmarks individually, but also by a combination of both audios and selected facial landmarks. EchoMimic has been comprehensively compared with alternative algorithms across various public datasets and our collected dataset, showcasing superior performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations. Additional visualization and access to the source code can be located on the EchoMimic project page.
abstract_ch: 以音频输入驱动的肖像图像动画领域在生成逼真且动态的肖像方面取得了显著进展。传统方法要么利用音频信号，要么仅使用面部关键点来驱动图像生成视频，尽管这些方法可以取得令人满意的结果，但仍然存在一些问题。例如，仅由音频驱动的方法有时会因为音频信号相对较弱而变得不稳定；而仅由面部关键点驱动的方法虽然在稳定性上有所提升，但由于过度控制关键点信息，可能会导致生成的肖像视频显得不自然。为了解决上述挑战，在本文中我们介绍了一种名为EchoMimic的新颖方法。EchoMimic同时利用音频和面部特征点进行训练。通过实施一种新型的训练策略，EchoMimic不仅能够单独通过音频或面部特征点生成肖像视频，还能够结合音频和选择的关键面部特征点共同生成肖像视频。我们在多个公开数据集和自收集的数据集中全面比较了EchoMimic与其他算法的表现，结果显示其在定量和定性评估中均展现出优越性能。此外，EchoMimic的相关可视化内容及源代码可以在其项目页面上找到。

title: Effective Diffusion Transformer Architecture for Image Super-Resolution
title_ch: 有效的扩散变换架构用于图像超分辨率
authors: Kun Cheng;Lei Yu;Zhijun Tu;Xiao He;Liyu Chen;Yong Guo;Mingrui Zhu;Nannan Wang;Xinbo Gao;Jie Hu;
affiliations: Xidian University;Huawei;Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications;
abstract: Recent advances indicate that diffusion models hold great promise in image super-resolution. While the latest methods are primarily based on latent diffusion models with convolutional neural networks, there are few attempts to explore transformers, which have demonstrated remarkable performance in image generation. In this work, we design an effective diffusion transformer for image super-resolution (DiT-SR) that achieves the visual quality of prior-based methods, but through a training-from-scratch manner. In practice, DiT-SR leverages an overall U-shaped architecture, and adopts a uniform isotropic design for all the transformer blocks across different stages. The former facilitates multi-scale hierarchical feature extraction, while the latter reallocates the computational resources to critical layers to further enhance performance. Moreover, we thoroughly analyze the limitation of the widely used AdaLN, and present a frequency-adaptive time-step conditioning module, enhancing the model's capacity to process distinct frequency information at different time steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiT-SR outperforms the existing training-from-scratch diffusion-based SR methods significantly, and even beats some of the prior-based methods on pretrained Stable Diffusion, proving the superiority of diffusion transformer in image super-resolution.
abstract_ch: 最近的研究表明，扩散模型在图像超分辨率方面具有巨大的潜力。尽管最新的方法主要基于潜在扩散模型和卷积神经网络，但很少有人尝试探索变换器，而变换器已经在图像生成任务中展现了卓越的表现。在这项工作中，我们设计了一种有效的扩散变换器（DiT-SR）用于图像超分辨率，它能够实现与基于先验的方法相当的视觉质量，但却采用了从零开始训练的方式。实际上，DiT-SR 利用了整体U形架构，并在不同阶段的所有变换器块中采用了均匀各向同性的设计。前者有助于多尺度层次特征提取，而后者则重新分配计算资源到关键层，进一步提升性能。此外，我们详细分析了广泛使用的AdaLN的局限性，并提出了一种频率自适应的时间步长条件模块，增强模型处理不同时间步长下独特频率信息的能力。大量的实验表明，DiT-SR 在图像超分辨率方面的表现显著优于现有的从零开始训练的扩散基SR方法，并且甚至在预训练的Stable Diffusion上超过了某些基于先验的方法，证明了扩散变换器在图像超分辨率领域的优越性。

title: Efficient Connectivity-Preserving Instance Segmentation with Supervoxel-Based Loss Function
title_ch: 基于 supervoxel 的损失函数的高效连通性保持实例分割
authors: Anna Grim;Jayaram Chandrashekar;Uygar Sümbül;
affiliations: Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence;
abstract: Reconstructing the intricate local morphology of neurons and their long-range projecting axons can address many connectivity related questions in neuroscience. The main bottleneck in connectomics pipelines is correcting topological errors, as multiple entangled neuronal arbors is a challenging instance segmentation problem. More broadly, segmentation of curvilinear, filamentous structures continues to pose significant challenges. To address this problem, we extend the notion of simple points from digital topology to connected sets of voxels (i.e. supervoxels) and propose a topology-aware neural network segmentation method with minimal computational overhead. We demonstrate its effectiveness on a new public dataset of 3-d light microscopy images of mouse brains, along with the benchmark datasets DRIVE, ISBI12, and CrackTree.
abstract_ch: 重建神经元及其长距离投射轴突的复杂局部形态可以解决神经科学中的许多连接相关问题。在连接组学的工作流程中，主要瓶颈在于纠正拓扑错误，因为多个纠缠的神经树突是一个复杂的实例分割问题。更广泛地说，曲线状、细丝状结构的分割继续提出重大挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们从数字拓扑扩展了简单点的概念，应用于连通的体素集合（即超体素），并提出了一种具有最小计算开销的拓扑意识神经网络分割方法。我们在一个新的公开数据集上展示了其有效性，该数据集包含小鼠大脑的三维荧光显微镜图像，同时也在基准数据集DRIVE、ISBI12和CrackTree上进行了测试。

title_ch: 高效的在线训练在零样本时间显微镜去噪和超分辨率中的应用

title: Elevating Flow-Guided Video Inpainting with Reference Generation
title_ch: 提升基于流引导的视频修复参考生成方法
authors: Suhwan Cho;Seoung Wug Oh;Sangyoun Lee;Joon-Young Lee;
affiliations: Yonsei University;Adobe;
abstract: Video inpainting (VI) is a challenging task that requires effective propagation of observable content across frames while simultaneously generating new content not present in the original video. In this study, we propose a robust and practical VI framework that leverages a large generative model for reference generation in combination with an advanced pixel propagation algorithm. Powered by a strong generative model, our method not only significantly enhances frame-level quality for object removal but also synthesizes new content in the missing areas based on user-provided text prompts. For pixel propagation, we introduce a one-shot pixel pulling method that effectively avoids error accumulation from repeated sampling while maintaining sub-pixel precision. To evaluate various VI methods in realistic scenarios, we also propose a high-quality VI benchmark, HQVI, comprising carefully generated videos using alpha matte composition. On public benchmarks and the HQVI dataset, our method demonstrates significantly higher visual quality and metric scores compared to existing solutions. Furthermore, it can process high-resolution videos exceeding 2K resolution with ease, underscoring its superiority for real-world applications.
abstract_ch: 视频修复（VI）是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要有效地在帧之间传播可观测内容，同时生成原始视频中不存在的新内容。在本研究中，我们提出了一种稳健且实用的VI框架，该框架结合了大型生成模型的参考生成与先进的像素传播算法。借助强大的生成模型，我们的方法不仅显著提升了对象移除的帧级质量，还能够根据用户提供的文本提示，在缺失区域合成新的内容。对于像素传播，我们引入了一次性像素拉取方法，该方法有效避免了重复采样引起的误差累积，同时保持了亚像素精度。为了在现实场景中评估各种VI方法，我们还提出了一种高质量的VI基准测试HQVI，其中包括使用alpha matte组合精心生成的视频。在公共基准测试和HQVI数据集上，我们的方法在视觉质量和度量得分方面均显著优于现有解决方案。此外，它能够轻松处理超过2K分辨率的高分辨率视频，突显了其在实际应用中的优越性。

title: EMHI: A Multimodal Egocentric Human Motion Dataset with HMD and Body-Worn IMUs
title_ch: EMHI：一种结合头戴式显示器和身体佩戴IMU的人本中心多模态人体动作数据集
authors: Zhen Fan;Peng Dai;Zhuo Su;Xu Gao;Zheng Lv;Jiarui Zhang;Tianyuan Du;Guidong Wang;Yang Zhang;
affiliations: PICO;
abstract: Egocentric human pose estimation (HPE) using wearable sensors is essential for VR/AR applications. Most methods rely solely on either egocentric-view images or sparse Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) signals, leading to inaccuracies due to self-occlusion in images or the sparseness and drift of inertial sensors. Most importantly, the lack of real-world datasets containing both modalities is a major obstacle to progress in this field. To overcome the barrier, we propose EMHI, a multimodal \textbf{E}gocentric human \textbf{M}otion dataset with \textbf{H}ead-Mounted Display (HMD) and body-worn \textbf{I}MUs, with all data collected under the real VR product suite. Specifically, EMHI provides synchronized stereo images from downward-sloping cameras on the headset and IMU data from body-worn sensors, along with pose annotations in SMPL format. This dataset consists of 885 sequences captured by 58 subjects performing 39 actions, totaling about 28.5 hours of recording. We evaluate the annotations by comparing them with optical marker-based SMPL fitting results. To substantiate the reliability of our dataset, we introduce MEPoser, a new baseline method for multimodal egocentric HPE, which employs a multimodal fusion encoder, temporal feature encoder, and MLP-based regression heads. The experiments on EMHI show that MEPoser outperforms existing single-modal methods and demonstrates the value of our dataset in solving the problem of egocentric HPE. We believe the release of EMHI and the method could advance the research of egocentric HPE and expedite the practical implementation of this technology in VR/AR products.
abstract_ch: 使用可穿戴传感器进行自躯干中心的人体姿态估计（HPE）对于VR/AR应用至关重要。大多数方法要么仅依赖于自躯干中心视角的图像，要么仅依赖稀疏的惯性测量单元（IMU）信号，这导致了由于图像中的自我遮挡或惯性传感器的稀疏性和漂移而导致的不准确性。尤为重要的是，缺乏包含这两种模态的真实世界数据集是该领域进展的主要障碍。为克服这一障碍，我们提出了一种名为EMHI的多模态自躯干中心人体运动数据集，该数据集结合了头戴式显示器（HMD）和身体佩戴的IMU，并在实际VR产品套件下收集了所有数据。具体而言，EMHI提供了同步的立体图像，这些图像来自头戴设备上向下倾斜的摄像头，以及来自身体佩戴传感器的IMU数据，并附有SMPL格式的姿态标注。该数据集包括58名受试者执行39种动作捕获的885个序列，总计约28.5小时的记录时间。我们通过将标注与基于光学标记的SMPL拟合结果进行比较来评估标注的准确性。为了证明我们数据集的可靠性，我们引入了MEPoser，这是一种新的多模态自躯干中心人体姿态估计基准方法，它采用多模态融合编码器、时间特征编码器和基于MLP的回归头部。在EMHI上的实验表明，MEPoser优于现有的单模态方法，并展示了我们数据集在解决自躯干中心人体姿态估计问题方面的价值。我们相信，EMHI的发布及其方法可以推动自躯干中心人体姿态估计的研究，并加速这项技术在VR/AR产品的实际应用。

title: Enhancing Low-Rank Adaptation with Recoverability-Based Reinforcement Pruning for Object Counting
title_ch: 基于可恢复性强化修剪以增强低秩适应性，用于目标计数
authors: Haojie Guo;Junyu Gao;Yuan Yuan;
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University;China Telecom;

title: Enhancing Robustness in Incremental Learning with Adversarial Training
title_ch: 通过对抗训练增强增量学习的鲁棒性
authors: Seungju Cho;Hongsin Lee;Changick Kim;
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;
abstract: Adversarial training is one of the most effective approaches against adversarial attacks. However, adversarial training has primarily been studied in scenarios where data for all classes is provided, with limited research conducted in the context of incremental learning where knowledge is introduced sequentially. In this study, we investigate Adversarially Robust Class Incremental Learning (ARCIL), which deals with adversarial robustness in incremental learning. We first explore a series of baselines that integrate incremental learning with existing adversarial training methods, finding that they lead to conflicts between acquiring new knowledge and retaining past knowledge. Furthermore, we discover that training new knowledge causes the disappearance of a key characteristic in robust models: a flat loss landscape in input space. To address such issues, we propose a novel and robust baseline for ARCIL, named \textbf{FL}atness-preserving \textbf{A}dversarial \textbf{I}ncremental learning for \textbf{R}obustness (\textbf{FLAIR}). Experimental results demonstrate that FLAIR significantly outperforms other baselines. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to comprehensively investigate the baselines, challenges, and solutions for ARCIL, which we believe represents a significant advance toward achieving real-world robustness. Codes are available at \url{https://github.com/HongsinLee/FLAIR}.
abstract_ch: 对抗训练是应对对抗攻击最有效的方法之一。然而，对抗训练主要是在所有类别数据都提供的情况下进行研究的，对于增量学习场景中的对抗鲁棒性研究相对较少，在这种场景下，知识是逐步引入的。在本研究中，我们探讨了对抗鲁棒增量分类学习（Adversarially Robust Class Incremental Learning, ARCIL），旨在处理增量学习中的对抗鲁棒性问题。我们首先探索了一系列将增量学习与现有对抗训练方法结合的基线，发现这些方法会导致获取新知识和保留旧知识之间的冲突。此外，我们发现引入新知识会引发一个问题：对抗鲁棒模型中的输入空间平坦损失景观消失。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新的、用于ARCIL的鲁棒基线，名为FLAtness-preservation Adversarial INcremental learning for RObustness（FLAIR）。实验结果表明，FLAIR显著优于其他基线。据我们所知，这是首次全面研究ARCIL的基线、挑战及解决方案，我们认为这代表了朝着实现实际应用中的对抗鲁棒性迈出的重要一步。相关代码可在https://github.com/HongsinLee/FLAIR获取。

title: EventMamba: Enhancing Spatio-Temporal Locality with State Space Models for Event-Based Video Reconstruction
title_ch: EventMamba：通过状态空间模型增强基于事件的视频重建的空间-时间局部性
authors: Chengjie Ge;Xueyang Fu;Peng He;Kunyu Wang;Chengzhi Cao;Zheng-Jun Zha;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;
abstract: Leveraging its robust linear global modeling capability, Mamba has notably excelled in computer vision. Despite its success, existing Mamba-based vision models have overlooked the nuances of event-driven tasks, especially in video reconstruction. Event-based video reconstruction (EBVR) demands spatial translation invariance and close attention to local event relationships in the spatio-temporal domain. Unfortunately, conventional Mamba algorithms apply static window partitions and standard reshape scanning methods, leading to significant losses in local connectivity. To overcome these limitations, we introduce EventMamba--a specialized model designed for EBVR tasks. EventMamba innovates by incorporating random window offset (RWO) in the spatial domain, moving away from the restrictive fixed partitioning. Additionally, it features a new consistent traversal serialization approach in the spatio-temporal domain, which maintains the proximity of adjacent events both spatially and temporally. These enhancements enable EventMamba to retain Mamba's robust modeling capabilities while significantly preserving the spatio-temporal locality of event data. Comprehensive testing on multiple datasets shows that EventMamba markedly enhances video reconstruction, drastically improving computation speed while delivering superior visual quality compared to Transformer-based methods.
abstract_ch: 利用其强大的线性全球建模能力，Mamba在计算机视觉领域表现尤为出色。尽管取得了成功，现有的基于Mamba的视觉模型在事件驱动任务方面仍然忽略了细节，特别是在视频重建方面。事件驱动的视频重建（EBVR）要求在空间-时间域内具有空间平移不变性和对局部事件关系的密切关注。然而，传统的Mamba算法采用静态窗口分区和标准的重塑扫描方法，导致局部连接性丧失。为克服这些限制，我们引入了EventMamba——一种专门针对EBVR任务的设计模型。EventMamba通过在空间域中引入随机窗口偏移（RWO），摆脱了固定的分区限制。此外，它还在空间-时间域中采用了新的一致遍历序列化方法，这种方法能够保持相邻事件在空间和时间上的接近性。这些改进使EventMamba能够在保留Mamba强大建模能力的同时，显著地保持事件数据的空间-时间局部性。在多个数据集上的全面测试表明，EventMamba在视频重建方面明显优于基于Transformer的方法，不仅大幅提高了计算速度，还提供了更优质的视觉效果。

title: Exploring Unbiased Deepfake Detection via Token-Level Shuffling and Mixing
title_ch: 通过令牌级别洗牌和混合探索公平的深度假信息检测
authors: Xinghe Fu;Zhiyuan Yan;Taiping Yao;Shen Chen;Xi Li;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Tencent;
abstract: The generalization problem is broadly recognized as a critical challenge in detecting deepfakes. Most previous work believes that the generalization gap is caused by the differences among various forgery methods. However, our investigation reveals that the generalization issue can still occur when forgery-irrelevant factors shift. In this work, we identify two biases that detectors may also be prone to overfitting: position bias and content bias, as depicted in Fig. 1. For the position bias, we observe that detectors are prone to lazily depending on the specific positions within an image (e.g., central regions even no forgery). As for content bias, we argue that detectors may potentially and mistakenly utilize forgery-unrelated information for detection (e.g., background, and hair). To intervene these biases, we propose two branches for shuffling and mixing with tokens in the latent space of transformers. For the shuffling branch, we rearrange the tokens and corresponding position embedding for each image while maintaining the local correlation. For the mixing branch, we randomly select and mix the tokens in the latent space between two images with the same label within the mini-batch to recombine the content information. During the learning process, we align the outputs of detectors from different branches in both feature space and logit space. Contrastive losses for features and divergence losses for logits are applied to obtain unbiased feature representation and classifiers. We demonstrate and verify the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments on widely used evaluation datasets.
abstract_ch: 普遍认为，泛化问题是在检测深度假信息时的一个关键挑战。大多数先前的工作都认为泛化差距是由各种伪造方法之间的差异引起的。然而，我们的研究揭示出，即使在伪造无关因素发生变化的情况下，泛化问题也可能出现。在这项工作中，我们识别出了两种可能使检测器过度拟合的偏差：位置偏差和内容偏差，如图1所示。对于位置偏差，我们观察到检测器倾向于懒惰地依赖图像中的特定位置（例如，即使没有伪造，也依赖于图像中心区域）。至于内容偏差，我们认为检测器可能会误用与伪造无关的信息来进行检测（例如，背景和头发）。为了干预这些偏差，我们提出了两个分支，在变压器的潜在空间中对令牌进行打乱和混合。在打乱分支中，我们在保持局部相关性的前提下重新排列每张图像及其对应的位置嵌入。而在混合分支中，我们在同一标签下的mini-batch中的两张图像之间随机选择并混合令牌以重组内容信息。在学习过程中，我们对来自不同分支的检测器的输出在特征空间和逻辑空间上进行对齐。我们使用对比损失来对齐特征，并使用离散损失来对齐逻辑，从而获得无偏的特征表示和分类器。通过在广泛使用的评估数据集上进行大量实验，我们展示了并验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Filter or Compensate: Towards Invariant Representation from Distribution Shift for Anomaly Detection
title_ch: 滤波或补偿：从分布偏移中获取不变表示以进行异常检测
authors: Zining Chen;Xingshuang Luo;Weiqiu Wang;Zhicheng Zhao;Fei Su;Aidong Men;
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications;Beijing Key Laboratory of Network System and Network Culture;Ministry of Culture and Tourism;
abstract: Recent Anomaly Detection (AD) methods have achieved great success with In-Distribution (ID) data. However, real-world data often exhibits distribution shift, causing huge performance decay on traditional AD methods. From this perspective, few previous work has explored AD with distribution shift, and the distribution-invariant normality learning has been proposed based on the Reverse Distillation (RD) framework. However, we observe the misalignment issue between the teacher and the student network that causes detection failure, thereby propose FiCo, Filter or Compensate, to address the distribution shift issue in AD. FiCo firstly compensates the distribution-specific information to reduce the misalignment between the teacher and student network via the Distribution-Specific Compensation (DiSCo) module, and secondly filters all abnormal information to capture distribution-invariant normality with the Distribution-Invariant Filter (DiIFi) module. Extensive experiments on three different AD benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of FiCo, which outperforms all existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, and even achieves better results on the ID scenario compared with RD-based methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/znchen666/FiCo.
abstract_ch: 近年来，最近异常检测（AD）方法在同分布（ID）数据上取得了巨大成功。然而，现实世界的数据常常表现出分布偏移，这导致了传统AD方法的巨大性能下降。从这个角度来看，很少有先前的工作探索了在分布偏移情况下的AD问题，基于逆蒸馏（Reverse Distillation, RD）框架提出了分布不变的正常性学习方法。然而，我们观察到教师网络和学生网络之间的对齐问题导致了检测失败，因此提出了一种名为FiCo（Filter or Compensate）的方法来解决AD中的分布偏移问题。FiCo首先通过分布特定补偿模块（Distribution-Specific Compensation, DiSCo）补偿分布特定的信息，以减少教师网络和学生网络之间的对齐偏差，其次通过分布不变滤波模块（Distribution-Invariant Filter, DiIFi）过滤所有异常信息，以捕捉分布不变的正常性。在三个不同的AD基准测试上的广泛实验表明，FiCo的有效性，它优于所有现有的最先进的（SOTA）方法，并且甚至在ID场景中比基于RD的方法表现更好。我们的代码可在https://github.com/znchen666/FiCo获取。

title: GGS: Generalizable Gaussian Splatting for Lane Switching in Autonomous Driving
title_ch: GGS：通用高斯渲染在自动驾驶中的车道切换应用
authors: Huasong Han;Kaixuan Zhou;Xiaoxiao Long;Yusen Wang;Chunxia Xiao;
affiliations: Wuhan University;Huawei;University of Hong Kong;
abstract: We propose GGS, a Generalizable Gaussian Splatting method for Autonomous Driving which can achieve realistic rendering under large viewpoint changes. Previous generalizable 3D gaussian splatting methods are limited to rendering novel views that are very close to the original pair of images, which cannot handle large differences in viewpoint. Especially in autonomous driving scenarios, images are typically collected from a single lane. The limited training perspective makes rendering images of a different lane very challenging. To further improve the rendering capability of GGS under large viewpoint changes, we introduces a novel virtual lane generation module into GSS method to enables high-quality lane switching even without a multi-lane dataset. Besides, we design a diffusion loss to supervise the generation of virtual lane image to further address the problem of lack of data in the virtual lanes. Finally, we also propose a depth refinement module to optimize depth estimation in the GSS model. Extensive validation of our method, compared to existing approaches, demonstrates state-of-the-art performance.
abstract_ch: 我们提出了一种通用高斯点绘制方法GGS（Generalizable Gaussian Splatting），该方法可以在大视角变化下实现逼真的渲染。之前的一些通用3D高斯点绘制方法仅限于渲染与原始图像对非常接近的新视角图像，无法处理视角之间的巨大差异。特别是在自动驾驶场景中，图像通常是从单一车道收集的。有限的训练视角使得在不同车道上生成高质量的图像变得非常具有挑战性。为了进一步提高GGS在大视角变化下的渲染能力，我们在GGS方法中引入了一个新颖的虚拟车道生成模块，即使没有多车道数据集也能实现高质量的车道切换。此外，我们设计了一种扩散损失来监督虚拟车道图像的生成，以进一步解决虚拟车道数据不足的问题。最后，我们还提出了一个深度细化模块，用于优化GSS模型中的深度估计。与现有方法相比，我们方法的广泛验证显示了其最先进的性能。

title: Gradient Alignment Improves Test-Time Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation
title_ch: 梯度对齐提高医学图像分割的测试时自适应能力
authors: Ziyang Chen;Yiwen Ye;Yongsheng Pan;Yong Xia;
affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University;
abstract: Although recent years have witnessed significant advancements in medical image segmentation, the pervasive issue of domain shift among medical images from diverse centres hinders the effective deployment of pre-trained models. Many Test-time Adaptation (TTA) methods have been proposed to address this issue by fine-tuning pre-trained models with test data during inference. These methods, however, often suffer from less-satisfactory optimization due to suboptimal optimization direction (dictated by the gradient) and fixed step-size (predicated on the learning rate). In this paper, we propose the Gradient alignment-based Test-time adaptation (GraTa) method to improve both the gradient direction and learning rate in the optimization procedure. Unlike conventional TTA methods, which primarily optimize the pseudo gradient derived from a self-supervised objective, our method incorporates an auxiliary gradient with the pseudo one to facilitate gradient alignment. Such gradient alignment enables the model to excavate the similarities between different gradients and correct the gradient direction to approximate the empirical gradient related to the current segmentation task. Additionally, we design a dynamic learning rate based on the cosine similarity between the pseudo and auxiliary gradients, thereby empowering the adaptive fine-tuning of pre-trained models on diverse test data. Extensive experiments establish the effectiveness of the proposed gradient alignment and dynamic learning rate and substantiate the superiority of our GraTa method over other state-of-the-art TTA methods on a benchmark medical image segmentation task. The code and weights of pre-trained source models are available at https://github.com/Chen-Ziyang/GraTa.
abstract_ch: 尽管近年来医学图像分割取得了显著进展，但来自不同中心的医学图像中的领域偏移问题阻碍了预训练模型的有效部署。许多测试时自适应（Test-time Adaptation, TTA）方法在推断过程中通过使用测试数据对预训练模型进行微调来解决这一问题。然而，这些方法往往由于次优的梯度方向优化（由梯度决定）和固定的步长（基于学习率预测）而优化效果不尽如人意。本文提出了一种基于梯度对齐的测试时自适应（GraTa）方法，以改进优化过程中的梯度方向和学习率。与传统的TTA方法主要优化从自我监督目标派生的伪梯度不同，我们的方法结合了伪梯度和辅助梯度以促进梯度对齐。这种梯度对齐使模型能够挖掘不同梯度之间的相似性，并校正梯度方向以逼近当前分割任务相关的经验梯度。此外，我们设计了一个基于伪梯度和辅助梯度余弦相似性的动态学习率，从而增强预训练模型在多样化的测试数据上的自适应微调能力。广泛的实验验证了所提出的梯度对齐和动态学习率的有效性，并证明了我们的GraTa方法在基准医学图像分割任务上优于其他最先进的TTA方法。预训练源模型的代码和权重可在https://github.com/Chen-Ziyang/GraTa获取。

title: Graphic Design with Large Multimodal Model
title_ch: 大型多模态模型图形设计
authors: Yutao Cheng;Zhao Zhang;Maoke Yang;Hui Nie;Chunyuan Li;Xinglong Wu;Jie Shao;
affiliations: ByteDance;Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: In the field of graphic design, automating the integration of design elements into a cohesive multi-layered artwork not only boosts productivity but also paves the way for the democratization of graphic design. One existing practice is Graphic Layout Generation (GLG), which aims to layout sequential design elements. It has been constrained by the necessity for a predefined correct sequence of layers, thus limiting creative potential and increasing user workload. In this paper, we present Hierarchical Layout Generation (HLG) as a more flexible and pragmatic setup, which creates graphic composition from unordered sets of design elements. To tackle the HLG task, we introduce Graphist, the first layout generation model based on large multimodal models. Graphist efficiently reframes the HLG as a sequence generation problem, utilizing RGB-A images as input, outputs a JSON draft protocol, indicating the coordinates, size, and order of each element. We develop new evaluation metrics for HLG. Graphist outperforms prior arts and establishes a strong baseline for this field. Project homepage: https://github.com/graphic-design-ai/graphist
abstract_ch: 在图形设计领域，自动化地将设计元素整合到一个连贯的多层作品中不仅能够提升生产力，还能促进图形设计的普及化。现有的做法之一是图形布局生成（GLG），其目标是排列顺序的设计元素。然而，GLG受到必须预先定义好正确图层顺序的限制，这不仅限制了创意潜力，还增加了用户的负担。在本文中，我们提出了层次布局生成（HLG）作为更灵活和实用的解决方案，它可以创建图形组成，从无序的设计元素集合开始。为了应对HLG任务，我们引入了Graphist，这是第一个基于大规模多模态模型的布局生成模型。Graphist高效地将HLG重新定义为序列生成问题，使用RGB-A图像作为输入，并输出一个JSON草图协议，指明每个元素的坐标、大小和顺序。我们还开发了新的评估指标来衡量HLG。Graphist在性能上优于先前的方法，并为该领域建立了强大的基准。项目主页：https://github.com/graphic-design-ai/graphist

title: Guided Real Image Dehazing Using YCbCr Color Space
title_ch: 使用YCbCr颜色空间引导去雾处理真实图像
authors: Wenxuan Fang;Junkai Fan;Yu Zheng;Jiangwei Weng;Ying Tai;Jun Li;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology;Nanjing University;
abstract: Image dehazing, particularly with learning-based methods, has gained significant attention due to its importance in real-world applications. However, relying solely on the RGB color space often fall short, frequently leaving residual haze. This arises from two main issues: the difficulty in obtaining clear textural features from hazy RGB images and the complexity of acquiring real haze/clean image pairs outside controlled environments like smoke-filled scenes. To address these issues, we first propose a novel Structure Guided Dehazing Network (SGDN) that leverages the superior structural properties of YCbCr features over RGB. It comprises two key modules: Bi-Color Guidance Bridge (BGB) and Color Enhancement Module (CEM). BGB integrates a phase integration module and an interactive attention module, utilizing the rich texture features of the YCbCr space to guide the RGB space, thereby recovering clearer features in both frequency and spatial domains. To maintain tonal consistency, CEM further enhances the color perception of RGB features by aggregating YCbCr channel information. Furthermore, for effective supervised learning, we introduce a Real-World Well-Aligned Haze (RW$^2$AH) dataset, which includes a diverse range of scenes from various geographical regions and climate conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple real-world smoke/haze datasets. Code and Dataset: \textcolor{blue}{\url{https://github.com/fiwy0527/AAAI25_SGDN.}}
abstract_ch: 基于学习的方法的图像去雾在实际应用中因其重要性而受到了广泛关注。然而，仅依赖RGB颜色空间往往效果不佳，经常留下残余的雾气。这主要源于两个问题：从有雾的RGB图像中获取清晰纹理特征的难度以及在烟雾弥漫等受控环境之外难以获得真实雾气/清晰图像对。为了解决这些问题，我们首先提出了一种新颖的结构引导去雾网络（SGDN），该网络利用YCbCr特征在结构上的优越性超越了RGB。它包含两个关键模块：双色引导桥（BGB）和颜色增强模块（CEM）。BGB整合了一个相位积分模块和一个交互注意力模块，通过利用YCbCr空间丰富的纹理特征来引导RGB空间，从而在频域和空域上恢复更清晰的特征。为了保持色调一致性，CEM进一步通过聚合YCbCr通道信息增强了RGB特征的颜色感知能力。此外，为了实现有效的监督学习，我们引入了一个名为Real-World Well-Aligned Haze（RW²AH）的数据集，该数据集涵盖了来自不同地理区域和气候条件下的多种场景。实验结果表明，我们的方法在多个实际烟雾/雾气数据集中超过了现有最先进的方法。代码和数据集：[https://github.com/fiwy0527/AAAI25_SGDN.]

title: HGSFusion: Radar-Camera Fusion with Hybrid Generation and Synchronization for 3D Object Detection
title_ch: HGSFusion：雷达-摄像头融合技术，结合混合生成与同步进行三维目标检测
authors: Zijian Gu;Jianwei Ma;Yan Huang;Honghao Wei;Zhanye Chen;Hui Zhang;Wei Hong;
affiliations: Southeast University;Washington State University;
abstract: Millimeter-wave radar plays a vital role in 3D object detection for autonomous driving due to its all-weather and all-lighting-condition capabilities for perception. However, radar point clouds suffer from pronounced sparsity and unavoidable angle estimation errors. To address these limitations, incorporating a camera may partially help mitigate the shortcomings. Nevertheless, the direct fusion of radar and camera data can lead to negative or even opposite effects due to the lack of depth information in images and low-quality image features under adverse lighting conditions. Hence, in this paper, we present the radar-camera fusion network with Hybrid Generation and Synchronization (HGSFusion), designed to better fuse radar potentials and image features for 3D object detection. Specifically, we propose the Radar Hybrid Generation Module (RHGM), which fully considers the Direction-Of-Arrival (DOA) estimation errors in radar signal processing. This module generates denser radar points through different Probability Density Functions (PDFs) with the assistance of semantic information. Meanwhile, we introduce the Dual Sync Module (DSM), comprising spatial sync and modality sync, to enhance image features with radar positional information and facilitate the fusion of distinct characteristics in different modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, outperforming the state-of-the-art methods in the VoD and TJ4DRadSet datasets by $6.53\%$ and $2.03\%$ in RoI AP and BEV AP, respectively. The code is available at https://github.com/garfield-cpp/HGSFusion.
abstract_ch: 毫米波雷达在自动驾驶中的三维物体检测中发挥着至关重要的作用，得益于其在各种天气和光照条件下的感知能力。然而，雷达点云存在明显的稀疏性和不可避免的角度估计误差。为了解决这些限制，引入摄像头可以在一定程度上缓解这些问题。不过，直接融合雷达和摄像头数据可能会导致负面影响甚至相反效果，因为图像缺乏深度信息，并且在恶劣光照条件下特征质量较低。因此，在本文中，我们提出了结合混合生成与同步（HGSFusion）的雷达-摄像头融合网络，旨在更好地融合雷达潜力和图像特征以实现三维物体检测。具体来说，我们提出了一种雷达混合生成模块（RHGM），该模块充分考虑了雷达信号处理中的到达方向（Direction-Of-Arrival, DOA）估计误差。通过利用语义信息，该模块使用不同的概率密度函数（Probability Density Functions, PDFs）生成更密集的雷达点云。同时，我们引入了双模态同步模块（Dual Sync Module, DSM），包括空间同步和模态同步，以增强图像特征并利用雷达位置信息，从而促进不同模态特征之间的融合。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法非常有效，在VoD和TJ4DRadSet数据集中分别在RoI AP和BEV AP方面优于最先进的方法，提高了6.53%和2.03%。代码可在https://github.com/garfield-cpp/HGSFusion获取。

title: HybridReg: Robust 3D Point Cloud Registration with Hybrid Motions
title_ch: HybridReg：具有混合运动的鲁棒三维点云注册
authors: Keyu Du;Hao Xu;Haipeng Li;Hong Qu;Chi-Wing Fu;Shuaicheng Liu;
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Megvii Technology;
abstract: Scene-level point cloud registration is very challenging when considering dynamic foregrounds. Existing indoor datasets mostly assume rigid motions, so the trained models cannot robustly handle scenes with non-rigid motions. On the other hand, non-rigid datasets are mainly object-level, so the trained models cannot generalize well to complex scenes. This paper presents HybridReg, a new approach to 3D point cloud registration, learning uncertainty mask to account for hybrid motions: rigid for backgrounds and non-rigid/rigid for instance-level foregrounds. First, we build a scene-level 3D registration dataset, namely HybridMatch, designed specifically with strategies to arrange diverse deforming foregrounds in a controllable manner. Second, we account for different motion types and formulate a mask-learning module to alleviate the interference of deforming outliers. Third, we exploit a simple yet effective negative log-likelihood loss to adopt uncertainty to guide the feature extraction and correlation computation. To our best knowledge, HybridReg is the first work that exploits hybrid motions for robust point cloud registration. Extensive experiments show HybridReg's strengths, leading it to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both widely-used indoor and outdoor datasets.
abstract_ch: 在考虑动态前景时，场景级别的点云注册非常具有挑战性。现有的室内数据集大多假设刚性运动，因此训练好的模型无法稳健地处理包含非刚性运动的场景。另一方面，非刚性数据集主要是对象级别的，所以训练好的模型难以很好地泛化到复杂的场景中。本文提出了一种新的三维点云注册方法——HybridReg，该方法学习不确定性掩码以应对混合运动：背景采用刚性运动，而实例级别的前景则采用非刚性和刚性运动。首先，我们构建了一个场景级别的3D注册数据集，即HybridMatch，该数据集特别设计了策略以可控的方式安排多样化的变形前景。其次，我们考虑了不同类型的运动，并制定了一个掩码学习模块来减轻变形离群值的干扰。第三，我们利用一种简单有效的负对数似然损失函数，通过不确定性指导特征提取和相关计算。据我们所知，HybridReg是首个利用混合运动实现稳健点云注册的工作。大量实验表明，HybridReg具有显著优势，在广泛使用的室内和室外数据集上均实现了最先进的性能。

title: ID-Sculpt: ID-aware 3D Head Generation from Single In-the-wild Portrait Image
title_ch: ID-Sculpt：基于单张真实世界肖像图像的身份感知3D头像生成
authors: Jinkun Hao;Junshu Tang;Jiangning Zhang;Ran Yi;Yijia Hong;Moran Li;Weijian Cao;Yating Wang;Chengjie Wang;Lizhuang Ma;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Tencent;
abstract: While recent works have achieved great success on image-to-3D object generation, high quality and fidelity 3D head generation from a single image remains a great challenge. Previous text-based methods for generating 3D heads were limited by text descriptions and image-based methods struggled to produce high-quality head geometry. To handle this challenging problem, we propose a novel framework, ID-Sculpt, to generate high-quality 3D heads while preserving their identities. Our work incorporates the identity information of the portrait image into three parts: 1) geometry initialization, 2) geometry sculpting, and 3) texture generation stages. Given a reference portrait image, we first align the identity features with text features to realize ID-aware guidance enhancement, which contains the control signals representing the face information. We then use the canny map, ID features of the portrait image, and a pre-trained text-to-normal/depth diffusion model to generate ID-aware geometry supervision, and 3D-GAN inversion is employed to generate ID-aware geometry initialization. Furthermore, with the ability to inject identity information into 3D head generation, we use ID-aware guidance to calculate ID-aware Score Distillation (ISD) for geometry sculpting. For texture generation, we adopt the ID Consistent Texture Inpainting and Refinement which progressively expands the view for texture inpainting to obtain an initialization UV texture map. We then use the ID-aware guidance to provide image-level supervision for noisy multi-view images to obtain a refined texture map. Extensive experiments demonstrate that we can generate high-quality 3D heads with accurate geometry and texture from a single in-the-wild portrait image.
abstract_ch: 尽管近期的工作在图像到3D对象生成方面取得了巨大成功，但从单张图像生成高质量和高保真度的3D头部仍然是一项巨大的挑战。以往基于文本的方法受限于文本描述，而基于图像的方法则难以产生高质量的头部几何形状。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——ID-Sculpt，以生成高质量的3D头部同时保留其身份信息。我们的工作将肖像图像的身份信息整合到三个阶段中：1）几何初始化，2）几何塑造，以及3）纹理生成阶段。给定一张参考肖像图像，我们首先对身份特征与文本特征进行对齐，实现身份感知的指导增强，这包含了代表面部信息的控制信号。然后，我们利用Canny图、肖像图像的身份特征以及预训练的文本到法线/深度扩散模型来生成身份感知的几何监督，并使用3D-GAN反转生成身份感知的几何初始化。此外，凭借能够将身份信息注入3D头部生成的能力，我们使用身份感知的指导计算身份感知的评分精炼（Score Distillation，简称SD）用于几何塑造。对于纹理生成，我们采用身份一致的纹理修复和细化方法，逐步扩展视角以获得初始UV纹理图。接着，我们利用身份感知的指导为噪声多视角图像提供图像级监督，以获得细化后的纹理图。广泛的实验表明，我们可以从野外拍摄的一张肖像图像中生成具有准确几何形状和纹理的高质量3D头部。

title: Implicit Location-Caption Alignment via Complementary Masking for Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning
title_ch: 通过互补掩码实现隐式位置-描述对齐的弱监督密集视频描述
authors: Shiping Ge;Qiang Chen;Zhiwei Jiang;Yafeng Yin;Liu Qin;Ziyao Chen;Qing Gu;
affiliations: Nanjing University;Tencent;
abstract: Weakly-Supervised Dense Video Captioning (WSDVC) aims to localize and describe all events of interest in a video without requiring annotations of event boundaries. This setting poses a great challenge in accurately locating the temporal location of event, as the relevant supervision is unavailable. Existing methods rely on explicit alignment constraints between event locations and captions, which involve complex event proposal procedures during both training and inference. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel implicit location-caption alignment paradigm by complementary masking, which simplifies the complex event proposal and localization process while maintaining effectiveness. Specifically, our model comprises two components: a dual-mode video captioning module and a mask generation module. The dual-mode video captioning module captures global event information and generates descriptive captions, while the mask generation module generates differentiable positive and negative masks for localizing the events. These masks enable the implicit alignment of event locations and captions by ensuring that captions generated from positively and negatively masked videos are complementary, thereby forming a complete video description. In this way, even under weak supervision, the event location and event caption can be aligned implicitly. Extensive experiments on the public datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms existing weakly-supervised methods and achieves competitive results compared to fully-supervised methods.
abstract_ch: 弱监督密集视频描述（WSDVC）的目标是在无需事件边界标注的情况下，定位并描述视频中的所有感兴趣事件。这一设置在准确确定事件的时间位置方面提出了巨大挑战，因为缺乏相关的监督信息。现有方法依赖于事件位置与描述之间的显式对齐约束，这需要在训练和推理过程中进行复杂的事件提案程序。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的互补掩码隐式事件-描述对齐范式，简化了复杂的事件提案和定位过程，同时保持了有效性。具体而言，我们的模型包含两个组件：一种双模式视频描述模块和一个掩码生成模块。双模式视频描述模块捕捉全局事件信息并生成描述性描述，而掩码生成模块则生成可微分的正负掩码以定位事件。这些掩码通过确保来自正负掩码视频生成的描述互补，从而实现事件位置和描述的隐式对齐，形成完整的视频描述。这样，在弱监督条件下，事件位置和事件描述可以实现隐式对齐。在公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的弱监督方法，并且在与全监督方法的比较中取得了竞争力的结果。

title: IniRetinex: Rethinking Retinex-type Low-Light Image Enhancer via Initialization Perspective
title_ch: IniRetinex：从初始化角度重思Retinex类型低光图像增强器
