title: Zero-Shot Scene Change Detection
title_ch: 零样本场景变更检测
authors: Kyusik Cho;Dong Yeop Kim;Euntai Kim;
affiliations: Yonsei University;Korea Electronics Technology Institute;
abstract: We present a novel, training-free approach to scene change detection. Our method leverages tracking models, which inherently perform change detection between consecutive frames of video by identifying common objects and detecting new or missing objects. Specifically, our method takes advantage of the change detection effect of the tracking model by inputting reference and query images instead of consecutive frames. Furthermore, we focus on the content gap and style gap between two input images in change detection, and address both issues by proposing adaptive content threshold and style bridging layers, respectively. Finally, we extend our approach to video, leveraging rich temporal information to enhance the performance of scene change detection. We compare our approach and baseline through various experiments. While existing train-based baseline tend to specialize only in the trained domain, our method shows consistent performance across various domains, proving the competitiveness of our approach.
abstract_ch: 我们提出了一种全新的、无需训练的方法来进行场景变化检测。该方法利用了跟踪模型的优势，这些模型本质上通过识别连续视频帧中的共同对象并检测新出现或缺失的对象来执行变化检测。具体来说，我们的方法通过输入参考图像和查询图像而不是连续帧来利用跟踪模型的变化检测效果。此外，在场景变化检测中，我们关注两幅输入图像之间的内容差距和风格差距，并分别通过提出自适应内容阈值层和风格桥梁层来解决这些问题。最后，我们将该方法扩展到视频领域，利用丰富的时序信息来增强场景变化检测的效果。我们通过各种实验将我们的方法与基线进行比较。虽然现有的基于训练的基线方法仅在训练过的领域内表现出专业化，但我们的方法在各种领域中都显示出了稳定的性能，证明了我们方法的竞争性。

title: A Method for Enhancing Generalization of Adam by Multiple Integrations
title_ch: 通过多次集成增强Adam算法泛化能力的方法
authors: Long Jin;Han Nong;Liangming Chen;Zhenming Su;
affiliations: Lanzhou University;
abstract: The insufficient generalization of adaptive moment estimation (Adam) has hindered its broader application. Recent studies have shown that flat minima in loss landscapes are highly associated with improved generalization. Inspired by the filtering effect of integration operations on high-frequency signals, we propose multiple integral Adam (MIAdam), a novel optimizer that integrates a multiple integral term into Adam. This multiple integral term effectively filters out sharp minima encountered during optimization, guiding the optimizer towards flatter regions and thereby enhancing generalization capability. We provide a theoretical explanation for the improvement in generalization through the diffusion theory framework and analyze the impact of the multiple integral term on the optimizer's convergence. Experimental results demonstrate that MIAdam not only enhances generalization and robustness against label noise but also maintains the rapid convergence characteristic of Adam, outperforming Adam and its variants in state-of-the-art benchmarks.
abstract_ch: 自适应矩估计（Adam）泛化不足的问题限制了其更广泛的应用。最近的研究表明，在损失景观中平坦极小值与更好的泛化密切相关。受积分运算对高频信号的滤波效应启发，我们提出了一种新型优化器——多重积分Adam（MIAdam），该优化器将多重积分项融入到Adam中。这种多重积分项有效地过滤掉了优化过程中遇到的尖锐极小值，引导优化器向更平坦的区域移动，从而增强泛化能力。我们通过扩散理论框架提供了改进泛化的理论解释，并分析了多重积分项对优化器收敛性的影响。实验结果表明，MIAdam 不仅增强了泛化能力和对抗标签噪声的鲁棒性，还保持了Adam及其变体的快速收敛特性，在最先进的基准测试中表现出色。

title: ARNet: Self-Supervised FG-SBIR with Unified Sample Feature Alignment and Multi-Scale Token Recycling
title_ch: ARNet：统一样本特征对齐与多尺度令牌回收的自监督前景-背景部分实例检索
authors: Jianan Jiang;Hao Tang;Zhilin Jiang;Weiren Yu;Di Wu;
affiliations: Hunan University;ExponentiAI Innovation;Peking University;University of Warwick;
abstract: Fine-Grained Sketch-Based Image Retrieval (FG-SBIR) aims to minimize the distance between sketches and corresponding images in the embedding space. However, scalability is hindered by the growing complexity of solutions, mainly due to the abstract nature of fine-grained sketches. In this paper, we propose an effective approach to narrow the gap between the two domains. It mainly facilitates unified mutual information sharing both intra- and inter-samples, rather than treating them as a single feature alignment problem between modalities. Specifically, our approach includes: (i) Employing dual weight-sharing networks to optimize alignment within the sketch and image domain, which also effectively mitigates model learning saturation issues. (ii) Introducing an objective optimization function based on contrastive loss to enhance the model's ability to align features in both intra- and inter-samples. (iii) Presenting a self-supervised Multi-Scale Token Recycling (MSTR) Module featured by recycling discarded patch tokens in multi-scale features, further enhancing representation capability and retrieval performance. Our framework achieves excellent results on CNN- and ViT-based backbones. Extensive experiments demonstrate its superiority over existing methods. We also introduce Cloths-V1, the first professional fashion sketch-image dataset, utilized to validate our method and will be beneficial for other applications.
abstract_ch: 细粒度草图基于图像检索（FG-SBIR）的目标是在嵌入空间中最小化草图与对应图像之间的距离。然而，由于细粒度草图的抽象性质导致解决方案日益复杂，可扩展性受到了限制。在本文中，我们提出了一种有效的方法来缩小这两个领域之间的差距。该方法主要促进统一的互信息在样本内和样本间共享，而不是将它们视为模态间单一特征对齐问题。具体来说，我们的方法包括：(i) 使用双权重共享网络优化草图和图像域内的对齐，这也有助于有效缓解模型学习饱和的问题。(ii) 引入基于对比损失的目标优化函数，以增强模型在样本内和样本间对特征进行对齐的能力。(iii) 提出一种自我监督的多尺度令牌回收（MSTR）模块，该模块通过在多尺度特征中回收丢弃的patch令牌，进一步增强表示能力和检索性能。我们的框架在基于CNN和ViT的骨干网络上取得了优异的结果。广泛的实验表明，它优于现有方法。我们还介绍了Cloths-V1，这是首个专业时尚草图图像数据集，用于验证我们的方法，并且对于其他应用也将是有益的。

title: BloomScene: Lightweight Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting for Crossmodal Scene Generation
title_ch: BloomScene：轻量级结构化3D高斯点渲染以实现跨模态场景生成
authors: Xiaolu Hou;Mingcheng Li;Dingkang Yang;Jiawei Chen;Ziyun Qian;Xiao Zhao;Yue Jiang;Jinjie Wei;Qingyao Xu;Lihua Zhang;
affiliations: Fudan University;Engineering Research Center of AI and Robotics;Jilin University;Jilin Province Artificial Intelligence and Unmanned Systems Engineering Research Center;
abstract: With the widespread use of virtual reality applications, 3D scene generation has become a new challenging research frontier. 3D scenes have highly complex structures and need to ensure that the output is dense, coherent, and contains all necessary structures. Many current 3D scene generation methods rely on pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models and monocular depth estimators. However, the generated scenes occupy large amounts of storage space and often lack effective regularisation methods, leading to geometric distortions. To this end, we propose BloomScene, a lightweight structured 3D Gaussian splatting for crossmodal scene generation, which creates diverse and high-quality 3D scenes from text or image inputs. Specifically, a crossmodal progressive scene generation framework is proposed to generate coherent scenes utilizing incremental point cloud reconstruction and 3D Gaussian splatting. Additionally, we propose a hierarchical depth prior-based regularization mechanism that utilizes multi-level constraints on depth accuracy and smoothness to enhance the realism and continuity of the generated scenes. Ultimately, we propose a structured context-guided compression mechanism that exploits structured hash grids to model the context of unorganized anchor attributes, which significantly eliminates structural redundancy and reduces storage overhead. Comprehensive experiments across multiple scenes demonstrate the significant potential and advantages of our framework compared with several baselines.
abstract_ch: 随着虚拟现实应用的广泛使用，3D场景生成已成为一个新的具有挑战性的研究前沿。3D场景结构极其复杂，需要确保输出的密度、连贯性，并包含所有必要的结构。目前许多3D场景生成方法依赖于预训练的文字到图像扩散模型和单目深度估计器。然而，生成的场景占用大量存储空间，并且常常缺乏有效的正则化方法，导致几何失真。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为BloomScene的轻量级结构化3D高斯点云聚合方法，用于跨模态场景生成，能够从文字或图像输入中生成多样且高质量的3D场景。具体而言，我们提出了一种跨模态渐进式场景生成框架，利用增量点云重建和3D高斯点云聚合生成连贯的场景。此外，我们还提出了一种分层深度先验为基础的正则化机制，通过多层次的深度准确性和平滑性约束来增强生成场景的真实感和连续性。最后，我们提出了一个结构化上下文引导压缩机制，利用结构化的哈希网格来建模无序锚属性的上下文，显著减少了结构冗余并降低了存储开销。在多个场景的全面实验中，我们的框架与几个基线相比展现了巨大的潜力和优势。

title: Bridging the Semantic Granularity Gap Between Text and Frame Representations for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
title_ch: 文本和框架表示之间弥合语义粒度差距以实现部分相关视频检索
authors: WooJin Jun;WonJun Moon;Cheol-Ho Cho;MinSeok Jung;Jae-Pil Heo;
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University;

title: BUFF: Bayesian Uncertainty Guided Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Single Image Super-Resolution
title_ch: Buff：贝叶斯不确定性引导扩散的概率模型用于单张图像超分辨率
authors: Zihao He;Shengchuan Zhang;Runze Hu;Yunhang Shen;Yan Zhang;
affiliations: Xiamen University;Tsinghua University;Tencent;
abstract: Super-resolution (SR) techniques are critical for enhancing image quality, particularly in scenarios where high-resolution imagery is essential yet limited by hardware constraints. Existing diffusion models for SR have relied predominantly on Gaussian models for noise generation, which often fall short when dealing with the complex and variable texture inherent in natural scenes. To address these deficiencies, we introduce the Bayesian Uncertainty Guided Diffusion Probabilistic Model (BUFF). BUFF distinguishes itself by incorporating a Bayesian network to generate high-resolution uncertainty masks. These masks guide the diffusion process, allowing for the adjustment of noise intensity in a manner that is both context-aware and adaptive. This novel approach not only enhances the fidelity of super-resolved images to their original high-resolution counterparts but also significantly mitigates artifacts and blurring in areas characterized by complex textures and fine details. The model demonstrates exceptional robustness against complex noise patterns and showcases superior adaptability in handling textures and edges within images. Empirical evidence, supported by visual results, illustrates the model's robustness, especially in challenging scenarios, and its effectiveness in addressing common SR issues such as blurring. Experimental evaluations conducted on the DIV2K dataset reveal that BUFF achieves a notable improvement, with a +0.61 increase compared to baseline in SSIM on BSD100, surpassing traditional diffusion approaches by an average additional +0.20dB PSNR gain. These findings underscore the potential of Bayesian methods in enhancing diffusion processes for SR, paving the way for future advancements in the field.
abstract_ch: 超分辨率（SR）技术对于提升图像质量至关重要，特别是在高分辨率图像需求迫切但受限于硬件条件的情况下。现有的SR扩散模型主要依赖高斯模型生成噪声，但在处理自然场景中复杂多变的纹理时往往表现不佳。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了贝叶斯不确定性引导扩散概率模型（BUFF）。BUFF的独特之处在于它结合了贝叶斯网络来生成高分辨率的不确定性掩码。这些掩码指导扩散过程，使得噪声强度可以根据上下文进行调整和适应。这一新颖的方法不仅增强了超分辨率图像与原始高分辨率图像的一致性，还显著减少了复杂纹理和细节点区域中的伪影和模糊现象。该模型在对抗复杂噪声模式方面表现出色，并且在处理图像中的纹理和边缘方面具有优越的适应性。实验证据，包括视觉结果，证明了该模型在挑战性场景中的稳健性及其有效应对SR常见问题（如模糊）的能力。在DIV2K数据集上的实验评估显示，BUFF相比基线方法在BSD100上的SSIM提高了0.61，在平均PSNR增益上提高了额外的0.20dB。这些发现突显了贝叶斯方法在增强SR扩散过程方面的潜力，为未来该领域的进步铺平了道路。

title: C2PD: Continuity-Constrained Pixelwise Deformation for Guided Depth Super-Resolution
title_ch: C2PD：连续性约束像素级变形引导深度超分辨率
authors: Jiahui Kang;Qing Cai;Runqing Tan;Yimei Liu;Zhi Liu;
affiliations: Ocean University of China;Shandong University;
abstract: Guided depth super-resolution (GDSR) has demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of domains, with numerous methods being proposed. However, existing methods often treat depth maps as images, where shading values are computed discretely, making them struggle to effectively restore the continuity inherent in the depth map. In this paper, we propose a novel approach that maximizes the utilization of spatial characteristics in depth, coupled with human abstract perception of real-world substance, by transforming the GDSR issue into deformation of a roughcast with ideal plasticity, which can be deformed by force like a continuous object. Specifically, we firstly designed a cross-modal operation, Continuity-constrained Asymmetrical Pixelwise Operation (CAPO), which can mimic the process of deforming an isovolumetrically flexible object through external forces. Utilizing CAPO as the fundamental component, we develop the Pixelwise Cross Gradient Deformation (PCGD), which is capable of emulating operations on ideal plastic objects (without volume constraint). Notably, our approach demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across four widely adopted benchmarks for GDSR, with significant advantages in large-scale tasks and generalizability.
abstract_ch: 引导深度超分辨率（GDSR）已经在众多领域展示了出色的性能，并且提出了许多方法。然而，现有的方法往往将深度图视为图像，其中阴影值被离散地计算，这使得它们难以有效地恢复深度图中存在的连续性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，该方法通过将GDSR问题转化为理想塑性材料的粗胚变形，最大化利用深度的空间特性，并结合人类对现实物质的抽象感知。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种跨模态操作——连续性约束非对称像素级操作（CAPO），它可以模拟在外力作用下等体积柔性物体变形的过程。利用CAPO作为基本组件，我们开发了像素级交叉梯度变形（PCGD），能够模拟无体积约束的理想塑性物体的操作。值得注意的是，我们的方法在四个广泛采用的GDSR基准测试中表现出了最先进的性能，在大规模任务和泛化能力方面具有显著优势。

title: CLIP-RestoreX: Restore Image Structure and Perception in Exposure Correction
title_ch: CLIP-RestoreX：在曝光校正中恢复图像结构和感知
authors: Xiang Huang;Qing Zhang;Jian-Fang Hu;Wei-Shi Zheng;
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University;Key Laboratory of Machine Intelligence and Advanced Computing;

title: CodecNeRF: Toward Fast Encoding and Decoding, Compact, and High-quality Novel-view Synthesis
title_ch: CodecNeRF：朝向快速编码与解码、紧凑且高质量的新视角合成
authors: Gyeongjin Kang;Younggeun Lee;Seungjun Oh;Eunbyung Park;
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University;
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have achieved huge success in effectively capturing and representing 3D objects and scenes. However, to establish a ubiquitous presence in everyday media formats, such as images and videos, we need to fulfill three key objectives: 1. fast encoding and decoding time, 2. compact model sizes, and 3. high-quality renderings. Despite recent advancements, a comprehensive algorithm that adequately addresses all objectives has yet to be fully realized. In this work, we present CodecNeRF, a neural codec for NeRF representations, consisting of an encoder and decoder architecture that can generate a NeRF representation in a single forward pass. Furthermore, inspired by the recent parameter-efficient finetuning approaches, we propose a finetuning method to efficiently adapt the generated NeRF representations to a new test instance, leading to high-quality image renderings and compact code sizes. The proposed CodecNeRF, a newly suggested encoding-decoding-finetuning pipeline for NeRF, achieved unprecedented compression performance of more than 100x and remarkable reduction in encoding time while maintaining (or improving) the image quality on widely used 3D object datasets.
abstract_ch: 神经辐射场（NeRF）在有效捕捉和表示3D对象和场景方面取得了巨大成功。然而，为了在日常媒体格式，如图像和视频中实现普遍的应用，我们需要满足三个关键目标：1. 快速的编码和解码时间，2. 紧凑的模型大小，以及3. 高质量的渲染效果。尽管最近有所进展，但一个全面的算法仍未能充分解决所有这些目标。在此项工作中，我们提出了CodecNeRF，这是一种用于NeRF表示的神经编解码器，它包含一个可以在单一前向传播过程中生成NeRF表示的编码器和解码器架构。此外，受近期参数高效微调方法的启发，我们提出了一种微调方法，以高效地适应生成的NeRF表示，从而获得高质量的图像渲染效果和紧凑的代码大小。所提出的CodecNeRF，在广泛使用的3D对象数据集上保持或提高了图像质量的同时，实现了超过100倍的前所未有的压缩性能，并显著减少了编码时间。

title: Color Transfer with Modulated Flows
title_ch: 调制流的颜色迁移
authors: Maria Larchenko;Alexander Lobashev;Dmitry Guskov;Vladimir Vladimirovich Palyulin;
affiliations: Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology;
abstract: In this work, we introduce Modulated Flows (ModFlows), a novel approach for color transfer between images based on rectified flows. The primary goal of the color transfer is to adjust the colors of a target image to match the color distribution of a reference image. Our technique is based on optimal transport and executes color transfer as an invertible transformation within the RGB color space. The ModFlows utilizes the bijective property of flows, enabling us to introduce a common intermediate color distribution and build a dataset of rectified flows. We train an encoder on this dataset to predict the weights of a rectified model for new images. After training on a set of optimal transport plans, our approach can generate plans for new pairs of distributions without additional fine-tuning. We additionally show that the trained encoder provides an image embedding, associated only with its color style. The presented method is capable of processing 4K images and achieves the state-of-the-art performance in terms of content and style similarity. Our source code is available at https://github.com/maria-larchenko/modflows
abstract_ch: 在本工作中，我们介绍了调制流（ModFlows），这是一种基于修正流的颜色图像间转移的新方法。颜色转移的主要目标是调整目标图像的颜色以匹配参考图像的颜色分布。我们的技术基于最优传输理论，并将颜色转移执行为RGB颜色空间内的可逆变换。ModFlows利用流的双射性质，使我们能够引入一个共同的中间颜色分布并构建一个修正流的数据集。我们训练了一个编码器，在这个数据集上预测新图像的修正模型权重。经过一系列最优传输计划的训练后，我们的方法可以生成新的颜色分布对的传输计划，而无需额外的微调。此外，我们还展示了训练后的编码器提供了仅与图像颜色风格相关的图像嵌入。所提出的方法能够处理4K图像，并在内容和风格相似性方面达到最先进的性能。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/maria-larchenko/modflows获取。

title: COLUMBUS: Evaluating COgnitive Lateral Understanding Through Multiple-Choice reBUSes
title_ch: 认知横向理解的评估：通过多项选择reBUS测试
authors: Koen Kraaijveld;Yifan Jiang;Kaixin Ma;Filip Ilievski;
affiliations: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam;University of Southern California;Tencent;
abstract: While visual question-answering (VQA) benchmarks have catalyzed the development of reasoning techniques, they have focused on vertical thinking. Effective problem-solving also necessitates lateral thinking, which remains understudied in AI and has not been used to test visual perception systems. To bridge this gap, we formulate visual lateral thinking as a multiple-choice question-answering task and describe a three-step taxonomy-driven methodology for instantiating task examples. Then, we develop COLUMBUS, a synthetic benchmark that applies the task pipeline to create QA sets with text and icon rebus puzzles based on publicly available collections of compounds and common phrases. COLUMBUS comprises over 1,000 puzzles, each with four answer candidates. While the SotA vision-language models (VLMs) achieve decent performance, our evaluation demonstrates a substantial gap between humans and models. VLMs benefit from human-curated descriptions but struggle to self-generate such representations at the right level of abstraction.
abstract_ch: 尽管视觉问答（VQA）基准测试促进了推理技术的发展，它们主要关注的是垂直思考。有效的解决问题还需要横向思考，而这种思考方式在人工智能领域尚未得到充分研究，并未被用于测试视觉感知系统。为了弥合这一差距，我们将视觉横向思考形式化为一个多选题回答任务，并描述了一个三步分类驱动的方法论，用于实例化任务示例。然后，我们开发了COLUMBUS，这是一个合成基准测试，将任务管道应用于基于公开可用的化合物和常用短语集合创建包含文字和图标谜语的问答集。COLUMBUS包含了超过1,000个谜语，每个谜语都有四个答案选项。虽然最先进的视觉语言模型（VLMs）取得了不错的性能，但我们的评估表明，人类与模型之间存在显著的差距。视觉语言模型受益于人工策划的描述，但在生成适当抽象级别的此类表示方面却面临挑战。

title: Constructing Fair Latent Space for Intersection of Fairness and Explainability
title_ch: 构建公平与可解释性交集的公平潜在空间
authors: Hyungjun Joo;Hyeonggeun Han;Sehwan Kim;Sangwoo Hong;Jungwoo Lee;
affiliations: Seoul National University;HodooAI Labs;
abstract: As the use of machine learning models has increased, numerous studies have aimed to enhance fairness. However, research on the intersection of fairness and explainability remains insufficient, leading to potential issues in gaining the trust of actual users. Here, we propose a novel module that constructs a fair latent space, enabling faithful explanation while ensuring fairness. The fair latent space is constructed by disentangling and redistributing labels and sensitive attributes, allowing the generation of counterfactual explanations for each type of information. Our module is attached to a pretrained generative model, transforming its biased latent space into a fair latent space. Additionally, since only the module needs to be trained, there are advantages in terms of time and cost savings, without the need to train the entire generative model. We validate the fair latent space with various fairness metrics and demonstrate that our approach can effectively provide explanations for biased decisions and assurances of fairness.
abstract_ch: 随着机器学习模型的应用增加，许多研究致力于提高公平性。然而，关于公平性和可解释性的交叉研究仍然不足，这可能导致实际用户对这些模型的信任度降低。在此，我们提出了一种新颖的模块，用于构建一个公平的潜在空间，该模块能够在确保公平性的前提下提供忠实的解释。公平的潜在空间通过分离和重新分配标签和敏感属性来构建，从而能够为每种信息生成反事实解释。我们的模块附加在预训练的生成模型上，将偏见的潜在空间转换为公平的潜在空间。此外，由于只需要训练该模块而无需重新训练整个生成模型，这种方法在时间和成本方面具有明显的优势。我们使用多种公平性指标验证了公平的潜在空间，并展示了我们的方法可以有效提供对有偏决策的解释以及公平性的保证。

title: ContextHOI: Spatial Context Learning for Human-Object Interaction Detection
title_ch: 空间上下文学习在人体对象交互检测中的应用
authors: Mingda Jia;Liming Zhao;Ge Li;Yun Zheng;
affiliations: Peking University;Alibaba Group;
abstract: Spatial contexts, such as the backgrounds and surroundings, are considered critical in Human-Object Interaction (HOI) recognition, especially when the instance-centric foreground is blurred or occluded. Recent advancements in HOI detectors are usually built upon detection transformer pipelines. While such an object-detection-oriented paradigm shows promise in localizing objects, its exploration of spatial context is often insufficient for accurately recognizing human actions. To enhance the capabilities of object detectors for HOI detection, we present a dual-branch framework named ContextHOI, which efficiently captures both object detection features and spatial contexts. In the context branch, we train the model to extract informative spatial context without requiring additional hand-craft background labels. Furthermore, we introduce context-aware spatial and semantic supervision to the context branch to filter out irrelevant noise and capture informative contexts. ContextHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance on the HICO-DET and v-coco benchmarks. For further validation, we construct a novel benchmark, HICO-ambiguous, which is a subset of HICO-DET that contains images with occluded or impaired instance cues. Extensive experiments across all benchmarks, complemented by visualizations, underscore the enhancements provided by ContextHOI, especially in recognizing interactions involving occluded or blurred instances.
abstract_ch: 空间上下文，如背景和周围环境，在人类物体交互（HOI）识别中被认为是至关重要的，尤其是在实例为中心的前景模糊或被遮挡的情况下。最近在HOI检测器方面的进展通常建立在检测变压器管道之上。虽然这种以物体检测为导向的范式在定位物体方面显示出潜力，但其对空间上下文的探索往往不足以准确地识别人类动作。为了增强物体检测器在HOI检测中的能力，我们提出了一种双分支框架，名为ContextHOI，该框架能够高效地捕捉物体检测特征和空间上下文。在上下文分支中，我们训练模型提取有用的空间上下文信息，而无需额外的手工制作背景标签。此外，我们还在上下文分支中引入了上下文感知的空间和语义监督，以过滤掉无关噪声并捕捉有用的空间上下文。ContextHOI在HICO-DET和v-coco基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。为进一步验证，我们构建了一个新的基准，HICO-ambiguous，它是HICO-DET的一个子集，包含有遮挡或受损实例线索的图像。所有基准上的广泛实验，结合可视化结果，强调了ContextHOI提供的增强功能，特别是在识别被遮挡或模糊的实例参与的交互方面。

title: DAMPER: A Dual-Stage Medical Report Generation Framework with Coarse-Grained MeSH Alignment and Fine-Grained Hypergraph Matching
title_ch: 阻尼器：一种双阶段医学报告生成框架，结合粗粒度MeSH对齐和细粒度超图匹配
authors: Xiaofei Huang;Wenting Chen;Jie Liu;Qisheng Lu;Xiaoling Luo;Linlin Shen;
affiliations: Shenzhen University;City University of Hong Kong;Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Processing;
abstract: Medical report generation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and patient management, summarizing diagnoses and recommendations based on medical imaging. However, existing work often overlook the clinical pipeline involved in report writing, where physicians typically conduct an initial quick review followed by a detailed examination. Moreover, current alignment methods may lead to misaligned relationships. To address these issues, we propose DAMPER, a dual-stage framework for medical report generation that mimics the clinical pipeline of report writing in two stages. In the first stage, a MeSH-Guided Coarse-Grained Alignment (MCG) stage that aligns chest X-ray (CXR) image features with medical subject headings (MeSH) features to generate a rough keyphrase representation of the overall impression. In the second stage, a Hypergraph-Enhanced Fine-Grained Alignment (HFG) stage that constructs hypergraphs for image patches and report annotations, modeling high-order relationships within each modality and performing hypergraph matching to capture semantic correlations between image regions and textual phrases. Finally,the coarse-grained visual features, generated MeSH representations, and visual hypergraph features are fed into a report decoder to produce the final medical report. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DAMPER in generating comprehensive and accurate medical reports, outperforming state-of-the-art methods across various evaluation metrics.
abstract_ch: 医学报告生成对于临床诊断和患者管理至关重要，它基于医疗影像总结诊断结果和建议。然而，现有的工作往往忽视了报告编写所涉及的临床流程，医生通常会先进行初步快速审查，再进行详细的检查。此外，当前的对齐方法可能会导致关系错位。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为DAMPER的双阶段框架，该框架模仿了报告编写中的临床流程。在第一阶段，一个医学主题头引导的大纲级对齐（MCG）阶段将胸部X光（CXR）图像特征与医学主题头（MeSH）特征对齐，以生成总体印象的粗略关键短语表示。在第二阶段，一个增强的超图精细对齐（HFG）阶段构建图像补丁和报告注释的超图，模型每种模态内的高阶关系，并通过超图匹配捕捉图像区域与文本短语之间的语义关联。最后，粗粒度的视觉特征、生成的MeSH表示和视觉超图特征被输入到报告解码器中，以生成最终的医学报告。在公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，DAMPER在生成全面准确的医学报告方面表现出色，在各种评估指标上优于现有最先进的方法。

title: DEEPTalk: Dynamic Emotion Embedding for Probabilistic Speech-Driven 3D Face Animation
title_ch: DEEPTalk：动态情感嵌入驱动的概率语音三维面部动画
authors: Jisoo Kim;Jungbin Cho;Joonho Park;Soonmin Hwang;Da Eun Kim;Geon Kim;Youngjae Yu;
affiliations: Yonsei University;GIANTSTEP Inc.;
abstract: Speech-driven 3D facial animation has garnered lots of attention thanks to its broad range of applications. Despite recent advancements in achieving realistic lip motion, current methods fail to capture the nuanced emotional undertones conveyed through speech and produce monotonous facial motion. These limitations result in blunt and repetitive facial animations, reducing user engagement and hindering their applicability. To address these challenges, we introduce DEEPTalk, a novel approach that generates diverse and emotionally rich 3D facial expressions directly from speech inputs. To achieve this, we first train DEE (Dynamic Emotion Embedding), which employs probabilistic contrastive learning to forge a joint emotion embedding space for both speech and facial motion. This probabilistic framework captures the uncertainty in interpreting emotions from speech and facial motion, enabling the derivation of emotion vectors from its multifaceted space. Moreover, to generate dynamic facial motion, we design TH-VQVAE (Temporally Hierarchical VQ-VAE) as an expressive and robust motion prior overcoming limitations of VAEs and VQ-VAEs. Utilizing these strong priors, we develop DEEPTalk, a talking head generator that non-autoregressively predicts codebook indices to create dynamic facial motion, incorporating a novel emotion consistency loss. Extensive experiments on various datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in creating diverse, emotionally expressive talking faces that maintain accurate lip-sync. Our project page is available at https://whwjdqls.github.io/deeptalk\_website/
abstract_ch: 语音驱动的3D面部动画因其广泛的应用范围而引起了大量关注。尽管最近在实现逼真的唇部运动方面取得了进展，但当前的方法无法捕捉通过语音传达的微妙情感内涵，从而产生单调乏味的面部动作。这些限制导致面部动画显得生硬和重复，降低了用户的参与度并阻碍了其应用。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了DEEPTalk，这是一种新颖的方法，可以直接从语音输入生成多样且富有情感的3D面部表情。为此，我们首先训练了DEE（动态情感嵌入），它采用概率对比学习来构建语音和面部运动的情感联合嵌入空间。这种概率框架捕捉了从语音和面部运动中解读情感的不确定性，使我们能够从中多维度的情感空间推导出情感向量。此外，为了生成动态面部动作，我们设计了TH-VQVAE（时序层次矢量量化变分自编码器）作为表达性和鲁棒性强的动作先验，克服了VAEs和VQ-VAEs的局限性。利用这些强大的先验知识，我们开发了DEEPTalk，这是一种说话头像生成器，可以非自回归地预测码本索引以创建动态面部动作，并引入了一种新颖的情感一致性损失。我们在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在创造多样且富有情感表现力的说话面孔方面非常有效，同时保持准确的唇部同步。我们的项目页面可在https://whwjdqls.github.io/deeptalk_website/访问。

title: Densely Connected Parameter-Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation
title_ch: 密集连接的参数高效调优以实现引用图像分割
authors: Jiaqi Huang;Zunnan Xu;Ting Liu;Yong Liu;Haonan Han;Kehong Yuan;Xiu Li;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;
abstract: In the domain of computer vision, Parameter-Efficient Tuning (PET) is increasingly replacing the traditional paradigm of pre-training followed by full fine-tuning. PET is particularly favored for its effectiveness in large foundation models, as it streamlines transfer learning costs and optimizes hardware utilization. However, the current PET methods are mainly designed for single-modal optimization. While some pioneering studies have undertaken preliminary explorations, they still remain at the level of aligned encoders (e.g., CLIP) and lack exploration of misaligned encoders. These methods show sub-optimal performance with misaligned encoders, as they fail to effectively align the multimodal features during fine-tuning. In this paper, we introduce DETRIS, a parameter-efficient tuning framework designed to enhance low-rank visual feature propagation by establishing dense interconnections between each layer and all preceding layers, which enables effective cross-modal feature interaction and adaptation to misaligned encoders. We also suggest using text adapters to improve textual features. Our simple yet efficient approach greatly surpasses state-of-the-art methods with 0.9% to 1.8% backbone parameter updates, evaluated on challenging benchmarks. Our project is available at \url{https://github.com/jiaqihuang01/DETRIS}.
abstract_ch: 在计算机视觉领域，参数高效微调（Parameter-Efficient Tuning, PET）正逐渐取代传统的预训练后全面微调的范式。PET特别受到青睐，因为它在大型基础模型中表现出色，能够简化迁移学习的成本并优化硬件利用。然而，当前的PET方法主要针对单模态优化设计。虽然一些开创性的研究已经进行了初步探索，但它们仍然停留在对齐编码器（如CLIP）的水平上，并且缺乏对未对齐编码器的探索。这些方法在使用未对齐编码器进行微调时表现不佳，因为它们无法有效地在多模态特征之间建立对齐。在本文中，我们介绍了DETRIS，这是一种参数高效的调优框架，旨在通过在每一层与所有前一层之间建立密集的连接来增强低秩视觉特征传播，从而实现有效的跨模态特征交互，并适应未对齐编码器。我们还建议使用文本适配器来提升文本特征。我们的简单而有效的方法在具有挑战性的基准测试中显著超越了最先进的方法，在主干参数更新量仅为0.9%至1.8%的情况下取得了优异性能。我们的项目可在\url{https://github.com/jiaqihuang01/DETRIS}获取。

title: DiffuseHigh: Training-Free Progressive High-Resolution Image Synthesis Through Structure Guidance
title_ch: 弥散高清：通过结构引导的无训练渐进高分辨率图像合成
authors: Younghyun Kim;Geunmin Hwang;Junyu Zhang;Eunbyung Park;
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University;Central South University;
abstract: Large-scale generative models, such as text-to-image diffusion models, have garnered widespread attention across diverse domains due to their creative and high-fidelity image generation. Nonetheless, existing large-scale diffusion models are confined to generating images of up to 1K resolution, which is far from meeting the demands of contemporary commercial applications. Directly sampling higher-resolution images often yields results marred by artifacts such as object repetition and distorted shapes. Addressing the aforementioned issues typically necessitates training or fine-tuning models on higher-resolution datasets. However, this poses a formidable challenge due to the difficulty in collecting large-scale high-resolution images and substantial computational resources. While several preceding works have proposed alternatives to bypass the cumbersome training process, they often fail to produce convincing results. In this work, we probe the generative ability of diffusion models at higher resolution beyond their original capability and propose a novel progressive approach that fully utilizes generated low-resolution images to guide the generation of higher-resolution images. Our method obviates the need for additional training or fine-tuning which significantly lowers the burden of computational costs. Extensive experiments and results validate the efficiency and efficacy of our method. Project page: https://yhyun225.github.io/DiffuseHigh/
abstract_ch: 大规模生成模型，如文本到图像的扩散模型，由于其创意性和高保真度图像生成能力，在多个领域引起了广泛关注。然而，现有的大规模扩散模型仅限于生成最高1K分辨率的图像，这远远不能满足当今商业应用的需求。直接采样更高分辨率的图像往往会得到带有诸如物体重复和形状失真等瑕疵的结果。解决这些问题通常需要在更高分辨率的数据集上训练或微调模型。然而，这带来了巨大的挑战，因为收集大规模高分辨率图像困难重重，并且需要大量的计算资源。虽然有一些先前的工作提出了绕过繁琐训练过程的替代方案，但它们往往无法产生令人信服的结果。在本工作中，我们探索了扩散模型在高于其原始能力的更高分辨率下的生成能力，并提出了一种新颖的分阶段方法，该方法充分利用生成的低分辨率图像来指导更高分辨率图像的生成。我们的方法消除了额外训练或微调的需要，从而显著降低了计算成本的负担。广泛的实验和结果验证了我们方法的有效性和效率。项目页面：https://yhyun225.github.io/DiffuseHigh/

title: Distilling Knowledge from Heterogeneous Architectures for Semantic Segmentation
title_ch: 从异构架构中提炼语义分割知识
authors: Yanglin Huang;Kai Hu;Yuan Zhang;Zhineng Chen;Xieping Gao;
affiliations: Xiangtan University;Fudan University;Hunan Normal University;
abstract: Current knowledge distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation focus on guiding the student to imitate the teacher's knowledge within homogeneous architectures. However, these methods overlook the diverse knowledge contained in architectures with different inductive biases, which is crucial for enabling the student to acquire a more precise and comprehensive understanding of the data during distillation. To this end, we propose for the first time a generic knowledge distillation method for semantic segmentation from a heterogeneous perspective, named HeteroAKD. Due to the substantial disparities between heterogeneous architectures, such as CNN and Transformer, directly transferring cross-architecture knowledge presents significant challenges. To eliminate the influence of architecture-specific information, the intermediate features of both the teacher and student are skillfully projected into an aligned logits space. Furthermore, to utilize diverse knowledge from heterogeneous architectures and deliver customized knowledge required by the student, a teacher-student knowledge mixing mechanism (KMM) and a teacher-student knowledge evaluation mechanism (KEM) are introduced. These mechanisms are performed by assessing the reliability and its discrepancy between heterogeneous teacher-student knowledge. Extensive experiments conducted on three main-stream benchmarks using various teacher-student pairs demonstrate that our HeteroAKD outperforms state-of-the-art KD methods in facilitating distillation between heterogeneous architectures.
abstract_ch: 当前的语义分割知识蒸馏（KD）方法主要关注在同构架构内引导学生模仿教师的知识。然而，这些方法忽视了不同归纳偏置架构中包含的多样化知识，这对于在蒸馏过程中使学生获得更精确和全面的数据理解至关重要。为了解决这一问题，我们首次从异构视角提出了一个通用的语义分割知识蒸馏方法，命名为HeteroAKD。由于异构架构之间存在显著差异，例如CNN和Transformer，直接跨架构转移知识面临重大挑战。为了消除特定于架构的信息影响，教师和学生的中间特征被巧妙地投影到对齐的logits空间中。此外，为了利用异构架构中的多样化知识，并提供满足学生需求的定制化知识，我们引入了一种教师-学生知识混合机制（KMM）和一种教师-学生知识评估机制（KEM）。这些机制通过评估异构教师-学生知识之间的可靠性和差异性来实现。在三个主流基准上进行的大量实验表明，我们的HeteroAKD在促进异构架构间的知识蒸馏方面优于最先进的KD方法。

title: Do Not DeepFake Me: Privacy-Preserving Neural 3D Head Reconstruction Without Sensitive Images
title_ch: 不要深度伪造我：无需敏感图像的隐私保护神经网络三维头部重建
authors: Jiayi Kong;Xurui Song;Shuo Huai;Baixin Xu;Jun Luo;Ying He;
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University;
abstract: While 3D head reconstruction is widely used for modeling, existing neural reconstruction approaches rely on high-resolution multi-view images, posing notable privacy issues. Individuals are particularly sensitive to facial features, and facial image leakage can lead to many malicious activities, such as unauthorized tracking and deepfake. In contrast, geometric data is less susceptible to misuse due to its complex processing requirements, and absence of facial texture features. In this paper, we propose a novel two-stage 3D facial reconstruction method aimed at avoiding exposure to sensitive facial information while preserving detailed geometric accuracy. Our approach first uses non-sensitive rear-head images for initial geometry and then refines this geometry using processed privacy-removed gradient images. Extensive experiments show that the resulting geometry is comparable to methods using full images, while the process is resistant to DeepFake applications and facial recognition (FR) systems, thereby proving its effectiveness in privacy protection.
abstract_ch: 尽管三维头部重建在建模中广泛应用，现有的神经重建方法依赖于高分辨率多视角图像，这带来了显著的隐私问题。人们特别敏感于面部特征，面部图像泄露可能导致许多恶意活动，如未经授权的跟踪和深度合成。相比之下，几何数据由于其复杂的处理要求和缺乏面部纹理特征，不易被滥用。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段三维面部重建方法，旨在避免暴露敏感的面部信息同时保持详细的几何准确性。该方法首先使用非敏感的背面头部图像进行初步几何重建，然后利用去除了隐私信息的处理过的梯度图像细化这一几何模型。广泛的实验表明，生成的几何模型与使用完整图像的方法相当，且整个过程对深度合成应用和面部识别系统具有抵抗力，从而证明了其在隐私保护方面的有效性。

title: DreamPhysics: Learning Physics-Based 3D Dynamics with Video Diffusion Priors
title_ch: DreamPhysics：利用视频扩散先验学习基于物理的3D动力学
authors: Tianyu Huang;Haoze Zhang;Yihan Zeng;Zhilu Zhang;Hui Li;Wangmeng Zuo;Rynson W. H. Lau;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;City University of Hong Kong;Huawei;
abstract: Dynamic 3D interaction has been attracting a lot of attention recently. However, creating such 4D content remains challenging. One solution is to animate 3D scenes with physics-based simulation, which requires manually assigning precise physical properties to the object or the simulated results would become unnatural. Another solution is to learn the deformation of 3D objects with the distillation of video generative models, which, however, tends to produce 3D videos with small and discontinuous motions due to the inappropriate extraction and application of physics priors. In this work, to combine the strengths and complementing shortcomings of the above two solutions, we propose to learn the physical properties of a material field with video diffusion priors, and then utilize a physics-based Material-Point-Method (MPM) simulator to generate 4D content with realistic motions. In particular, we propose motion distillation sampling to emphasize video motion information during distillation. In addition, to facilitate the optimization, we further propose a KAN-based material field with frame boosting. Experimental results demonstrate that our method enjoys more realistic motions than state-of-the-arts do.
abstract_ch: 近年来，动态3D交互吸引了大量关注。然而，创建此类4D内容仍然具有挑战性。一种解决方案是通过基于物理的模拟来动画化3D场景，这需要手动为对象分配精确的物理属性，否则模拟结果会显得不自然。另一种解决方案是利用视频生成模型的蒸馏提取3D对象的变形信息，但这往往会生成具有小幅度和不连续运动的3D视频，原因在于物理先验的不当提取和应用。在本文中，为了结合上述两种解决方案的优点并弥补其不足，我们提出了一种方法：通过视频扩散先验学习材料场的物理属性，然后使用基于物理的粒子点方法（Material-Point-Method，MPM）模拟器生成具有真实运动的4D内容。特别地，我们提出了运动蒸馏采样以在蒸馏过程中强调视频中的运动信息。此外，为了便于优化，我们进一步提出了一种基于KAN（Knowledge-Augmented Network）的材料场，并引入了帧增强技术。实验结果表明，我们的方法比现有最先进的方法能生成更加真实的运动。

title: Efficient Gaussian Splatting for Monocular Dynamic Scene Rendering via Sparse Time-Variant Attribute Modeling
title_ch: 基于稀疏时变属性建模的高效高斯点云渲染方法用于单目动态场景渲染
authors: Hanyang Kong;Xingyi Yang;Xinchao Wang;
affiliations: National University of Singapore;
abstract: Rendering dynamic scenes from monocular videos is a crucial yet challenging task. The recent deformable Gaussian Splatting has emerged as a robust solution to represent real-world dynamic scenes. However, it often leads to heavily redundant Gaussians, attempting to fit every training view at various time steps, leading to slower rendering speeds. Additionally, the attributes of Gaussians in static areas are time-invariant, making it unnecessary to model every Gaussian, which can cause jittering in static regions. In practice, the primary bottleneck in rendering speed for dynamic scenes is the number of Gaussians. In response, we introduce Efficient Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (EDGS), which represents dynamic scenes via sparse time-variant attribute modeling. Our approach formulates dynamic scenes using a sparse anchor-grid representation, with the motion flow of dense Gaussians calculated via a classical kernel representation. Furthermore, we propose an unsupervised strategy to efficiently filter out anchors corresponding to static areas. Only anchors associated with deformable objects are input into MLPs to query time-variant attributes. Experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that our EDGS significantly improves the rendering speed with superior rendering quality compared to previous state-of-the-art methods.
abstract_ch: 从单目视频渲染动态场景是一项关键但具有挑战性的任务。最近提出的可变形高斯点积方法已成为表示真实世界动态场景的一种稳健解决方案。然而，这种方法往往会生成高度冗余的高斯模型，试图在各个时间步匹配每一种训练视角，导致渲染速度变慢。此外，在静态区域，高斯模型的属性随时间保持不变，因此没有必要为每个高斯建模，这可能导致静态区域出现抖动现象。实际上，动态场景渲染速度的主要瓶颈在于高斯模型的数量。为此，我们引入了高效动态高斯点积（EDGS）方法，通过稀疏的时间变化属性建模来表示动态场景。我们的方法使用稀疏锚网格表示动态场景，并通过经典的核表示计算密集高斯的运动流。此外，我们提出了一种无监督策略，以高效地过滤掉对应于静态区域的锚点。仅将与可变形对象相关的锚点输入到MLP中查询时间变化属性。实验结果表明，与之前的最先进的方法相比，我们的EDGS显著提高了渲染速度，同时保持了更高的渲染质量。

title: EGSRAL:An Enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting Based Renderer with Automated Labeling for Large-Scale Driving Scene
title_ch: EGSRAL：一种基于增强3D高斯斑点渲染器及自动标注的大规模驾驶场景渲染方法
authors: Yixiong Huo;Guangfeng Jiang;Hongyang Wei;Ji Liu;Song Zhang;Han Liu;Xingliang Huang;Mingjie Lu;Jinzhang Peng;Dong Li;Lu Tian;Emad Barsoum;
affiliations: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.;
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D GS) has gained popularity due to its faster rendering speed and high-quality novel view synthesis. Some researchers have explored using 3D GS for reconstructing driving scenes. However, these methods often rely on various data types, such as depth maps, 3D boxes, and trajectories of moving objects. Additionally, the lack of annotations for synthesized images limits their direct application in downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose EGSRAL, a 3D GS-based method that relies solely on training images without extra annotations. EGSRAL enhances 3D GS's capability to model both dynamic objects and static backgrounds and introduces a novel adaptor for auto labeling, generating corresponding annotations based on existing annotations. We also propose a grouping strategy for vanilla 3D GS to address perspective issues in rendering large-scale, complex scenes. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets without any extra annotation. For example, the PSNR metric reaches 29.04 on the nuScenes dataset. Moreover, our automated labeling can significantly improve the performance of 2D/3D detection tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/jiangxb98/EGSRAL.
abstract_ch: 由于其更快的渲染速度和高质量的新视角合成能力，3D高斯散点图（3D GS）受到了广泛关注。一些研究人员探索了使用3D GS来重建驾驶场景。然而，这些方法通常依赖于多种数据类型，如深度图、3D框以及移动物体的轨迹。此外，合成图像缺乏注释限制了它们在下游任务中的直接应用。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了EGSRAL，这是一种基于3D GS的方法，仅依赖训练图像而无需额外注释。EGSRAL增强了3D GS对动态对象和静态背景建模的能力，并引入了一个新颖的适配器进行自动标注，根据现有注释生成相应的注释。我们还提出了一种分组策略，以解决传统3D GS在渲染大规模复杂场景时的视角问题。我们的方法在多个数据集上实现了最先进的性能，且没有任何额外的注释。例如，PSNR指标在nuScenes数据集上达到了29.04。此外，我们的自动化标注可以显著提高2D/3D检测任务的性能。代码可在https://github.com/jiangxb98/EGSRAL获取。

title: Energy-Guided Optimization for Personalized Image Editing with Pretrained Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_ch: 基于能量引导的优化方法在预训练文本到图像扩散模型中的个性化图像编辑
authors: Rui Jiang;Xinghe Fu;Guangcong Zheng;Teng Li;Taiping Yao;Xi Li;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Tencent;
abstract: The rapid advancement of pretrained text-driven diffusion models has significantly enriched applications in image generation and editing. However, as the demand for personalized content editing increases, new challenges emerge especially when dealing with arbitrary objects and complex scenes. Existing methods usually mistakes mask as the object shape prior, which struggle to achieve a seamless integration result. The mostly used inversion noise initialization also hinders the identity consistency towards the target object. To address these challenges, we propose a novel training-free framework that formulates personalized content editing as the optimization of edited images in the latent space, using diffusion models as the energy function guidance conditioned by reference text-image pairs. A coarse-to-fine strategy is proposed that employs text energy guidance at the early stage to achieve a natural transition toward the target class and uses point-to-point feature-level image energy guidance to perform fine-grained appearance alignment with the target object. Additionally, we introduce the latent space content composition to enhance overall identity consistency with the target. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method excels in object replacement even with a large domain gap, highlighting its potential for high-quality, personalized image editing.
abstract_ch: 预训练文本驱动扩散模型的快速发展极大地丰富了图像生成和编辑的应用。然而，随着个性化内容编辑需求的增加，特别是在处理任意对象和复杂场景时，新的挑战也随之出现。现有方法通常将掩码误认为是对象形状先验，这使得实现无缝融合结果变得困难。常用的反转噪声初始化也妨碍了目标对象的身份一致性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新的无需训练框架，将其个性化内容编辑形式化为在潜在空间优化编辑图像的过程，并利用条件于参考图文对的扩散模型作为能量函数指导。我们提出了一种从粗到细的策略，在早期阶段使用文本能量指导以实现自然的目标类过渡，并通过点对点特征级图像能量指导来实现与目标对象的精细外观对齐。此外，我们引入了潜在空间内容组成，以增强整体的身份一致性。大量实验表明，即使在存在较大领域差距的情况下，我们的方法也能出色地实现对象替换，突显了其在高质量个性化图像编辑方面的潜力。

title: Event-Enhanced Blurry Video Super-Resolution
title_ch: 事件增强模糊视频超分辨率
authors: Dachun Kai;Yueyi Zhang;Jin Wang;Zeyu Xiao;Zhiwei Xiong;Xiaoyan Sun;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;Hefei Comprehensive National Science Center;National University of Singapore;
abstract: In this paper, we tackle the task of blurry video super-resolution (BVSR), aiming to generate high-resolution (HR) videos from low-resolution (LR) and blurry inputs. Current BVSR methods often fail to restore sharp details at high resolutions, resulting in noticeable artifacts and jitter due to insufficient motion information for deconvolution and the lack of high-frequency details in LR frames. To address these challenges, we introduce event signals into BVSR and propose a novel event-enhanced network, Ev-DeblurVSR. To effectively fuse information from frames and events for feature deblurring, we introduce a reciprocal feature deblurring module that leverages motion information from intra-frame events to deblur frame features while reciprocally using global scene context from the frames to enhance event features. Furthermore, to enhance temporal consistency, we propose a hybrid deformable alignment module that fully exploits the complementary motion information from inter-frame events and optical flow to improve motion estimation in the deformable alignment process. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Ev-DeblurVSR establishes a new state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Notably, on real data, our method is +2.59 dB more accurate and 7.28$\times$ faster than the recent best BVSR baseline FMA-Net. Code: https://github.com/DachunKai/Ev-DeblurVSR.
abstract_ch: 在本文中，我们研究了模糊视频超分辨率（BVSR）任务，旨在从低分辨率（LR）和模糊输入生成高分辨率（HR）视频。当前的BVSR方法往往在高分辨率下无法恢复清晰细节，导致去模糊过程中出现明显的伪影和抖动，这是因为缺乏足够的运动信息进行反卷积以及LR帧中缺乏高频细节。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了事件信号到BVSR，并提出了一种新颖的增强事件网络——Ev-DeblurVSR。为了有效融合帧和事件中的信息以实现特征去模糊化，我们引入了一个互惠特征去模糊模块，该模块利用帧内事件的运动信息来去模糊帧特征，同时通过使用帧中的全局场景上下文来增强事件特征。此外，为了增强时间一致性，我们提出了一个混合变形对齐模块，在变形对齐过程中充分利用帧间事件和光流中的互补运动信息，以改进运动估计。大量评估表明，Ev-DeblurVSR在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上均建立了新的性能基准。特别地，在真实数据上，我们的方法比最近的最佳BVSR基线FMA-Net准确度高2.59 dB且速度快7.28倍。代码：https://github.com/DachunKai/Ev-DeblurVSR。

title: Every Component Counts: Rethinking the Measure of Success for Medical Semantic Segmentation in Multi-Instance Segmentation Tasks
title_ch: 每一组件都至关重要：重新思考多实例分割任务中医疗语义分割的成功度量标准
authors: Alexander Jaus;Constantin Marc Seibold;Simon Reiß;Zdravko Marinov;Keyi Li;Zeling Ye;Stefan Krieg;Jens Kleesiek;Rainer Stiefelhagen;
affiliations: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology;University Hospital Essen;
abstract: We present Connected-Component~(CC)-Metrics, a novel semantic segmentation evaluation protocol, targeted to align existing semantic segmentation metrics to a multi-instance detection scenario in which each connected component matters. We motivate this setup in the common medical scenario of semantic metastases segmentation in a full-body PET/CT. We show how existing semantic segmentation metrics suffer from a bias towards larger connected components contradicting the clinical assessment of scans in which tumor size and clinical relevance are uncorrelated. To rebalance existing segmentation metrics, we propose to evaluate them on a per-component basis thus giving each tumor the same weight irrespective of its size. To match predictions to ground-truth segments, we employ a proximity-based matching criterion, evaluating common metrics locally at the component of interest. Using this approach, we break free of biases introduced by large metastasis for overlap-based metrics such as Dice or Surface Dice. CC-Metrics also improves distance-based metrics such as Hausdorff Distances which are uninformative for small changes that do not influence the maximum or 95th percentile, and avoids pitfalls introduced by directly combining counting-based metrics with overlap-based metrics as it is done in Panoptic Quality.
abstract_ch: 我们提出了一种新颖的语义分割评估协议——连接组件指标（Connected-Component~CC-Metrics），旨在将现有的语义分割度量与每个连接组件都重要的多实例检测场景相匹配。我们在全身PET/CT中的语义转移瘤分割这一常见医疗场景中阐述了这种设置。我们展示了现有语义分割度量如何受到对较大连接组件的偏见影响，这与肿瘤大小和临床相关性在扫描中的不相关性相矛盾。为了重新平衡现有的分割度量，我们建议基于每个组件进行评估，从而赋予每个肿瘤相同的权重，无论其大小如何。为了将预测与真实标签的区域相匹配，我们采用基于接近性的匹配标准，在感兴趣的组件上局部评估常见的度量标准。通过这种方法，我们摆脱了Dice或表面Dice等重叠基度量标准引入的大转移瘤带来的偏见。CC-Metrics还改进了基于距离的度量标准，如哈斯多夫距离，这些度量标准对于小的变化无法提供有用的信息，因为这些变化不会影响最大值或第95百分位数。此外，CC-Metrics避免了直接将计数基度量标准与重叠基度量标准结合使用时可能产生的陷阱，例如在全景质量评估中所做的一样。

title: EvoChart: A Benchmark and a Self-Training Approach Towards Real-World Chart Understanding
title_ch: EvoChart：一个面向实际应用的图表理解基准及自训练方法
authors: Muye Huang;Han Lai;Xinyu Zhang;Wenjun Wu;Jie Ma;Lingling Zhang;Jun Liu;
affiliations: Xi'an Jiao Tong University;Shaanxi Province Key Laboratory of Big Data Knowledge Engineering;
abstract: Chart understanding enables automated data analysis for humans, which requires models to achieve highly accurate visual comprehension. While existing Visual Language Models (VLMs) have shown progress in chart understanding, the lack of high-quality training data and comprehensive evaluation benchmarks hinders VLM chart comprehension. In this paper, we introduce EvoChart, a novel self-training method for generating synthetic chart data to enhance VLMs' capabilities in real-world chart comprehension. We also propose EvoChart-QA, a noval benchmark for measuring models' chart comprehension abilities in real-world scenarios. Specifically, EvoChart is a unique self-training data synthesis approach that simultaneously produces high-quality training corpus and a high-performance chart understanding model. EvoChart-QA consists of 650 distinct real-world charts collected from 140 different websites and 1,250 expert-curated questions that focus on chart understanding. Experimental results on various open-source and proprietary VLMs tested on EvoChart-QA demonstrate that even the best proprietary model, GPT-4o, achieves only 49.8% accuracy. Moreover, the EvoChart method significantly boosts the performance of open-source VLMs on real-world chart understanding tasks, achieving 54.2% accuracy on EvoChart-QA.
abstract_ch: 图表理解使人类能够实现自动化的数据分析，这需要模型达到高度准确的视觉理解。虽然现有的视觉语言模型（VLMs）在图表理解方面已经取得了进展，但高质量训练数据和全面的评估基准的缺乏阻碍了VLMs的图表理解能力。在本文中，我们介绍了EvoChart，这是一种新颖的自训练方法，用于生成合成图表数据以增强VLMs在实际图表理解中的能力。我们还提出了EvoChart-QA，这是一种新的基准，用于衡量模型在实际场景下的图表理解能力。具体而言，EvoChart是一种独特的自训练数据合成方法，同时生成高质量的训练语料库和高性能的图表理解模型。EvoChart-QA包含650个不同的真实世界图表，这些图表来自140个不同的网站，以及1250个专家策划的问题，这些问题主要关注图表理解。在使用EvoChart-QA测试的各种开源和专有VLMs的实验结果表明，即使是最先进的专有模型GPT-4o也只能达到49.8%的准确率。此外，EvoChart方法显著提升了开源VLMs在实际图表理解任务中的性能，在EvoChart-QA上的准确率为54.2%。

title: Exploiting Diffusion Prior for Real-World Image Dehazing with Unpaired Training
title_ch: 利用扩散先验进行无配对训练下的实时图像去雾
authors: Yunwei Lan;Zhigao Cui;Chang Liu;Jialun Peng;Nian Wang;Xin Luo;Dong Liu;
affiliations: Rocket Force University of Engineering;University of Science and Technology of China;
abstract: Unpaired training has been verified as one of the most effective paradigms for real scene dehazing by learning from unpaired real-world hazy and clear images. Although numerous studies have been proposed, current methods demonstrate limited generalization for various real scenes due to limited feature representation and insufficient use of real-world prior. Inspired by the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models in producing both hazy and clear images, we exploit diffusion prior for real-world image dehazing, and propose an unpaired framework named Diff-Dehazer. Specifically, we leverage diffusion prior as bijective mapping learners within the CycleGAN, a classic unpaired learning framework. Considering that physical priors contain pivotal statistics information of real-world data, we further excavate real-world knowledge by integrating physical priors into our framework. Furthermore, we introduce a new perspective for adequately leveraging the representation ability of diffusion models by removing degradation in image and text modalities, so as to improve the dehazing effect. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our method. Our code https://github.com/ywxjm/Diff-Dehazer.
abstract_ch: 未配对训练已被验证为通过学习未配对的真实雾化和清晰图像，是实现真实场景去雾效果最有效的范式之一。尽管已经提出了众多研究方法，但由于特征表示有限且在利用真实世界先验方面不够充分，当前的方法在各种真实场景中的泛化能力仍然有限。受扩散模型在生成雾化和清晰图像方面强大生成能力的启发，我们利用扩散先验作为CycleGAN（一种经典的未配对学习框架）中的双射映射学习者，并提出了一种名为Diff-Dehazer的未配对框架。具体而言，我们利用扩散先验作为CycleGAN中的双射映射学习者。考虑到物理先验包含了真实世界数据的关键统计信息，我们进一步通过将物理先验整合进我们的框架来挖掘真实世界的知识。此外，我们引入了一个新的视角，通过去除图像和文本模态中的退化现象，更充分地发挥扩散模型的表示能力，以提高去雾效果。在多个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法具有优越的表现力。我们的代码位于https://github.com/ywxjm/Diff-Dehazer。

title: Exploiting Multimodal Spatial-temporal Patterns for Video Object Tracking
title_ch: 利用多模态空间-时间模式进行视频目标跟踪
authors: Xiantao Hu;Ying Tai;Xu Zhao;Chen Zhao;Zhenyu Zhang;Jun Li;Bineng Zhong;Jian Yang;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology;Nanjing University;Guangxi Normal University;
abstract: Multimodal tracking has garnered widespread attention as a result of its ability to effectively address the inherent limitations of traditional RGB tracking. However, existing multimodal trackers mainly focus on the fusion and enhancement of spatial features or merely leverage the sparse temporal relationships between video frames. These approaches do not fully exploit the temporal correlations in multimodal videos, making it difficult to capture the dynamic changes and motion information of targets in complex scenarios. To alleviate this problem, we propose a unified multimodal spatial-temporal tracking approach named STTrack. In contrast to previous paradigms that solely relied on updating reference information, we introduced a temporal state generator (TSG) that continuously generates a sequence of tokens containing multimodal temporal information. These temporal information tokens are used to guide the localization of the target in the next time state, establish long-range contextual relationships between video frames, and capture the temporal trajectory of the target. Furthermore, at the spatial level, we introduced the mamba fusion and background suppression interactive (BSI) modules. These modules establish a dual-stage mechanism for coordinating information interaction and fusion between modalities. Extensive comparisons on five benchmark datasets illustrate that STTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance across various multimodal tracking scenarios. Code is available at: https://github.com/NJU-PCALab/STTrack.
abstract_ch: 多模态跟踪由于能够有效解决传统RGB跟踪固有的局限性而引起了广泛的关注。然而，现有的多模态跟踪器主要集中在空间特征的融合和增强上，或者仅仅利用视频帧之间的稀疏时间关系。这些方法未能充分利用多模态视频中的时间相关性，使得在复杂场景中难以捕捉目标的动态变化和运动信息。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为STTrack的统一多模态时空跟踪方法。与之前仅依赖更新参考信息的范式不同，我们引入了一个时间状态生成器（TSG），它能够持续生成包含多模态时间信息的一系列令牌。这些时间信息令牌用于指导下一时间状态的目标定位、建立视频帧之间的长距离上下文关系以及捕捉目标的时间轨迹。此外，在空间层面，我们引入了mamba融合和背景抑制交互（BSI）模块。这些模块建立了模态间信息交互和融合的双重机制。在五个基准数据集上的广泛比较表明，STTrack在各种多模态跟踪场景中实现了最先进的性能。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/NJU-PCALab/STTrack。

title: Exploring Enhanced Contextual Information for Video-Level Object Tracking
title_ch: 探索增强上下文信息的视频级目标跟踪
authors: Ben Kang;Xin Chen;Simiao Lai;Yang Liu;Yi Liu;Dong Wang;
affiliations: Dalian University of Technology;Baidu;
abstract: Contextual information at the video level has become increasingly crucial for visual object tracking. However, existing methods typically use only a few tokens to convey this information, which can lead to information loss and limit their ability to fully capture the context. To address this issue, we propose a new video-level visual object tracking framework called MCITrack. It leverages Mamba's hidden states to continuously record and transmit extensive contextual information throughout the video stream, resulting in more robust object tracking. The core component of MCITrack is the Contextual Information Fusion module, which consists of the mamba layer and the cross-attention layer. The mamba layer stores historical contextual information, while the cross-attention layer integrates this information into the current visual features of each backbone block. This module enhances the model's ability to capture and utilize contextual information at multiple levels through deep integration with the backbone. Experiments demonstrate that MCITrack achieves competitive performance across numerous benchmarks. For instance, it gets 76.6% AUC on LaSOT and 80.0% AO on GOT-10k, establishing a new state-of-the-art performance. Code and models are available at https://github.com/kangben258/MCITrack.
abstract_ch: 视频级别上下文信息对于视觉对象跟踪变得越来越重要。然而，现有方法通常仅使用少量标记来传达这些信息，这可能导致信息丢失并限制其完全捕捉上下文的能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的视频级别视觉对象跟踪框架，称为MCITrack。该框架利用Mamba的隐藏状态，持续记录和传输整个视频流中的大量上下文信息，从而实现更稳健的对象跟踪。MCITrack的核心组件是上下文信息融合模块，该模块包括Mamba层和交叉注意力层。Mamba层存储历史上下文信息，而交叉注意力层则将这些信息整合到每个骨干块的当前视觉特征中。该模块通过与骨干的深度集成，增强了模型在多个级别上捕获和利用上下文信息的能力。实验表明，MCITrack在多个基准测试中实现了竞争力的性能。例如，在LaSOT上获得了76.6%的AUC，在GOT-10k上获得了80.0%的AO，建立了新的最先进性能。代码和模型可在https://github.com/kangben258/MCITrack获取。

title: Exploring More from Multiple Gait Modalities for Human Identification
title_ch: 多模态步态识别的人类身份探索
authors: Dongyang Jin;Chao Fan;Weihua Chen;Shiqi Yu;
affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology;Shenzhen University;Alibaba Group;
abstract: The gait, as a kind of soft biometric characteristic, can reflect the distinct walking patterns of individuals at a distance, exhibiting a promising technique for unrestrained human identification. With largely excluding gait-unrelated cues hidden in RGB videos, the silhouette and skeleton, though visually compact, have acted as two of the most prevailing gait modalities for a long time. Recently, several attempts have been made to introduce more informative data forms like human parsing and optical flow images to capture gait characteristics, along with multi-branch architectures. However, due to the inconsistency within model designs and experiment settings, we argue that a comprehensive and fair comparative study among these popular gait modalities, involving the representational capacity and fusion strategy exploration, is still lacking. From the perspectives of fine vs. coarse-grained shape and whole vs. pixel-wise motion modeling, this work presents an in-depth investigation of three popular gait representations, i.e., silhouette, human parsing, and optical flow, with various fusion evaluations, and experimentally exposes their similarities and differences. Based on the obtained insights, we further develop a C$^2$Fusion strategy, consequently building our new framework MultiGait++. C$^2$Fusion preserves commonalities while highlighting differences to enrich the learning of gait features. To verify our findings and conclusions, extensive experiments on Gait3D, GREW, CCPG, and SUSTech1K are conducted. The code is available at https://github.com/ShiqiYu/OpenGait.
abstract_ch: 步态作为一种软生物特征，可以在远处反映个体独特的行走模式，展现出一种无约束的人类识别有希望的技术。通过大量排除RGB视频中的步态无关线索，轮廓和骨架尽管在视觉上较为紧凑，但长期以来一直是两种最常用的步态模态。最近，人们尝试引入更具信息量的数据形式，如人体解析和光流图像来捕捉步态特征，并结合多分支架构。然而，由于模型设计和实验设置之间的一致性不足，我们认为对这些流行的步态模态进行全面而公平的比较研究仍然缺乏，特别是涉及表征能力和融合策略的探索。从精细与粗略形状以及整体与像素级运动建模的角度出发，本文深入探讨了三种流行的步态表示方法，即轮廓、人体解析和光流，并进行了各种融合评估，实验证明了它们之间的相似性和差异性。基于获得的见解，我们进一步开发了一种C$^2$融合策略，从而构建了我们的新框架MultiGait++。C$^2$融合策略保留共同点同时突出差异，以丰富步态特征的学习。为了验证我们的发现和结论，在Gait3D、GREW、CCPG和SUSTech1K数据集上进行了广泛的实验。相关代码可在https://github.com/ShiqiYu/OpenGait获取。

title: FashionTailor: Controllable Clothing Editing for Human Images with Appearance Preserving
title_ch: FashionTailor：具有外观保持的人体图像可控服装编辑
authors: Jie Hou;Jianghong Ma;Xiangyu Mu;Haijun Zhang;Zhao Zhang;

title: FastLGS: Speeding Up Language Embedded Gaussians with Feature Grid Mapping
title_ch: FastLGS：通过特征网格映射加速嵌入语言高斯过程
authors: Yuzhou Ji;He Zhu;Junshu Tang;Wuyi Liu;Zhizhong Zhang;Xin Tan;Yuan Xie;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Shanghai Key Laboratory of Computer Software Evaluating and Testing;
abstract: The semantically interactive radiance field has always been an appealing task for its potential to facilitate user-friendly and automated real-world 3D scene understanding applications. However, it is a challenging task to achieve high quality, efficiency and zero-shot ability at the same time with semantics in radiance fields. In this work, we present FastLGS, an approach that supports real-time open-vocabulary query within 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) under high resolution. We propose the semantic feature grid to save multi-view CLIP features which are extracted based on Segment Anything Model (SAM) masks, and map the grids to low dimensional features for semantic field training through 3DGS. Once trained, we can restore pixel-aligned CLIP embeddings through feature grids from rendered features for open-vocabulary queries. Comparisons with other state-of-the-art methods prove that FastLGS can achieve the first place performance concerning both speed and accuracy, where FastLGS is 98x faster than LERF and 4x faster than LangSplat. Meanwhile, experiments show that FastLGS is adaptive and compatible with many downstream tasks, such as 3D segmentation and 3D object inpainting, which can be easily applied to other 3D manipulation systems.
abstract_ch: 语义交互辐射场一直是一个引人入胜的任务，因为它有潜力促进用户友好且自动化的高分辨率3D场景理解应用。然而，同时在辐射场中实现高质量、高效性和零样本能力是一项具有挑战性的任务。在这项工作中，我们提出了FastLGS，一种支持在3D高分辨率高斯斑点化（3DGS）下进行实时开放式词汇查询的方法。我们提出了一种语义特征网格来保存基于Segment Anything Model（SAM）掩码提取的多视图CLIP特征，并通过3DGS将这些网格映射到低维特征以训练语义场。一旦训练完成，我们可以通过渲染特征从特征网格恢复像素对齐的CLIP嵌入，从而进行开放式词汇查询。与其他最先进的方法相比，FastLGS在速度和准确性方面均表现优异，其中FastLGS比LERF快98倍，比LangSplat快4倍。同时，实验表明FastLGS具有适应性和兼容性，可以应用于许多下游任务，如3D分割和3D对象修补，这些任务可以轻松地应用于其他3D操作系统。

title: FatesGS: Fast and Accurate Sparse-View Surface Reconstruction Using Gaussian Splatting with Depth-Feature Consistency
title_ch: FatesGS：快速准确的稀疏视图表面重建方法，采用深度特征一致性高斯点积
authors: Han Huang;Yulun Wu;Chao Deng;Ge Gao;Ming Gu;Yu-Shen Liu;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;
abstract: Recently, Gaussian Splatting has sparked a new trend in the field of computer vision. Apart from novel view synthesis, it has also been extended to the area of multi-view reconstruction. The latest methods facilitate complete, detailed surface reconstruction while ensuring fast training speed. However, these methods still require dense input views, and their output quality significantly degrades with sparse views. We observed that the Gaussian primitives tend to overfit the few training views, leading to noisy floaters and incomplete reconstruction surfaces. In this paper, we present an innovative sparse-view reconstruction framework that leverages intra-view depth and multi-view feature consistency to achieve remarkably accurate surface reconstruction. Specifically, we utilize monocular depth ranking information to supervise the consistency of depth distribution within patches and employ a smoothness loss to enhance the continuity of the distribution. To achieve finer surface reconstruction, we optimize the absolute position of depth through multi-view projection features. Extensive experiments on DTU and BlendedMVS demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods with a speedup of 60x to 200x, achieving swift and fine-grained mesh reconstruction without the need for costly pre-training.
abstract_ch: 最近，高斯绘制法在计算机视觉领域引发了新的研究趋势。除了新颖视图合成之外，它还被扩展到多视图重建的领域。最新的方法能够在保持快速训练速度的同时实现完整的、详细的表面重建。然而，这些方法仍然需要密集的输入视图，且当使用稀疏视图时，输出质量会显著下降。我们观察到，高斯原语倾向于过度拟合少数训练视图，导致噪声点和不完整的重建表面。在本文中，我们提出了一种创新的稀疏视图重建框架，该框架利用视内深度和多视图特征一致性来实现高度准确的表面重建。具体来说，我们利用单目深度排名信息监督深度分布的一致性，并采用平滑损失增强分布的连续性。为了实现更精细的表面重建，我们通过多视图投影特征优化深度的绝对位置。在DTU和BlendedMVS上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在速度上比最先进的方法快60倍至200倍，能够在无需昂贵预训练的情况下实现快速且精细的网格重建。

title: FlexiTex: Enhancing Texture Generation via Visual Guidance
title_ch: FlexiTex：通过视觉引导增强纹理生成
authors: Dadong Jiang;Xianghui Yang;Zibo Zhao;Sheng Zhang;Jiaao Yu;Zeqiang Lai;Shaoxiong Yang;Chunchao Guo;Xiaobo Zhou;Zhihui Ke;
affiliations: Tianjin University;Tencent;
abstract: Recent texture generation methods achieve impressive results due to the powerful generative prior they leverage from large-scale text-to-image diffusion models. However, abstract textual prompts are limited in providing global textural or shape information, which results in the texture generation methods producing blurry or inconsistent patterns. To tackle this, we present FlexiTex, embedding rich information via visual guidance to generate a high-quality texture. The core of FlexiTex is the Visual Guidance Enhancement module, which incorporates more specific information from visual guidance to reduce ambiguity in the text prompt and preserve high-frequency details. To further enhance the visual guidance, we introduce a Direction-Aware Adaptation module that automatically designs direction prompts based on different camera poses, avoiding the Janus problem and maintaining semantically global consistency. Benefiting from the visual guidance, FlexiTex produces quantitatively and qualitatively sound results, demonstrating its potential to advance texture generation for real-world applications.
abstract_ch: 近年来，借助大规模文本到图像扩散模型的强大生成先验，纹理生成方法取得了令人印象深刻的成果。然而，抽象的文字提示在提供全局纹理或形状信息方面有限制，导致这些方法生成模糊或不一致的图案。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了FlexiTex，通过视觉引导嵌入丰富的信息来生成高质量的纹理。FlexiTex的核心是视觉引导增强模块，该模块结合了更多具体的视觉引导信息，以减少文字提示中的歧义并保留高频细节。为了进一步增强视觉引导，我们引入了一个方向感知自适应模块，该模块根据不同的相机姿态自动设计方向提示，避免了“双面镜”问题，并保持了语义上的全局一致性。得益于视觉引导，FlexiTex生成的结果在定量和定性上都更为可靠，展示了其在现实应用中推进纹理生成的潜力。

title: Game4Loc: A UAV Geo-Localization Benchmark from Game Data
title_ch: Game4Loc：来自游戏数据的无人机地理定位基准
authors: Yuxiang Ji;Boyong He;Zhuoyue Tan;Liaoni Wu;
affiliations: Xiamen University;
abstract: The vision-based geo-localization technology for UAV, serving as a secondary source of GPS information in addition to the global navigation satellite systems (GNSS), can still operate independently in the GPS-denied environment. Recent deep learning based methods attribute this as the task of image matching and retrieval. By retrieving drone-view images in geo-tagged satellite image database, approximate localization information can be obtained. However, due to high costs and privacy concerns, it is usually difficult to obtain large quantities of drone-view images from a continuous area. Existing drone-view datasets are mostly composed of small-scale aerial photography with a strong assumption that there exists a perfect one-to-one aligned reference image for any query, leaving a significant gap from the practical localization scenario. In this work, we construct a large-range contiguous area UAV geo-localization dataset named GTA-UAV, featuring multiple flight altitudes, attitudes, scenes, and targets using modern computer games. Based on this dataset, we introduce a more practical UAV geo-localization task including partial matches of cross-view paired data, and expand the image-level retrieval to the actual localization in terms of distance (meters). For the construction of drone-view and satellite-view pairs, we adopt a weight-based contrastive learning approach, which allows for effective learning while avoiding additional post-processing matching steps. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our data and training method for UAV geo-localization, as well as the generalization capabilities to real-world scenarios.
abstract_ch: 基于视觉的地基无人机地理定位技术，在全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）之外充当GPS信息的次要来源，即使在GPS受限环境中仍能独立运行。最近基于深度学习的方法将这一任务归结为图像匹配和检索。通过从带有地理标记的卫星图像数据库中检索无人机视角图像，可以获取大致的定位信息。然而，由于成本高昂和隐私问题，通常难以从连续区域获得大量无人机视角图像。现有的无人机视角数据集大多由小规模航拍图片组成，并且假设对于任何查询都存在完美的一对一对齐参考图像，这与实际的地理定位场景之间存在显著差距。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个名为GTA-UAV的大范围连续区域无人机地理定位数据集，该数据集利用现代计算机游戏，涵盖了多种飞行高度、姿态、场景和目标。基于此数据集，我们引入了一个更实际的无人机地理定位任务，包括跨视图配对数据的部分匹配，并将图像级别的检索扩展到实际的距离（米）地理定位。在构建无人机视角和卫星视角配对时，我们采用了基于权重的对比学习方法，这不仅有助于有效的学习，还能避免额外的后处理匹配步骤。实验表明，我们的数据和训练方法在无人机地理定位方面具有有效性，并且具有适应现实世界场景的一般化能力。

title: GaussianSR: High Fidelity 2D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-Scale Image Super-Resolution
title_ch: 高保真任意尺度图像超分辨率的2D高斯斑点渲染
authors: Jintong Hu;Bin Xia;Bin Chen;Wenming Yang;Lei Zhang;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Peking University;Hong Kong Polytechnic University;OPPO Research Institute;
abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) have significantly advanced the field of arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) of images. Most existing INR-based ASSR networks first extract features from the given low-resolution image using an encoder, and then render the super-resolved result via a multi-layer perceptron decoder. Although these approaches have shown promising results, their performance is constrained by the limited representation ability of discrete latent codes in the encoded features. In this paper, we propose a novel ASSR method named GaussianSR that overcomes this limitation through 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS). Unlike traditional methods that treat pixels as discrete points, GaussianSR represents each pixel as a continuous Gaussian field. The encoded features are simultaneously refined and upsampled by rendering the mutually stacked Gaussian fields. As a result, long-range dependencies are established to enhance representation ability. In addition, a classifier is developed to dynamically assign Gaussian kernels to all pixels to further improve flexibility. All components of GaussianSR (i.e., encoder, classifier, Gaussian kernels, and decoder) are jointly learned end-to-end. Experiments demonstrate that GaussianSR achieves superior ASSR performance with fewer parameters than existing methods while enjoying interpretable and content-aware feature aggregations.
abstract_ch: 隐式神经表示（INRs）在图像任意尺度超分辨率（ASSR）领域取得了显著进展。大多数现有的基于INR的ASSR网络首先使用编码器从给定的低分辨率图像中提取特征，然后通过多层感知机解码器生成超分辨率的结果。尽管这些方法展示了令人鼓舞的结果，但它们的表现受限于编码特征中离散潜码的有限表示能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为GaussianSR的新ASSR方法，通过二维高斯斑点化（2DGS）克服了这一限制。与传统方法将像素视为离散点不同，GaussianSR 将每个像素表示为连续的高斯场。编码特征同时被细化和上采样，通过渲染相互叠加的高斯场来实现。因此，建立起了长距离依赖关系，以增强表示能力。此外，还开发了一个分类器，可以动态地为所有像素分配高斯核，进一步提高灵活性。GaussianSR的所有组件（即编码器、分类器、高斯核和解码器）都是端到端联合学习的。实验表明，GaussianSR 在参数量较少的情况下实现了优于现有方法的ASSR性能，并且具有可解释性和内容感知的特征聚合能力。

title: Generalized Class Discovery in Instance Segmentation
title_ch: 泛化类发现实例分割
authors: Cuong Manh Hoang;Yeejin Lee;Byeongkeun Kang;
affiliations: Seoul National University of Science and Technology;Chung-Ang University;
abstract: This work addresses the task of generalized class discovery (GCD) in instance segmentation. The goal is to discover novel classes and obtain a model capable of segmenting instances of both known and novel categories, given labeled and unlabeled data. Since the real world contains numerous objects with long-tailed distributions, the instance distribution for each class is inherently imbalanced. To address the imbalanced distributions, we propose an instance-wise temperature assignment (ITA) method for contrastive learning and class-wise reliability criteria for pseudo-labels. The ITA method relaxes instance discrimination for samples belonging to head classes to enhance GCD. The reliability criteria are to avoid excluding most pseudo-labels for tail classes when training an instance segmentation network using pseudo-labels from GCD. Additionally, we propose dynamically adjusting the criteria to leverage diverse samples in the early stages while relying only on reliable pseudo-labels in the later stages. We also introduce an efficient soft attention module to encode object-specific representations for GCD. Finally, we evaluate our proposed method by conducting experiments on two settings: COCO$_{half}$ + LVIS and LVIS + Visual Genome. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.
abstract_ch: 这篇工作探讨了实例分割中的通用类发现（GCD）任务。目标是在有标记和无标记数据的情况下，发现新的类别并获得一个能够分割已知和新类别实例的模型。由于现实世界中包含大量具有长尾分布的对象，每个类别的实例分布本质上是不平衡的。为了解决不平衡的问题，我们提出了一种针对对比学习的实例级温度分配（ITA）方法以及一种类别级可靠性标准来处理伪标签。ITA方法放宽了头部类别样本的实例区分度以增强GCD。可靠性标准旨在避免在使用GCD生成的伪标签训练实例分割网络时，将尾部类别中的大多数伪标签排除在外。此外，我们还提出动态调整标准，在早期阶段利用多样化的样本，而在后期阶段仅依赖可靠的伪标签。最后，我们通过在COCO$_{half}$ + LVIS和LVIS + Visual Genome两个设置下进行实验来评估我们提出的方法。实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于之前最先进的方法。

title: Generative Medical Segmentation
title_ch: 生成医学分割
authors: Jiayu Huo;Xi Ouyang;Sébastien Ourselin;Rachel Sparks;
affiliations: King’s College London;Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.;
abstract: Rapid advancements in medical image segmentation performance have been significantly driven by the development of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs). These models follow the discriminative pixel-wise classification learning paradigm and often have limited ability to generalize across diverse medical imaging datasets. In this manuscript, we introduce Generative Medical Segmentation (GMS), a novel approach leveraging a generative model to perform image segmentation. Concretely, GMS employs a robust pre-trained vision foundation model to extract latent representations for images and corresponding ground truth masks, followed by a model that learns a mapping function from the image to the mask in the latent space. Once trained, the model generates an estimated segmentation mask using the pre-trained vision foundation model to decode the predicted latent representation back into the image space. The design of GMS leads to fewer trainable parameters in the model which reduces the risk of overfitting and enhances its generalization capability. Our experimental analysis across five public datasets in different medical imaging domains demonstrates GMS outperforms existing discriminative and generative segmentation models. Furthermore, GMS is able to generalize well across datasets from different centers within the same imaging modality. Our experiments suggest GMS offers a scalable and effective solution for medical image segmentation. GMS implementation and trained model weights are available at https://github.com/King-HAW/GMS.
abstract_ch: 医学图像分割性能的快速提升很大程度上得益于卷积神经网络（CNNs）和视觉变换器（ViTs）的发展。这些模型遵循区分性像素级分类的学习范式，通常在不同医学影像数据集上的泛化能力有限。在这篇论文中，我们介绍了生成医学分割（GMS），这是一种利用生成模型进行图像分割的新方法。具体来说，GMS 使用一个稳健的预训练视觉基础模型来提取图像及其对应的真实掩码的潜在表示，然后通过一个模型学习从图像到掩码的映射函数，该映射发生在潜在空间中。一旦训练完成，该模型将使用预训练的视觉基础模型生成估计的分割掩码，以将预测的潜在表示解码回图像空间。GMS 的设计减少了模型中的可训练参数数量，从而降低了过拟合的风险并增强了其泛化能力。我们在五个不同的医学影像领域公开的数据集中进行的实验分析表明，GMS 在医学图像分割方面优于现有的区分性和生成性分割模型。此外，GMS 能够很好地跨同一成像模态的不同中心的数据集泛化。我们的实验表明，GMS 提供了一个可扩展且有效的医学图像分割解决方案。GMS 的实现和训练模型权重可在 https://github.com/King-HAW/GMS 获取。

title: Multispectral Pedestrian Detection with Sparsely Annotated Label
title_ch: 基于稀疏标注标签的多光谱行人检测
authors: Chan Lee;Seungho Shin;Gyeong-Moon Park;Jung Uk Kim;
affiliations: Kyung Hee University;
abstract: Although existing Sparsely Annotated Object Detection (SAOD) approches have made progress in handling sparsely annotated environments in multispectral domain, where only some pedestrians are annotated, they still have the following limitations: (i) they lack considerations for improving the quality of pseudo-labels for missing annotations, and (ii) they rely on fixed ground truth annotations, which leads to learning only a limited range of pedestrian visual appearances in the multispectral domain. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework called Sparsely Annotated Multispectral Pedestrian Detection (SAMPD). For limitation (i), we introduce Multispectral Pedestrian-aware Adaptive Weight (MPAW) and Positive Pseudo-label Enhancement (PPE) module. Utilizing multispectral knowledge, these modules ensure the generation of high-quality pseudo-labels and enable effective learning by increasing weights for high-quality pseudo-labels based on modality characteristics. To address limitation (ii), we propose an Adaptive Pedestrian Retrieval Augmentation (APRA) module, which adaptively incorporates pedestrian patches from ground-truth and dynamically integrates high-quality pseudo-labels with the ground-truth, facilitating a more diverse learning pool of pedestrians. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our SAMPD significantly enhances performance in sparsely annotated environments within the multispectral domain.
abstract_ch: 尽管现有的稀疏标注行人检测（SAOD）方法在多光谱域中处理稀疏标注环境方面取得了进展，其中只有部分行人在进行标注，但它们仍然存在以下局限性：（i）缺乏提高缺失标注质量的考虑，以及（ii）依赖于固定的地面真实标注，这导致只能学习有限范围的行人视觉外观。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为稀疏标注多光谱行人检测（SAMPD）的新框架。针对局限性（i），我们引入了多光谱行人感知自适应权重（MPAW）模块和正向伪标签增强（PPE）模块。利用多光谱知识，这些模块确保生成高质量的伪标签，并通过基于模态特征增加高质量伪标签的权重来实现有效的学习。针对局限性（ii），我们提出了自适应行人检索增强（APRA）模块，该模块能够自适应地从地面真实标注中融入行人补丁，并动态地将高质量伪标签与地面真实标注集成，从而促进更加多样化的行人学习池。广泛的实验结果表明，我们的SAMPD在多光谱域中的稀疏标注环境中显著提升了性能。

abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER) remains a challenging task due to label ambiguity caused by the subjective nature of facial expressions and noisy samples. Additionally, class imbalance, which is common in real-world datasets, further complicates FER. Although many studies have shown impressive improvements, they typically address only one of these issues, leading to suboptimal results. To tackle both challenges simultaneously, we propose a novel framework called Navigating Label Ambiguity (NLA), which is robust under real-world conditions. The motivation behind NLA is that dynamically estimating and emphasizing ambiguous samples at each iteration helps mitigate noise and class imbalance by reducing the model's bias toward majority classes. To achieve this, NLA consists of two main components: Noise-aware Adaptive Weighting (NAW) and consistency regularization. Specifically, NAW adaptively assigns higher importance to ambiguous samples and lower importance to noisy ones, based on the correlation between the intermediate prediction scores for the ground truth and the nearest negative. Moreover, we incorporate a regularization term to ensure consistent latent distributions. Consequently, NLA enables the model to progressively focus on more challenging ambiguous samples, which primarily belong to the minority class, in the later stages of training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NLA outperforms existing methods in both overall and mean accuracy, confirming its robustness against noise and class imbalance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework to address both problems simultaneously.
abstract_ch: 面部表情识别（FER）仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务，原因在于面部表情的主观性质导致标签模糊，并且样本噪声较大。此外，类不平衡在真实世界的数据集中非常普遍，进一步复杂化了面部表情识别。尽管许多研究显示出了显著的进步，但它们通常仅解决了这些问题中的一个，导致结果不尽如人意。为了同时应对这两个挑战，我们提出了一种名为“导航标签模糊性”（Navigating Label Ambiguity，简称NLA）的新框架，在实际条件下该框架表现出高度鲁棒性。NLA 的动机在于，动态估计和强调每次迭代中的模糊样本有助于通过减少模型对多数类别偏见来减轻噪声和类不平衡问题。为了实现这一点，NLA 包含两个主要组成部分：噪声感知自适应加权（Noise-aware Adaptive Weighting，简称NAW）和一致性正则化。具体来说，NAW 根据中间预测分数与地面真实值最近的负样本之间的相关性，动态地赋予模糊样本更高的重要性和噪声样本更低的重要性。此外，我们引入了一个正则化项以确保潜在分布的一致性。因此，NLA 能够使模型在训练后期逐步关注更具挑战性的模糊样本，这些样本主要属于少数类别。广泛的实验表明，NLA 在总体准确率和平均准确率上均优于现有方法，证实了其对抗噪声和类不平衡的鲁棒性。据我们所知，这是首个同时解决这两个问题的框架。

title_ch: 基于邻居的置信度调整：使用激光雷达进行3D稀有目标检测
