title: NeSyCoCo: A Neuro-Symbolic Concept Composer for Compositional Generalization
title_ch: NeSyCoCo：一种神经符号概念合成器，用于组合性泛化
authors: Danial Kamali;Elham J. Barezi;Parisa Kordjamshidi;
affiliations: Michigan State University;
abstract: Compositional generalization is crucial for artificial intelligence agents to solve complex vision-language reasoning tasks. Neuro-symbolic approaches have demonstrated promise in capturing compositional structures, but they face critical challenges: (a) reliance on predefined predicates for symbolic representations that limit adaptability, (b) difficulty in extracting predicates from raw data, and (c) using non-differentiable operations for combining primitive concepts. To address these issues, we propose NeSyCoCo, a neuro-symbolic framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate symbolic representations and map them to differentiable neural computations. NeSyCoCo introduces three innovations: (a) augmenting natural language inputs with dependency structures to enhance the alignment with symbolic representations, (b) employing distributed word representations to link diverse, linguistically motivated logical predicates to neural modules, and (c) using the soft composition of normalized predicate scores to align symbolic and differentiable reasoning. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art results on the ReaSCAN and CLEVR-CoGenT compositional generalization benchmarks and demonstrates robust performance with novel concepts in the CLEVR-SYN benchmark.
abstract_ch: 组合泛化对于人工智能代理解决复杂的视觉-语言推理任务至关重要。神经符号方法在捕捉组合结构方面展现出了潜力，但它们面临着关键挑战：（a）依赖预定义谓词进行符号表示，这限制了其适应性；（b）从原始数据中提取谓词的难度较大；（c）使用非可微操作来结合基本概念。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了NeSyCoCo，这是一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）生成符号表示并将这些表示映射到可微神经计算的神经符号框架。NeSyCoCo 引入了三项创新：（a）通过增加自然语言输入的依存结构来增强与符号表示的对齐；（b）采用分布式词向量将多样且语言驱动的逻辑谓词连接到神经模块；（c）使用归一化谓词分数的软组合来对齐符号和可微推理。我们的框架在ReaSCAN 和 CLEVR-CoGenT 组合泛化基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，并在CLEVR-SYN 基准测试中展示了对新颖概念的稳健表现。

title: Optimizing Human Pose Estimation Through Focused Human and Joint Regions
title_ch: 通过聚焦人体和关节区域优化人体姿态估计
authors: Yingying Jiao;Zhigang Wang;Zhenguang Liu;Shaojing Fan;Sifan Wu;Zheqi Wu;Zhuoyue Xu;
affiliations: Jilin University;Zhejiang Gongshang University;Zhejiang University;Hangzhou High-Tech Zone Institute of Blockchain and Data Security;National University of Singapore;
abstract: Human pose estimation has given rise to a broad spectrum of novel and compelling applications, including action recognition, sports analysis, as well as surveillance. However, accurate video pose estimation remains an open challenge. One aspect that has been overlooked so far is that existing methods learn motion clues from all pixels rather than focusing on the target human body, making them easily misled and disrupted by unimportant information such as background changes or movements of other people. Additionally, while the current Transformer-based pose estimation methods has demonstrated impressive performance with global modeling, they struggle with local context perception and precise positional identification. In this paper, we try to tackle these challenges from three aspects: (1) We propose a bilayer Human-Keypoint Mask module that performs coarse-to-fine visual token refinement, which gradually zooms in on the target human body and keypoints while masking out unimportant figure regions. (2) We further introduce a novel deformable cross attention mechanism and a bidirectional separation strategy to adaptively aggregate spatial and temporal motion clues from constrained surrounding contexts. (3) We mathematically formulate the deformable cross attention, constraining that the model focuses solely on the regions centered at the target person body. Empirically, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on three large-scale benchmark datasets. A remarkable highlight is that our method achieves an 84.8 mean Average Precision (mAP) on the challenging wrist joint, which significantly outperforms the 81.5 mAP achieved by the current state-of-the-art method on the PoseTrack2017 dataset.
abstract_ch: 人体姿态估计已经催生出一系列新颖且引人注目的应用，包括动作识别、体育分析以及监控。然而，准确的视频姿态估计仍然是一个开放性的挑战。迄今为止被忽视的一个方面是：现有方法从所有像素中学习运动线索，而不是专注于目标人体，这使得它们容易受到背景变化或其他人移动等不重要信息的误导和干扰。此外，虽然当前基于Transformer的人体姿态估计方法在全局建模方面表现出色，但在局部上下文感知和精确的位置识别方面仍存在困难。在这篇论文中，我们尝试从三个方面来应对这些挑战：（1）我们提出了一种双层人体关键点掩码模块，执行粗到细的视觉标记细化，逐步聚焦于目标人体和关键点，同时屏蔽掉不重要的图形单元区域。（2）我们进一步引入了一种新颖的可变形交叉注意力机制和双向分离策略，以适应性地从受限的周围上下文中聚合空间和时间运动线索。（3）我们从数学上形式化了可变形交叉注意力机制，确保模型仅关注目标人体中心的区域。实验证明，我们的方法在三个大规模基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。一个显著亮点是，我们的方法在具有挑战性的腕关节姿态估计上达到了84.8的平均精度（mAP），这一成绩明显优于当前最先进的PoseTrack2017数据集上实现的81.5的mAP。

title: Orchestrating the Symphony of Prompt Distribution Learning for Human-Object Interaction Detection
title_ch: orchestrating 人类与物体交互检测中的提示分布学习交响曲
authors: Mingda Jia;Liming Zhao;Ge Li;Yun Zheng;
affiliations: Peking University;Alibaba Group;
abstract: Human-object interaction (HOI) detectors with popular query-transformer architecture have achieved promising performance. However, accurately identifying uncommon visual patterns and distinguishing between ambiguous HOIs continue to be difficult for them. We observe that these difficulties may arise from the limited capacity of traditional detector queries in representing diverse intra-category patterns and inter-category dependencies. To address this, we introduce the Interaction Prompt Distribution Learning (InterProDa) approach. InterProDa learns multiple sets of soft prompts and estimates category distributions from various prompts. It then incorporates HOI queries with category distributions, making them capable of representing near-infinite intra-category dynamics and universal cross-category relationships. Our InterProDa detector demonstrates competitive performance on HICO-DET and vcoco benchmarks. Additionally, our method can be integrated into most transformer-based HOI detectors, significantly enhancing their performance with minimal additional parameters.
abstract_ch: 基于流行查询变换器架构的人-物交互（HOI）检测器已经取得了令人瞩目的性能。然而，它们在准确识别不常见的视觉模式和区分模糊的人-物交互方面仍然存在困难。我们观察到，这些困难可能源于传统检测器查询有限的表现能力，无法充分代表类别内的多样模式和跨类别的依赖关系。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了交互提示分布学习（InterProDa）方法。InterProDa 学习多个软提示集，并从各种提示中估计类别分布。然后将人-物交互查询与类别分布结合，使其能够表示近乎无限的类别内动态变化和普遍的跨类别关系。我们的 InterProDa 检测器在 HICO-DET 和 vcoco 基准测试中表现出竞争力。此外，我们的方法可以集成到大多数基于变换器的人-物交互检测器中，只需少量额外参数即可显著提升其性能。

title: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition: A New Benchmark Dataset and a Large Language Model Augmented Framework
title_ch: 行人属性识别：一个新的基准数据集和一个大型语言模型增强框架
authors: Jiandong Jin;Xiao Wang;Qian Zhu;Haiyang Wang;Chenglong Li;
affiliations: Anhui University;Anhui Provincial Key Laboratory of Security Artificial Intelligence;
abstract: Pedestrian Attribute Recognition (PAR) is one of the indispensable tasks in human-centered research. However, existing datasets neglect different domains (e.g., environments, times, populations, and data sources), only conducting simple random splits, and the performance of these datasets has already approached saturation. In the past five years, no large-scale dataset has been opened to the public. To address this issue, this paper proposes a new large-scale, cross-domain pedestrian attribute recognition dataset to fill the data gap, termed MSP60K. It consists of 60,122 images and 57 attribute annotations across eight scenarios. Synthetic degradation is also conducted to further narrow the gap between the dataset and real-world challenging scenarios. To establish a more rigorous benchmark, we evaluate 17 representative PAR models under both random and cross-domain split protocols on our dataset. Additionally, we propose an innovative Large Language Model (LLM) augmented PAR framework, named LLM-PAR. This framework processes pedestrian images through a Vision Transformer (ViT) backbone to extract features and introduces a multi-embedding query Transformer to learn partial-aware features for attribute classification. Significantly, we enhance this framework with LLM for ensemble learning and visual feature augmentation. Comprehensive experiments across multiple PAR benchmark datasets have thoroughly validated the efficacy of our proposed framework. The dataset and source code accompanying this paper will be made publicly available at \url{https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenPAR}.
abstract_ch: 行人属性识别（PAR）是基于人类的研究中不可或缺的任务之一。然而，现有的数据集忽略了不同的领域（例如环境、时间、人群和数据来源），仅仅进行了简单的随机分割，这些数据集的表现已经接近饱和。在过去五年中，没有大规模的数据集向公众开放。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种新的大规模跨域行人属性识别数据集，称为MSP60K，以填补数据空白。该数据集包含60,122张图像和八个场景下的57个属性注释。为了进一步缩小数据集与现实世界具有挑战性的场景之间的差距，还进行了合成降级处理。为了建立一个更为严格的基准，我们在我们的数据集上评估了17个代表性的PAR模型，分别在随机分割协议和跨域分割协议下进行。此外，我们提出了一种创新的大型语言模型（LLM）增强的行人属性识别框架，名为LLM-PAR。该框架通过Vision Transformer（ViT）骨干网络处理行人图像以提取特征，并引入多嵌入查询Transformer来学习部分感知特征以用于属性分类。显著的是，我们通过LLM增强了此框架，用于集成学习和视觉特征增强。针对多个PAR基准数据集进行的全面实验已充分验证了我们所提出的框架的有效性。本文的数据集和源代码将可在\url{https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenPAR}公开获取。

title: PixelMan: Consistent Object Editing with Diffusion Models via Pixel Manipulation and Generation
title_ch: PixelMan：通过像素操作与生成的一致性对象编辑方法
authors: Liyao Jiang;Negar Hassanpour;Mohammad Salameh;Mohammadreza Samadi;Jiao He;Fengyu Sun;Di Niu;
affiliations: University of Alberta;Huawei;
abstract: Recent research explores the potential of Diffusion Models (DMs) for consistent object editing, which aims to modify object position, size, and composition, etc., while preserving the consistency of objects and background without changing their texture and attributes. Current inference-time methods often rely on DDIM inversion, which inherently compromises efficiency and the achievable consistency of edited images. Recent methods also utilize energy guidance which iteratively updates the predicted noise and can drive the latents away from the original image, resulting in distortions. In this paper, we propose PixelMan, an inversion-free and training-free method for achieving consistent object editing via Pixel Manipulation and generation, where we directly create a duplicate copy of the source object at target location in the pixel space, and introduce an efficient sampling approach to iteratively harmonize the manipulated object into the target location and inpaint its original location, while ensuring image consistency by anchoring the edited image to be generated to the pixel-manipulated image as well as by introducing various consistency-preserving optimization techniques during inference. Experimental evaluations based on benchmark datasets as well as extensive visual comparisons show that in as few as 16 inference steps, PixelMan outperforms a range of state-of-the-art training-based and training-free methods (usually requiring 50 steps) on multiple consistent object editing tasks.
abstract_ch: 最近的研究探讨了扩散模型（DMs）在实现一致的对象编辑方面的潜力，旨在修改对象的位置、大小和组成等，同时保持对象和背景的一致性，而不改变它们的纹理和属性。当前的推理时间方法通常依赖于DDIM反演，这本身会牺牲效率和编辑图像能达到的一致性。最近的方法还利用能量引导，通过迭代更新预测噪声来驱动潜在变量远离原始图像，导致失真。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为PixelMan的方法，这是一种无需反演和无需训练的实现一致对象编辑的方法，通过像素操纵和生成，直接在像素空间中在目标位置创建源对象的副本，并引入一种高效的采样方法来逐步将操纵对象融合到目标位置并填补其原始位置，同时通过将编辑后的图像生成锚定到像素操纵的图像以及引入多种一致性保留的优化技术来确保图像的一致性。基于基准数据集的实验评估以及广泛的视觉对比表明，在仅16步的推理步骤中，PixelMan 在多个一致对象编辑任务上优于一系列最新的基于训练和非基于训练的方法（这些方法通常需要50步）。

title: PLATYPUS: Progressive Local Surface Estimator for Arbitrary-Scale Point Cloud Upsampling
title_ch: platypus：面向任意尺度点云上采样的渐进式局部表面估计方法
authors: Donghyun Kim;Hyeonkyeong Kwon;Yumin Kim;Seong Jae Hwang;
affiliations: Yonsei University;Korea University;
abstract: 3D point clouds are increasingly vital for applications like autonomous driving and robotics, yet the raw data captured by sensors often suffer from noise and sparsity, creating challenges for downstream tasks. Consequently, point cloud upsampling becomes essential for improving density and uniformity, with recent approaches showing promise by projecting randomly generated query points onto the underlying surface of sparse point clouds. However, these methods often result in outliers, non-uniformity, and difficulties in handling regions with high curvature and intricate structures. In this work, we address these challenges by introducing the Progressive Local Surface Estimator (PLSE), which more effectively captures local features in complex regions through a curvature-based sampling technique that selectively targets high-curvature areas. Additionally, we incorporate a curriculum learning strategy that leverages the curvature distribution within the point cloud to naturally assess the sample difficulty, enabling curriculum learning on point cloud data for the first time. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving high-quality, dense point clouds with superior accuracy and detail.
abstract_ch: 三维点云在自动驾驶和机器人等领域中越来越重要，但传感器捕获的原始数据往往存在噪声和稀疏性问题，这为下游任务带来了挑战。因此，点云上采样变得至关重要，以提高密度和均匀性。最近的方法通过将随机生成的查询点投影到稀疏点云的基础表面上显示出一定的前景，然而这些方法通常会导致异常值、非均匀性和难以处理高曲率和复杂结构区域的问题。在本工作中，我们通过引入渐进局部表面估计器（PLSE），利用基于曲率的采样技术有选择地针对高曲率区域，更有效地捕捉复杂区域中的局部特征。此外，我们还结合了一种课程学习策略，该策略利用点云内的曲率分布自然评估样本难度，从而首次实现了点云数据的课程学习。实验结果表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，能够生成高质量、密集且细节丰富的点云。

title: PoseMamba: Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation with Bidirectional Global-Local Spatio-Temporal State Space Model
title_ch: PoseMamba：基于双向全局-局部时空状态空间模型的一维人体三维姿态估计
authors: Yunlong Huang;Junshuo Liu;Ke Xian;Robert Caiming Qiu;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology;
abstract: Transformers have significantly advanced the field of 3D human pose estimation (HPE). However, existing transformer-based methods primarily use self-attention mechanisms for spatio-temporal modeling, leading to a quadratic complexity, unidirectional modeling of spatio-temporal relationships, and insufficient learning of spatial-temporal correlations. Recently, the Mamba architecture, utilizing the state space model (SSM), has exhibited superior long-range modeling capabilities in a variety of vision tasks with linear complexity. In this paper, we propose PoseMamba, a novel purely SSM-based approach with linear complexity for 3D human pose estimation in monocular video. Specifically, we propose a bidirectional global-local spatio-temporal SSM block that comprehensively models human joint relations within individual frames as well as temporal correlations across frames. Within this bidirectional global-local spatio-temporal SSM block, we introduce a reordering strategy to enhance the local modeling capability of the SSM. This strategy provides a more logical geometric scanning order and integrates it with the global SSM, resulting in a combined global-local spatial scan. We have quantitatively and qualitatively evaluated our approach using two benchmark datasets: Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PoseMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance on both datasets while maintaining a smaller model size and reducing computational costs. The code and models will be released.
abstract_ch: Transformer技术显著推动了三维人体姿态估计（3D HPE）领域的发展。然而，现有的基于Transformer的方法主要使用自注意力机制进行时空建模，这导致了二次复杂度、单向的时空关系建模以及对时空相关性的学习不足。最近，利用状态空间模型（SSM）的Mamba架构在多种视觉任务中展示了优越的长距离建模能力，并且具有线性复杂度。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为PoseMamba的新颖方法，这是一种基于SSM的线性复杂度方法，用于单目视频中的三维人体姿态估计。具体而言，我们提出了一种双向全局-局部时空SSM块，该块不仅能够全面建模单个帧内的人体关节关系，还能跨帧建模时空相关性。在这个双向全局-局部时空SSM块中，我们引入了一种重排序策略来增强SSM的局部建模能力。该策略提供了一个更逻辑化的几何扫描顺序，并将其与全局SSM相结合，形成了一个综合的全局-局部空间扫描。我们使用两个基准数据集：Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP，从定量和定性的角度评估了我们的方法。广泛的实验表明，PoseMamba在两个数据集上都实现了最先进的性能，同时保持了较小的模型大小并降低了计算成本。代码和模型将被公开发布。

title: Prediction-Feedback DETR for Temporal Action Detection
title_ch: 预测反馈DETR在时间动作检测中的应用
authors: Jihwan Kim;Miso Lee;Cheol-Ho Cho;Jihyun Lee;Jae-Pil Heo;
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University;
abstract: Temporal Action Detection (TAD) is fundamental yet challenging for real-world video applications. Leveraging the unique benefits of transformers, various DETR-based approaches have been adopted in TAD. However, it has recently been identified that the attention collapse in self-attention causes the performance degradation of DETR for TAD. Building upon previous research, this paper newly addresses the attention collapse problem in cross-attention within DETR-based TAD methods. Moreover, our findings reveal that cross-attention exhibits patterns distinct from predictions, indicating a short-cut phenomenon. To resolve this, we propose a new framework, Prediction-Feedback DETR (Pred-DETR), which utilizes predictions to restore the collapse and align the cross- and self-attention with predictions. Specifically, we devise novel prediction-feedback objectives using guidance from the relations of the predictions. As a result, Pred-DETR significantly alleviates the collapse and achieves state-of-the-art performance among DETR-based methods on various challenging benchmarks including THUMOS14, ActivityNet-v1.3, HACS, and FineAction.
abstract_ch: 时空动作检测（TAD）对于现实世界的视频应用来说是基础且具有挑战性的。利用变换器的独特优势，各种DETR（检测-估计-跟踪）基于的方法已被应用于TAD。然而，最近的研究发现，在自注意力中的注意坍塌导致了DETR在TAD上的性能下降。在此基础上，本文新地解决了DETR基于的时空动作检测方法中交叉注意力的注意坍塌问题，并且我们的研究发现交叉注意力表现出与预测不同的模式，暗示了一种捷径现象。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的框架——预测反馈DETR（Pred-DETR），该框架利用预测来恢复注意坍塌，并将交叉注意力和自注意力与预测对齐。具体而言，我们设计了新颖的预测反馈目标，这些目标得到了预测关系的指导。结果表明，Pred-DETR显著缓解了注意坍塌的问题，并在THUMOS14、ActivityNet-v1.3、HACS和FineAction等多个具有挑战性的基准测试中达到了DETR基方法的最佳性能。

title: Progressive Multi-granular Alignments for Grounded Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
title_ch: 面向地面推理的大规模视觉-语言模型的渐进多粒度对齐
authors: Quang-Hung Le;Long Hoang Dang;Ngan Hoang Le;Truyen Tran;Thao Minh Le;
affiliations: Deakin University;Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology;University of Arkansas;
abstract: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) excel at matching concepts across multi-modal inputs but struggle with compositional concepts and high-level relationships between entities. This paper introduces Progressive multi-granular Vision-Language alignments (PromViL), a novel framework to enhance LVLMs' ability in performing grounded compositional visual reasoning tasks. Our approach constructs a hierarchical structure of multi-modal alignments, ranging from simple to complex concepts. By progressively aligning textual descriptions with corresponding visual regions, our model learns to leverage contextual information from lower levels to inform higher-level reasoning. To facilitate this learning process, we introduce a data generation process that creates a novel dataset derived from Visual Genome, providing a wide range of nested compositional vision-language pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that our PromViL framework significantly outperforms baselines on various visual grounding and compositional question answering tasks. The code is available at: https://github.com/lqh52/PromViL.
abstract_ch: 现有的大型多模态视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在匹配多模态输入中的概念方面表现出色，但在处理组成概念和实体之间的高层关系时存在困难。本文介绍了渐进多层次视觉-语言对齐（PromViL）框架，这是一种新颖的方法，旨在增强LVLMs在执行基于视觉的组合推理任务方面的能力。我们的方法构建了一个从简单到复杂的多模态对齐的分层结构。通过逐步将文本描述与相应的视觉区域对齐，我们的模型学会了利用较低层次的上下文信息来指导较高层次的推理。为了促进这一学习过程，我们引入了一个数据生成过程，创建了一个源自Visual Genome的新数据集，提供了广泛的嵌套组合视觉-语言配对。实验结果表明，我们的PromViL框架在各种视觉定位和组合问答任务上显著优于基线模型。代码可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/lqh52/PromViL。

title: ProtoOcc: Accurate, Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Branch Encoder-Prototype Query Decoder
title_ch: ProtoOcc: 基于双支路编码-原型查询解码的准确高效三维占用预测
authors: Jungho Kim;Changwon Kang;Dongyoung Lee;Sehwan Choi;Jun Won Choi;
affiliations: Seoul National University;Hanyang University;
abstract: In this paper, we introduce ProtoOcc, a novel 3D occupancy prediction model designed to predict the occupancy states and semantic classes of 3D voxels through a deep semantic understanding of scenes. ProtoOcc consists of two main components: the Dual Branch Encoder (DBE) and the Prototype Query Decoder (PQD). The DBE produces a new 3D voxel representation by combining 3D voxel and BEV representations across multiple scales through a dual branch structure. This design enhances both performance and computational efficiency by providing a large receptive field for the BEV representation while maintaining a smaller receptive field for the voxel representation. The PQD introduces Prototype Queries to accelerate the decoding process. Scene-Adaptive Prototypes are derived from the 3D voxel features of input sample, while Scene-Agnostic Prototypes are computed by applying Scene-Adaptive Prototypes to an Exponential Moving Average during the training phase. By using these prototype-based queries for decoding, we can directly predict 3D occupancy in a single step, eliminating the need for iterative Transformer decoding. Additionally, we propose the Robust Prototype Learning, which injects noise into prototype generation process and trains the model to denoise during the training phase. ProtoOcc achieves state-of-the-art performance with 45.02% mIoU on the Occ3D-nuScenes benchmark. For single-frame method, it reaches 39.56% mIoU with an inference speed of 12.83 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 3090. Our code can be found at https://github.com/SPA-junghokim/ProtoOcc.
abstract_ch: 在本文中，我们介绍了一种名为ProtoOcc的新颖3D占用预测模型，该模型旨在通过场景的深度语义理解来预测3D体素的状态和语义类别。ProtoOcc由两个主要组件组成：双分支编码器（DBE）和原型查询解码器（PQD）。DBE通过双分支结构结合多尺度下的3D体素和鸟瞰图（BEV）表示生成一种新的3D体素表示。这种设计通过为BEV表示提供较大的感受野，同时保持较小的感受野来增强性能和计算效率。PQD引入了原型查询以加速解码过程。场景自适应原型是从输入样本的3D体素特征中派生出来的，而场景无关原型则是在训练阶段通过将场景自适应原型应用于指数移动平均值（Exponential Moving Average）计算得出的。利用这些基于原型的查询进行解码，我们可以直接在单步中预测3D占用状态，从而消除迭代Transformer解码的需要。此外，我们提出了鲁棒的原型学习方法，在原型生成过程中注入噪声，并在训练阶段训练模型进行去噪。在Occ3D-nuScenes基准测试中，ProtoOcc实现了最先进的性能，mIoU为45.02%。对于单帧方法，它达到了39.56%的mIoU，推理速度为12.83 FPS，使用的是NVIDIA RTX 3090显卡。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/SPA-junghokim/ProtoOcc找到。

title: PSReg: Prior-guided Sparse Mixture of Experts for Point Cloud Registration
title_ch: PSReg: 前向引导稀疏专家混合模型用于点云注册
authors: Xiaoshui Huang;Zhou Huang;Yifan Zuo;Yongshun Gong;Chengdong Zhang;Deyang Liu;Yuming Fang;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Huaihua University;Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics;Jiangxi Provincial Key Laboratory of Multimedia Intelligent Processing;Shandong University;Anqing Normal University;
abstract: The discriminative feature is crucial for point cloud registration. Recent methods improve the feature discriminative by distinguishing between non-overlapping and overlapping region points. However, they still face challenges in distinguishing the ambiguous structures in the overlapping regions. Therefore, the ambiguous features they extracted resulted in a significant number of outlier matches from overlapping regions. To solve this problem, we propose a prior-guided SMoE-based registration method to improve the feature distinctiveness by dispatching the potential correspondences to the same experts. Specifically, we propose a prior-guided SMoE module by fusing prior overlap and potential correspondence embeddings for routing, assigning tokens to the most suitable experts for processing. In addition, we propose a registration framework by a specific combination of Transformer layer and prior-guided SMoE module. The proposed method not only pays attention to the importance of locating the overlapping areas of point clouds, but also commits to finding more accurate correspondences in overlapping areas. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, achieving state-of-the-art registration recall (95.7\%/79.3\%) on the 3DMatch/3DLoMatch benchmark. Moreover, we also test the performance on ModelNet40 and demonstrate excellent performance.
abstract_ch: 区分特征对于点云配准至关重要。最近的方法通过区分重叠区域和非重叠区域的点来提高特征的区分性，但它们仍然难以区分重叠区域中的模糊结构。因此，他们提取的模糊特征导致了大量来自重叠区域的离群点匹配。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种先验指导下的SMoE基配准方法，通过将潜在对应关系分配给相同的专家来提高特征的区分性。具体来说，我们提出了一种融合先验重叠和潜在对应嵌入的先验指导下的SMoE模块，用于路由，将令牌分配给最适合处理的专家。此外，我们还提出了一种特定组合的Transformer层和先验指导下的SMoE模块的配准框架。所提出的方法不仅关注点云重叠区域的定位重要性，还致力于在重叠区域找到更准确的对应关系。我们的广泛实验表明了该方法的有效性，在3DMatch/3DLoMatch基准上实现了最先进的配准召回率（95.7% / 79.3%）。此外，我们在ModelNet40上也测试了其性能，并展示了卓越的表现。

title: QORT-Former: Query-optimized Real-time Transformer for Understanding Two Hands Manipulating Objects
title_ch: QORT-Former：查询优化实时变压器，用于理解双手操作物体
authors: Elkhan Ismayilzada;MD Khalequzzaman Chowdhury Sayem;Yihalem Yimolal Tiruneh;Mubarrat Tajoar Chowdhury;Muhammadjon Boboev;Seungryul Baek;
affiliations: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology;Michigan State University;
abstract: Significant advancements have been achieved in the realm of understanding poses and interactions of two hands manipulating an object. The emergence of augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) technologies has heightened the demand for real-time performance in these applications. However, current state-of-the-art models often exhibit promising results at the expense of substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we present a query-optimized real-time Transformer (QORT-Former), the first Transformer-based real-time framework for 3D pose estimation of two hands and an object. We first limit the number of queries and decoders to meet the efficiency requirement. Given limited number of queries and decoders, we propose to optimize queries which are taken as input to the Transformer decoder, to secure better accuracy: (1) we propose to divide queries into three types (a left hand query, a right hand query and an object query) and enhance query features (2) by using the contact information between hands and an object and (3) by using three-step update of enhanced image and query features with respect to one another. With proposed methods, we achieved real-time pose estimation performance using just 108 queries and 1 decoder (53.5 FPS on an RTX 3090TI GPU). Surpassing state-of-the-art results on the H2O dataset by 17.6% (left hand), 22.8% (right hand), and 27.2% (object), as well as on the FPHA dataset by 5.3% (right hand) and 10.4% (object), our method excels in accuracy. Additionally, it sets the state-of-the-art in interaction recognition, maintaining real-time efficiency with an off-the-shelf action recognition module.
abstract_ch: 在理解双手操作物体的姿态和交互方面取得了显著进展。随着增强现实（AR）和虚拟现实（VR）技术的发展，这些应用对实时性能的需求也日益增加。然而，当前最先进的模型往往在牺牲大量计算开销的情况下表现出令人鼓舞的结果。本文我们提出了一种查询优化的实时Transformer（QORT-Former），这是首个基于Transformer的实时框架，用于估计双手和物体的3D姿态。我们首先限制查询和解码器的数量以满足效率要求。在有限的查询和解码器数量下，我们提出优化作为Transformer解码器输入的查询，以确保更高的准确性：（1）我们将查询分为三种类型（左手查询、右手查询和物体查询），并增强查询特征；（2）利用手与物体之间的接触信息；（3）通过相互更新增强的图像和查询特征，实现三步更新。借助所提出的方法，我们仅使用108个查询和1个解码器就实现了实时姿态估计性能（在RTX 3090TI GPU上达到53.5 FPS）。在H2O数据集上，我们的方法分别在左手、右手和物体的姿态估计方面超越了最先进的结果17.6%、22.8%和27.2%；在FPHA数据集上，分别在右手和物体的姿态估计方面超越了最先进的结果5.3%和10.4%，我们在准确性方面表现优异。此外，该方法在交互识别方面达到了最先进的水平，并且能够保持实时效率，同时使用现成的动作识别模块。

title: Query Quantized Neural SLAM
title_ch: 查询量化神经SLAM
authors: Sijia Jiang;Jing Hua;Zhizhong Han;
affiliations: Wayne State University;
abstract: Neural implicit representations have shown remarkable abilities in jointly modeling geometry, color, and camera poses in simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Current methods use coordinates, positional encodings, or other geometry features as input to query neural implicit functions for signed distances and color which produce rendering errors to drive the optimization in overfitting image observations. However, due to the run time efficiency requirement in SLAM systems, we are merely allowed to conduct optimization on each frame in few iterations, which is far from enough for neural networks to overfit these queries. The underfitting usually results in severe drifts in camera tracking and artifacts in reconstruction. To resolve this issue, we propose query quantized neural SLAM which uses quantized queries to reduce variations of input for much easier and faster overfitting a frame. To this end, we quantize a query into a discrete representation with a set of codes, and only allow neural networks to observe a finite number of variations. This allows neural networks to become increasingly familiar with these codes after overfitting more and more previous frames. Moreover, we also introduce novel initialization, losses, and argumentation to stabilize the optimization with significant uncertainty in the early optimization stage, constrain the optimization space, and estimate camera poses more accurately. We justify the effectiveness of each design and report visual and numerical comparisons on widely used benchmarks to show our superiority over the latest methods in both reconstruction and camera tracking.
abstract_ch: 神经隐式表示在同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）中展示了在几何、颜色和相机姿态联合建模方面的显著能力。当前的方法使用坐标、位置编码或其他几何特征作为输入，查询神经隐式函数以获取符号距离和颜色，这些查询用于驱动优化以拟合图像观察值。然而，由于SLAM系统对运行时效率的要求，我们仅能在少量迭代中对每一帧进行优化，这远远不足以让神经网络充分拟合这些查询。因此，通常会导致相机跟踪中的严重漂移和重建中的伪影。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种查询量化神经SLAM方法，该方法通过使用量化查询来减少输入的变异性，从而使神经网络更容易和更快地对每一帧进行过拟合。为此，我们将一个查询量化为一组离散代码的表示，并仅允许神经网络观察有限数量的变化。这使得神经网络能够在对越来越多的先前帧进行过拟合后逐渐熟悉这些代码。此外，我们还引入了新颖的初始化方法、损失函数和数据增强技术，以在早期优化阶段存在显著不确定性的情况下稳定优化过程，限制优化空间，并更准确地估计相机姿态。我们验证了每个设计的有效性，并在广泛使用的基准测试上报告了视觉和数值比较，展示了我们在重建和相机跟踪方面优于最新方法的优越性。

title: Resolving Multi-Condition Confusion for Finetuning-Free Personalized Image Generation
title_ch: 无微调个性化图像生成中的多条件混淆问题解决
authors: Qihan Huang;Siming Fu;Jinlong Liu;Hao Jiang;Yipeng Yu;Jie Song;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Alibaba Group;
abstract: Personalized text-to-image generation methods can generate customized images based on the reference images, which have garnered wide research interest. Recent methods propose a finetuning-free approach with a decoupled cross-attention mechanism to generate personalized images requiring no test-time finetuning. However, when multiple reference images are provided, the current decoupled cross-attention mechanism encounters the object confusion problem and fails to map each reference image to its corresponding object, thereby seriously limiting its scope of application. To address the object confusion problem, in this work we investigate the relevance of different positions of the latent image features to the target object in diffusion model, and accordingly propose a weighted-merge method to merge multiple reference image features into the corresponding objects. Next, we integrate this weighted-merge method into existing pre-trained models and continue to train the model on a multi-object dataset constructed from the open-sourced SA-1B dataset. To mitigate object confusion and reduce training costs, we propose an object quality score to estimate the image quality for the selection of high-quality training samples. Furthermore, our weighted-merge training framework can be employed on single-object generation when a single object has multiple reference images. The experiments verify that our method achieves superior performance to the state-of-the-arts on the Concept101 dataset and DreamBooth dataset of multi-object personalized image generation, and remarkably improves the performance on single-object personalized image generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/hqhQAQ/MIP-Adapter.
abstract_ch: 个性化文本到图像生成方法可以根据参考图像生成定制化的图像，并且引起了广泛的研究兴趣。最近的方法提出了一种无需微调的解耦交叉注意力机制来生成个性化图像，这样在测试时也不需要进行微调。然而，当提供多个参考图像时，当前的解耦交叉注意力机制会遇到对象混淆问题，无法将每个参考图像映射到相应对象，从而严重限制了其应用范围。为了解决对象混淆问题，在这项工作中，我们研究了扩散模型中潜在图像特征的不同位置与目标对象的相关性，并据此提出了加权合并方法，用于将多个参考图像特征合并到相应对象中。接着，我们将这个加权合并方法集成到现有的预训练模型中，并继续在从开源SA-1B数据集中构建的多对象数据集上训练模型。为了减轻对象混淆并降低训练成本，我们提出了一种对象质量评分方法来估计图像质量，以选择高质量的训练样本。此外，我们的加权合并训练框架也可以应用于单个对象生成，特别是当一个对象有多个参考图像时。实验验证了我们的方法在Concept101数据集和DreamBooth数据集的多对象个性化图像生成方面优于最先进的方法，并显著提高了单个对象个性化图像生成的性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hqhQAQ/MIP-Adapter获取。

title: Rethinking Open-Vocabulary Segmentation of Radiance Fields in 3D Space
title_ch: 重新思考三维空间中辐射场的开放式词汇分割方法
authors: Hyunjee Lee;Youngsik Yun;Jeongmin Bae;Seoha Kim;Youngjung Uh;
affiliations: Yonsei University;
abstract: Understanding the 3D semantics of a scene is a fundamental problem for various scenarios such as embodied agents. While NeRFs and 3DGS excel at novel-view synthesis, previous methods for understanding their semantics have been limited to incomplete 3D understanding: their segmentation results are rendered as 2D masks that do not represent the entire 3D space. To address this limitation, we redefine the problem to segment the 3D volume and propose the following methods for better 3D understanding. We directly supervise the 3D points to train the language embedding field, unlike previous methods that anchor supervision at 2D pixels. We transfer the learned language field to 3DGS, achieving the first real-time rendering speed without sacrificing training time or accuracy. Lastly, we introduce a 3D querying and evaluation protocol for assessing the reconstructed geometry and semantics together. Code, checkpoints, and annotations are available at the project page.
abstract_ch: 理解场景的三维语义是诸如具身智能代理等各种场景中的一个基本问题。虽然NeRF和3DGS在新颖视图合成方面表现出色，但之前的方法在理解其语义时仅限于不完整的三维理解：它们的分割结果被渲染为2D掩码，并不能代表整个三维空间。为了应对这一局限性，我们将问题重新定义为分割三维体积，并提出了一些方法以获得更好的三维理解。我们直接监督三维点来训练语言嵌入场，而不是像之前的方法那样将监督锚定在二维像素上。我们将学习到的语言场转移到3DGS中，实现了首个无需牺牲训练时间和准确性的实时渲染速度。最后，我们引入了一个三维查询和评估协议，用于同时评估重建的几何结构和语义。代码、检查点和注释可在项目页面获取。

title: SAFIRE: Segment Any Forged Image Region
title_ch: SAFIRE：任意伪造图像区域分割
authors: Myung-Joon Kwon;Wonjun Lee;Seung-Hun Nam;Minji Son;Changick Kim;
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;NAVER WEBTOON AI;
abstract: Most techniques approach the problem of image forgery localization as a binary segmentation task, training neural networks to label original areas as 0 and forged areas as 1. In contrast, we tackle this issue from a more fundamental perspective by partitioning images according to their originating sources. To this end, we propose Segment Any Forged Image Region (SAFIRE), which solves forgery localization using point prompting. Each point on an image is used to segment the source region containing itself. This allows us to partition images into multiple source regions, a capability achieved for the first time. Additionally, rather than memorizing certain forgery traces, SAFIRE naturally focuses on uniform characteristics within each source region. This approach leads to more stable and effective learning, achieving superior performance in both the new task and the traditional binary forgery localization.
abstract_ch: 大多数技术将图像伪造定位问题视为二元分割任务，训练神经网络将原始区域标记为0，伪造区域标记为1。相比之下，我们从更基本的角度出发，根据图像的来源对其进行分区。为此，我们提出了“任意伪造图像区域分割”（SAFIRE），该方法使用点提示来解决伪造定位问题。图像中的每个点用于分割包含该点的源区域。这使得我们可以将图像划分为多个源区域，这是首次实现的功能。此外，与记忆特定的伪造痕迹不同，SAFIRE 自然地专注于每个源区域内的均匀特征。这种方法导致了更加稳定和有效的学习，实现了在新任务和传统二元伪造定位中的优越性能。

title: SatCLIP: Global, General-Purpose Location Embeddings with Satellite Imagery
title_ch: SatCLIP：基于卫星图像的全球通用地理位置嵌入
authors: Konstantin Klemmer;Esther Rolf;Caleb Robinson;Lester Mackey;Marc Rußwurm;
affiliations: Microsoft;University of Colorado Boulder;Wageningen University & Research;
abstract: Geographic information is essential for modeling tasks in fields ranging from ecology to epidemiology. However, extracting relevant location characteristics for a given task can be challenging, often requiring expensive data fusion or distillation from massive global imagery datasets. To address this challenge, we introduce Satellite Contrastive Location-Image Pretraining (SatCLIP). This global, general-purpose geographic location encoder learns an implicit representation of locations by matching CNN and ViT inferred visual patterns of openly available satellite imagery with their geographic coordinates. The resulting SatCLIP location encoder efficiently summarizes the characteristics of any given location for convenient use in downstream tasks. In our experiments, we use SatCLIP embeddings to improve prediction performance on nine diverse location-dependent tasks including temperature prediction, animal recognition, and population density estimation. Across tasks, SatCLIP consistently outperforms alternative location encoders and improves geographic generalization by encoding visual similarities of spatially distant environments. These results demonstrate the potential of vision-location models to learn meaningful representations of our planet from the vast, varied, and largely untapped modalities of geospatial data.
abstract_ch: 地理信息对于从生态学到流行病学等多个领域的建模任务至关重要。然而，提取特定任务的相关位置特征往往是具有挑战性的，通常需要昂贵的数据融合或从庞大的全球影像数据集中提炼大规模数据。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了卫星对比位置-图像预训练（SatCLIP）。该全球通用的位置编码器通过将卷积神经网络（CNN）和视觉变换器（ViT）推断出的公开可用卫星影像中的视觉模式与地理坐标匹配，学习隐含的位置表示。由此产生的SatCLIP位置编码器能够高效地总结任何给定位置的特征，便于在下游任务中使用。在我们的实验中，我们利用SatCLIP嵌入来提高温度预测、动物识别和人口密度估计等九个不同位置依赖任务的预测性能。在所有任务中，SatCLIP均表现出色，并通过编码空间上相距遥远环境的视觉相似性，提升了地理泛化能力。这些结果展示了视觉-位置模型从大量多样且尚未充分利用的地理空间数据中学习有意义的地球表示形式的潜力。

title: SCCS: Deep Neural Spectral Clustering for Self-Supervised Subcellular Structure Segmentation
title_ch: SCCS：深度神经光谱聚类的自我监督亚细胞结构分割
