title: Making Large Vision Language Models to Be Good Few-Shot Learners
title_ch: 让大型视觉语言模型成为优秀的少样本学习者
authors: Fan Liu;Wenwen Cai;Jian Huo;Chuanyi Zhang;Delong Chen;Jun Zhou;
affiliations: Hohai University;Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;Griffith University;
abstract: Few-shot classification (FSC) is a fundamental yet challenging task in computer vision that involves recognizing novel classes from limited data. While previous methods have focused on enhancing visual features or incorporating additional modalities, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) offer a promising alternative due to their rich knowledge and strong visual perception. However, LVLMs risk learning specific response formats rather than effectively extracting useful information from support data in FSC tasks. In this paper, we investigate LVLMs' performance in FSC and identify key issues such as insufficient learning and the presence of severe positional biases. To tackle the above challenges, we adopt the meta-learning strategy to teach models "learn to learn". By constructing a rich set of meta-tasks for instruction fine-tuning, LVLMs enhance the ability to extract information from few-shot support data for classification. Additionally, we further boost LVLM's few-shot learning capabilities through label augmentation and candidate selection in the fine-tuning and inference stage, respectively. Label augmentation is implemented via a character perturbation strategy to ensure the model focuses on support information. Candidate selection leverages attribute descriptions to filter out unreliable candidates and simplify the task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance on both general and fine-grained datasets. Furthermore, our candidate selection strategy has been proven beneficial for training-free LVLMs.
abstract_ch: 少样本分类（Few-shot Classification, FSC）是计算机视觉中的一个基本但具有挑战性的任务，涉及从有限数据中识别新的类别。尽管之前的方法主要集中在增强视觉特征或引入额外的模态，大型视觉语言模型（Large Vision Language Models, LVLMs）因其丰富的知识和强大的视觉感知能力提供了另一种有前景的选择。然而，在FSC任务中，LVLMs存在学习特定响应格式的风险，而不是有效地从支持数据中提取有用信息。在本文中，我们研究了LVLMs在FSC任务中的表现，并识别出关键问题，如学习不足和严重的位序偏差。为应对上述挑战，我们采用元学习策略来教导模型“学会学习”。通过构建丰富的元任务集进行指令微调，LVLMs增强了从少量支持数据中提取分类信息的能力。此外，我们在微调和推理阶段分别通过标签扩增和候选选择进一步提升了LVLMs的少样本学习能力。标签扩增通过字符扰动策略实施，以确保模型专注于支持信息。候选选择利用属性描述来过滤掉不可靠的候选，简化任务。大量实验表明，我们的方法在通用和细粒度数据集上均实现了优越的性能。此外，我们的候选选择策略已被证明对无训练LVLMs有益。

title: Mamba-CAD: State Space Model for 3D Computer-Aided Design Generative Modeling
title_ch: Mamba-CAD：三维计算机辅助设计生成建模的状态空间模型
authors: Xueyang Li;Yunzhong Lou;Yu Song;Xiangdong Zhou;
affiliations: Fudan University;

title: MambaLCT: Boosting Tracking via Long-term Context State Space Model
title_ch: MambaLCT：通过长期上下文状态空间模型提升跟踪性能
authors: Xiaohai Li;Bineng Zhong;Qihua Liang;Guorong Li;Zhiyi Mo;Shuxiang Song;
affiliations: Guangxi Normal University;Wuzhou University;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: Effectively constructing context information with long-term dependencies from video sequences is crucial for object tracking. However, the context length constructed by existing work is limited, only considering object information from adjacent frames or video clips, leading to insufficient utilization of contextual information. To address this issue, we propose MambaLCT, which constructs and utilizes target variation cues from the first frame to the current frame for robust tracking. First, a novel unidirectional Context Mamba module is designed to scan frame features along the temporal dimension, gathering target change cues throughout the entire sequence. Specifically, target-related information in frame features is compressed into a hidden state space through selective scanning mechanism. The target information across the entire video is continuously aggregated into target variation cues. Next, we inject the target change cues into the attention mechanism, providing temporal information for modeling the relationship between the template and search frames. The advantage of MambaLCT is its ability to continuously extend the length of the context, capturing complete target change cues, which enhances the stability and robustness of the tracker. Extensive experiments show that long-term context information enhances the model's ability to perceive targets in complex scenarios. MambaLCT achieves new SOTA performance on six benchmarks while maintaining real-time running speeds.
abstract_ch: 从视频序列中有效地构建具有长期依赖性的上下文信息对于目标跟踪至关重要。然而，现有工作的上下文长度有限，仅考虑了相邻帧或视频片段中的对象信息，导致上下文信息的利用不足。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了MambaLCT，该方法从第一帧到当前帧构建并利用目标变化线索，以实现稳健的目标跟踪。首先，设计了一个新颖的一维Context Mamba模块，在时间维度上扫描帧特征，收集整个序列中的目标变化线索。具体而言，通过选择性扫描机制将与目标相关的帧特征信息压缩到隐藏状态空间中，从而在整个视频中持续聚合目标信息，形成目标变化线索。其次，我们将目标变化线索注入注意力机制中，为模板帧和搜索帧之间的关系建模提供时间信息。MambaLCT的优势在于其能够不断延长上下文长度，捕捉完整的目标变化线索，从而增强跟踪器的稳定性和鲁棒性。广泛实验表明，长期上下文信息提高了模型在复杂场景下感知目标的能力。MambaLCT在六个基准测试上实现了新的SOTA性能，同时保持实时运行速度。

title: MAMS: Model-Agnostic Module Selection Framework for Video Captioning
title_ch: MAMS：视频字幕生成的模型无关模块选择框架
authors: Sangho Lee;Il Yong Chun;Hogun Park;
affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University;Hippo T&C Company Incorporated;Institute for Basic Science;
abstract: Multi-modal transformers are rapidly gaining attention in video captioning tasks. Existing multi-modal video captioning methods typically extract a fixed number of frames, which raises critical challenges. When a limited number of frames are extracted, important frames with essential information for caption generation may be missed. Conversely, extracting an excessive number of frames includes consecutive frames, potentially causing redundancy in visual tokens extracted from consecutive video frames. To extract an appropriate number of frames for each video, this paper proposes the first model-agnostic module selection framework in video captioning that has two main functions: (1) selecting a caption generation module with an appropriate size based on visual tokens extracted from video frames, and (2) constructing subsets of visual tokens for the selected caption generation module. Furthermore, we propose a new adaptive attention masking scheme that enhances attention on important visual tokens. Our experiments on three different benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves the performance of three recent video captioning models.
abstract_ch: 多模态变压器在视频字幕任务中正迅速获得关注。现有的多模态视频字幕方法通常提取固定数量的帧，这引发了关键挑战。当仅提取有限数量的帧时，可能错过包含生成字幕所需重要信息的关键帧。相反，如果提取过多的帧，可能会包括连续帧，从而导致从连续视频帧中提取的视觉标记存在冗余。为了为每个视频提取适当数量的帧，本文提出了视频字幕中的第一个模型无关的选择模块框架，该框架具有两个主要功能：（1）根据从视频帧中提取的视觉标记选择一个合适的大小的字幕生成模块；（2）为所选的字幕生成模块构建视觉标记子集。此外，我们提出了一种新的自适应注意力掩码方案，以增强对重要视觉标记的关注。我们在三个不同的基准数据集上的实验表明，所提出的框架显著提高了三种最近的视频字幕模型的性能。

title: MaskViM: Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation with State Space Models
title_ch: MaskViM：基于状态空间模型的领域泛化语义分割
authors: Jiahao Li;Yang Lu;Yuan Xie;Yanyun Qu;
affiliations: Xiamen University;East China Normal University;

title: Memory Efficient Matting with Adaptive Token Routing
title_ch: 高效内存抠图方法与自适应令牌路由
authors: Yiheng Lin;Yihan Hu;Chenyi Zhang;Ting Liu;Xiaochao Qu;Luoqi Liu;Yao Zhao;Yunchao Wei;
affiliations: Beijing Jiao Tong University;Visual Intelligence;Ministry of Education;Pengcheng Laboratory;Meitu Inc;
abstract: Transformer-based models have recently achieved outstanding performance in image matting. However, their application to high-resolution images remains challenging due to the quadratic complexity of global self-attention. To address this issue, we propose MEMatte, a \textbf{m}emory-\textbf{e}fficient \textbf{m}atting framework for processing high-resolution images. MEMatte incorporates a router before each global attention block, directing informative tokens to the global attention while routing other tokens to a Lightweight Token Refinement Module (LTRM). Specifically, the router employs a local-global strategy to predict the routing probability of each token, and the LTRM utilizes efficient modules to simulate global attention. Additionally, we introduce a Batch-constrained Adaptive Token Routing (BATR) mechanism, which allows each router to dynamically route tokens based on image content and the stages of attention block in the network. Furthermore, we construct an ultra high-resolution image matting dataset, UHR-395, comprising 35,500 training images and 1,000 test images, with an average resolution of $4872\times6017$. This dataset is created by compositing 395 different alpha mattes across 11 categories onto various backgrounds, all with high-quality manual annotation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MEMatte outperforms existing methods on both high-resolution and real-world datasets, significantly reducing memory usage by approximately 88% and latency by 50% on the Composition-1K benchmark. Our code is available at https://github.com/linyiheng123/MEMatte.
abstract_ch: 基于Transformer的模型在图像抠图领域最近取得了卓越的表现。然而，由于全局自注意力的二次复杂性，这些模型在处理高分辨率图像时仍然面临挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为MEMatte的记忆高效图像抠图框架。MEMatte在每个全局注意力模块之前引入了一个路由器，该路由器将信息性标记导向全局注意力，而将其他标记导向一个轻量级标记精炼模块（LTRM）。具体来说，路由器采用局部-全局策略来预测每个标记的路由概率，而LTRM则利用高效的模块模拟全局注意力。此外，我们引入了一种批量约束自适应标记路由机制（BATR），允许每个路由器根据图像内容和网络中的注意力块阶段动态路由标记。我们还构建了一个超高分辨率图像抠图数据集UHR-395，包含35,500张训练图像和1,000张测试图像，平均分辨率为$4872\times6017$。该数据集通过将395个不同的alpha抠图分布在11个类别上并叠加到各种背景上创建而成，并且所有图像都具有高质量的手动标注。大量实验表明，MEMatte在高分辨率和真实世界数据集上的表现优于现有方法，在Composition-1K基准测试中，内存使用率降低了约88%，延迟降低了50%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/linyiheng123/MEMatte获取。

title: MergeNet: Knowledge Migration Across Heterogeneous Models, Tasks, and Modalities
title_ch: MergeNet：跨异构模型、任务和模态的知识迁移
authors: Kunxi Li;Tianyu Zhan;Kairui Fu;Shengyu Zhang;Kun Kuang;Jiwei Li;Zhou Zhao;Fan Wu;Fei Wu;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;
abstract: In this study, we focus on heterogeneous knowledge transfer across entirely different model architectures, tasks, and modalities. Existing knowledge transfer methods (e.g., backbone sharing, knowledge distillation) often hinge on shared elements within model structures or task-specific features/labels, limiting transfers to complex model types or tasks. To overcome these challenges, we present MergeNet, which learns to bridge the gap of parameter spaces of heterogeneous models, facilitating the direct interaction, extraction, and application of knowledge within these parameter spaces. The core mechanism of MergeNet lies in the parameter adapter, which operates by querying the source model's low-rank parameters and adeptly learning to identify and map parameters into the target model. MergeNet is learned alongside both models, allowing our framework to dynamically transfer and adapt knowledge relevant to the current stage, including the training trajectory knowledge of the source model. Extensive experiments on heterogeneous knowledge transfer demonstrate significant improvements in challenging settings, where representative approaches may falter or prove less applicable.
abstract_ch: 在本研究中，我们专注于不完全相同模型架构、任务和模态之间的异构知识迁移。现有的知识迁移方法（例如，骨干共享、知识蒸馏）通常依赖于模型结构内的共享元素或特定任务的特征/标签，这限制了复杂模型类型或任务之间的知识迁移。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了MergeNet，它能够学习跨越不同模型参数空间的鸿沟，促进这些参数空间内的知识直接交互、提取和应用。MergeNet的核心机制在于参数适配器，该适配器通过查询源模型的低秩参数，并巧妙地学习识别并映射参数到目标模型。MergeNet与两个模型同时学习，使我们的框架能够在当前阶段动态地转移和适应相关知识，包括源模型的训练轨迹知识。在异构知识迁移的广泛实验中，MergeNet在具有挑战性的设置中展示了显著的改进，而代表性的方法可能在这些情况下表现不佳或不太适用。

title: Micro-macro Wavelet-based Gaussian Splatting for 3D Reconstruction from Unconstrained Images
title_ch: 基于微宏小波高斯点积的无约束图像三维重建
authors: Yihui Li;Chengxin Lv;Hongyu Yang;Di Huang;
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Complex and Critical Software Environment;Beihang University;Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory;
abstract: 3D reconstruction from unconstrained image collections presents substantial challenges due to varying appearances and transient occlusions. In this paper, we introduce Micro-macro Wavelet-based Gaussian Splatting (MW-GS), a novel approach designed to enhance 3D reconstruction by disentangling scene representations into global, refined, and intrinsic components. The proposed method features two key innovations: Micro-macro Projection, which allows Gaussian points to capture details from feature maps across multiple scales with enhanced diversity; and Wavelet-based Sampling, which leverages frequency domain information to refine feature representations and significantly improve the modeling of scene appearances. Additionally, we incorporate a Hierarchical Residual Fusion Network to seamlessly integrate these features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MW-GS delivers state-of-the-art rendering performance, surpassing existing methods.
abstract_ch: 从不受约束的图像集合进行三维重建面临着重大挑战，原因在于场景外观的变化和瞬时遮挡。在本文中，我们介绍了一种新颖的方法——微宏观小波基高斯点积（Micro-macro Wavelet-based Gaussian Splatting，简称MW-GS），该方法旨在通过将场景表示分解为全局、细化和固有三个组件来提升三维重建效果。所提出的方法具有两项关键技术创新：微宏观投影，使高斯点能够跨多个尺度捕捉特征图中的细节，并增强多样性；小波基采样，利用频域信息细化特征表示，显著提高对场景外观建模的效果。此外，我们还引入了层次残差融合网络，以无缝集成这些特征。大量实验表明，MW-GS提供了最先进的渲染性能，超越了现有方法。

title: Multi-Granularity Video Object Segmentation
title_ch: 多粒度视频对象分割
authors: Sangbeom Lim;Seongchan Kim;Seungjun An;Seokju Cho;Paul Hongsuck Seo;Seungryong Kim;
affiliations: Korea University;Samsung;Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;
abstract: Current benchmarks for video segmentation are limited to annotating only salient objects (i.e., foreground instances). Despite their impressive architectural designs, previous works trained on these benchmarks have struggled to adapt to real-world scenarios. Thus, developing a new video segmentation dataset aimed at tracking multi-granularity segmentation target in the video scene is necessary. In this work, we aim to generate multi-granularity video segmentation dataset that is annotated for both salient and non-salient masks. To achieve this, we propose a large-scale, densely annotated multi-granularity video object segmentation (MUG-VOS) dataset that includes various types and granularities of mask annotations. We automatically collected a training set that assists in tracking both salient and non-salient objects, and we also curated a human-annotated test set for reliable evaluation. In addition, we present memory-based mask propagation model (MMPM), trained and evaluated on MUG-VOS dataset, which leads to the best performance among the existing video object segmentation methods and Segment SAM-based video segmentation methods. Project page is available at https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/MUG-VOS.
abstract_ch: 当前的视频分割基准仅限于标注显著对象（即前景实例）。尽管之前的工作在这些基准上的架构设计令人印象深刻，但它们在适应真实世界场景方面仍面临挑战。因此，在视频场景中开发一个新的旨在跟踪多粒度分割目标的新视频分割数据集是必要的。在这项工作中，我们旨在生成一个同时标注显著和非显著掩模的多粒度视频分割数据集。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了一种大规模、密集标注的多粒度视频对象分割（MUG-VOS）数据集，其中包括各种类型的掩模标注。我们自动收集了一个训练集，以辅助跟踪显著和非显著对象，并且我们也整理了一个由人类标注的测试集，以便进行可靠的评估。此外，我们介绍了基于记忆的掩模传播模型（MMPM），该模型在MUG-VOS数据集上进行了训练和评估，其性能在现有的视频对象分割方法和Segment SAM为基础的视频分割方法中表现最佳。项目页面可在https://cvlab-kaist.github.io/MUG-VOS获取。

title: Multi-Label Few-Shot Image Classification via Pairwise Feature Augmentation and Flexible Prompt Learning
title_ch: 基于成对特征增强和灵活提示学习的多标签少量-shot图像分类
authors: Han Liu;Yuanyuan Wang;Xiaotong Zhang;Feng Zhang;Wei Wang;Fenglong Ma;Hong Yu;
affiliations: Dalian University of Technology;Peking University;Shenzhen MSU-BIT University;Pennsylvania State University;

title: Multi-StyleGS: Stylized Gaussian Splatting with Multiple Styles
title_ch: 多风格GS：多种风格的样式化高斯点云渲染
authors: Yangkai Lin;Jiabao Lei;Kui Jia;
affiliations: South China University of Technology;Chinese University of Hong Kong;
abstract: In recent years, there has been a growing demand to stylize a given 3D scene to align with the artistic style of reference images for creative purposes. While 3D Gaussian Splatting(GS) has emerged as a promising and efficient method for realistic 3D scene modeling, there remains a challenge in adapting it to stylize 3D GS to match with multiple styles through automatic local style transfer or manual designation, while maintaining memory efficiency for stylization training. In this paper, we introduce a novel 3D GS stylization solution termed Multi-StyleGS to tackle these challenges. In particular, we employ a bipartite matching mechanism to au tomatically identify correspondences between the style images and the local regions of the rendered images. To facilitate local style transfer, we introduce a novel semantic style loss function that employs a segmentation network to apply distinct styles to various objects of the scene and propose a local-global feature matching to enhance the multi-view consistency. Furthermore, this technique can achieve memory efficient training, more texture details and better color match. To better assign a robust semantic label to each Gaussian, we propose several techniques to regularize the segmentation network. As demonstrated by our comprehensive experiments, our approach outperforms existing ones in producing plausible stylization results and offering flexible editing.
abstract_ch: 近年来，人们对将给定的3D场景风格化以与参考图像的艺术风格一致的需求日益增长。虽然3D高斯散点图（GS）已成为一种有前途且高效的现实3D场景建模方法，但在自动局部风格迁移或手动指定以匹配多种风格的同时保持风格化训练的内存效率方面仍存在挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为Multi-StyleGS的新颖3D GS风格化解决方案，以应对这些挑战。特别是，我们采用二分匹配机制自动识别风格图像与渲染图像局部区域之间的对应关系。为了促进局部风格迁移，我们引入了一种新颖的语义风格损失函数，该函数利用分割网络对场景中的不同物体应用独特的风格，并提出局部-全局特征匹配来增强多视图一致性。此外，这种方法可以实现高效的内存训练、更多的纹理细节和更好的颜色匹配。为了更好地为每个高斯分配稳健的语义标签，我们提出了几种技术来正则化分割网络。通过我们的全面实验表明，我们的方法在生成可信的风格化结果和提供灵活编辑方面优于现有方法。

title: Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation with Weakly Synchronized Images
title_ch: 多视图弱同步三维人体姿态估计
authors: Ling Li;Ruiwen Gu;Chongyang Wang;Junliang Xing;Xinchun Yu;Xiao-Ping Zhang;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;Sichuan University;

title: Multimodal Hypothetical Summary for Retrieval-based Multi-image Question Answering
title_ch: 基于检索的多图像问答的多模态假设性摘要
authors: Peize Li;Qingyi Si;Peng Fu;Zheng Lin;Yan Wang;
affiliations: Jilin University;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Huawei;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: Retrieval-based multi-image question answering (QA) task involves retrieving multiple question-related images and synthesizing these images to generate an answer. Conventional "retrieve-then-answer" pipelines often suffer from cascading errors because the training objective of QA fails to optimize the retrieval stage. To address this issue, we propose a novel method to effectively introduce and reference retrieved information into the QA. Given the image set to be retrieved, we employ a multimodal large language model (visual perspective) and a large language model (textual perspective) to obtain multimodal hypothetical summary in question-form and description-form. By combining visual and textual perspectives, MHyS captures image content more specifically and replaces real images in retrieval, which eliminates the modality gap by transforming into text-to-text retrieval and helps improve retrieval. To more advantageously introduce retrieval with QA, we employ contrastive learning to align queries (questions) with MHyS. Moreover, we propose a coarse-to-fine strategy for calculating both sentence-level and word-level similarity scores, to further enhance retrieval and filter out irrelevant details. Our approach achieves a 3.7% absolute improvement over state-of-the-art methods on RETVQA and a 14.5% improvement over CLIP. Comprehensive experiments and detailed ablation studies demonstrate the superiority of our method.
abstract_ch: 基于检索的多图像问答（QA）任务涉及检索多个与问题相关的图像，并综合这些图像生成答案。传统的“先检索后回答”管道常常受到级联错误的影响，因为问答的训练目标未能优化检索阶段。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的方法，以有效引入和引用检索到的信息来改进问答。给定需要检索的图像集，我们采用一个跨模态大语言模型（视觉视角）和一个大语言模型（文本视角），获得问题形式和描述形式的跨模态假设性摘要。通过结合视觉和文本视角，MHyS能够更具体地捕捉图像内容，并用文本替代实际图像进行检索，从而通过转换为文本到文本的检索来消除模态差异，有助于提高检索效果。为了更有效地将检索与问答结合起来，我们使用对比学习来对齐查询（问题）与MHyS。此外，我们提出了从粗到细的策略来计算句子级和词级相似度分数，进一步增强检索并过滤掉无关细节。我们的方法在RETVQA上实现了绝对3.7%的改进，在CLIP上实现了14.5%的改进。全面的实验和详细的消融研究证明了我们方法的优越性。

title: NightHaze: Nighttime Image Dehazing via Self-Prior Learning
title_ch: NightHaze: 通过自我先验学习的夜间图像去雾技术
authors: Beibei Lin;Yeying Jin;Yan Wending;Wei Ye;Yuan Yuan;Robby T. Tan;
affiliations: National University of Singapore;Huawei;
abstract: Masked autoencoder (MAE) shows that severe augmentation during training produces robust representations for high-level tasks. This paper brings the MAE-like framework to nighttime image enhancement, demonstrating that severe augmentation during training produces strong network priors that are resilient to real-world night haze degradations. We propose a novel nighttime image dehazing method with self-prior learning. Our main novelty lies in the design of severe augmentation, which allows our model to learn robust priors. Unlike MAE that uses masking, we leverage two key challenging factors of nighttime images as augmentation: light effects and noise. During training, we intentionally degrade clear images by blending them with light effects as well as by adding noise, and subsequently restore the clear images. This enables our model to learn clear background priors. By increasing the noise values to approach as high as the pixel intensity values of the glow and light effect blended images, our augmentation becomes severe, resulting in stronger priors. While our self-prior learning is considerably effective in suppressing glow and revealing details of background scenes, in some cases, there are still some undesired artifacts that remain, particularly in the forms of over-suppression. To address these artifacts, we propose a self-refinement module based on the semi-supervised teacher-student framework. Our NightHaze, especially our MAE-like self-prior learning, shows that models trained with severe augmentation effectively improve the visibility of input haze images, approaching the clarity of clear nighttime images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our NightHaze achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing nighttime image dehazing methods by a substantial margin of 15.5% for MUSIQ and 23.5% for ClipIQA.
abstract_ch: 遮蔽自编码器（MAE）表明，在训练过程中进行严重的数据增强可以产生适用于高级任务的稳健表示。本文将类似MAE的框架应用于夜间图像增强，证明了在训练过程中进行严重的数据增强能够生成强大的网络先验，这些先验对真实世界中的夜雾退化具有较强的鲁棒性。我们提出了一种新颖的夜间图像去雾方法，该方法采用自我先验学习。我们的主要创新之处在于设计了严重的数据增强，这使我们的模型能够学习稳健的先验。与使用遮蔽的MAE不同，我们利用夜间图像的两个关键挑战因素作为增强手段：光效和噪声。在训练过程中，我们故意通过融合光效以及添加噪声来降解清晰图像，并随后恢复这些清晰图像。这使得我们的模型能够学习清晰背景的先验。通过增加噪声值以接近融合光效和光晕图像的像素强度值，我们的增强变得严重，从而生成更强的先验。尽管我们的自我先验学习在抑制光晕和揭示背景场景细节方面表现出显著的有效性，但在某些情况下，仍然会有一些不希望出现的伪影残留，特别是过度抑制的形式。为了解决这些伪影，我们提出了基于半监督教师-学生框架的自我精炼模块。我们的NightHaze，尤其是我们的MAE-like自我先验学习，表明使用严重增强训练的模型能够有效提高输入雾化图像的可见度，使其接近清晰夜间图像的清晰度。大量实验表明，我们的NightHaze在性能上达到了最先进的水平，相较于MUSIQ和ClipIQA现有的夜间图像去雾方法，分别在性能上提升了15.5%和23.5%。

title: Pamba: Enhancing Global Interaction in Point Clouds via State Space Model
title_ch: Pamba: 基于状态空间模型增强点云全球交互
authors: Zhuoyuan Li;Yubo Ai;Jiahao Lu;ChuXin Wang;Jiacheng Deng;Hanzhi Chang;Yanzhe Liang;Wenfei Yang;Shifeng Zhang;Tianzhu Zhang;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;Sangfor Technologies;
abstract: Transformers have demonstrated impressive results for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation. However, the quadratic complexity of transformer makes computation costs high, limiting the number of points that can be processed simultaneously and impeding the modeling of long-range dependencies between objects in a single scene. Drawing inspiration from the great potential of recent state space models (SSM) for long sequence modeling, we introduce Mamba, an SSM-based architecture, to the point cloud domain and propose Pamba, a novel architecture with strong global modeling capability under linear complexity. Specifically, to make the disorderness of point clouds fit in with the causal nature of Mamba, we propose a multi-path serialization strategy applicable to point clouds. Besides, we propose the ConvMamba block to compensate for the shortcomings of Mamba in modeling local geometries and in unidirectional modeling. Pamba obtains state-of-the-art results on several 3D point cloud segmentation tasks, including ScanNet v2, ScanNet200, S3DIS and nuScenes, while its effectiveness is validated by extensive experiments.
abstract_ch: Transformer在3D点云语义分割任务中展现了令人印象深刻的成果。然而，Transformer的二次复杂性使得计算成本高昂，限制了可以同时处理的点的数量，并阻碍了对单个场景中对象之间长距离依赖关系的建模。受到近期状态空间模型（SSM）在长序列建模方面巨大潜力的启发，我们引入了Mamba这一基于SSM的架构，并提出了一种名为Pamba的新架构，其具有线性复杂度和强大的全局建模能力。具体而言，为了使点云的无序性与Mamba的因果性质相匹配，我们提出了适用于点云的多路径序列化策略。此外，我们还提出了ConvMamba块，以弥补Mamba在局部几何建模和单向建模方面的不足。Pamba在多个3D点云分割任务上取得了最先进的成果，包括ScanNet v2、ScanNet200、S3DIS和nuScenes，其有效性通过广泛的实验得到了验证。

title: Patch-level Sounding Object Tracking for Audio-Visual Question Answering
title_ch: 基于patch级别的声源跟踪的多模态问答
authors: Zhangbin Li;Jinxing Zhou;Jing Zhang;Shengeng Tang;Kun Li;Dan Guo;
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology;
abstract: Answering questions related to audio-visual scenes, i.e., the AVQA task, is becoming increasingly popular. A critical challenge is accurately identifying and tracking sounding objects related to the question along the timeline. In this paper, we present a new Patch-level Sounding Object Tracking (PSOT) method. It begins with a Motion-driven Key Patch Tracking (M-KPT) module, which relies on visual motion information to identify salient visual patches with significant movements that are more likely to relate to sounding objects and questions. We measure the patch-wise motion intensity map between neighboring video frames and utilize it to construct and guide a motion-driven graph network. Meanwhile, we design a Sound-driven KPT (S-KPT) module to explicitly track sounding patches. This module also involves a graph network, with the adjacency matrix regularized by the audio-visual correspondence map. The M-KPT and S-KPT modules are performed in parallel for each temporal segment, allowing balanced tracking of salient and sounding objects. Based on the tracked patches, we further propose a Question-driven KPT (Q-KPT) module to retain patches highly relevant to the question, ensuring the model focuses on the most informative clues. The audio-visual-question features are updated during the processing of these modules, which are then aggregated for final answer prediction. Extensive experiments on standard datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, achieving competitive performance even compared to recent large-scale pretraining-based approaches.
abstract_ch: 与音频-视觉场景相关的问答任务（AVQA）越来越受欢迎。一个关键挑战是在时间轴上准确识别和跟踪与问题相关的发声对象。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的基于补丁级别的发声对象跟踪（PSOT）方法。该方法以运动驱动的关键补丁跟踪（M-KPT）模块为基础，依赖于视觉运动信息来识别具有显著运动的显著视觉补丁，这些补丁更有可能与发声对象和问题相关。我们计算相邻视频帧之间的补丁级运动强度图，并利用它构建和引导一个运动驱动的图网络。同时，我们设计了一个声源驱动的关键补丁跟踪（S-KPT）模块，明确地跟踪发声补丁。这个模块也涉及一个图网络，其邻接矩阵由音频-视觉对应图调节。M-KPT和S-KPT模块在同一时间分割上并行执行，允许对显著和发声对象进行平衡跟踪。基于跟踪的补丁，我们进一步提出了一个问题驱动的关键补丁跟踪（Q-KPT）模块，保留与问题高度相关的补丁，确保模型专注于最具有信息量的线索。在整个模块处理过程中，音频-视觉-问题特征会得到更新，然后聚合以进行最终答案预测。在标准数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法非常有效，即使与最近的大规模预训练方法相比也能达到竞争力的性能。

title: Path-Adaptive Matting for Efficient Inference Under Various Computational Cost Constraints
title_ch: 路径自适应抠图：在各种计算成本约束下的高效推理
authors: Qinglin Liu;Zonglin Li;Xiaoqian Lv;Xin Sun;Ru Li;Shengping Zhang;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;
abstract: In this paper, we explore a novel image matting task aimed at achieving efficient inference under various computational cost constraints, specifically FLOP limitations, using a single matting network. Existing matting methods which have not explored scalable architectures or path-learning strategies, fail to tackle this challenge. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Path-Adaptive Matting (PAM), a framework that dynamically adjusts network paths based on image contexts and computational cost constraints. We formulate the training of the computational cost-constrained matting network as a bilevel optimization problem, jointly optimizing the matting network and the path estimator. Building on this formalization, we design a path-adaptive matting architecture by incorporating path selection layers and learnable connect layers to estimate optimal paths and perform efficient inference within a unified network. Furthermore, we propose a performance-aware path-learning strategy to generate path labels online by evaluating a few paths sampled from the prior distribution of optimal paths and network estimations, enabling robust and efficient online path learning. Experiments on five image matting datasets demonstrate that the proposed PAM framework achieves competitive performance across a range of computational cost constraints.
abstract_ch: 在本文中，我们探讨了一种新的图像抠图任务，旨在在各种计算成本约束下（特别是FLOP限制）实现高效的推理。现有的抠图方法由于未探索可扩展的架构或路径学习策略，无法应对这一挑战。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了路径自适应抠图（Path-Adaptive Matting, PAM），这是一种根据图像上下文和计算成本约束动态调整网络路径的框架。我们将受计算成本约束的抠图网络的训练形式化为一个双层优化问题，同时优化抠图网络和路径估计器。基于此形式化，我们设计了一种路径自适应抠图架构，通过引入路径选择层和可学习连接层来估计最优路径，并在统一网络中进行高效推理。此外，我们提出了一种性能感知的路径学习策略，在线生成路径标签，通过评估从最优路径先验分布和网络估计中采样的少数几条路径来实现鲁棒且高效的路径学习。在五个图像抠图数据集上的实验表明，所提出的PAM框架在不同计算成本约束范围内均能取得竞争力的表现。

title: PersonaMagic: Stage-Regulated High-Fidelity Face Customization with Tandem Equilibrium
title_ch: PersonaMagic：舞台调节高保真面部定制与串联平衡
authors: Xinzhe Li;Jiahui Zhan;Shengfeng He;Yangyang Xu;Junyu Dong;Huaidong Zhang;Yong Du;
affiliations: Ocean University of China;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Singapore Management University;Harbin Institute of Technology;South China University of Technology;
abstract: Personalized image generation has made significant strides in adapting content to novel concepts. However, a persistent challenge remains: balancing the accurate reconstruction of unseen concepts with the need for editability according to the prompt, especially when dealing with the complex nuances of facial features. In this study, we delve into the temporal dynamics of the text-to-image conditioning process, emphasizing the crucial role of stage partitioning in introducing new concepts. We present PersonaMagic, a stage-regulated generative technique designed for high-fidelity face customization. Using a simple MLP network, our method learns a series of embeddings within a specific timestep interval to capture face concepts. Additionally, we develop a Tandem Equilibrium mechanism that adjusts self-attention responses in the text encoder, balancing text description and identity preservation, improving both areas. Extensive experiments confirm the superiority of PersonaMagic over state-of-the-art methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations. Moreover, its robustness and flexibility are validated in non-facial domains, and it can also serve as a valuable plug-in for enhancing the performance of pretrained personalization models.
abstract_ch: 个性化图像生成在适应新颖概念方面取得了显著进展。然而，一个持续存在的挑战仍然存在：在根据提示进行编辑的需求与准确重建未见过的概念之间找到平衡，尤其是在处理面部特征的复杂细微之处时。在这项研究中，我们探讨了从文本生成图像的过程中的时间动态特性，强调阶段划分在引入新概念中的关键作用。我们提出了PersonaMagic，这是一种受阶段调控的生成技术，旨在实现高保真度的面部定制。通过使用一个简单的MLP网络，我们的方法在一个特定的时间步长区间内学习一系列嵌入，以捕捉面部概念。此外，我们还开发了一种联合作用均衡机制，该机制调整文本编码器中的自注意力响应，平衡文本描述和身份保留，从而同时提升这两个方面。大量实验证实，在定性和定量评估中，PersonaMagic 都优于现有最先进的方法。此外，其稳健性和灵活性也在非面部领域得到验证，并且可以作为增强预训练个性化模型性能的一个有价值的插件。

title: Prompt-SID: Learning Structural Representation Prompt via Latent Diffusion for Single Image Denoising
title_ch: 通过潜在扩散学习结构表示的单图像去噪提示
authors: Huaqiu Li;Wang Zhang;Xiaowan Hu;Tao Jiang;Zikang Chen;Haoqian Wang;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;
abstract: Many studies have concentrated on constructing supervised models utilizing paired datasets for image denoising, which proves to be expensive and time-consuming. Current self-supervised and unsupervised approaches typically rely on blind-spot networks or sub-image pairs sampling, resulting in pixel information loss and destruction of detailed structural information, thereby significantly constraining the efficacy of such methods. In this paper, we introduce Prompt-SID, a prompt-learning-based single image denoising framework that emphasizes preserving of structural details. This approach is trained in a self-supervised manner using downsampled image pairs. It captures original-scale image information through structural encoding and integrates this prompt into the denoiser. To achieve this, we propose a structural representation generation model based on the latent diffusion process and design a structural attention module within the transformer-based denoiser architecture to decode the prompt. Additionally, we introduce a scale replay training mechanism, which effectively mitigates the scale gap from images of different resolutions. We conduct comprehensive experiments on synthetic, real-world, and fluorescence imaging datasets, showcasing the remarkable effectiveness of Prompt-SID. Our code will be released at https://github.com/huaqlili/Prompt-SID.
abstract_ch: 许多研究集中在利用配对数据集构建监督模型进行图像去噪上，这证明是非常昂贵且耗时的。当前的自监督和无监督方法通常依赖于盲区网络或子图像配对采样，导致像素信息丢失并破坏了详细的结构信息，从而显著限制了这些方法的效果。在本文中，我们介绍了基于提示学习的单图像去噪框架Prompt-SID，该框架强调保留结构细节。这种方法通过下采样的图像配对以自监督的方式进行训练，捕捉原始尺度的图像信息并通过结构编码，将这一提示整合到去噪器中。为了实现这一点，我们提出了一种基于潜在扩散过程的结构表示生成模型，并在基于变压器的去噪器架构中设计了一个结构注意力模块来解码提示。此外，我们引入了一种尺度回放训练机制，有效缓解了不同分辨率图像之间的尺度差距。我们在合成、真实世界和荧光成像数据集上进行了全面实验，展示了Prompt-SID的卓越效果。我们的代码将在https://github.com/huaqlili/Prompt-SID发布。

title: Prototypical Calibrating Ambiguous Samples for Micro-Action Recognition
title_ch: 原型校准模糊样本以实现微动作识别
authors: Kun Li;Dan Guo;Guoliang Chen;Chunxiao Fan;Jingyuan Xu;Zhiliang Wu;Hehe Fan;Meng Wang;
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology;Hefei Comprehensive National Science Center;Zhejiang University;
abstract: Micro-Action Recognition (MAR) has gained increasing attention due to its crucial role as a form of non-verbal communication in social interactions, with promising potential for applications in human communication and emotion analysis. However, current approaches often overlook the inherent ambiguity in micro-actions, which arises from the wide category range and subtle visual differences between categories. This oversight hampers the accuracy of micro-action recognition. In this paper, we propose a novel Prototypical Calibrating Ambiguous Network (PCAN) to unleash and mitigate the ambiguity of MAR. Firstly, we employ a hierarchical action-tree to identify the ambiguous sample, categorizing them into distinct sets of ambiguous samples of false negatives and false positives, considering both body- and action-level categories. Secondly, we implement an ambiguous contrastive refinement module to calibrate these ambiguous samples by regulating the distance between ambiguous samples and their corresponding prototypes. This calibration process aims to pull false negative (FN) samples closer to their respective prototypes and push false positive (FP) samples apart from their affiliated prototypes. In addition, we propose a new prototypical diversity amplification loss to strengthen the model's capacity by amplifying the differences between different prototypes. Finally, we propose a prototype-guided rectification to rectify prediction by incorporating the representability of prototypes. Extensive experiments conducted on the benchmark dataset demonstrate the superior performance of our method compared to existing approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/kunli-cs/PCAN.
abstract_ch: 微动作识别（MAR）由于其在社交互动中作为非言语沟通形式的关键作用，以及其在人类沟通和情感分析中的潜在应用，正逐渐受到关注。然而，当前的方法往往忽视了微动作固有的模糊性，这种模糊性源于类别范围广泛以及类别之间细微的视觉差异。这种忽视阻碍了微动作识别的准确性。本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的原型校准模糊网络（PCAN），以释放并缓解MAR中的模糊性。首先，我们采用层次化动作树来识别模糊样本，并将它们分为假阴性和假阳性两类不同的模糊样本集，同时考虑身体和动作级别的类别。其次，我们实现了一个模糊对比细化模块，通过调节模糊样本与其对应原型之间的距离来校准这些模糊样本。这一校准过程旨在将假阴性样本拉近其各自的原型，同时将假阳性样本推开与其关联的原型。此外，我们提出了一个新的原型多样性放大损失，以增强模型的能力，通过放大不同原型之间的差异来加强模型。最后，我们提出了一种由原型引导的校正方法，通过结合原型的表现能力来纠正预测。在基准数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法在性能上优于现有方法。代码可在https://github.com/kunli-cs/PCAN获取。

title: RCTrans: Radar-Camera Transformer via Radar Densifier and Sequential Decoder for 3D Object Detection
title_ch: 雷达-摄像头变换器：通过雷达密集化和序列解码器进行3D物体检测
authors: Yiheng Li;Yang Yang;Zhen Lei;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Hong Kong Institute of Science & Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: In radar-camera 3D object detection, the radar point clouds are sparse and noisy, which causes difficulties in fusing camera and radar modalities. To solve this, we introduce a novel query-based detection method named Radar-Camera Transformer (RCTrans). Specifically, we first design a Radar Dense Encoder to enrich the sparse valid radar tokens, and then concatenate them with the image tokens. By doing this, we can fully explore the 3D information of each interest region and reduce the interference of empty tokens during the fusing stage. We then design a Pruning Sequential Decoder to predict 3D boxes based on the obtained tokens and random initialized queries. To alleviate the effect of elevation ambiguity in radar point clouds, we gradually locate the position of the object via a sequential fusion structure. It helps to get more precise and flexible correspondences between tokens and queries. A pruning training strategy is adopted in the decoder, which can save much time during inference and inhibit queries from losing their distinctiveness. Extensive experiments on the large-scale nuScenes dataset prove the superiority of our method, and we also achieve new state-of-the-art radar-camera 3D detection results. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/liyih/RCTrans.
abstract_ch: 在雷达-相机三维物体检测中，雷达点云稀疏且噪声较大，这给融合相机和雷达模态带来了困难。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新颖的基于查询的检测方法，名为Radar-Camera Transformer（RCTrans）。具体来说，我们首先设计了一个雷达密集编码器，以丰富有效的雷达标记，并将它们与图像标记连接起来。通过这种方式，可以在融合阶段充分探索每个感兴趣区域的三维信息，并减少空标记对融合过程的干扰。然后，我们设计了一个剪枝序列解码器，根据获得的标记和随机初始化的查询来预测三维框。为了减轻雷达点云中的仰角模糊效应，我们采用了一种逐步定位物体的顺序融合结构，这有助于提高标记与查询之间的精确且灵活的对应关系。在解码器中采用了剪枝训练策略，在推理过程中可以节省大量时间，并抑制查询失去其独特性。在大规模nuScenes数据集上的广泛实验证明了我们方法的优越性，我们也取得了新的雷达-相机三维检测的state-of-the-art结果。我们的实现可在https://github.com/liyih/RCTrans找到。

title: REGNav: Room Expert Guided Image-Goal Navigation
title_ch: REGNav: 房间专家引导的目标导向图像导航
authors: Pengna Li;Kangyi Wu;Jingwen Fu;Sanping Zhou;
affiliations: Xi'an Jiao Tong University;
abstract: Image-goal navigation aims to steer an agent towards the goal location specified by an image. Most prior methods tackle this task by learning a navigation policy, which extracts visual features of goal and observation images, compares their similarity and predicts actions. However, if the agent is in a different room from the goal image, it's extremely challenging to identify their similarity and infer the likely goal location, which may result in the agent wandering around. Intuitively, when humans carry out this task, they may roughly compare the current observation with the goal image, having an approximate concept of whether they are in the same room before executing the actions. Inspired by this intuition, we try to imitate human behaviour and propose a Room Expert Guided Image-Goal Navigation model (REGNav) to equip the agent with the ability to analyze whether goal and observation images are taken in the same room. Specifically, we first pre-train a room expert with an unsupervised learning technique on the self-collected unlabelled room images. The expert can extract the hidden room style information of goal and observation images and predict their relationship about whether they belong to the same room. In addition, two different fusion approaches are explored to efficiently guide the agent navigation with the room relation knowledge. Extensive experiments show that our REGNav surpasses prior state-of-the-art works on three popular benchmarks.
abstract_ch: 图像目标导航旨在引导智能体朝由图像指定的目标位置移动。大多数先前的方法通过学习一个导航策略来解决这一任务，该策略提取目标和观察图像的视觉特征，比较它们的相似性并预测动作。然而，如果智能体所在的房间与目标图像中的房间不同，识别它们的相似性和推断可能的目标位置将极其具有挑战性，这可能导致智能体在房间里漫无目的地徘徊。直观地讲，当人类执行这一任务时，他们可能会大致比较当前观察与目标图像，并在执行动作之前对是否处于同一房间有一个大概的概念。受此启发，我们尝试模仿人类的行为，提出了一种基于房间专家指导的图像目标导航模型（REGNav），以使智能体具备分析目标和观察图像是否在同一房间的能力。具体而言，我们首先使用无监督学习技术对自收集的未标注房间图像进行预训练，以培养一个“房间专家”。这个专家能够提取目标和观察图像中的隐藏房间风格信息，并预测它们是否属于同一房间的关系。此外，我们还探索了两种不同的融合方法，以便有效地利用房间关系知识引导智能体导航。大量实验表明，我们的REGNav在三个流行的基准测试上超越了先前的最先进的工作。

title: Relation-aware Hierarchical Prompt for Open-vocabulary Scene Graph Generation
title_ch: 基于关系的层次化提示以生成开放式词汇场景图
authors: Tao Liu;Rongjie Li;Chongyu Wang;Xuming He;
affiliations: ShanghaiTech University;Shanghai Engineering Research Center of Intelligent Vision and Imaging;
abstract: Open-vocabulary Scene Graph Generation (OV-SGG) overcomes the limitations of the closed-set assumption by aligning visual relationship representations with open-vocabulary textual representations. This enables the identification of novel visual relationships, making it applicable to real-world scenarios with diverse relationships. However, existing OV-SGG methods are constrained by fixed text representations, limiting diversity and accuracy in image-text alignment. To address these challenges, we propose the Relation-Aware Hierarchical Prompting (RAHP) framework, which enhances text representation by integrating subject-object and region-specific relation information. Our approach utilizes entity clustering to address the complexity of relation triplet categories, enabling the effective integration of subject-object information. Additionally, we utilize a large language model (LLM) to generate detailed region-aware prompts, capturing fine-grained visual interactions and improving alignment between visual and textual modalities. RAHP also introduces a dynamic selection mechanism within Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which adaptively selects relevant text prompts based on the visual content, reducing noise from irrelevant prompts. Extensive experiments on the Visual Genome and Open Images v6 datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in addressing the challenges of open-vocabulary scene graph generation. The code is available at: https://github.com/Leon022/RAHP
abstract_ch: 开放词汇场景图生成（Open-vocabulary Scene Graph Generation，OV-SGG）通过将视觉关系表示与开放词汇的文本表示对齐，克服了封闭集假设的限制，使得能够识别新的视觉关系，从而适用于具有多样关系的现实世界场景。然而，现有的OV-SGG方法受限于固定的文本表示，这限制了图像-文本对齐的多样性和准确性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了关系感知层次提示框架（Relation-Aware Hierarchical Prompting，RAHP），该框架通过整合主语-宾语和区域特定的关系信息来增强文本表示。我们的方法利用实体聚类来应对关系三元组类别的复杂性，使主语-宾语信息的有效整合成为可能。此外，我们利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成详细的区域感知提示，捕捉细微的视觉交互并提高视觉模态与文本模态之间的对齐度。RAHP还在视觉语言模型（VLMs）中引入了一种动态选择机制，该机制根据视觉内容自适应地选择相关文本提示，从而减少无关提示带来的噪声。在Visual Genome和Open Images v6数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的框架始终能够达到最先进的性能，证明了其在解决开放词汇场景图生成挑战方面的有效性。相关代码可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/Leon022/RAHP

title: RemDet: Rethinking Efficient Model Design for UAV Object Detection
title_ch: RemDet：重新思考针对无人机目标检测的高效模型设计
authors: Chen Li;Rui Zhao;Zeyu Wang;Huiying Xu;Xinzhong Zhu;
affiliations: Zhejiang Normal University;
abstract: Object detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) images has emerged as a focal area of research, which presents two significant challenges: i) objects are typically small and dense within vast images; ii) computational resource constraints render most models unsuitable for real-time deployment. Current real-time object detectors are not optimized for UAV images, and complex methods designed for small object detection often lack real-time capabilities. To address these challenges, we propose a novel detector, RemDet (Reparameter efficient multiplication Detector). Our contributions are as follows: 1) Rethinking the challenges of existing detectors for small and dense UAV images, and proposing information loss as a design guideline for efficient models. 2) We introduce the ChannelC2f module to enhance small object detection performance, demonstrating that high-dimensional representations can effectively mitigate information loss. 3) We design the GatedFFN module to provide not only strong performance but also low latency, effectively addressing the challenges of real-time detection. Our research reveals that GatedFFN, through the use of multiplication, is more cost-effective than feed-forward networks for high-dimensional representation. 4) We propose the CED module, which combines the advantages of ViT and CNN downsampling to effectively reduce information loss. It specifically enhances context information for small and dense objects. Extensive experiments on large UAV datasets, Visdrone and UAVDT, validate the real-time efficiency and superior performance of our methods. On the challenging UAV dataset VisDrone, our methods not only provided state-of-the-art results, improving detection by more than 3.4%, but also achieve 110 FPS on a single 4090.
abstract_ch: 无人机（UAV）图像中的目标检测已成为研究的重点领域，这带来了两个重大挑战：i) 对象通常在广阔的图像中较小且密集；ii) 计算资源限制使得大多数模型不适合实时部署。当前的实时目标检测器并未针对UAV图像进行优化，而专门设计用于小对象检测的复杂方法往往缺乏实时能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新型检测器，RemDet（可重构高效乘法检测器）。我们的贡献如下：1) 重新思考现有检测器在处理小而密集的UAV图像时面临的挑战，并将信息丢失作为高效模型设计的指导原则。2) 我们引入了ChannelC2f模块以提高小对象检测性能，证明了高维表示能够有效缓解信息丢失。3) 我们设计了GatedFFN模块，不仅提供强大的性能，还具有低延迟的特点，有效解决了实时检测的挑战。我们的研究揭示，通过使用乘法，GatedFFN相较于前馈网络，在高维表示方面更具成本效益。4) 我们提出了CED模块，该模块结合了ViT和CNN下采样的优点，有效地减少了信息丢失。它特别增强了对小而密集的对象的上下文信息。在大规模UAV数据集Visdrone和UAVDT上的广泛实验验证了我们方法的实时效率和优越性能。在具有挑战性的UAV数据集VisDrone上，我们的方法不仅提供了最先进的结果，改善了检测精度超过3.4%，还在单个4090 GPU上实现了110 FPS。

title: Rethinking Transformer-Based Blind-Spot Network for Self-Supervised Image Denoising
title_ch: 重新思考基于变压器的盲区网络以实现自监督图像去噪
authors: Junyi Li;Zhilu Zhang;Wangmeng Zuo;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;
abstract: Blind-spot networks (BSN) have been prevalent neural architectures in self-supervised image denoising (SSID). However, most existing BSNs are conducted with convolution layers. Although transformers have shown the potential to overcome the limitations of convolutions in many image restoration tasks, the attention mechanisms may violate the blind-spot requirement, thereby restricting their applicability in BSN. To this end, we propose to analyze and redesign the channel and spatial attentions to meet the blind-spot requirement. Specifically, channel self-attention may leak the blind-spot information in multi-scale architectures, since the downsampling shuffles the spatial feature into channel dimensions. To alleviate this problem, we divide the channel into several groups and perform channel attention separately. For spatial selfattention, we apply an elaborate mask to the attention matrix to restrict and mimic the receptive field of dilated convolution. Based on the redesigned channel and window attentions, we build a Transformer-based Blind-Spot Network (TBSN), which shows strong local fitting and global perspective abilities. Furthermore, we introduce a knowledge distillation strategy that distills TBSN into smaller denoisers to improve computational efficiency while maintaining performance. Extensive experiments on real-world image denoising datasets show that TBSN largely extends the receptive field and exhibits favorable performance against state-of-theart SSID methods.
abstract_ch: 盲点网络（BSN）在自我监督图像去噪（SSID）领域中是一种常见的神经架构。然而，现有的大多数BSN都是通过卷积层实现的。尽管变压器已经在许多图像恢复任务中展示了克服卷积局限性的潜力，但注意力机制可能会违反盲点的要求，从而限制了它们在BSN中的应用。为此，我们提出分析和重新设计通道和空间注意力机制以满足盲点要求。具体而言，在多尺度架构中，通道自注意力可能泄露盲点信息，因为下采样会将空间特征混入通道维度中。为了解决这个问题，我们将通道分成几个组，并分别对每个组进行通道注意力处理。对于空间自注意力，我们应用了一个精细的掩码来限制和模拟膨胀卷积的感受野。基于重新设计的通道和窗口注意力机制，我们构建了一个基于变压器的盲点网络（TBSN），该网络显示出了强大的局部拟合能力和全局视角能力。此外，我们引入了一种知识蒸馏策略，将TBSN蒸馏成更小的去噪器，以提高计算效率同时保持性能。在现实世界图像去噪数据集上的广泛实验表明，TBSN大大扩展了感受野，并且在与最先进的SSID方法对比时表现出优越的性能。

title: Revisiting CAD Model Generation by Learning Raster Sketch
title_ch: 重新学习栅格草图学习生成CAD模型
authors: Pu Li;Wenhao Zhang;Jianwei Guo;Jinglu Chen;Dong-Ming Yan;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Beijing Normal University;
abstract: The integration of deep generative networks into generating Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models has garnered increasing attention over recent years. Traditional methods often rely on discrete sequences of parametric line/curve segments to represent sketches. Differently, we introduce RECAD, a novel framework that generates Raster sketches and 3D Extrusions for CAD models. Representing sketches as raster images offers several advantages over discrete sequences: 1) it breaks the limitations on the types and numbers of lines/curves, providing enhanced geometric representation capabilities; 2) it enables interpolation within a continuous latent space; and 3) it allows for more intuitive user control over the output. Technically, RECAD employs two diffusion networks: the first network generates extrusion boxes conditioned on the number and types of extrusions, while the second network produces sketch images conditioned on these extrusion boxes. By combining these two networks, RECAD effectively generates sketch-and-extrude CAD models, offering a more robust and intuitive approach to CAD model generation. Experimental results indicate that RECAD achieves strong performance in unconditional generation, while also demonstrating effectiveness in conditional generation and output editing.
abstract_ch: 近年来，将深度生成网络集成到计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型生成中引起了越来越多的关注。传统方法通常依赖于参数线条/曲线序列来表示草图。相比之下，我们引入了RECAD，这是一种新颖的框架，用于生成用于CAD模型的栅格草图和三维凸出部分。将草图表示为栅格图像相比于离散序列具有以下几个优势：1）它打破了线条/曲线类型和数量的限制，提供了增强的几何表示能力；2）它能够在连续的潜在空间中实现插值；3）它允许用户对输出进行更直观的控制。从技术上讲，RECAD使用了两个扩散网络：第一个网络根据凸出部分的数量和类型生成凸出框，而第二个网络则根据这些凸出框生成草图图像。通过结合这两个网络，RECAD有效地生成了带有凸出部分的草图CAD模型，提供了一种更为稳健和直观的CAD模型生成方法。实验结果表明，RECAD在无条件生成方面表现出色，同时也在有条件生成和输出编辑方面显示出有效性。

title: S-INF: Towards Realistic Indoor Scene Synthesis via Scene Implicit Neural Field
title_ch: 通过场景隐式神经场实现面向现实的室内场景合成
authors: Zixi Liang;Guowei Xu;Haifeng Wu;Ye Huang;Wen Li;Lixin Duan;
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;Sichuan Academy of Medical Sciences and Sichuan Provincial People’s Hospital;
abstract: Learning-based methods have become increasingly popular in 3D indoor scene synthesis (ISS), showing superior performance over traditional optimization-based approaches. These learning-based methods typically model distributions on simple yet explicit scene representations using generative models. However, due to the oversimplified explicit representations that overlook detailed information and the lack of guidance from multimodal relationships within the scene, most learning-based methods struggle to generate indoor scenes with realistic object arrangements and styles. In this paper, we introduce a new method, Scene Implicit Neural Field (S-INF), for indoor scene synthesis, aiming to learn meaningful representations of multimodal relationships, to enhance the realism of indoor scene synthesis. S-INF assumes that the scene layout is often related to the object-detailed information. It disentangles the multimodal relationships into scene layout relationships and detailed object relationships, fusing them later through implicit neural fields (INFs). By learning specialized scene layout relationships and projecting them into S-INF, we achieve a realistic generation of scene layout. Additionally, S-INF captures dense and detailed object relationships through differentiable rendering, ensuring stylistic consistency across objects. Through extensive experiments on the benchmark 3D-FRONT dataset, we demonstrate that our method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance under different types of ISS.
abstract_ch: 基于学习的方法在三维室内场景合成（ISS）中越来越受欢迎，显示出优于传统优化方法的性能。这些基于学习的方法通常使用生成模型来建模简单但明确的场景表示的分布。然而，由于这些方法忽略了详细的场景信息，并且缺乏来自场景内部多模态关系的指导，大多数基于学习的方法难以生成具有真实物体布局和风格的室内场景。本文介绍了一种新的方法——场景隐式神经场（S-INF），用于室内场景合成，旨在学习有意义的多模态关系表示，以增强室内场景合成的真实感。S-INF 假设场景布局往往与物体的详细信息相关。它将多模态关系分解为场景布局关系和详细物体关系，然后通过隐式神经场（INFs）进行融合。通过学习专门的场景布局关系并将其投影到 S-INF 中，我们实现了场景布局的真实生成。此外，S-INF 通过可微渲染捕捉密集和详细的物体关系，确保物体间的风格一致性。通过对基准 3D-FRONT 数据集进行广泛的实验，我们证明了该方法在不同类型的 ISS 中始终能实现最先进的性能。

title: SCott: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Stochastic Consistency Distillation
title_ch: Scott: 加速扩散模型的随机一致性蒸馏
authors: Hongjian Liu;Qingsong Xie;Tianxiang Ye;Zhijie Deng;Chen Chen;Shixiang Tang;Xueyang Fu;Haonan Lu;Zheng-Jun Zha;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;OPPO;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Chinese University of Hong Kong;
abstract: The iterative sampling procedure employed by diffusion models (DMs) often leads to significant inference latency. To address this, we propose Stochastic Consistency Distillation (SCott) to enable accelerated text-to-image generation, where high-quality and diverse generations can be achieved within just 2-4 sampling steps. In contrast to vanilla consistency distillation (CD) which distills the ordinary differential equation solvers-based sampling process of a pre-trained teacher model into a student, SCott explores the possibility and validates the efficacy of integrating stochastic differential equation (SDE) solvers into CD to fully unleash the potential of the teacher. SCott is augmented with elaborate strategies to control the noise strength and sampling process of the SDE solver. An adversarial loss is further incorporated to strengthen the consistency constraints in rare sampling steps. Empirically, on the MSCOCO-2017 5K dataset with a Stable Diffusion-V1.5 teacher, SCott achieves an FID of 21.9 with 2 sampling steps, surpassing that of the 1-step InstaFlow (23.4) and the 4-step UFOGen (22.1). Moreover, SCott can yield more diverse samples than other consistency models for high-resolution image generation, with up to 16% improvement in a qualified metric.
abstract_ch: 扩散模型（DMs）采用的迭代采样过程通常会导致显著的推理延迟。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了随机一致性提炼（SCott）方法，以实现加速的文字到图像生成，在仅仅2-4次采样步骤内即可获得高质量且多样化的生成结果。与传统的仅基于常微分方程求解器的一致性提炼（CD）不同，SCott 探索了将随机微分方程（SDE）求解器整合进 CD 的可能性，并验证了这种方法的有效性，从而全面释放教师模型的潜力。SCott 进一步增强了对 SDE 求解器噪声强度和采样过程的控制策略。此外，还引入了一种对抗损失来强化在罕见采样步骤中的一致性约束。实验结果显示，在使用 MSCOCO-2017 5K 数据集和一个预训练的 Stable Diffusion-V1.5 教师模型时，SCott 在2步采样步骤中实现了21.9的 FID 分数，超过了单步 InstaFlow（23.4）和四步 UFOGen（22.1）。此外，SCott 在高分辨率图像生成方面还能提供更多样化的样本，在合格的度量标准上比其他一致性模型提高了高达16%。

title: Semantic-guided Masked Mutual Learning for Multi-modal Brain Tumor Segmentation with Arbitrary Missing Modalities
title_ch: 基于语义引导的掩蔽互学习方法在任意模态缺失下的多模态脑肿瘤分割
authors: Guoyan Liang;Qin Zhou;Zhe Wang;Jingyuan Chen;Lin Gu;Chang Yao;Sai Wu;Bingcang Huang;Kai Chen;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Hangzhou High-Tech Zone Institute of Blockchain and Data Security;East China University of Science and Technology;University of Tokyo;Gongli Hospital;
abstract: Malignant brain tumors have become an aggressive and dangerous disease that leads to death worldwide.Multi-modal MRI data is crucial for accurate brain tumor segmentation, but missing modalities common in clinical practice can severely degrade the segmentation performance. While incomplete multi-modal learning methods attempt to address this, learning robust and discriminative features from arbitrary missing modalities remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose a novel Semantic-guided Masked Mutual Learning (SMML) approach to distill robust and discriminative knowledge across diverse missing modality scenarios.Specifically, we propose a novel dual-branch masked mutual learning scheme guided by Hierarchical Consistency Constraints (HCC) to ensure multi-level consistency, thereby enhancing mutual learning in incomplete multi-modal scenarios. The HCC framework comprises a pixel-level constraint that selects and exchanges reliable knowledge to guide the mutual learning process. Additionally, it includes a feature-level constraint that uncovers robust inter-sample and inter-class relational knowledge within the latent feature space. To further enhance multi-modal learning from missing modality data, we integrate a refinement network into each student branch. This network leverages semantic priors from the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to provide supplementary information, effectively complementing the masked mutual learning strategy in capturing auxiliary discriminative knowledge. Extensive experiments on three challenging brain tumor segmentation datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves performance over state-of-the-art methods in diverse missing modality settings.
abstract_ch: 恶性脑肿瘤已成为一种全球范围内具有侵略性和危险性的致命疾病。多模态MRI数据对于准确的脑肿瘤分割至关重要，但在临床实践中常见的模态缺失会严重降低分割性能。尽管不完整的多模态学习方法试图解决这一问题，但从任意缺失模态中学习稳健且区分性强的特征仍然是一个挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的语义引导掩码互学习（SMML）方法，以提炼出适用于多种模态缺失场景的稳健和区分性强的知识。具体而言，我们提出了一种由层次一致性约束（HCC）引导的双分支掩码互学习方案，以确保多层次的一致性，从而增强在不完整多模态场景中的互学习能力。HCC框架包括一个像素级约束，该约束选择并交换可靠的知识来指导互学习过程；还包括一个特征级约束，用于揭示潜在特征空间内的稳健的跨样本和跨类别关系知识。为了进一步增强从缺失模态数据中进行多模态学习的能力，我们在每个学生分支中整合了一个精炼网络。该网络利用Segment Anything Model (SAM) 的语义先验提供补充信息，有效补充了掩码互学习策略，使其能够捕捉辅助区分性知识。在三个具有挑战性的脑肿瘤分割数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在多种模态缺失设置中显著提高了性能，超过了最先进的方法。

title: Similar Modality Enhancement and Action Consistency Learning for Weakly Supervised Temporal Action Localization
title_ch: 弱监督时间动作定位中的类似模态增强和动作一致性学习
authors: Maodong Li;Chao Zheng;Jian Wang;Bing Li;
affiliations: Wuhan University;Hubei Luojia Laboratory;

title: Skip Mamba Diffusion for Monocular 3D Semantic Scene Completion
title_ch: 单目三维语义场景完成中的Mamba跳跃扩散
authors: Li Liang;Naveed Akhtar;Jordan Vice;Xiangrui Kong;Ajmal Saeed Mian;
affiliations: University of Western Australia;University of Melbourne;
abstract: 3D semantic scene completion is critical for multiple downstream tasks in autonomous systems. It estimates missing geometric and semantic information in the acquired scene data. Due to the challenging real-world conditions, this task usually demands complex models that process multi-modal data to achieve acceptable performance. We propose a unique neural model, leveraging advances from the state space and diffusion generative modeling to achieve remarkable 3D semantic scene completion performance with monocular image input. Our technique processes the data in the conditioned latent space of a variational autoencoder where diffusion modeling is carried out with an innovative state space technique. A key component of our neural network is the proposed Skimba (Skip Mamba) denoiser, which is adept at efficiently processing long-sequence data. The Skimba diffusion model is integral to our 3D scene completion network, incorporating a triple Mamba structure, dimensional decomposition residuals and varying dilations along three directions. We also adopt a variant of this network for the subsequent semantic segmentation stage of our method. Extensive evaluation on the standard SemanticKITTI and SSCBench-KITTI360 datasets show that our approach not only outperforms other monocular techniques by a large margin, it also achieves competitive performance against stereo methods. The code is available at https://github.com/xrkong/skimba
abstract_ch: 三维语义场景完成对于自主系统中的多个下游任务至关重要。它能够估计在获取的场景数据中缺失的几何和语义信息。由于现实世界条件的挑战性，这项任务通常需要复杂的模型来处理多模态数据以达到可接受的性能。我们提出了一种独特的神经网络模型，利用状态空间和扩散生成建模的进步，仅通过单目图像输入就能实现卓越的三维语义场景完成性能。我们的技术在变分自编码器的条件潜在空间中处理数据，在此空间中采用了创新的状态空间技术进行扩散建模。我们神经网络的关键组件是所提出的Skimba（Skip Mamba）去噪器，它擅长高效处理长序列数据。Skimba扩散模型是构成我们三维场景完成网络的重要部分，它包含三重Mamba结构、维度分解残差以及三个方向上变化的膨胀率。我们还为方法的后续语义分割阶段采用该网络的一个变体。在标准SemanticKITTI和SSCBench-KITTI360数据集上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法不仅在与其他单目技术的比较中表现出显著的优势，而且在与立体方法的性能对比中也达到了竞争力。代码可在https://github.com/xrkong/skimba 获取。

title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Reprogramming Visual-Language Model for General Deepfake Detection
title_ch: 站在巨人的肩膀上：为通用换脸检测重新编程视觉-语言模型
authors: Kaiqing Lin;Yuzhen Lin;Weixiang Li;Taiping Yao;Bin Li;
affiliations: Shenzhen University;Tencent;
abstract: The proliferation of deepfake faces poses huge potential negative impacts on our daily lives. Despite substantial advancements in deepfake detection over these years, the generalizability of existing methods against forgeries from unseen datasets or created by emerging generative models remains constrained. In this paper, inspired by the zero-shot advantages of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), we propose a novel approach that repurposes a well-trained VLM for general deepfake detection. Motivated by the model reprogramming paradigm that manipulates the model prediction via input perturbations, our method can reprogram a pre-trained VLM model (e.g., CLIP) solely based on manipulating its input without tuning the inner parameters. First, learnable visual perturbations are used to refine feature extraction for deepfake detection. Then, we exploit information of face embedding to create sample-level adaptative text prompts, improving the performance. Extensive experiments on several popular benchmark datasets demonstrate that (1) the cross-dataset and cross-manipulation performances of deepfake detection can be significantly and consistently improved (e.g., over 88\% AUC in cross-dataset setting from FF++ to WildDeepfake); (2) the superior performances are achieved with fewer trainable parameters, making it a promising approach for real-world applications.
abstract_ch: 生成的深度伪造面孔在日常生活中带来了巨大的潜在负面影响。尽管近年来在深度伪造检测方面取得了显著进展，但现有方法针对未见过的数据集或由新兴生成模型创建的伪造内容的一般化能力仍然受到限制。在本文中，我们受视觉语言模型（VLMs）零样本优势的启发，提出了一种新的方法，旨在重新利用一个训练良好的VLM进行通用深度伪造检测。我们的方法基于通过输入扰动操纵预训练VLM模型的预测，而无需调整其内部参数。首先，可学习的视觉扰动被用于细化特征提取以提高深度伪造检测能力。接着，我们利用面部嵌入信息来创建样本级别的自适应文本提示，进一步提升性能。在多个流行基准数据集上的广泛实验表明：（1）深度伪造检测在跨数据集和跨篡改情况下的性能可以显著且一致地提高（例如，在从FF++到WildDeepfake的跨数据集设置中，AUC超过88%）；（2）这种方法实现了更优的性能，同时所需的可训练参数较少，使其成为现实世界应用中的有前景的方法。

title: StructSR: Refuse Spurious Details in Real-World Image Super-Resolution
title_ch: StructSR：拒绝现实世界图像超分辨率中的虚假细节
authors: Yachao Li;Dong Liang;Tianyu Ding;Sheng-Jun Huang;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics;Microsoft;
abstract: Diffusion-based models have shown great promise in real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR), but often generate content with structural errors and spurious texture details due to the empirical priors and illusions of these models. To address this issue, we introduce StructSR, a simple, effective, and plug-and-play method that enhances structural fidelity and suppresses spurious details for diffusion-based Real-ISR. StructSR operates without the need for additional fine-tuning, external model priors, or high-level semantic knowledge. At its core is the Structure-Aware Screening (SAS) mechanism, which identifies the image with the highest structural similarity to the low-resolution (LR) input in the early inference stage, allowing us to leverage it as a historical structure knowledge to suppress the generation of spurious details. By intervening in the diffusion inference process, StructSR seamlessly integrates with existing diffusion-based Real-ISR models. Our experimental results demonstrate that StructSR significantly improves the fidelity of structure and texture, improving the PSNR and SSIM metrics by an average of 5.27% and 9.36% on a synthetic dataset (DIV2K-Val) and 4.13% and 8.64% on two real-world datasets (RealSR and DRealSR) when integrated with four state-of-the-art diffusion-based Real-ISR methods.
abstract_ch: 基于扩散的模型在现实世界的图像超分辨率（Real-ISR）方面展现出了巨大的潜力，但往往由于这些模型的经验先验和错觉，生成的内容会出现结构错误和虚假纹理细节。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了StructSR，这是一种简单、有效且即插即用的方法，可以增强结构保真度并抑制虚假细节。StructSR 在不需要额外微调、外部模型先验或高层次语义知识的情况下运作。其核心机制是结构感知筛选（Structure-Aware Screening, SAS），该机制在早期推理阶段识别与低分辨率（LR）输入具有最高结构相似性的图像，从而允许我们利用它作为历史结构知识来抑制虚假细节的生成。通过干预扩散推理过程，StructSR 可以无缝地与现有的基于扩散的 Real-ISR 模型集成。我们的实验结果显示，当将 StructSR 集成到四种最先进的基于扩散的 Real-ISR 方法中时，它可以显著提高结构和纹理的保真度，在合成数据集（DIV2K-Val）上分别提高了 PSNR 和 SSIM 指标的平均值 5.27% 和 9.36%，在两个真实世界的数据集（RealSR 和 DRealSR）上分别提高了 4.13% 和 8.64%。

title: StyO: Stylize Your Face in Only One-Shot
title_ch: StyO：一键美化你的面容
authors: Bonan Li;Zicheng Zhang;Xuecheng Nie;Congying Han;Yinhan Hu;Xinmin Qiu;Tiande Guo;
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Meitu Inc.;
abstract: This paper focuses on face stylization with a single artistic target. Existing works for this task often fail to retain the source content while achieving geometry variation. Here, we present a novel StyO model, ie. Stylize the face in only One-shot, to solve the above problem. In particular, StyO exploits a disentanglement and recombination strategy. It first disentangles the content and style of source and target images into identifiers, which are then recombined in a cross manner to derive the stylized face image. In this way, StyO decomposes complex images into independent and specific attributes, and simplifies one-shot face stylization as the combination of different attributes from input images, thus producing results better matching face geometry of target image and content of source one. StyO is implemented with latent diffusion models (LDM) and composed of two key modules: 1) Identifier Disentanglement Learner (IDL) for disentanglement phase. It represents identifiers as contrastive text prompts, ie. positive and negative descriptions. And it introduces a novel triple reconstruction loss to fine-tune the pre-trained LDM for encoding style and content into corresponding identifiers; 2) Fine-grained Content Controller (FCC) for the recombination phase. It recombines disentangled identifiers from IDL to form an augmented text prompt for generating stylized faces. In addition, FCC also constrains the cross-attention maps of latent and text features to preserve source face details in results. The extensive evaluation shows that StyO produces high-quality images on numerous paintings of various styles and outperforms the current state-of-the-art.
abstract_ch: 本文专注于使用单一艺术目标进行面部风格化。现有的此类任务作品往往在实现几何变化的同时未能保留源内容。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的StyO模型，即“单次风格化”，以解决上述问题。特别是，StyO 利用了分离和重组策略。它首先将源图像和目标图像的内容和风格分离为标识符，然后以交叉方式重组这些标识符，从而推导出风格化的面部图像。这样，StyO 将复杂图像分解为独立且特定的属性，并通过输入图像的不同属性组合简化单次面部风格化过程，从而产生更符合目标图像几何结构和源图像内容的结果。StyO 是基于潜在扩散模型（LDM）实现的，并由两个关键模块组成：1）标识符分离学习器（IDL），用于分离阶段。它将标识符表示为对比性文本提示，即正描述和负描述，并引入了一种新的三重重建损失，以微调预训练的LDM，使其能够将风格和内容编码为相应的标识符；2）细粒度内容控制器（FCC），用于重组阶段。它将IDL分离出的标识符重新组合成增强的文本提示，用于生成风格化的面部图像。此外，FCC 还约束了潜在特征和文本特征之间的交叉注意力图，以在结果中保留源面部的细节。广泛的评估表明，StyO 在各种风格的众多绘画上产生了高质量的图像，并优于当前最先进的技术。

authors: Ruihuang Li;Liyi Chen;Zhengqiang Zhang;Varun Jampani;Vishal M. Patel;Lei Zhang;
affiliations: Hong Kong Polytechnic University;OPPO Research Institute;Stability AI;Johns Hopkins University;

title: TCPFormer: Learning Temporal Correlation with Implicit Pose Proxy for 3D Human Pose Estimation
title_ch: TCPFormer：利用隐式姿态代理学习时空相关性的人体三维姿态估计
authors: Jiajie Liu;Mengyuan Liu;Hong Liu;Wenhao Li;
affiliations: Peking University;Nanyang Technological University;
abstract: Recent multi-frame lifting methods have dominated the 3D human pose estimation. However, previous methods ignore the intricate dependence within the 2D pose sequence and learn single temporal correlation. To alleviate this limitation, we propose TCPFormer, which leverages an implicit pose proxy as an intermediate representation. Each proxy within the implicit pose proxy can build one temporal correlation therefore helping us learn more comprehensive temporal correlation of human motion. Specifically, our method consists of three key components: Proxy Update Module (PUM), Proxy Invocation Module (PIM), and Proxy Attention Module (PAM). PUM first uses pose features to update the implicit pose proxy, enabling it to store representative information from the pose sequence. PIM then invocates and integrates the pose proxy with the pose sequence to enhance the motion semantics of each pose. Finally, PAM leverages the above mapping between the pose sequence and pose proxy to enhance the temporal correlation of the whole pose sequence. Experiments on the Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP datasets demonstrate that our proposed TCPFormer outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods.
abstract_ch: 最近的多帧提升方法在三维人体姿态估计领域占据主导地位。然而，先前的方法忽略了2D姿态序列中的复杂依赖关系，并仅学习单一时间关联。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了TCPFormer，该方法利用隐式姿态代理作为中间表示。每个隐式姿态代理可以构建一个时间关联，从而帮助我们学习更全面的人体运动的时间关联。具体而言，我们的方法包含三个关键组件：Proxy Update Module（PUM）、Proxy Invocation Module（PIM）和Proxy Attention Module（PAM）。PUM首先使用姿态特征来更新隐式姿态代理，使其能够存储姿态序列中的代表性信息。PIM随后调用并整合姿态代理与姿态序列，以增强每个姿态的运动语义。最后，PAM利用姿态序列与姿态代理之间的上述映射关系，增强整个姿态序列的时间关联。在Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP数据集上的实验表明，我们提出的TCPFormer优于之前的最先进的方法。

title: Temporal Action Localization with Cross Layer Task Decoupling and Refinement
title_ch: 跨层任务解耦与精炼的时序动作定位
authors: Qiang Li;Di Liu;Jun Kong;Sen Li;Hui Xu;Jianzhong Wang;
affiliations: Northeast Normal University;Northeast Electric Power University;Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;Changchun Humanities and Sciences College;
abstract: Temporal action localization (TAL) involves dual tasks to classify and localize actions within untrimmed videos. However, the two tasks often have conflicting requirements for features. Existing methods typically employ separate heads for classification and localization tasks but share the same input feature, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this issue, we propose a novel TAL method with Cross Layer Task Decoupling and Refinement (CLTDR). Based on the feature pyramid of video, CLTDR strategy integrates semantically strong features from higher pyramid layers and detailed boundary-aware boundary features from lower pyramid layers to effectively disentangle the action classification and localization tasks. Moreover, the multiple features from cross layers are also employed to refine and align the disentangled classification and regression results. At last, a lightweight Gated Multi-Granularity (GMG) module is proposed to comprehensively extract and aggregate video features at instant, local, and global temporal granularities. Benefiting from the CLTDR and GMG modules, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on five challenging benchmarks: THUMOS14, MultiTHUMOS, EPIC-KITCHENS-100, ActivityNet-1.3, and HACS. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at: https://github.com/LiQiang0307/CLTDR-GMG.
abstract_ch: 时空动作定位（TAL）涉及双重任务，即在未剪辑视频中对动作进行分类和定位。然而，这两个任务往往对特征的需求存在冲突。现有方法通常为分类和定位任务分别使用独立的头部，但共享相同的输入特征，导致性能不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的TAL方法——交叉层任务解耦与细化（CLTDR）。基于视频特征金字塔，CLTDR策略整合了高层特征中的语义强特征和低层特征中的边界意识细节特征，有效分离了动作分类和定位任务。此外，来自交叉层的多种特征也被用于细化和对齐分离出来的分类和回归结果。最后，我们提出了一种轻量级门控多粒度（GMG）模块，以全面提取并聚合视频在瞬间、局部和全局时间粒度上的特征。得益于CLTDR和GMG模块，我们的方法在五个具有挑战性的基准测试（THUMOS14、MultiTHUMOS、EPIC-KITCHENS-100、ActivityNet-1.3 和 HACS）上实现了最先进的性能。我们的代码和预训练模型已公开发布于：https://github.com/LiQiang0307/CLTDR-GMG。

title: Text and Image Are Mutually Beneficial: Enhancing Training-Free Few-Shot Classification with CLIP
title_ch: 图文互益：利用CLIP增强无监督少量样本分类
authors: Yayuan Li;Jintao Guo;Lei Qi;Wenbin Li;Yinghuan Shi;
affiliations: Nanjing University;Southeast University;
abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) has been widely used in vision tasks. Notably, CLIP has demonstrated promising performance in few-shot learning (FSL). However, existing CLIP-based methods in training-free FSL (i.e., without the requirement of additional training) mainly learn different modalities independently, leading to two essential issues: 1) severe anomalous match in image modality; 2) varying quality of generated text prompts. To address these issues, we build a mutual guidance mechanism, that introduces an Image-Guided-Text (IGT) component to rectify varying quality of text prompts through image representations, and a Text-Guided-Image (TGI) component to mitigate the anomalous match of image modality through text representations. By integrating IGT and TGI, we adopt a perspective of Text-Image Mutual guidance Optimization, proposing TIMO. Extensive experiments show that TIMO significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) training-free method. Additionally, by exploring the extent of mutual guidance, we propose an enhanced variant, TIMO-S, which even surpasses the best training-required methods by 0.33% with approximately 100 times less time cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/lyymuwu/TIMO.
abstract_ch: 对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）在视觉任务中被广泛应用。值得注意的是，CLIP 在零样本学习（FSL）中展示了令人鼓舞的性能。然而，在无需额外训练的 CLIP 基础方法（即不要求额外训练的方法）中，现有的方法主要独立地学习不同的模态，导致两个关键问题：1）图像模态中的严重异常匹配；2）生成的文本提示质量参差不齐。为了解决这些问题，我们构建了一种互指导机制，通过引入图像引导文本（IGT）组件来利用图像表示纠正文本提示的质量差异，并通过文本表示减轻图像模态的异常匹配问题。通过整合 IGT 和 TGI，我们提出了文本-图像互指导优化的新视角，即 TIMO。广泛的实验表明，TIMO 显著优于最先进的（SOTA）无需训练的方法。此外，通过探索互指导的程度，我们提出了一种增强变体 TIMO-S，即使仅花费约 100 倍少的时间成本，其性能也超越了最佳需要训练的方法 0.33%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/lyymuwu/TIMO 获取。

title: Thinking Racial Bias in Fair Forgery Detection: Models, Datasets and Evaluations
title_ch: 思考公平伪造检测中的种族偏见：模型、数据集和评估
authors: Decheng Liu;Zongqi Wang;Chunlei Peng;Nannan Wang;Ruimin Hu;Xinbo Gao;
affiliations: Xidian University;Tsinghua University;Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications;
abstract: Due to the successful development of deep image generation technology, forgery detection plays a more important role in social and economic security. Racial bias has not been explored thoroughly in the deep forgery detection field. In the paper, we first contribute a dedicated dataset called the Fair Forgery Detection (FairFD) dataset, where we prove the racial bias of public state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Different from existing forgery detection datasets, the self-constructed FairFD dataset contains a balanced racial ratio and diverse forgery generation images with the largest-scale subjects. Additionally, we identify the problems with naive fairness metrics when benchmarking forgery detection models. To comprehensively evaluate fairness, we design novel metrics including Approach Averaged Metric and Utility Regularized Metric, which can avoid deceptive results. We also present an effective and robust post-processing technique, Bias Pruning with Fair Activations (BPFA), which improves fairness without requiring retraining or weight updates. Extensive experiments conducted with 12 representative forgery detection models demonstrate the value of the proposed dataset and the reasonability of the designed fairness metrics. By applying the BPFA to the existing fairest detector, we achieve a new SOTA. Furthermore, we conduct more in-depth analyses to offer more insights to inspire researchers in the community.
abstract_ch: 由于深度图像生成技术的成功开发，伪造检测在社会和经济安全方面扮演了更为重要的角色。现有的伪造检测领域中，种族偏见尚未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们首先贡献了一个专门的数据集，称为公平伪造检测（FairFD）数据集，在该数据集中，我们证明了公共最先进的（SOTA）方法存在种族偏见。与现有伪造检测数据集不同，自行构建的FairFD数据集包含平衡的种族比例和多样化的伪造生成图像，具有最大的主体规模。此外，我们指出了在基准测试伪造检测模型时，朴素公平度量指标存在的问题。为了全面评估公平性，我们设计了新的指标，包括方法平均指标和效用正则化指标，这些指标能够避免误导性的结果。我们还提出了一种有效的且稳健的后处理技术——公平激活剪枝（Bias Pruning with Fair Activations，BPFA），该技术可以在不需重新训练或更新权重的情况下提高公平性。通过使用BPFA对现有的最公平检测器进行改进，我们在实验中取得了新的SOTA结果。此外，我们进行了更深入的分析，为社区中的研究人员提供了更多的见解。
