title: Transferable Adversarial Face Attack with Text Controlled Attribute
title_ch: 可转移的对抗面部攻击与文本控制属性
authors: Wenyun Li;Zheng Zhang;Xiangyuan Lan;Dongmei Jiang;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Pengcheng Laboratory;Pazhou Laboratory;
abstract: Traditional adversarial attacks typically produce adversarial examples under norm-constrained conditions, whereas unrestricted adversarial examples are free-form with semantically meaningful perturbations. Current unrestricted adversarial impersonation attacks exhibit limited control over adversarial face attributes and often suffer from low transferability. In this paper, we propose a novel Text Controlled Attribute Attack (TCA$^2$) to generate photorealistic adversarial impersonation faces guided by natural language. Specifically, the category-level personal softmax vector is employed to precisely guide the impersonation attacks. Additionally, we propose both data and model augmentation strategies to achieve transferable attacks on unknown target models. Finally, a generative model, \textit{i.e}, Style-GAN, is utilized to synthesize impersonated faces with desired attributes. Extensive experiments on two high-resolution face recognition datasets validate that our TCA$^2$ method can generate natural text-guided adversarial impersonation faces with high transferability. We also evaluate our method on real-world face recognition systems, \textit{i.e}, Face++ and Aliyun, further demonstrating the practical potential of our approach.
abstract_ch: 传统对抗攻击通常在范数约束条件下生成对抗样本，而无约束的对抗样本则是自由形式的，并且具有语义相关的扰动。当前的无约束对抗冒充攻击对对抗人脸属性的控制有限，往往难以实现高转移性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的文字控制属性攻击（TCA$^2$）方法，通过自然语言指导生成逼真的人脸对抗样本。具体而言，类别级别的个人软最大向量被用于精确引导冒充攻击。此外，我们提出了数据和模型增强策略，以在未知目标模型上实现可转移的攻击。最后，我们利用生成模型，即Style-GAN，合成具有所需属性的冒充人脸。在两个高分辨率人脸识别数据集上的广泛实验验证了我们的TCA$^2$方法可以生成自然文字引导且具有高转移性的对抗冒充人脸。我们还评估了该方法在真实世界的人脸识别系统（例如Face++和阿里云）上的效果，进一步证明了我们方法的实际潜力。

title: Tri-Ergon: Fine-Grained Video-to-Audio Generation with Multi-Modal Conditions and LUFS Control
title_ch: Tri-Ergon: 细粒度视频到音频生成，结合多模态条件和LUFS控制
authors: Bingliang Li;Fengyu Yang;Yuxin Mao;Qingwen Ye;Hongkai Chen;Yiran Zhong;
affiliations: vivo Mobile Communication Co., Ltd;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Northwestern Polytechnical University;OpenNLP Lab;
abstract: Video-to-audio (V2A) generation utilizes visual-only video features to produce realistic sounds that correspond to the scene. However, current V2A models often lack fine-grained control over the generated audio, especially in terms of loudness variation and the incorporation of multi-modal conditions. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Tri-Ergon, a diffusion-based V2A model that incorporates textual, auditory, and pixel-level visual prompts to enable detailed and semantically rich audio synthesis. Additionally, we introduce Loudness Units relative to Full Scale (LUFS) embedding, which allows for precise manual control of the loudness changes over time for individual audio channels, enabling our model to effectively address the intricate correlation of video and audio in real-world Foley workflows. Tri-Ergon is capable of creating 44.1 kHz high-fidelity stereo audio clips of varying lengths up to 60 seconds, which significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art V2A methods that typically generate mono audio for a fixed duration.
abstract_ch: 视频到音频（V2A）生成利用仅视觉的视频特征来产生与场景对应的逼真声音。然而，当前的V2A模型往往缺乏对生成音频的精细控制，尤其是在响度变化和多模态条件融入方面。为克服这些限制，我们引入了Tri-Ergon，这是一种基于扩散的V2A模型，它整合了文本、听觉和像素级视觉提示，以实现详细且语义丰富的音频合成。此外，我们还引入了相对全规模响度单位（LUFS）嵌入，这使得用户能够精确手动控制单个音频通道随时间的响度变化，从而使我们的模型能够有效解决实际世界中福莱尔流程中视频和音频的复杂关联问题。Tri-Ergon 能够生成最高可达60秒长度的44.1 kHz高保真立体声音频片段，这在很大程度上优于现有最先进的V2A方法，后者通常只能固定时长生成单声道音频。

title: U-KAN Makes Strong Backbone for Medical Image Segmentation and Generation
title_ch: U-KAN为医学图像分割和生成提供强大的支撑
authors: Chenxin Li;Xinyu Liu;Wuyang Li;Cheng Wang;Hengyu Liu;Yifan Liu;Zhen Chen;Yixuan Yuan;
affiliations: Chinese University of Hong Kong;
abstract: U-Net has become a cornerstone in various visual applications such as image segmentation and diffusion probability models. While numerous innovative designs and improvements have been introduced by incorporating transformers or MLPs, the networks are still limited to linearly modeling patterns as well as the deficient interpretability. To address these challenges, our intuition is inspired by the impressive results of the Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) in terms of accuracy and interpretability, which reshape the neural network learning via the stack of non-linear learnable activation functions derived from the Kolmogorov-Anold representation theorem. Specifically, in this paper, we explore the untapped potential of KANs in improving backbones for vision tasks. We investigate, modify and re-design the established U-Net pipeline by integrating the dedicated KAN layers on the tokenized intermediate representation, termed U-KAN. Rigorous medical image segmentation benchmarks verify the superiority of U-KAN by higher accuracy even with less computation cost. We further delved into the potential of U-KAN as an alternative U-Net noise predictor in diffusion models, demonstrating its applicability in generating task-oriented model architectures. These endeavours unveil valuable insights and sheds light on the prospect that with U-KAN, you can make strong backbone for medical image segmentation and generation. Project page:\url{https://yes-u-kan.github.io/}.
abstract_ch: U-Net已成为各种视觉应用中的基石，包括图像分割和扩散概率模型。虽然通过引入变压器或MLPs，已经提出了许多创新设计和改进，但这些网络仍然局限于线性模式化模式以及解释能力不足的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们从Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）在准确性和可解释性方面取得的令人印象深刻的结果中获得了灵感，KANs通过堆叠源自柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺尔德表示定理的非线性可学习激活函数重新塑造了神经网络的学习方式。具体而言，在本文中，我们探讨了KANs在提高视觉任务骨干网方面的未开发潜力。我们通过对已建立的U-Net管道进行调查、修改和重新设计，将专门的KAN层集成到分词中间表示中，称为U-KAN。严格的医学图像分割基准测试验证了U-KAN的优越性，即使计算成本较低，其准确率也更高。我们进一步深入研究了U-KAN作为扩散模型中替代U-Net噪声预测器的可能性，展示了其生成任务导向型模型架构的应用前景。这些努力揭示了宝贵的见解，并为利用U-KAN构建强大的医学图像分割和生成骨干网提供了希望。项目页面：[https://yes-u-kan.github.io/](https://yes-u-kan.github.io/)。

title: UFO: Enhancing Diffusion-Based Video Generation with a Uniform Frame Organizer
title_ch: UFO：一种统一帧组织器增强基于扩散的视频生成方法
authors: Delong Liu;Zhaohui Hou;Mingjie Zhan;Shihao Han;Zhicheng Zhao;Fei Su;
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications;SenseTime;Beijing Key Laboratory of Network System and Network Culture;Ministry of Culture and Tourism;
abstract: Recently, diffusion-based video generation models have achieved significant success. However, existing models often suffer from issues like weak consistency and declining image quality over time. To overcome these challenges, inspired by aesthetic principles, we propose a non-invasive plug-in called Uniform Frame Organizer (UFO), which is compatible with any diffusion-based video generation model. The UFO comprises a series of adaptive adapters with adjustable intensities, which can significantly enhance the consistency between the foreground and background of videos and improve image quality without altering the original model parameters when integrated. The training for UFO is simple, efficient, requires minimal resources, and supports stylized training. Its modular design allows for the combination of multiple UFOs, enabling the customization of personalized video generation models. Furthermore, the UFO also supports direct transferability across different models of the same specification without the need for specific retraining. The experimental results indicate that UFO effectively enhances video generation quality and demonstrates its superiority in public video generation benchmarks. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/Delong-liu-bupt/UFO.
abstract_ch: 最近，基于扩散的视频生成模型取得了显著的成功。然而，现有的模型往往存在一致性较弱和随时间推移图像质量下降的问题。为克服这些挑战，我们受美学原则启发，提出了一种非侵入性的插件——Uniform Frame Organizer（UFO），它可以与任何基于扩散的视频生成模型兼容。UFO 包含一系列可调节强度的自适应适配器，可以显著增强视频前景和背景之间的一致性，并在集成时无需更改原始模型参数即可提高图像质量。UFO 的训练过程简单、高效、资源需求低，并支持风格化训练。其模块化设计允许组合多个 UFO，从而实现个性化的视频生成模型定制。此外，UFO 还支持直接在相同规格的不同模型之间进行迁移，无需特定的重新训练。实验结果表明，UFO 显著提高了视频生成质量，并在公共视频生成基准测试中展示了其优越性。代码将在 https://github.com/Delong-liu-bupt/UFO 公开发布。

title: UN-DETR: Promoting Objectness Learning via Joint Supervision for Unknown Object Detection
title_ch: 通过联合监督促进未知物体检测的对象性学习
authors: HaoMiao Liu;Hao Xu;Chuhuai Yue;Bo Ma;
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology;
abstract: Unknown Object Detection (UOD) aims to identify objects of unseen categories, differing from the traditional detection paradigm limited by the closed-world assumption. A key component of UOD is learning a generalized representation, i.e. objectness for both known and unknown categories to distinguish and localize objects from the background in a class-agnostic manner. However, previous methods obtain supervision signals for learning objectness in isolation from either localization or classification information, leading to poor performance for UOD. To address this issue, we propose a transformer-based UOD framework, UN-DETR. Based on this, we craft Instance Presence Score (IPS) to represent the probability of an object's presence. For the purpose of information complementarity, IPS employs a strategy of joint supervised learning, integrating attributes representing general objectness from the positional and the categorical latent space as supervision signals. To enhance IPS learning, we introduce a one-to-many assignment strategy to incorporate more supervision. Then, we propose Unbiased Query Selection to provide premium initial query vectors for the decoder. Additionally, we propose an IPS-guided post-process strategy to filter redundant boxes and correct classification predictions for known and unknown objects. Finally, we pretrain the entire UN-DETR in an unsupervised manner, in order to obtain objectness prior. Our UN-DETR is comprehensively evaluated on multiple UOD and known detection benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness and achieving state-of-the-art performance.
abstract_ch: 未知对象检测（UOD）旨在识别未见过类别的对象，这与传统检测范式受限于封闭世界假设不同。UOD的关键组件是学习一种通用表示，即对已知和未知类别都进行对象性的学习，以在无类别限制的情况下区分和定位对象。然而，先前的方法是孤立地从局部化或分类信息中获得监督信号来学习对象性，导致UOD表现不佳。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于变压器的UOD框架——UN-DETR。在此基础上，我们设计了实例存在得分（IPS）来表示对象存在的概率。为了实现信息互补，IPS采用联合监督学习策略，结合位置和类别潜在空间中的属性作为监督信号，代表一般对象性。为了增强IPS的学习效果，我们引入了一对多分配策略，以整合更多的监督信息。此外，我们提出了无偏查询选择方法，为解码器提供优质的初始查询向量。最后，我们以无监督方式预训练整个UN-DETR，以获取对象性的先验知识。我们的UN-DETR在多个UOD和已知检测基准上进行了全面评估，证明了其有效性和达到了最先进的性能。

title: VEGAS: Towards Visually Explainable and Grounded Artificial Social Intelligence
title_ch: VEGAS：迈向具有视觉可解释性和grounded性的 artificial social intelligence（人工社会智能）
authors: Hao Li;Hao Fei;Zechao Hu;Zhengwei Yang;Zheng Wang;
affiliations: Wuhan University;National University of Singapore;
abstract: Social Intelligence Queries (Social-IQ) serve as the primary multimodal benchmark for evaluating a model's social intelligence level. While impressive multiple-choice question(MCQ) accuracy is achieved by current solutions, increasing evidence shows that they are largely, and in some cases entirely, dependent on language modality, overlooking visual context. Additionally, the closed-set nature further prevents the exploration of whether and to what extent the reasoning path behind selection is correct. To address these limitations, we propose the Visually Explainable and Grounded Artificial Social Intelligence (VEGAS) model. As a generative multimodal model, VEGAS leverages open-ended answering to provide explainable responses, which enhances the clarity and evaluation of reasoning paths. To enable visually grounded answering, we propose a novel sampling strategy to provide the model with more relevant visual frames. We then enhance the model's interpretation of these frames through Generalist Instruction Fine-Tuning (GIFT), which aims to: i) learn multimodal-language transformations for fundamental emotional social traits, and ii) establish multimodal joint reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments, comprising modality ablation, open-ended assessments, and supervised MCQ evaluations, consistently show that VEGAS effectively utilizes visual information in reasoning to produce correct and also credible answers. We expect this work to of fer a new perspective on Social-IQ and advance the development of human-like social AI.
abstract_ch: 社会智能查询（Social-IQ）作为评估模型社交智能水平的主要多模态基准。尽管当前解决方案在多项选择题（MCQ）方面取得了令人印象深刻的准确性，但越来越多的证据表明，它们很大程度上依赖于语言模态，忽视了视觉上下文。此外，封闭式问题的性质进一步阻碍了探索选择背后推理路径正确性的可能性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了可视觉解释和基于视觉的 artificial 社会智能（VEGAS）模型。作为一种生成型多模态模型，VEGAS 利用开放式回答来提供可解释的响应，从而增强推理路径的清晰度和评估。为了实现基于视觉的回答，我们提出了一种新的采样策略，以使模型获得更多的相关视觉帧。然后，通过通用指令微调（GIFT），我们增强模型对这些帧的理解，其目标是：i）学习多模态-语言转换，以掌握基本的情感社会特征；ii）建立多模态联合推理能力。广泛的经验研究表明，VEGAS 能够有效利用推理过程中的视觉信息，产生正确的且可信的答案。我们期望这项工作能为 Social-IQ 提供新的视角，并促进类似人类的社会人工智能的发展。

title: VidEvent: A Large Dataset for Understanding Dynamic Evolution of Events in Videos
title_ch: VidEvent：理解视频中事件动态演变的大规模数据集
authors: Baoyu Liang;Qile Su;Shoutai Zhu;Yuchen Liang;Chao Tong;
affiliations: Beihang University;
abstract: Despite the significant impact of visual events on human cognition, understanding events in videos remains a challenging task for AI due to their complex structures, semantic hierarchies, and dynamic evolution. To address this, we propose the task of video event understanding that extracts event scripts and makes predictions with these scripts from videos. To support this task, we introduce VidEvent, a large-scale dataset containing over 23,000 well-labeled events, featuring detailed event structures, broad hierarchies, and logical relations extracted from movie recap videos. The dataset was created through a meticulous annotation process, ensuring high-quality and reliable event data. We also provide comprehensive baseline models offering detailed descriptions of their architecture and performance metrics. These models serve as benchmarks for future research, facilitating comparisons and improvements. Our analysis of VidEvent and the baseline models highlights the dataset's potential to advance video event understanding and encourages the exploration of innovative algorithms and models. The dataset and related resources are publicly available at www.videvent.top.
abstract_ch: 尽管视觉事件对人类认知有重大影响，但由于视频中的复杂结构、语义层次以及动态演变，AI 理解视频中的事件仍是一项具有挑战性的任务。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了视频事件理解的任务，该任务从视频中提取事件脚本并使用这些脚本进行预测。为了支持这一任务，我们引入了VidEvent数据集，该数据集包含超过23,000个高质量标注的事件，涵盖了详细的事件结构、广泛的语义层次以及从电影概要视频中提取的逻辑关系。该数据集通过细致的标注过程创建，确保了数据的质量和可靠性。我们还提供了全面的基本模型，详细描述了其架构和性能指标。这些模型为未来的研究提供了基准，促进了比较与改进。我们对VidEvent数据集和基本模型的分析突显了该数据集在推进视频事件理解方面的潜力，并鼓励探索创新算法和模型。相关数据集和资源已在www.videvent.top公开提供。

title: ViG: Linear-complexity Visual Sequence Learning with Gated Linear Attention
title_ch: ViG：带有门控线性注意力的线性复杂度视觉序列学习
authors: Bencheng Liao;Xinggang Wang;Lianghui Zhu;Qian Zhang;Chang Huang;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science & Technology;Horizon Robotics;
abstract: Recently, linear complexity sequence modeling networks have achieved modeling capabilities similar to Vision Transformers on a variety of computer vision tasks, while using fewer FLOPs and less memory. However, their advantage in terms of actual runtime speed is not significant. To address this issue, we introduce Gated Linear Attention (GLA) for vision, leveraging its superior hardware-awareness and efficiency. We propose direction-wise gating to capture 1D global context through bidirectional modeling and a 2D gating locality injection to adaptively inject 2D local details into 1D global context. Our hardware-aware implementation further merges forward and backward scanning into a single kernel, enhancing parallelism and reducing memory cost and latency. The proposed model, ViG, offers a favorable trade-off in accuracy, parameters, and FLOPs on ImageNet and downstream tasks, outperforming popular Transformer and CNN-based models. Notably, ViG-S matches DeiT-B's accuracy while using only 27% of the parameters and 20% of the FLOPs, running 2$\times$ faster on $224\times224$ images. At $1024\times1024$ resolution, ViG-T uses 5.2$\times$ fewer FLOPs, saves 90% GPU memory, runs 4.8$\times$ faster, and achieves 20.7% higher top-1 accuracy than DeiT-T. These results position ViG as an efficient and scalable solution for visual representation learning. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/hustvl/ViG}.
abstract_ch: 最近，线性复杂度序列建模网络在多种计算机视觉任务上实现了与视觉变换器相近的建模能力，同时使用更少的FLOPs和更小的内存。然而，在实际运行速度方面，它们的优势并不明显。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了门控线性注意力（GLA），利用其优秀的硬件感知能力和效率。我们提出了方向门控机制来通过双向建模捕获1D全局上下文，并提出了一种二维局部细节注入机制，以自适应地将2D局部细节注入到1D全局上下文中。我们的硬件感知实现进一步将前向扫描和后向扫描合并为一个内核，增强了并行性并降低了内存成本和延迟。所提出的模型ViG在ImageNet和下游任务上提供了准确度、参数量和FLOPs之间的有利权衡，优于流行的Transformer和CNN基模型。值得注意的是，ViG-S仅使用DeiT-B参数量的27%和FLOPs的20%，但在$224\times224$图像上的运行速度是其两倍。在$1024\times1024$分辨率下，ViG-T使用的FLOPs仅为DeiT-T的5.2倍，节省了90%的GPU内存，运行速度快4.8倍，并且Top-1准确率比DeiT-T高20.7%。这些结果使ViG成为视觉表示学习的一种高效且可扩展的解决方案。代码可在https://github.com/hustvl/ViG获取。

title: 3DMambaIPF: A State Space Model for Iterative Point Cloud Filtering via Differentiable Rendering
title_ch: 3DMambaIPF：一种通过可微渲染进行迭代点云过滤的状态空间模型
authors: Qingyuan Zhou;Weidong Yang;Ben Fei;Jingyi Xu;Rui Zhang;Keyi Liu;Yeqi Luo;Ying He;
affiliations: Fudan University;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Nanyang Technological University;
abstract: Noise is an inevitable aspect of point cloud acquisition, necessitating filtering as a fundamental task within the realm of 3D vision. Existing learning-based filtering methods have shown promising capabilities on small-scale synthetic or real-world datasets. Nonetheless, the effectiveness of these methods is constrained when dealing with a substantial quantity of point clouds. This limitation primarily stems from their limited denoising capabilities for large-scale point clouds and their inclination to generate noisy outliers after denoising. The recent introduction of State Space Models (SSMs) for long sequence modeling in Natural Language Processing (NLP) presents a promising solution for handling large-scale data. Encouraged by iterative point cloud filtering methods, we introduce 3DMambaIPF, firstly incorporating Mamba (Selective SSM) architecture to sequentially handle extensive point clouds from large scenes, capitalizing on its strengths in selective input processing and long sequence modeling capabilities. Additionally, we integrate a robust and fast differentiable rendering loss to constrain the noisy points around the surface. In contrast to previous methodologies, this differentiable rendering loss enhances the visual realism of denoised geometric structures and aligns point cloud boundaries more closely with those observed in real-world objects. Extensive evaluation on datasets comprising small-scale synthetic and real-world models (typically with up to 50K points) demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results. Moreover, we showcase the superior scalability and efficiency of our method on large-scale models with about 500K points, where the majority of the existing learning-based denoising methods are unable to handle.
abstract_ch: 噪声是点云获取过程中不可避免的一部分，在三维视觉领域，噪声过滤是一项基本任务。现有的基于学习的过滤方法在小型合成或真实世界数据集上显示出有前景的能力。然而，当处理大量点云时，这些方法的有效性受到限制。这一局限主要来自于它们对大规模点云的去噪能力有限，以及在去噪后倾向于生成噪声异常值。最近，自然语言处理（NLP）领域中长序列建模的State Space Models（SSMs）的引入为处理大规模数据提供了有希望的解决方案。受迭代点云过滤方法的启发，我们提出了3DMambaIPF，首次将Mamba（选择性SSM）架构应用于从大场景中顺序处理大量点云，利用其在选择性输入处理和长序列建模方面的优势。此外，我们整合了一种稳健且快速的可微渲染损失，以约束去噪后的噪声点靠近表面。与之前的过滤方法不同，这种可微渲染损失增强了去噪几何结构的视觉真实性，并使点云边界更紧密地符合真实世界对象的观察边界。在包含小型合成和真实世界模型（通常包含多达5万个点）的数据集上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法达到了最先进的性能。此外，我们在大约包含50万个点的大规模模型上展示了我们方法的优越可扩展性和效率，而大多数现有的基于学习的去噪方法无法处理此类大规模模型。

title: A Comprehensive Overhaul of Multimodal Assistant with Small Language Models
title_ch: 面向小语言模型的多模态助手全面升级
authors: Minjie Zhu;Yichen Zhu;Ning Liu;Xin Liu;Zhiyuan Xu;Chaomin Shen;Yaxin Peng;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Midea Group;Shanghai University;
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have showcased impressive skills in tasks related to visual understanding and reasoning. Yet, their widespread application faces obstacles due to the high computational demands during both the training and inference phases, restricting their use to a limited audience within the research and user communities. In this paper, we investigate the design aspects of Multimodal Small Language Models (MSLMs) and propose an efficient multimodal assistant named Mipha, which is designed to create synergy among various aspects: visual representation, language models, and optimization strategies. We show that without increasing the volume of training data, our Mipha-3B outperforms the state-of-the-art large MLLMs, especially LLaVA-1.5-13B, on multiple benchmarks. Through detailed discussion, we provide insights and guidelines for developing strong MSLMs that rival the capabilities of MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhuyiche/llava-phi.
abstract_ch: 多模态小型语言模型（MSLMs）在与视觉理解与推理相关的任务上展示了令人印象深刻的技能。然而，由于在训练和推理阶段都面临着高昂的计算需求，这限制了它们的应用范围，仅限于研究和用户社区中的少数人群。在本文中，我们探讨了多模态小型语言模型的设计方面，并提出了一种高效的多模态助手Mipha，旨在将视觉表示、语言模型和优化策略各方面进行协同。我们证明，在不增加训练数据量的情况下，我们的Mipha-3B在多个基准测试上优于最先进的大型MSLMs，尤其是LLaVA-1.5-13B。通过详细的讨论，我们提供了开发能够匹敌大型语言模型能力的小型多模态语言模型的见解和指南。我们的代码可在https://github.com/zhuyiche/llava-phi获取。

title: A New Adversarial Perspective for LiDAR-based 3D Object Detection
title_ch: 基于LiDAR的3D物体检测的新对抗视角
authors: Shijun Zheng;Weiquan Liu;Yu Guo;Yu Zang;Siqi Shen;Cheng Wang;
affiliations: Xiamen University;Jimei University;
abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) rely on LiDAR sensors for environmental perception and decision-making in driving scenarios. However, ensuring the safety and reliability of AVs in complex environments remains a pressing challenge. To address this issue, we introduce a real-world dataset (ROLiD) comprising LiDAR-scanned point clouds of two random objects: water mist and smoke. In this paper, we introduce a novel adversarial perspective by proposing an attack framework that utilizes water mist and smoke to simulate environmental interference. Specifically, we propose a point cloud sequence generation method using a motion and content decomposition generative adversarial network named PCS-GAN to simulate the distribution of random objects. Furthermore, leveraging the simulated LiDAR scanning characteristics implemented with Range Image, we examine the effects of introducing random object perturbations at various positions on the target vehicle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that adversarial perturbations based on random objects effectively deceive vehicle detection and reduce the recognition rate of 3D object detection models.
abstract_ch: 自动驾驶车辆（AVs）依赖于激光雷达（LiDAR）传感器进行环境感知和驾驶场景中的决策。然而，在复杂环境中确保AVs的安全性和可靠性仍然是一个紧迫的挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一个名为ROLiD的真实世界数据集，该数据集包含随机物体——水雾和烟雾的LiDAR扫描点云。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的对抗视角，通过利用水雾和烟雾来模拟环境干扰。具体而言，我们提出了一种名为PCS-GAN的运动和内容分解生成对抗网络方法，用于模拟随机物体的分布。此外，借助Range Image实现的模拟LiDAR扫描特性，我们研究了在目标车辆的不同位置引入随机物体扰动对检测效果的影响。广泛的实验表明，基于随机物体的对抗扰动能够有效欺骗车辆检测，并降低3D物体检测模型的识别率。

title: AdaCo: Overcoming Visual Foundation Model Noise in 3D Semantic Segmentation via Adaptive Label Correction
title_ch: AdaCo：通过自适应标签修正克服三维语义分割中的视觉基础模型噪声
authors: Pufan Zou;Shijia Zhao;Weijie Huang;Qiming Xia;Chenglu Wen;Wei Li;Cheng Wang;
affiliations: Xiamen University;Inceptio;
abstract: Recently, Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have shown a remarkable generalization performance in 3D perception tasks. However, their effectiveness in large-scale outdoor datasets remains constrained by the scarcity of accurate supervision signals, the extensive noise caused by variable outdoor conditions, and the abundance of unknown objects. In this work, we propose a novel label-free learning method, Adaptive Label Correction (AdaCo), for 3D semantic segmentation. AdaCo first introduces the Cross-modal Label Generation Module (CLGM), providing cross-modal supervision with the formidable interpretive capabilities of the VFMs. Subsequently, AdaCo incorporates the Adaptive Noise Corrector (ANC), updating and adjusting the noisy samples within this supervision iteratively during training. Moreover, we develop an Adaptive Robust Loss (ARL) function to modulate each sample's sensitivity to noisy supervision, preventing potential underfitting issues associated with robust loss. Our proposed AdaCo can effectively mitigate the performance limitations of label-free learning networks in 3D semantic segmentation tasks. Extensive experiments on two outdoor benchmark datasets highlight the superior performance of our method.
abstract_ch: 最近，视觉基础模型（VFMs）在3D感知任务中展现了出色的泛化性能。然而，在大规模户外数据集中，它们的有效性仍然受到准确监督信号稀缺、由多变的户外条件引起的大量噪声以及未知物体数量众多的限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的无标签学习方法——自适应标签修正（AdaCo），用于3D语义分割。AdaCo首先引入了跨模态标签生成模块（CLGM），利用VFMs强大的解释能力提供跨模态监督。随后，AdaCo结合了自适应噪声校正器（ANC），在训练过程中逐步更新和调整监督中的噪声样本。此外，我们开发了一种自适应鲁棒损失函数（ARL），以调节每个样本对噪声监督的敏感度，防止与鲁棒损失相关的潜在过拟合问题。我们提出的AdaCo能够在3D语义分割任务中有效缓解无标签学习网络的性能限制。在两个户外基准数据集上的广泛实验中，我们的方法表现出了优越的性能。

title: Adaptive Prototype Replay for Class Incremental Semantic Segmentation
title_ch: 自适应原型重播用于类增量语义分割
authors: Guilin Zhu;Dongyue Wu;Changxin Gao;Runmin Wang;Weidong Yang;Nong Sang;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology;Hunan Normal University;
abstract: Class incremental semantic segmentation (CISS) aims to segment new classes during continual steps while preventing the forgetting of old knowledge. Existing methods alleviate catastrophic forgetting by replaying distributions of previously learned classes using stored prototypes or features. However, they overlook a critical issue: in CISS, the representation of class knowledge is updated continuously through incremental learning, whereas prototype replay methods maintain fixed prototypes. This mismatch between updated representation and fixed prototypes limits the effectiveness of the prototype replay strategy. To address this issue, we propose the Adaptive prototype replay (Adapter) for CISS in this paper. Adapter comprises an adaptive deviation compen sation (ADC) strategy and an uncertainty-aware constraint (UAC) loss. Specifically, the ADC strategy dynamically updates the stored prototypes based on the estimated representation shift distance to match the updated representation of old class. The UAC loss reduces prediction uncertainty, aggregating discriminative features to aid in generating compact prototypes. Additionally, we introduce a compensation-based prototype similarity discriminative (CPD) loss to ensure adequate differentiation between similar prototypes, thereby enhancing the efficiency of the adaptive prototype replay strategy. Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K datasets demonstrate that Adapter achieves state-of-the-art results and proves effective across various CISS tasks, particularly in challenging multi-step scenarios. The code and model is available at https://github.com/zhu-gl-ux/Adapter.
abstract_ch: 增量语义分割（Incremental Semantic Segmentation, CISS）旨在在持续学习过程中对新类进行分割，同时防止旧知识遗忘。现有方法通过使用存储的原型或特征重新播放以前学习过的类的分布来缓解灾难性遗忘问题。然而，这些方法忽略了关键问题：在CISS中，通过增量学习不断更新类知识的表示，而原型重播方法则保持固定原型不变。这种更新表示与固定原型之间的不匹配限制了原型重播策略的有效性。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了适用于CISS的自适应原型重播（Adapter）方法。Adapter包括自适应偏差补偿（Adaptive Deviation Compensation, ADC）策略和基于不确定性约束（Uncertainty-Aware Constraint, UAC）的损失函数。具体而言，ADC策略根据估计的表示位移距离动态更新存储的原型，以匹配旧类的更新表示。UAC损失降低预测不确定性，聚合区分性特征以帮助生成紧凑的原型。此外，我们引入了一种基于补偿的原型相似性区分（Compensation-Based Prototype Similarity Discriminative, CPD）损失函数，以确保相似原型之间的充分区分，从而提高自适应原型重播策略的效率。在Pascal VOC和ADE20K数据集上的广泛实验表明，Adapter达到了最先进的性能，并且在各种CISS任务中证明有效，特别是在具有挑战性的多步场景中。代码和模型可在https://github.com/zhu-gl-ux/Adapter获取。

title: All-in-One: Transferring Vision Foundation Models into Stereo Matching
title_ch: 全栈解决方案：将视觉基础模型应用于立体匹配
authors: Jingyi Zhou;Haoyu Zhang;Jiakang Yuan;Peng Ye;Tao Chen;Hao Jiang;Meiya Chen;Yangyang Zhang;
affiliations: Fudan University;Shanghai AI Laboratory;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Xiaomi Inc.;
abstract: As a fundamental vision task, stereo matching has made remarkable progress. While recent iterative optimization-based methods have achieved promising performance, their feature extraction capabilities still have room for improvement. Inspired by the ability of vision foundation models (VFMs) to extract general representations, in this work, we propose AIO-Stereo which can flexibly select and transfer knowledge from multiple heterogeneous VFMs to a single stereo matching model. To better reconcile features between heterogeneous VFMs and the stereo matching model and fully exploit prior knowledge from VFMs, we proposed a dual-level feature utilization mechanism that aligns heterogeneous features and transfers multi-level knowledge. Based on the mechanism, a dual-level selective knowledge transfer module is designed to selectively transfer knowledge and integrate the advantages of multiple VFMs. Experimental results show that AIO-Stereo achieves start-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets and ranks $1^{st}$ on the Middlebury dataset and outperforms all the published work on the ETH3D benchmark.
abstract_ch: 作为一项基本的视觉任务，立体匹配已经取得了显著的进步。尽管最近基于迭代优化的方法取得了令人鼓舞的效果，但在特征提取能力方面仍有改进的空间。受视觉基础模型（VFMs）提取通用表示能力的启发，在这项工作中，我们提出了一种AIO-Stereo方法，它可以灵活地从多个异构VFMs选择并转移知识到一个单一的立体匹配模型。为了更好地协调异构VFMs与立体匹配模型之间的特征，并充分利用VFMs中的先验知识，我们提出了一种双层特征利用机制，该机制能够对异构特征进行对齐并转移多层知识。基于这一机制，我们设计了一个双层选择性知识转移模块，以选择性地转移知识并整合多个VFMs的优势。实验结果表明，AIO-Stereo在多个数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并在Middlebury数据集上排名第一，同时在ETH3D基准测试中优于所有已发表的工作。

title: Anti-Diffusion: Preventing Abuse of Modifications of Diffusion-Based Models
title_ch: 反扩散：防止基于扩散模型的修改被滥用
authors: Li Zheng;Liangbin Xie;Jiantao Zhou;Xintao Wang;Haiwei Wu;Jinyu Tian;
affiliations: University of Macau;Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology;Kuaishou Technology;Macau University of Science and Technology;
abstract: Although diffusion-based techniques have shown remarkable success in image generation and editing tasks, their abuse can lead to severe negative social impacts. Recently, some works have been proposed to provide defense against the abuse of diffusion-based methods. However, their protection may be limited in specific scenarios by manually defined prompts or the stable diffusion (SD) version. Furthermore, these methods solely focus on tuning methods, overlooking editing methods that could also pose a significant threat. In this work, we propose Anti-Diffusion, a privacy protection system designed for general diffusion-based methods, applicable to both tuning and editing techniques. To mitigate the limitations of manually defined prompts on defense performance, we introduce the prompt tuning (PT) strategy that enables precise expression of original images. To provide defense against both tuning and editing methods, we propose the semantic disturbance loss (SDL) to disrupt the semantic information of protected images. Given the limited research on the defense against editing methods, we develop a dataset named Defense-Edit to assess the defense performance of various methods. Experiments demonstrate that our Anti-Diffusion achieves superior defense performance across a wide range of diffusion-based techniques in different scenarios.
abstract_ch: 尽管基于扩散的技术在图像生成和编辑任务中表现出色，但其滥用可能导致严重的负面社会影响。最近，一些研究提出了防御基于扩散方法滥用的方案。然而，在特定场景下，这些防御措施可能受到手动定义提示词或稳定扩散（SD）版本的限制。此外，这些方法仅专注于调优方法，而忽视了编辑方法也可能带来的重大威胁。在此项工作中，我们提出了一种名为Anti-Diffusion的隐私保护系统，适用于一般的基于扩散的方法，既包括调优技术也包括编辑技术。为了减轻手动定义提示词对防御性能的限制，我们引入了提示词调优（PT）策略，以实现对原始图像精确表达的需求。为了同时防御调优和编辑方法，我们提出了语义干扰损失（SDL），以扰乱受保护图像的语义信息。鉴于对抗编辑方法的研究相对有限，我们开发了一个名为Defense-Edit的数据集，用于评估各种方法的防御性能。实验表明，我们的Anti-Diffusion在不同场景下的多种基于扩散的技术中实现了卓越的防御性能。

title: Bootstraping Clustering of Gaussians for View-consistent 3D Scene Understanding
title_ch: 基于Bootstrap聚类的高一致性3D场景理解
authors: Wenbo Zhang;Lu Zhang;Ping Hu;Liqian Ma;Yunzhi Zhuge;Huchuan Lu;
affiliations: Dalian University of Technology;University of Electronic Science and Technology of China;ZMO AI;
abstract: Injecting semantics into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently garnered significant attention. While current approaches typically distill 3D semantic features from 2D foundational models (e.g., CLIP and SAM) to facilitate novel view segmentation and semantic understanding, their heavy reliance on 2D supervision can undermine cross-view semantic consistency and necessitate complex data preparation processes, therefore hindering view-consistent scene understanding. In this work, we present FreeGS, an unsupervised semantic-embedded 3DGS framework that achieves view-consistent 3D scene understanding without the need for 2D labels. Instead of directly learning semantic features, we introduce the IDentity-coupled Semantic Field (IDSF) into 3DGS, which captures both semantic representations and view-consistent instance indices for each Gaussian. We optimize IDSF with a two-step alternating strategy: semantics help to extract coherent instances in 3D space, while the resulting instances regularize the injection of stable semantics from 2D space. Additionally, we adopt a 2D-3D joint contrastive loss to enhance the complementarity between view-consistent 3D geometry and rich semantics during the bootstrapping process, enabling FreeGS to uniformly perform tasks such as novel-view semantic segmentation, object selection, and 3D object detection. Extensive experiments on LERF-Mask, 3D-OVS, and ScanNet datasets demonstrate that FreeGS performs comparably to state-of-the-art methods while avoiding the complex data preprocessing workload. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wb014/FreeGS.
abstract_ch: 将3D语义注入到3D高斯绘制（3DGS）中最近引起了广泛关注。当前的方法通常从2D基础模型（例如CLIP和SAM）中提炼3D语义特征，以促进新颖视图分割和语义理解，但它们对2D监督的高度依赖可能会削弱跨视图语义一致性，并需要复杂的数据准备过程，从而妨碍视图一致的场景理解。在本工作中，我们提出了FreeGS，这是一个无需2D标签的无监督语义嵌入3DGS框架，实现了视图一致的3D场景理解。我们不是直接学习语义特征，而是引入了ID耦合语义场（IDSF）到3DGS中，该方法捕捉每个高斯的语义表示以及视图一致的实例索引。我们通过两步交替策略优化IDSF：语义有助于在三维空间中提取一致的实例，而生成的实例则规范三维空间中的稳定语义注入。此外，我们采用2D-3D联合对比损失，在初始化过程中增强视图一致的3D几何与丰富语义之间的互补性，从而使FreeGS能够均匀地执行诸如新颖视图语义分割、对象选择和3D对象检测等任务。在LERF-Mask、3D-OVS和ScanNet数据集上的广泛实验表明，FreeGS在避免复杂的数据预处理工作量的同时，性能可与最先进的方法相媲美。我们的代码已公开发布在https://github.com/wb014/FreeGS。

title: CAMSIC: Content-aware Masked Image Modeling Transformer for Stereo Image Compression
title_ch: CAMSiC：内容感知遮罩图像建模变换器用于立体图像压缩
authors: Xinjie Zhang;Shenyuan Gao;Zhening Liu;Jiawei Shao;Xingtong Ge;Dailan He;Tongda Xu;Yan Wang;Jun Zhang;
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;SenseTime;China Telecom;Chinese University of Hong Kong;Tsinghua University;
abstract: Existing learning-based stereo image codec adopt sophisticated transformation with simple entropy models derived from single image codecs to encode latent representations. However, those entropy models struggle to effectively capture the spatial-disparity characteristics inherent in stereo images, which leads to suboptimal rate-distortion results. In this paper, we propose a stereo image compression framework, named CAMSIC. CAMSIC independently transforms each image to latent representation and employs a powerful decoder-free Transformer entropy model to capture both spatial and disparity dependencies, by introducing a novel content-aware masked image modeling (MIM) technique. Our content-aware MIM facilitates efficient bidirectional interaction between prior information and estimated tokens, which naturally obviates the need for an extra Transformer decoder. Experiments show that our stereo image codec achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance on two stereo image datasets Cityscapes and InStereo2K with fast encoding and decoding speed. Code is available at https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/CAMSIC.
abstract_ch: 现有的基于学习的立体图像编码器采用复杂的变换，结合单一图像编码器衍生出的简单熵模型来编码潜在表示。然而，这些熵模型难以有效地捕捉立体图像中存在的空间-视差特性，导致次优的率失真性能。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为CAMSIC的立体图像压缩框架。CAMSIC独立地将每一幅图像转换为潜在表示，并采用一个强大的无需解码器的Transformer熵模型来捕捉空间和视差依赖性，通过引入一种新颖的内容感知掩蔽图像建模（MIM）技术。我们提出的内容感知MIM促进了先验信息与估计代币之间高效的双向交互，自然地消除了额外Transformer解码器的需求。实验表明，我们的立体图像编码器在Cityscapes和InStereo2K两个立体图像数据集上实现了最先进的率失真性能，并且具有快速的编码和解码速度。代码可在https://github.com/Xinjie-Q/CAMSIC获得。

title: Category Prompt Mamba Network for Nuclei Segmentation and Classification
title_ch: 类别提示：曼巴网络用于核分割和分类
authors: Ye Zhang;Zijie Fang;Yifeng Wang;Lingbo Zhang;Xianchao Guan;Yongbing Zhang;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften;Tsinghua University;Pengcheng Laboratory;
abstract: Nuclei segmentation and classification provide an essential basis for tumor immune microenvironment analysis. The previous nuclei segmentation and classification models require splitting large images into smaller patches for training, leading to two significant issues. First, nuclei at the borders of adjacent patches often misalign during inference. Second, this patch-based approach significantly increases the model's training and inference time. Recently, Mamba has garnered attention for its ability to model large-scale images with linear time complexity and low memory consumption. It offers a promising solution for training nuclei segmentation and classification models on full-sized images. However, the Mamba orientation-based scanning method lacks account for category-specific features, resulting in sub-optimal performance in scenarios with imbalanced class distributions. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a novel scanning strategy based on category probability sorting, which independently ranks and scans features for each category according to confidence from high to low. This approach enhances the feature representation of uncertain samples and mitigates the issues caused by imbalanced distributions. Extensive experiments conducted on four public datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, delivering superior performance in nuclei segmentation and classification tasks.
abstract_ch: 细胞核分割和分类为肿瘤免疫微环境分析提供了基础。之前的细胞核分割和分类模型需要将大图像分割成较小的patches进行训练，这导致了两个显著的问题。首先，在推理过程中，相邻patches边界的细胞核往往会错位。其次，这种基于patches的方法大大增加了模型的训练时间和推理时间。最近，Mamba因其能够以线性时间复杂度和低内存消耗来建模大规模图像而引起了关注。它为在全尺寸图像上训练细胞核分割和分类模型提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，Mamba基于方向的扫描方法未能考虑到类别特定的特征，导致在类别分布不平衡的情况下性能不佳。为了解决这些挑战，本文提出了一种新的基于类别概率排序的扫描策略，该策略独立地根据置信度从高到低对每个类别进行排名和扫描特征。这种方法增强了不确定样本的特征表示，并缓解了由类别分布不平衡引起的问题。在四个公开数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法，在细胞核分割和分类任务中表现出更优的性能。

title: Cobra: Extending Mamba to Multi-Modal Large Language Model for Efficient Inference
title_ch: Cobra：将响尾蛇扩展为多模态大型语言模型以实现高效推理
authors: Han Zhao;Min Zhang;Wei Zhao;Pengxiang Ding;Siteng Huang;Donglin Wang;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Westlake University;Alibaba Group;
abstract: In recent years, the application of multimodal large language models (MLLM) in various fields has achieved remarkable success. However, as the foundation model for many downstream tasks, current MLLMs are composed of the well-known Transformer network, which has a less efficient quadratic computation complexity. To improve the efficiency of such basic models, we propose Cobra, a linear computational complexity MLLM. Specifically, Cobra integrates the efficient Mamba language model into the visual modality. Moreover, we explore and study various modal fusion schemes to create an effective multi-modal Mamba. Extensive experiments demonstrate that (1) Cobra achieves extremely competitive performance with current computationally efficient state-of-the-art methods, e.g., LLaVA-Phi, TinyLLaVA, and MobileVLM v2, and has faster speed due to Cobra's linear sequential modeling. (2) Interestingly, the results of closed-set challenging prediction benchmarks show that Cobra performs well in overcoming visual illusions and spatial relationship judgments. (3) Notably, Cobra even achieves comparable performance to LLaVA with about 43% of the number of parameters. We will make all codes of Cobra open-source and hope that the proposed method can facilitate future research on complexity problems in MLLM. Our project page is available at: https://sites.google.com/view/cobravlm.
abstract_ch: 近年来，多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）在各个领域的应用取得了显著的成功。然而，作为许多下游任务的基础模型，当前的MLLMs主要由著名的Transformer网络构成，其计算复杂度为二次。为了提高这类基础模型的效率，我们提出了Cobra，一种具有线性计算复杂度的MLLM。具体而言，Cobra 将高效的Mamba语言模型整合到了视觉模态中。此外，我们还探索和研究了各种模态融合方案，以创建有效的多模态Mamba。广泛的经验表明：（1）Cobra 在与当前高效的方法（如LLaVA-Phi、TinyLLaVA 和 MobileVLM v2）相当的竞争性能方面表现出色，并且由于Cobra 的线性序列建模方式，其速度更快。（2）有趣的是，在封闭集挑战预测基准测试中，Cobra 在克服视觉幻象和空间关系判断方面表现良好。（3）值得注意的是，Cobra 即使在参数数量约为LLaVA 的43%的情况下，也能达到与其相当的性能。我们将Cobra 的所有代码开源，并希望所提出的方法能够促进未来对MLLM 复杂性问题的研究。我们的项目页面可访问：https://sites.google.com/view/cobravlm。

title: CoCoCo: Improving Text-Guided Video Inpainting for Better Consistency, Controllability and Compatibility
title_ch: CoCoCo: 提升文本引导的视频修复一致性、可控性和兼容性
authors: Bojia Zi;Shihao Zhao;Xianbiao Qi;Jianan Wang;Yukai Shi;Qianyu Chen;Bin Liang;Rong Xiao;Kam-Fai Wong;Lei Zhang;
affiliations: Chinese University of Hong Kong;University of Hong Kong;International Digital Economy Academy;Intellifusion Inc.;
abstract: Recent advancements in video generation have been remarkable, yet many existing methods struggle with issues of consistency and poor text-video alignment. Moreover, the field lacks effective techniques for text-guided video inpainting, a stark contrast to the well-explored domain of text-guided image inpainting. To this end, this paper proposes a novel text-guided video inpainting model that achieves better consistency, controllability and compatibility. Specifically, we introduce a simple but efficient motion capture module to preserve motion consistency, and design an instance-aware region selection instead of a random region selection to obtain better textual controllability, and utilize a novel strategy to inject some personalized models into our CoCoCo model and thus obtain better model compatibility. Extensive experiments show that our model can generate high-quality video clips. Meanwhile, our model shows better motion consistency, textual controllability and model compatibility. More details are shown in [cococozibojia.github.io](cococozibojia.github.io).
abstract_ch: 近期在视频生成方面的进展令人瞩目，但许多现有方法在一致性和文本与视频对齐方面仍存在诸多问题。此外，该领域缺乏有效的文本引导视频修补技术，这与已经广泛研究的文本引导图像修补领域形成了鲜明对比。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种新的文本引导视频修补模型，能够实现更好的一致性、可控性和兼容性。具体来说，我们引入了一个简单而高效的运动捕捉模块来保持运动一致性，并设计了实例感知区域选择而非随机区域选择以获得更好的文本可控性，同时利用一种新颖的策略将一些个性化模型注入到我们的CoCoCo模型中，从而提高模型兼容性。大量实验表明，我们的模型可以生成高质量的视频片段。同时，我们的模型在运动一致性、文本可控性和模型兼容性方面表现更好。更多细节请参见[cococozibojia.github.io](cococozibojia.github.io)。

title: ContextualStory: Consistent Visual Storytelling with Spatially-Enhanced and Storyline Context
title_ch: 情境故事：通过空间增强和故事情境一致性的视觉叙事
authors: Sixiao Zheng;Yanwei Fu;
affiliations: Fudan University;Shanghai Innovation Institute;
abstract: Visual storytelling involves generating a sequence of coherent frames from a textual storyline while maintaining consistency in characters and scenes. Existing autoregressive methods, which rely on previous frame-sentence pairs, struggle with high memory usage, slow generation speeds, and limited context integration. To address these issues, we propose ContextualStory, a novel framework designed to generate coherent story frames and extend frames for visual storytelling. ContextualStory utilizes Spatially-Enhanced Temporal Attention to capture spatial and temporal dependencies, handling significant character movements effectively. Additionally, we introduce a Storyline Contextualizer to enrich context in storyline embedding, and a StoryFlow Adapter to measure scene changes between frames for guiding the model. Extensive experiments on PororoSV and FlintstonesSV datasets demonstrate that ContextualStory significantly outperforms existing SOTA methods in both story visualization and continuation. Code is available at https://github.com/sixiaozheng/ContextualStory.
abstract_ch: 视觉叙事涉及从文本故事情节生成一系列连贯的画面，并保持角色和场景的一致性。现有的自回归方法依赖于先前的帧-句子对，但在高内存使用、缓慢生成速度以及有限的上下文整合方面存在困难。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为ContextualStory的新框架，旨在生成连贯的故事画面并扩展帧以进行视觉叙事。ContextualStory利用空间增强的时间注意力机制来捕捉空间和时间依赖关系，有效地处理了显著的角色移动。此外，我们引入了故事线语境化模块来丰富故事线嵌入的上下文信息，并提出了故事流适配器来测量帧之间的场景变化，从而指导模型。在PororoSV和FlintstonesSV数据集上的广泛实验表明，ContextualStory在故事可视化和延续方面显著优于现有最先进的方法。源代码可在https://github.com/sixiaozheng/ContextualStory获取。

title: Controllable Distortion-Perception Tradeoff Through Latent Diffusion for Neural Image Compression
title_ch: 通过潜在扩散实现可控失真感知权衡的神经图像压缩
authors: Chuqin Zhou;Guo Lu;Jiangchuan Li;Xiangyu Chen;Zhengxue Cheng;Li Song;Wenjun Zhang;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;China Telecom;
abstract: Neural image compression often faces a challenging trade-off among rate, distortion and perception. While most existing methods typically focus on either achieving high pixel-level fidelity or optimizing for perceptual metrics, we propose a novel approach that simultaneously addresses both aspects for a fixed neural image codec. Specifically, we introduce a plug-and-play module at the decoder side that leverages a latent diffusion process to transform the decoded features, enhancing either low distortion or high perceptual quality without altering the original image compression codec. Our approach facilitates fusion of original and transformed features without additional training, enabling users to flexibly adjust the balance between distortion and perception during inference. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the pretrained codecs with a wide, adjustable distortion-perception range while maintaining their original compression capabilities. For instance, we can achieve more than 150% improvement in LPIPS-BDRate without sacrificing more than 1 dB in PSNR.
abstract_ch: 神经图像压缩常常面临率、失真和感知之间的挑战性权衡。虽然大多数现有方法通常侧重于在像素级别上实现高保真度或优化感知指标，我们提出了一种新的方法，在固定神经图像编解码器的情况下同时解决这两个方面的问题。具体而言，我们在解码器侧引入了一个即插即用模块，利用潜在扩散过程来转换解码特征，从而在不改变原始图像压缩编解码器的情况下，提升低失真或高感知质量。我们的方法可以在推理时不需额外训练，灵活地融合原始和转换后的特征，使用户能够在推理过程中自由调整失真和感知之间的平衡。大量实验结果表明，我们的方法显著提升了预训练编解码器的性能，提供了广泛的可调节失真-感知范围，同时保持了它们原有的压缩能力。例如，我们可以在不牺牲超过1 dB的PSNR的情况下，实现LPIPS-BDRate超过150%的改进。

title: Core-to-Global Reasoning for Compositional Visual Question Answering
title_ch: 核心到全局的推理方法在组合视觉问答中的应用

title: Cross-Modal Few-Shot Learning with Second-Order Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
title_ch: 跨模态少样本学习中的二阶神经常微分方程方法
authors: Yi Zhang;Chun-Wun Cheng;Junyi He;Zhihai He;Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb;Yuyan Chen;Angelica I Aviles-Rivero;
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology;Southern University of Science and Technology;University of Cambridge;Pengcheng Laboratory;Fudan University;Tsinghua University;
abstract: We introduce SONO, a novel method leveraging Second-Order Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Second-Order NODEs) to enhance cross-modal few-shot learning. By employing a simple yet effective architecture consisting of a Second-Order NODEs model paired with a cross-modal classifier, SONO addresses the significant challenge of overfitting, which is common in few-shot scenarios due to limited training examples. Our second-order approach can approximate a broader class of functions, enhancing the model's expressive power and feature generalization capabilities. We initialize our cross-modal classifier with text embeddings derived from class-relevant prompts, streamlining training efficiency by avoiding the need for frequent text encoder processing. Additionally, we utilize text-based image augmentation, exploiting CLIP's robust image-text correlation to enrich training data significantly. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that SONO outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in few-shot learning performance.
abstract_ch: 我们介绍了一种名为SONO的新方法，它利用二次神经常微分方程（Second-Order NODEs）来增强跨模态少样本学习。通过采用一个简单的有效架构——由二次神经常微分方程模型与跨模态分类器组成，SONO解决了少样本场景中常见的过拟合问题。我们的二次方法能够逼近更广泛的函数类，从而增强模型的表达能力和特征泛化能力。我们使用与类别相关的提示提取的文本嵌入初始化跨模态分类器，通过避免频繁处理文本编码器简化了训练效率。此外，我们还利用基于文本的图像增强技术，借助CLIP强大的图像-文本关联性显著丰富了训练数据。在多个数据集上的广泛实验表明，SONO在少样本学习性能上优于现有的最先进的方法。

title: Cross-PCR: A Robust Cross-Source Point Cloud Registration Framework
title_ch: 跨PCR：一种稳健的跨源点云注册框架
authors: Guiyu Zhao;Zhentao Guo;Zewen Du;Hongbin Ma;
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology;
abstract: Due to the density inconsistency and distribution difference between cross-source point clouds, previous methods fail in cross-source point cloud registration. We propose a density-robust feature extraction and matching scheme to achieve robust and accurate cross-source registration. To address the density inconsistency between cross-source data, we introduce a density-robust encoder for extracting density-robust features. To tackle the issue of challenging feature matching and few correct correspondences, we adopt a loose-to-strict matching pipeline with a ``loose generation, strict selection'' idea. Under it, we employ a one-to-many strategy to loosely generate initial correspondences. Subsequently, high-quality correspondences are strictly selected to achieve robust registration through sparse matching and dense matching. On the challenging Kinect-LiDAR scene in the cross-source 3DCSR dataset, our method improves feature matching recall by 63.5 percentage points (pp) and registration recall by 57.6 pp. It also achieves the best performance on 3DMatch, while maintaining robustness under diverse downsampling densities.
abstract_ch: 由于跨源点云之间的密度不一致和分布差异，之前的注册方法无法实现跨源点云的稳健和准确注册。我们提出了一种密度鲁棒特征提取和匹配方案以实现稳健且精确的跨源注册。为了解决跨源数据之间的密度不一致性问题，我们引入了一种密度鲁棒编码器来提取密度鲁棒特征。为了应对具有挑战性的特征匹配问题和正确的对应关系较少的情况，我们采用了一种宽松到严格的匹配管道，遵循“先宽松生成，后严格选择”的理念。在此理念下，我们使用一对一到多对一的策略来宽松地生成初始对应关系。随后，通过稀疏匹配和密集匹配严格选择高质量的对应关系，以实现稳健的注册。在跨源3DCSR数据集中具有挑战性的Kinect-LiDAR场景上，我们的方法将特征匹配召回率提高了63.5个百分点（pp），注册召回率提高了57.6个百分点（pp）。同时，在3DMatch上也取得了最佳性能，并且在不同下采样密度下保持了稳健性。

title: DECIDER: Difference-aware Contrastive Diffusion Model with Adversarial Perturbations for Image Change Captioning
title_ch: 决策者：基于差异感知的对抗扰动对比扩散模型在图像变化描述中的应用

affiliations: Hunan University;Guangdong Engineering Technology Research Center;CRRC Zhuzhou Institute;

title: Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Consistency Learning for Self-Supervised Tracking
title_ch: 解耦时空一致性学习的自我监督跟踪
authors: Yaozong Zheng;Bineng Zhong;Qihua Liang;Ning Li;Shuxiang Song;
affiliations: Guangxi Normal University;
abstract: The success of visual tracking has been largely driven by datasets with manual box annotations. However, these box annotations require tremendous human effort, limiting the scale and diversity of existing tracking datasets. In this work, we present a novel Self-Supervised Tracking framework named \textbf{\tracker}, designed to eliminate the need of box annotations. Specifically, a decoupled spatio-temporal consistency training framework is proposed to learn rich target information across timestamps through global spatial localization and local temporal association. This allows for the simulation of appearance and motion variations of instances in real-world scenarios. Furthermore, an instance contrastive loss is designed to learn instance-level correspondences from a multi-view perspective, offering robust instance supervision without additional labels. This new design paradigm enables {\tracker} to effectively learn generic tracking representations in a self-supervised manner, while reducing reliance on extensive box annotations. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets demonstrate that {\tracker} surpasses \textit{SOTA} self-supervised tracking methods, achieving an improvement of more than 25.3\%, 20.4\%, and 14.8\% in AUC (AO) score on the GOT10K, LaSOT, TrackingNet datasets, respectively. Code: https://github.com/GXNU-ZhongLab/SSTrack.
abstract_ch: 视觉跟踪的成功很大程度上得益于带有手动框标注的数据集。然而，这些框标注需要巨大的人力投入，限制了现有跟踪数据集的规模和多样性。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为**\tracker** 的新颖自监督跟踪框架，旨在消除框标注的需求。具体而言，我们提出了一种解耦的空间-时间一致性训练框架，通过全局空间定位和局部时间关联来学习跨时间戳丰富的目标信息。这使得能够在真实世界场景中模拟实例的外观和运动变化。此外，我们设计了一种实例对比损失，从多视角出发学习实例级别的对应关系，提供鲁棒的实例监督而无需额外标签。这一新的设计理念使\tracker能够以自监督的方式有效地学习通用的跟踪表示，同时减少对大量框标注的依赖。在九个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，\tracker超越了现有的自监督跟踪方法，在GOT10K、LaSOT、TrackingNet数据集上的AUC（AO）分数分别提高了超过25.3%、20.4%和14.8%。代码：https://github.com/GXNU-ZhongLab/SSTrack。

title: Decoupling Scattering: Pseudo-Label Guided NeRF for Scenes with Scattering Media
title_ch: 去耦散射：伪标签引导的NeRF在含有散射介质的场景中的应用
authors: Mingyang Zhang;Junkang Zhang;Faming Fang;Guixu Zhang;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Shanghai Key Laboratory of Multidimensional Information Processing;

title: Dense Audio-Visual Event Localization Under Cross-Modal Consistency and Multi-Temporal Granularity Collaboration
title_ch: 跨模态一致性与多时间粒度协作下的密集音频-视觉事件定位
authors: Ziheng Zhou;Jinxing Zhou;Wei Qian;Shengeng Tang;Xiaojun Chang;Dan Guo;
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology;University of Science and Technology of China;Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence;
abstract: In the field of audio-visual learning, most research tasks focus exclusively on short videos. This paper focuses on the more practical Dense Audio-Visual Event Localization (DAVEL) task, advancing audio-visual scene understanding for longer, untrimmed videos. This task seeks to identify and temporally pinpoint all events simultaneously occurring in both audio and visual streams. Typically, each video encompasses dense events of multiple classes, which may overlap on the timeline, each exhibiting varied durations. Given these challenges, effectively exploiting the audio-visual relations and the temporal features encoded at various granularities becomes crucial. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel CCNet, comprising two core modules: the Cross-Modal Consistency Collaboration (CMCC) and the Multi-Temporal Granularity Collaboration (MTGC). Specifically, the CMCC module contains two branches: a cross-modal interaction branch and a temporal consistency-gated branch. The former branch facilitates the aggregation of consistent event semantics across modalities through the encoding of audio-visual relations, while the latter branch guides one modality's focus to pivotal event-relevant temporal areas as discerned in the other modality. The MTGC module includes a coarse-to-fine collaboration block and a fine-to-coarse collaboration block, providing bidirectional support among coarse- and fine-grained temporal features. Extensive experiments on the UnAV-100 dataset validate our module design, resulting in a new state-of-the-art performance in dense audio-visual event localization. The code is available at https://github.com/zzhhfut/CCNet-AAAI2025.
abstract_ch: 在视听学习领域，大多数研究任务专注于短视频。本文则聚焦于更实用的密集视听事件定位（DAVEL）任务，旨在推进对较长且未剪辑视频的视听场景理解。该任务寻求同时识别并精确确定视听流中所有并发事件的时间位置。通常情况下，每段视频包含多个类别的密集事件，这些事件在时间线上可能重叠，且持续时间各异。鉴于这些挑战，有效地利用不同模态之间的视听关系以及各种粒度层次上编码的时间特征变得至关重要。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了一种新颖的CCNet，包含两个核心模块：跨模态一致性协作（CMCC）和多粒度时间协作（MTGC）。具体而言，CMCC模块包括两条分支：跨模态交互分支和时间一致性门控分支。前者通过编码视听关系来促进一致事件语义在不同模态间的聚合，后者则引导一个模态关注另一个模态中识别出的关键事件相关的时间区域。MTGC模块包括粗到细协作块和细到粗协作块，提供粗粒度和细粒度时间特征之间的双向支持。在UnAV-100数据集上的广泛实验验证了我们模块设计的有效性，从而在密集视听事件定位方面达到了新的最佳性能。相关代码可在https://github.com/zzhhfut/CCNet-AAAI2025获取。

title: DiffGrasp: Whole-Body Grasping Synthesis Guided by Object Motion Using a Diffusion Model
title_ch: DiffGrasp：基于对象运动用扩散模型引导的全身抓取合成
authors: Yonghao Zhang;Qiang He;Yanguang Wan;Yinda Zhang;Xiaoming Deng;Cuixia Ma;Hongan Wang;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Google;
abstract: Generating high-quality whole-body human object interaction motion sequences is becoming increasingly important in various fields such as animation, VR/AR, and robotics. The main challenge of this task lies in determining the level of involvement of each hand given the complex shapes of objects in different sizes and their different motion trajectories, while ensuring strong grasping realism and guaranteeing the coordination of movement in all body parts. Contrasting with existing work, which either generates human interaction motion sequences without detailed hand grasping poses or only models a static grasping pose, we propose a simple yet effective framework that jointly models the relationship between the body, hands, and the given object motion sequences within a single diffusion model. To guide our network in perceiving the object's spatial position and learning more natural grasping poses, we introduce novel contact-aware losses and incorporate a data-driven, carefully designed guidance. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art method and generates plausible whole-body motion sequences.
abstract_ch: 生成高质量的全身人体物体交互运动序列在动画、VR/AR和机器人等领域变得越来越重要。这项任务的主要挑战在于，在面对不同形状、大小各异且具有不同运动轨迹的物体时，确定每只手的参与程度，同时确保握持的真实感并保证全身各部位运动的协调性。与现有的工作相比，这些工作要么不详细地生成包含人类交互运动序列和具体手部握持姿势的内容，要么仅建模静态握持姿势，我们提出了一种简单而有效的框架，在单一扩散模型内联合建模身体、手部与给定物体运动序列之间的关系。为了引导我们的网络感知物体的空间位置并学习更自然的握持姿势，我们引入了新颖的接触感知损失，并结合了数据驱动、精心设计的指导策略。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于现有最先进的方法，并能生成可信的全身运动序列。

title: DiMSOD: A Diffusion-Based Framework for Multi-Modal Salient Object Detection
title_ch: DiMSOD：一种基于扩散的多模态显著对象检测框架
authors: Shuo Zhang;Jiaming Huang;Wenbing Tang;Yan Wu;Terrence Hu;Xiaogang Xu;Jing Liu;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Huolala Technology Center;Nanyang Technological University;Chinese University of Hong Kong;

title: DreaMark: Rooting Watermark in Score Distillation Sampling Generated Neural Radiance Fields
title_ch: DreaMark：根植于评分精炼采样的水印神经辐射场
authors: Xingyu Zhu;Xiapu Luo;Xuetao Wei;
affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology;Hong Kong Polytechnic University;
abstract: Recent advancements in text-to-3D generation can generate neural radiance fields (NeRFs) with score distillation sampling, enabling 3D asset creation without real-world data capture. With the rapid advancement in NeRF generation quality, protecting the copyright of the generated NeRF has become increasingly important. While prior works can watermark NeRFs in a post-generation way, they suffer from two vulnerabilities. First, a delay lies between NeRF generation and watermarking because the secret message is embedded into the NeRF model post-generation through fine-tuning. Second, generating a non-watermarked NeRF as an intermediate creates a potential vulnerability for theft. To address both issues, we propose Dreamark to embed a secret message by backdooring the NeRF during NeRF generation. In detail, we first pre-train a watermark decoder. Then, the Dreamark generates backdoored NeRFs in a way that the target secret message can be verified by the pre-trained watermark decoder on an arbitrary trigger viewport. We evaluate the generation quality and watermark robustness against image- and model-level attacks. Extensive experiments show that the watermarking process will not degrade the generation quality, and the watermark achieves 90+% accuracy among both image-level attacks (e.g., Gaussian noise) and model-level attacks (e.g., pruning attack).
abstract_ch: 最近在文本到三维生成方面的进展能够利用得分蒸馏采样生成神经辐射场（NeRF），从而在无需实际数据采集的情况下创建三维资产。随着NeRF生成质量的迅速提升，保护生成的NeRF版权变得越来越重要。尽管先前的工作可以在生成后对NeRF进行水印处理，但它们存在两个漏洞。首先，在NeRF生成和水印处理之间存在延迟，因为秘密信息是在生成后的微调过程中嵌入到NeRF模型中的。其次，生成非水印NeRF作为中间步骤可能会为盗窃创造潜在的风险。为了同时解决这两个问题，我们提出了Dreamark，在NeRF生成过程中通过后门嵌入秘密信息。具体而言，我们首先预训练一个水印解码器。然后，Dreamark以一种方式生成后门NeRF，使得预训练的水印解码器可以在任意触发视窗上验证目标的秘密信息。我们评估了生成质量和水印在图像级和模型级攻击下的鲁棒性。广泛实验表明，水印过程不会降低生成质量，并且水印在图像级攻击（例如，高斯噪声）和模型级攻击（例如，修剪攻击）中都能达到90%以上的准确率。

title: DriveDreamer-2: LLM-Enhanced World Models for Diverse Driving Video Generation
title_ch: DriveDreamer-2: 基于LLM增强的世界模型在多样化驾驶视频生成中的应用
authors: Guosheng Zhao;Xiaofeng Wang;Zheng Zhu;Xinze Chen;Guan Huang;Xiaoyi Bao;Xingang Wang;
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Luoyang Institute for Robot and Intelligent Equipment;4GigaAI;
abstract: World models have demonstrated superiority in autonomous driving, particularly in the generation of multi-view driving videos. However, significant challenges still exist in generating customized driving videos. In this paper, we propose DriveDreamer-2, which builds upon the framework of DriveDreamer and incorporates a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate user-defined driving videos. Specifically, an LLM interface is initially incorporated to convert a user's query into agent trajectories. Subsequently, a HDMap, adhering to traffic regulations, is generated based on the trajectories. Ultimately, we propose the Unified Multi-View Model to enhance temporal and spatial coherence in the generated driving videos. DriveDreamer-2 is the first world model to generate customized driving videos, it can generate uncommon driving videos (e.g., vehicles abruptly cut in) in a user-friendly manner. Besides, experimental results demonstrate that the generated videos enhance the training of driving perception methods (e.g., 3D detection and tracking). Furthermore, video generation quality of DriveDreamer-2 surpasses other state-of-the-art methods, showcasing FID and FVD scores of 11.2 and 55.7, representing relative improvements of 30% and 50%.
abstract_ch: 世界模型在自动驾驶领域已经显示出优越性，尤其是在生成多视角驾驶视频方面。然而，在生成定制化驾驶视频方面仍然存在重大挑战。在本文中，我们提出了DriveDreamer-2，该模型基于DriveDreamer框架，并结合了一个大型语言模型（LLM）以生成用户定义的驾驶视频。具体而言，最初引入了一个LLM接口，将用户的查询转换为代理轨迹。随后，根据这些轨迹生成了一个遵守交通规则的高精度地图（HDMap）。最终，我们提出了一种统一的多视角模型，以增强生成驾驶视频的时间和空间连贯性。DriveDreamer-2是第一个能够以用户友好方式生成定制化驾驶视频的世界模型，它可以生成不常见的驾驶视频（例如，车辆突然切入）。此外，实验结果表明，生成的视频可以提高驾驶感知方法（例如，三维检测和跟踪）的训练效果。而且，DriveDreamer-2的视频生成质量超过了其他最先进的方法，其FID和FVD得分分别为11.2和55.7，分别代表了30%和50%的相对改进。

title: Dynamic Contrastive Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Image Restoration
title_ch: 动态对比知识蒸馏以实现高效的图像恢复
authors: Yunshuai Zhou;Junbo Qiao;Jincheng Liao;Wei Li;Simiao Li;Jiao Xie;Yunhang Shen;Jie Hu;Shaohui Lin;
affiliations: East China Normal University;Huawei;Xiamen University;MOE Key Laboratory of Advanced Theory and Application in Statistics and Data Science;
abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a valuable yet challenging approach that enhances a compact student network by learning from a high-performance but cumbersome teacher model. However, previous KD methods for image restoration overlook the state of the student during the distillation, adopting a fixed solution space that limits the capability of KD. Additionally, relying solely on L1-type loss struggles to leverage the distribution information of images. In this work, we propose a novel dynamic contrastive knowledge distillation (DCKD) framework for image restoration. Specifically, we introduce dynamic contrastive regularization to perceive the student's learning state and dynamically adjust the distilled solution space using contrastive learning. Additionally, we also propose a distribution mapping module to extract and align the pixel-level category distribution of the teacher and student models. Note that the proposed DCKD is a structure-agnostic distillation framework, which can adapt to different backbones and can be combined with methods that optimize upper-bound constraints to further enhance model performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DCKD significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art KD methods across various image restoration tasks and backbones.
abstract_ch: 知识蒸馏（KD）是一种有价值的但具有挑战性的方法，通过让学生网络从高性能但复杂的教师模型中学习来增强紧凑的学生网络。然而，先前用于图像恢复的知识蒸馏方法忽略了学生在网络蒸馏过程中的状态，采用了一个固定的解空间，这限制了KD的能力。此外，仅依赖L1型损失难以充分利用图像的分布信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的动态对比知识蒸馏（DCKD）框架用于图像恢复。具体而言，我们引入了动态对比正则化来感知学生的学习状态，并使用对比学习动态调整蒸馏的解空间。同时，我们还提出了一种分布映射模块，用于提取和对齐教师和学生模型的像素级类别分布。值得注意的是，所提出的DCKD是一种结构无关的蒸馏框架，可以适应不同的骨干网络，并且可以与优化上限约束的方法结合使用，以进一步提高模型性能。广泛的实验表明，DCKD在各种图像恢复任务和骨干网络上显著优于最先进的KD方法。

title: Dynamic Entity-Masked Graph Diffusion Model for Histopathology Image Representation Learning
title_ch: 动态实体遮蔽图扩散模型在组织病理学图像表示学习中的应用
authors: Zhenfeng Zhuang;Min Cen;Yanfeng Li;Fangyu Zhou;Lequan Yu;Baptiste Magnier;Liansheng Wang;
affiliations: Xiamen University;University of Science and Technology of China;University of Hong Kong;University of Montpellier;Centre Hospitalier Universitaire de Nimes;
abstract: Significant disparities between the features of natural images and those inherent to histopathological images make it challenging to directly apply and transfer pre-trained models from natural images to histopathology tasks. Moreover, the frequent lack of annotations in histopathology patch images has driven researchers to explore self-supervised learning methods like mask reconstruction for learning representations from large amounts of unlabeled data. Crucially, previous mask-based efforts in self-supervised learning have often overlooked the spatial interactions among entities, which are essential for constructing accurate representations of pathological entities. To address these challenges, constructing graphs of entities is a promising approach. In addition, the diffusion reconstruction strategy has recently shown superior performance through its random intensity noise addition technique to enhance the robust learned representation. Therefore, we introduce H-MGDM, a novel self-supervised Histopathology image representation learning method through the Dynamic Entity-Masked Graph Diffusion Model. Specifically, we propose to use complementary subgraphs as latent diffusion conditions and self-supervised targets respectively during pre-training. We note that the graph can embed entities' topological relationships and enhance representation. Dynamic conditions and targets can improve pathological fine reconstruction. Our model has conducted pretraining experiments on three large histopathological datasets. The advanced predictive performance and interpretability of H-MGDM are clearly evaluated on comprehensive downstream tasks such as classification and survival analysis on six datasets. Our code will be publicly available at https://github.com/centurion-crawler/H-MGDM.
abstract_ch: 自然图像和病理图像固有的特征之间存在显著差异，这使得直接将预训练模型从自然图像任务应用到病理学任务变得具有挑战性。此外，病理图像片段数据标注的缺乏促使研究人员探索自监督学习方法，如掩码重建，以从大量未标注的数据中学习表示。然而，先前基于掩码的自监督学习努力往往忽略了实体之间的空间交互作用，这些交互作用对于构建准确的病理实体表示至关重要。为了解决这些挑战，构建实体图是一个有前景的方法。另外，最近扩散重建策略通过其随机强度噪声添加技术展示了优越性能，增强了鲁棒性的学习表示。因此，我们引入了H-MGDM，这是一种新颖的自监督病理图像表示学习方法，通过动态实体掩码图扩散模型。具体来说，在预训练过程中，我们提出使用互补子图作为潜在扩散条件和自监督目标。我们注意到，图可以嵌入实体的拓扑关系并增强表示能力。动态条件和目标可以提高病理精细重建的效果。我们的模型在三个大型病理学数据集上进行了预训练实验，并在六个数据集上的分类和生存分析等全面下游任务中，H-MGDM表现出先进的预测性能和可解释性。我们的代码将在https://github.com/centurion-crawler/H-MGDM公开。

title: DZAD: Diffusion-based Zero-shot Anomaly Detection
title_ch: 基于扩散的零样本异常检测
authors: Tianrui Zhang;Liang Gao;Xinyu Li;Yiping Gao;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology;National University of Singapore;

title: EDENet: Echo Direction Encoding Network for Place Recognition Based on Ground Penetrating Radar
title_ch: EDENet：基于地面穿透雷达的方向回声编码网络用于位置识别
authors: Pengyu Zhang;Xieyuanli Chen;Yuwei Chen;Beizhen Bi;Zhuo Xu;Tian Jin;Xiaotao Huang;Liang Shen;
affiliations: National University of Defense Technology;National University of Singapore;
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) based localization has gained significant recognition in robotics due to its ability to detect stable subsurface features, offering advantages in environments where traditional sensors like cameras and LiDAR may struggle. However, existing methods are primarily focused on small-scale place recognition (PR), leaving the challenges of PR in large-scale maps unaddressed. These challenges include the inherent sparsity of underground features and the variability in underground dielectric constants, which complicate robust localization. In this work, we investigate the geometric relationship between GPR echo sequences and underground scenes, leveraging the robustness of directional features to inform our network design. We introduce learnable Gabor filters for the precise extraction of directional responses, coupled with a direction-aware attention mechanism for effective geometric encoding. To further enhance performance, we incorporate a shift-invariant unit and a multi-scale aggregation strategy to better accommodate variations in di-electric constants. Experiments conducted on public datasets demonstrate that our proposed EDENet not only surpasses existing solutions in terms of PR performance but also offers advantages in model size and computational efficiency.
abstract_ch: 基于地面穿透雷达（GPR）的定位技术在机器人领域因其能够检测稳定的地下特征而获得了显著的认可，特别是在传统传感器如摄像头和LiDAR可能表现不佳的环境中具有优势。然而，现有的方法主要集中在小范围环境识别上，而对于大规模地图中的环境识别挑战则鲜有涉及。这些挑战包括地下特征的固有稀疏性和地下介电常数的可变性，这使得稳健的定位变得更加复杂。在本工作中，我们研究了GPR回波序列与地下场景之间的几何关系，并利用方向性特征的鲁棒性来指导我们的网络设计。我们引入了可学习的高斯滤波器以精确提取方向响应，并结合了一种方向感知的注意力机制以实现有效的几何编码。为了进一步提升性能，我们还整合了一个移不变单元和多尺度聚合策略，以更好地适应介电常数的变化。在公共数据集上的实验表明，我们提出的EDENet不仅在环境识别性能上超过了现有解决方案，还在模型大小和计算效率方面具备优势。

title: Enhancing Implicit Neural Representations via Symmetric Power Transformation
title_ch: 通过对称幂变换增强隐式神经表示
authors: Weixiang Zhang;Shuzhao Xie;Chengwei Ren;Shijia Ge;Mingzi Wang;Zhi Wang;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;
abstract: We propose symmetric power transformation to enhance the capacity of Implicit Neural Representation~(INR) from the perspective of data transformation. Unlike prior work utilizing random permutation or index rearrangement, our method features a reversible operation that does not require additional storage consumption. Specifically, we first investigate the characteristics of data that can benefit the training of INR, proposing the Range-Defined Symmetric Hypothesis, which posits that specific range and symmetry can improve the expressive ability of INR. Based on this hypothesis, we propose a nonlinear symmetric power transformation to achieve both range-defined and symmetric properties simultaneously. We use the power coefficient to redistribute data to approximate symmetry within the target range. To improve the robustness of the transformation, we further design deviation-aware calibration and adaptive soft boundary to address issues of extreme deviation boosting and continuity breaking. Extensive experiments are conducted to verify the performance of the proposed method, demonstrating that our transformation can reliably improve INR compared with other data transformations. We also conduct 1D audio, 2D image and 3D video fitting tasks to demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of our method.
abstract_ch: 我们从数据变换的角度提出了一种对称幂变换方法，以增强隐式神经表示（INR）的能力。与之前的工作利用随机排列或索引重排不同，我们的方法具有一个无需额外存储消耗的可逆操作。具体来说，我们首先研究了能够促进INR训练的数据特性，提出了范围定义的对称性假设，认为特定范围和对称性可以提高INR的表达能力。基于这一假设，我们提出了一种非线性的对称幂变换，以同时实现范围定义和对称性。我们使用幂系数来重新分布数据，以在目标范围内近似实现对称性。为了提高变换的鲁棒性，我们进一步设计了偏差感知校准和自适应软边界，以解决极端偏差放大和连续性破坏的问题。进行了大量的实验来验证所提方法的性能，结果显示，我们的变换可以可靠地改善INR，相较于其他数据变换方法。我们还进行了1D音频、2D图像和3D视频拟合任务，以证明我们方法的有效性和适用性。

title: Enhancing Multimodal Large Language Models Complex Reason via Similarity Computation
title_ch: 增强多模态大型语言模型的复杂推理通过相似性计算
authors: Xiaofeng Zhang;Fanshuo Zeng;Yihao Quan;Zheng Hui;Jiawei Yao;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Beijing Jiao Tong University;Columbia University;University of Washington;
abstract: Multimodal large language models have experienced rapid growth, and numerous different models have emerged. The interpretability of LVLMs remains an under-explored area. Especially when faced with more complex tasks such as chain-of-thought reasoning, its internal mechanisms still resemble a black box that is difficult to decipher. By studying the interaction and information flow between images and text, we noticed that in models such as LLaVA1.5, image tokens that are semantically related to text are more likely to have information flow convergence in the LLM decoding layer, and these image tokens receive higher attention scores. However, those image tokens that are less relevant to the text do not have information flow convergence, and they only get very small attention scores. To efficiently utilize the image information, we propose a new image token reduction method, Simignore, which aims to improve the complex reasoning ability of LVLMs by computing the similarity between image and text embeddings and ignoring image tokens that are irrelevant and unimportant to the text. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method for complex reasoning tasks. The paper's source code can be accessed from \url{https://github.com/FanshuoZeng/Simignore}.
abstract_ch: 多模态大型语言模型经历了快速发展，出现了众多不同的模型。LVLMs（Large Vision-Language Models）的可解释性仍然是一个未被充分探索的领域。特别是在面对链式推理等更复杂任务时，其内部机制仍然像一个难以破解的黑箱。通过研究图像与文本之间的交互和信息流，我们注意到在如LLaVA1.5这样的模型中，与文本语义相关的图像标记更有可能在LLM解码层中实现信息流的汇聚，并且这些图像标记会获得更高的注意力分数。然而，那些与文本关联度较低的图像标记则不会出现信息流的汇聚，它们仅获得非常小的注意力分数。为了高效利用图像信息，我们提出了一种新的图像标记减少方法——Simignore，该方法旨在通过计算图像和文本嵌入之间的相似性来忽略对文本无关且不重要的图像标记，从而提高LVLMs的复杂推理能力。通过广泛的实验，我们展示了该方法在复杂推理任务中的有效性。该论文的源代码可以从[https://github.com/FanshuoZeng/Simignore]访问。

title: Exploring Task-Level Optimal Prompts for Visual In-Context Learning
title_ch: 探索任务级别最优提示以实现视觉上下文学习
authors: Yan Zhu;Huan Ma;Changqing Zhang;
affiliations: Tianjin University;
abstract: With the development of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) in recent years, Visual In-Context Learning (VICL) has become a better choice compared to modifying models in most scenarios. Different from retraining or fine-tuning model, VICL does not require modifications to the model's weights or architecture, and only needs a prompt with demonstrations to teach VFM how to solve tasks. Currently, significant computational cost for finding optimal prompts for every test sample hinders the deployment of VICL, as determining which demonstrations to use for constructing prompts is very costly. In this paper, however, we find a counterintuitive phenomenon that most test samples actually achieve optimal performance under the same prompts, and searching for sample-level prompts only costs more time but results in completely identical prompts. Therefore, we propose task-level prompting to reduce the cost of searching for prompts during the inference stage and introduce two time-saving yet effective task-level prompt search strategies. Extensive experimental results show that our proposed method can identify near-optimal prompts and reach the best VICL performance with a minimal cost that prior work has never achieved.
abstract_ch: 近年来，随着视觉基础模型（VFMs）的发展，视觉在上下文学习（VICL）在大多数场景下已成为更好的选择，相比之下，修改模型的效果较差。与重新训练或微调模型不同，VICL 不需要对模型的权重或架构进行修改，只需一个包含示范的提示即可教会 VFMs 如何解决任务。然而，目前为每个测试样本找到最优提示所需的巨大计算成本阻碍了 VICL 的部署，因为确定用于构建提示的示范需要非常高的成本。然而，在本文中，我们发现了一个反常识的现象：大多数测试样本实际上在相同的提示下就能达到最优性能，寻找样本级别的提示只会花费更多时间，但结果却是完全相同的提示。因此，我们提出任务级别提示来降低推理阶段寻找提示的成本，并引入了两种节省时间且有效的任务级别提示搜索策略。广泛的实验结果表明，我们提出的方法能够识别接近最优的提示，并以先前工作从未实现的最小成本达到最佳的 VICL 性能。

title: Few-Shot Domain Adaptation for Learned Image Compression
title_ch: 基于少量示例的领域适应性学习图像压缩
authors: Tianyu Zhang;Haotian Zhang;Yuqi Li;Li Li;Dong Liu;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;
abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) has achieved state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance, deemed promising for next-generation image compression techniques. However, pre-trained LIC models usually suffer from significant performance degradation when applied to out-of-training-domain images, implying their poor generalization capabilities. To tackle this problem, we propose a few-shot domain adaptation method for LIC by integrating plug-and-play adapters into pre-trained models. Drawing inspiration from the analogy between latent channels and frequency components, we examine domain gaps in LIC and observe that out-of-training-domain images disrupt pre-trained channel-wise decomposition. Consequently, we introduce a method for channel-wise re-allocation using convolution-based adapters and low-rank adapters, which are lightweight and compatible to mainstream LIC schemes. Extensive experiments across multiple domains and multiple representative LIC schemes demonstrate that our method significantly enhances pre-trained models, achieving comparable performance to H.266/VVC intra coding with merely 25 target-domain samples. Additionally, our method matches the performance of full-model finetune while transmitting fewer than $2\%$ of the parameters.
abstract_ch: 学习图像压缩（LIC）已经实现了最先进的率失真性能，并被认为是有潜力用于下一代图像压缩技术。然而，预训练的LIC模型在应用于不在训练域内的图像时通常会遭受显著的性能下降，这表明它们的泛化能力较差。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种针对LIC的少样本域适应方法，通过将插件式适配器整合到预训练模型中来应对挑战。受到潜通道与频率分量之间类比的启发，我们研究了LIC中的域差距，并发现不在训练域内的图像会破坏预训练的通道级分解。因此，我们引入了一种基于卷积的适配器和低秩适配器进行通道级重新分配的方法，这些适配器轻量化且兼容主流的LIC方案。我们在多个领域和多种代表性LIC方案上进行了广泛的实验，结果显示我们的方法显著提升了预训练模型的表现，仅使用25个目标域样本就达到了与H.266/VVC内编码相当的性能。此外，我们的方法在参数传输量不到2%的情况下，匹配了全模型微调的性能。

title: GaussianPainter: Painting Point Cloud into 3D Gaussians with Normal Guidance
title_ch: GaussianPainter：使用法线引导将点云绘制为3D高斯分布
authors: Jingqiu Zhou;Lue Fan;Xuesong Chen;Linjiang Huang;Si Liu;Hongsheng Li;
affiliations: Chinese University of Hong Kong;Chinese Academy of Sciences;Centre for Perceptual and Interactive Intelligence;Beihang University;
abstract: In this paper, we present GaussianPainter, the first method to paint a point cloud into 3D Gaussians given a reference image. GaussianPainter introduces an innovative feed-forward approach to overcome the limitations of time-consuming test-time optimization in 3D Gaussian splatting. Our method addresses a critical challenge in the field: the non-uniqueness problem inherent in the large parameter space of 3D Gaussian splatting. This space, encompassing rotation, anisotropic scales, and spherical harmonic coefficients, introduces the challenge of rendering similar images from substantially different Gaussian fields. As a result, feed-forward networks face instability when attempting to directly predict high-quality Gaussian fields, struggling to converge on consistent parameters for a given output. To address this issue, we propose to estimate a surface normal for each point to determine its Gaussian rotation. This strategy enables the network to effectively predict the remaining Gaussian parameters in the constrained space. We further enhance our approach with an appearance injection module, incorporating reference image appearance into Gaussian fields via a multiscale triplane representation. Our method successfully balances efficiency and fidelity in 3D Gaussian generation, achieving high-quality, diverse, and robust 3D content creation from point clouds in a single forward pass.
abstract_ch: 在本文中，我们提出了GaussianPainter，这是首个能够根据参考图像将点云绘制为3D高斯分布的方法。GaussianPainter引入了一种创新的前馈方法，以克服3D高斯点绘制中耗时的测试时间优化的限制。我们的方法解决了领域内一个关键挑战：3D高斯点绘制中的参数空间庞大导致的非唯一性问题。这个空间涵盖了旋转、各向异性尺度以及球谐系数，引入了从显著不同的高斯场中渲染相似图像的挑战。因此，前馈网络在尝试直接预测高质量的高斯场时面临不稳定性问题，难以为给定输出收敛于一致的参数。为了解决这一问题，我们提出为每个点估计一个表面法线来确定其高斯旋转。这一策略使网络能够在受限的空间中有效地预测剩余的高斯参数。此外，我们还通过外观注入模块进一步增强了该方法，利用多尺度三平面表示将参考图像的外观融入到高斯场中。我们的方法成功地在效率和保真度之间找到了平衡，在单次前馈过程中实现了从点云生成高质量、多样性和鲁棒性强的3D内容。

title: GoHD: Gaze-oriented and Highly Disentangled Portrait Animation with Rhythmic Poses and Realistic Expressions
title_ch: GoHD：面向凝视且高度解耦的人像动画，伴有节奏化的姿势和逼真的表情
authors: Ziqi Zhou;Weize Quan;Hailin Shi;Wei Li;Lili Wang;Dong-Ming Yan;
affiliations: Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;NIO;Banma Inc.;Beihang University;
abstract: Audio-driven talking head generation necessitates seamless integration of audio and visual data amidst the challenges posed by diverse input portraits and intricate correlations between audio and facial motions. In response, we propose a robust framework GoHD designed to produce highly realistic, expressive, and controllable portrait videos from any reference identity with any motion. GoHD innovates with three key modules: Firstly, an animation module utilizing latent navigation is introduced to improve the generalization ability across unseen input styles. This module achieves high disentanglement of motion and identity, and it also incorporates gaze orientation to rectify unnatural eye movements that were previously overlooked. Secondly, a conformer-structured conditional diffusion model is designed to guarantee head poses that are aware of prosody. Thirdly, to estimate lip-synchronized and realistic expressions from the input audio within limited training data, a two-stage training strategy is devised to decouple frequent and frame-wise lip motion distillation from the generation of other more temporally dependent but less audio-related motions, e.g., blinks and frowns. Extensive experiments validate GoHD's advanced generalization capabilities, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating realistic talking face results on arbitrary subjects.
abstract_ch: 基于音频的头部生成需要在多种输入肖像和复杂的音频与面部动作关联带来的挑战中，实现音频和视觉数据的无缝整合。为此，我们提出了一种名为GoHD的稳健框架，旨在从任何参考身份和任何动作中生成高度逼真、表达丰富且可控的肖像视频。GoHD创新性地引入了三个关键模块：首先，一个利用潜在导航的动画模块被引入以提高对未见过的输入风格的泛化能力。该模块实现了运动和身份之间的高分离度，并且还整合了注视方向以纠正之前忽略的不自然的眼部动作。其次，设计了一种基于Conformer结构的条件扩散模型，以确保头部姿态能够意识到语调。最后，为了在有限的训练数据下从输入音频中估计同步且逼真的唇部表情，我们开发了一种两阶段训练策略，将频繁出现的帧级唇部动作提炼与生成其他更依赖于时间但较少与音频相关的动作（如眨眼和皱眉）区分开来。大量实验验证了GoHD的高级泛化能力，展示了其在任意主题上生成逼真说话人脸结果的有效性。
