title: Hierarchical Cross-Modal Alignment for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection
title_ch: 开放词汇量的层次跨模态对齐三维物体检测
authors: Youjun Zhao;Jiaying Lin;Rynson W. H. Lau;
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong;
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection (OV-3DOD) aims at localizing and classifying novel objects beyond closed sets. The recent success of vision-language models (VLMs) has demonstrated their remarkable capabilities to understand open vocabularies. Existing works that leverage VLMs for 3D object detection (3DOD) generally resort to representations that lose the rich scene context required for 3D perception. To address this problem, we propose in this paper a hierarchical framework, named HCMA, to simultaneously learn local object and global scene information for OV-3DOD. Specifically, we first design a Hierarchical Data Integration (HDI) approach to obtain coarse-to-fine 3D-image-text data, which is fed into a VLM to extract object-centric knowledge. To facilitate the association of feature hierarchies, we then propose an Interactive Cross-Modal Alignment (ICMA) strategy to establish effective intra-level and inter-level feature connections. To better align features across different levels, we further propose an Object-Focusing Context Adjustment (OFCA) module to refine multi-level features by emphasizing object-related features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms SOTA methods on the existing OV-3DOD benchmarks. It also achieves promising OV-3DOD results even without any 3D annotations.
abstract_ch: 开放词汇3D物体检测（OV-3DOD）旨在定位和分类超出封闭词汇集范围的新物体。近期视觉语言模型（VLMs）的成功表明了它们在理解开放词汇方面的能力。现有利用VLMs进行3D物体检测（3DOD）的工作通常依赖于丢失了所需丰富场景上下文的表示方法，这影响了3D感知的效果。为了解决这一问题，我们在本文中提出了一种分层框架，命名为HCMA，以同时学习局部物体信息和全局场景信息来实现OV-3DOD。具体而言，我们首先设计了一个分层数据集成（HDI）方法，以获取从粗到细的3D图像-文本数据，并将其输入到VLM中提取以物体为中心的知识。为了促进特征层次间的关联，我们随后提出了一个交互式跨模态对齐（ICMA）策略，建立了有效的同一层次内和不同层次间的特征连接。为了更好地对齐不同层次的特征，我们进一步提出了一种物体聚焦上下文调整（OFCA）模块，通过强调与物体相关的特征来细化多层特征。广泛实验表明，所提出的方法在现有的OV-3DOD基准测试中优于SOTA方法。即使没有3D注释，该方法也取得了令人鼓舞的OV-3DOD结果。

title: Improving Generalization of Deep Neural Networks by Optimum Shifting
title_ch: 通过最优移位提高深度神经网络的泛化能力
authors: Yuyan Zhou;Ye Li;Lei Feng;Sheng-Jun Huang;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics;Singapore University of Technology and Design;
abstract: Recent studies showed that the generalization of neural networks is correlated with the sharpness of the loss landscape, and flat minima suggests a better generalization ability than sharp minima. In this paper, we propose a novel method called \emph{optimum shifting}, which changes the parameters of a neural network from a sharp minimum to a flatter one while maintaining the same training loss value. Our method is based on the observation that when the input and output of a neural network are fixed, the matrix multiplications within the network can be treated as systems of under-determined linear equations, enabling adjustment of parameters in the solution space, which can be simply accomplished by solving a constrained optimization problem. Furthermore, we introduce a practical stochastic optimum shifting technique utilizing the Neural Collapse theory to reduce computational costs and provide more degrees of freedom for optimum shifting. Extensive experiments (including classification and detection) with various deep neural network architectures on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
abstract_ch: 最近的研究表明，神经网络的泛化能力与其损失景观的锐度相关，平坦的极小值比尖锐的极小值暗示了更好的泛化能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“最优位移”的新方法，该方法能够在保持相同训练损失值的情况下，将神经网络的参数从尖锐的极小值转换为更平坦的极小值。我们的方法基于这样一个观察：当神经网络的输入和输出固定时，网络中的矩阵乘法可以被视为欠定线性方程组系统，从而允许在解空间中调整参数，这可以通过求解一个约束优化问题来简单实现。此外，我们还引入了一种实用的随机最优位移技术，利用神经塌缩理论来降低计算成本，并为最优位移提供更多自由度。我们在基准数据集上对各种深度神经网络架构进行的广泛实验（包括分类和检测）证明了我们方法的有效性。

title: Improving Generalization of Universal Adversarial Perturbation via Dynamic Maximin Optimization
title_ch: 通过动态最大化最小优化提高通用对抗性扰动的泛化能力
authors: Yechao Zhang;Yingzhe Xu;Junyu Shi;Leo Yu Zhang;Shengshan Hu;Minghui Li;Yanjun Zhang;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology;Griffith University;University of Technology Sydney;
abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are susceptible to universal adversarial perturbations (UAPs). These perturbations are meticulously designed to fool the target model universally across all sample classes. Unlike instance-specific adversarial examples (AEs), generating UAPs is more complex because they must be generalized across a wide range of data samples and models. Our research reveals that existing universal attack methods, which optimize UAPs using DNNs with static model parameter snapshots, do not fully leverage the potential of DNNs to generate more effective UAPs. Rather than optimizing UAPs against static DNN models with a fixed training set, we suggest using dynamic model-data pairs to generate UAPs. In particular, we introduce a dynamic maximin optimization strategy, aiming to optimize the UAP across a variety of optimal model-data pairs. We term this approach DM-UAP. DM-UAP utilizes an iterative max-min-min optimization framework that refines the model-data pairs, coupled with a curriculum UAP learning algorithm to examine the combined space of model parameters and data thoroughly. Comprehensive experiments on the ImageNet dataset demonstrate that the proposed DM-UAP markedly enhances both cross-sample universality and cross-model transferability of UAPs. Using only 500 samples for UAP generation, DM-UAP outperforms the state-of-the-art approach with an average increase in fooling ratio of 12.108%.
abstract_ch: 深度神经网络（DNNs）容易受到通用对抗性扰动（UAPs）的影响。这些扰动被精心设计，能够在所有样本类别上普遍欺骗目标模型。与针对特定实例生成的对抗性例子（AEs）不同，生成UAPs更为复杂，因为它们必须在广泛的數據样本和模型范围内进行泛化。我们的研究发现，现有的通用攻击方法通过使用具有静态模型参数快照的DNN来优化UAPs，并未充分利用DNNs生成更有效的UAPs的潜力。我们建议不再仅使用固定训练集的静态DNN模型来优化UAPs，而是采用动态模型-数据对来生成UAPs。特别是，我们引入了一种动态最大化最小优化策略，旨在优化各种最优模型-数据对上的UAPs。我们将这种方法称为DM-UAP。DM-UAP利用了一个迭代的最大-最小-最小优化框架，不断细化模型-数据对，并结合了一种分阶UAP学习算法，以全面检查模型参数和数据的空间。在ImageNet数据集上的综合实验表明，提出的DM-UAP显著增强了UAPs的跨样本通用性和跨模型可转移性。仅使用500个样本生成UAPs时，DM-UAP比最先进的方法平均提高了12.108%的欺骗率。

title: InstantSticker: Realistic Decal Blending via Disentangled Object Reconstruction
title_ch: 即刻贴纸：通过解耦对象重建实现的逼真贴花融合
authors: Yi Zhang;Xiaoyang Huang;Yishun Dou;Yue Shi;Rui Shi;Ye Chen;Bingbing Ni;Wenjun Zhang;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Huawei;
abstract: We present InstantSticker, a disentangled reconstruction pipeline based on Image-Based Lighting (IBL), which focuses on highly realistic decal blending, simulates stickers attached to the reconstructed surface, and allows for instant editing and real-time rendering. To achieve stereoscopic impression of the decal, we introduce shadow factor into IBL, which can be adaptively optimized during training. This allows the shadow brightness of surfaces to be accurately decomposed rather than baked into the diffuse color, ensuring that the edited texture exhibits authentic shading. To address the issues of warping and blurriness in previous methods, we apply As-Rigid-As-Possible (ARAP) parameterization to pre-unfold a specified area of the mesh and use the local UV mapping combined with a neural texture map to enhance the ability to express high-frequency details in that area. For instant editing, we utilize the Disney BRDF model, explicitly defining material colors with 3-channel diffuse albedo. This enables instant replacement of albedo RGB values during the editing process, avoiding the prolonged optimization required in previous approaches. In our experiment, we introduce the Ratio Variance Warping (RVW) metric to evaluate the local geometric warping of the decal area. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses previous decal blending methods in terms of editing quality, editing speed and rendering speed, achieving the state-of-the-art.
abstract_ch: 我们提出了基于图像基础照明（IBL）的InstantSticker，这是一种解耦重构管道，专注于高度真实的贴花混合，模拟粘贴在重构表面的贴花，并允许即时编辑和实时渲染。为了实现贴花的立体印象，我们在IBL中引入了阴影因子，该因子可以在训练过程中自适应优化，从而使表面的阴影亮度能够准确分解而不是烘焙到漫反射颜色中，确保编辑后的纹理表现出真实的阴影效果。为了解决之前方法中存在的变形和模糊问题，我们应用了As-Rigid-As-Possible（ARAP）参数化来预先展开网格的指定区域，并使用局部UV映射结合神经纹理图来增强对该区域高频细节的表达能力。对于即时编辑，我们利用了迪士尼BRDF模型，明确定义了材料颜色的三通道漫反射相位。这使得在编辑过程中可以即时替换相位RGB值，避免了之前方法所需的长时间优化。在我们的实验中，我们引入了Ratio Variance Warping（RVW）度量来评估贴花区域的局部几何变形。广泛的实验结果表明，我们的方法在编辑质量、编辑速度和渲染速度方面均超越了之前的贴花混合方法，达到了业界领先水平。

title: IPVTON: Image-based 3D Virtual Try-on with Image Prompt Adapter
title_ch: 基于图像的3D虚拟试衣与图像提示适配器
authors: Xiaojing Zhong;Zhonghua Wu;Xiaofeng Yang;Guosheng Lin;Qingyao Wu;
affiliations: South China University of Technology;SenseTime Research;Nanyang Technological University;Pengcheng Laboratory;
abstract: Given a pair of images depicting a person and a garment separately, image-based 3D virtual try-on methods aim to reconstruct a 3D human model that realistically portrays the person wearing the desired garment. In this paper, we present IPVTON, a novel image-based 3D virtual try-on framework. IPVTON employs score distillation sampling with image prompts to optimize a hybrid 3D human representation, integrating target garment features into diffusion priors through an image prompt adapter. To avoid interference with non-target areas, we leverage mask-guided image prompt embeddings to focus the image features on the try-on regions. Moreover, we impose geometric constraints on the 3D model with a pseudo silhouette generated by ControlNet, ensuring that the clothed 3D human model retains the shape of the source identity while accurately wearing the target garments. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that IPVTON outperforms previous methods in image-based 3D virtual try-on tasks, excelling in both geometry and texture.
abstract_ch: 给定一对分别展示一个人和一件衣物的图像，基于图像的3D虚拟试穿方法旨在重建一个真实地展现该人穿着所选衣物的3D人体模型。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于图像的3D虚拟试穿框架——IPVTON。IPVTON采用带有图像提示的评分蒸馏采样来优化一种混合的3D人体表示，通过图像提示适配器将目标衣物特征整合到扩散先验中。为了避免对非目标区域产生干扰，我们利用掩码引导的图像提示嵌入聚焦图像特征于试穿区域。此外，我们还使用ControlNet生成的伪轮廓对3D模型施加几何约束，确保穿着后的3D人体模型保留源身份的形状，同时准确地穿着目标衣物。广泛的定性和定量实验表明，IPVTON在基于图像的3D虚拟试穿任务中优于先前的方法，在几何形状和纹理方面表现出色。

title: Iterative Self-Training with Class-Aware Text-to-Image Synthesis for Visual Task Learning
title_ch: 迭代自训练结合类感知文本到图像合成的视觉任务学习
authors: Xiang Zhang;Wanqing Zhao;Pengyang Li;Ying Liu;Hangzai Luo;Sheng Zhong;Jinye Peng;Jianping Fan;

title: Joint Class-level and Instance-level Relationship Modeling for Novel Class Discovery

title: KALAHash: Knowledge-Anchored Low-Resource Adaptation for Deep Hashing
title_ch: KALAHash：知识锚定低资源适应深度哈希
authors: Shu Zhao;Tan Yu;Xiaoshuai Hao;Wenchao Ma;Vijaykrishnan Narayanan;
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University;NVIDIA;Samsung;
abstract: Deep hashing has been widely used for large-scale approximate nearest neighbor search due to its storage and search efficiency. However, existing deep hashing methods predominantly rely on abundant training data, leaving the more challenging scenario of low-resource adaptation for deep hashing relatively underexplored. This setting involves adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks with only an extremely small number of training samples available. Our preliminary benchmarks reveal that current methods suffer significant performance degradation due to the distribution shift caused by limited training samples. To address these challenges, we introduce Class-Calibration LoRA (CLoRA), a novel plug-and-play approach that dynamically constructs low-rank adaptation matrices by leveraging class-level textual knowledge embeddings. CLoRA effectively incorporates prior class knowledge as anchors, enabling parameter-efficient fine-tuning while maintaining the original data distribution. Furthermore, we propose Knowledge-Guided Discrete Optimization (KIDDO), a framework to utilize class knowledge to compensate for the scarcity of visual information and enhance the discriminability of hash codes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method, Knowledge- Anchored Low-Resource Adaptation Hashing (KALAHash), significantly boosts retrieval performance and achieves a 4x data efficiency in low-resource scenarios.
abstract_ch: 深度哈希在大规模近似最近邻搜索中广泛应用，得益于其存储和搜索效率。然而，现有的深度哈希方法主要依赖丰富的训练数据，使得低资源适应性场景下的深度哈希相对较少被探索。在这种设置下，只有极少量的训练样本可用于适应预训练模型以完成下游任务。我们的初步基准测试表明，当前的方法因有限的训练样本导致的数据分布变化而遭受显著性能下降。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了Class-Calibration LoRA（CLoRA），这是一种新颖的即插即用方法，通过利用类级文本知识嵌入动态构建低秩适应矩阵。CLoRA有效地将先验类知识作为锚点，实现参数高效的微调，同时保持原始数据分布。此外，我们提出了知识引导离散优化（KIDDO）框架，利用类知识来弥补视觉信息的稀缺性，并增强哈希码的区分能力。广泛实验表明，我们提出的方法——知识锚定低资源适应哈希（KALAHash）——显著提升了检索性能，并在低资源场景中实现了4倍的数据效率提升。

title_ch: L-Man：一种大型多模态模型，统一了以人类为中心的任务

title: Large Images Are Gaussians: High-Quality Large Image Representation with Levels of 2D Gaussian Splatting
title_ch: 大图是高斯函数：基于2D高斯点绘制的高质量大图表示
authors: Lingting Zhu;Guying Lin;Jinnan Chen;Xinjie Zhang;Zhenchao Jin;Zhao Wang;Lequan Yu;
affiliations: University of Hong Kong;Carnegie Mellon University;National University of Singapore;Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;Chinese University of Hong Kong;
abstract: While Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have demonstrated significant success in image representation, they are often hindered by large training memory and slow decoding speed. Recently, Gaussian Splatting (GS) has emerged as a promising solution in 3D reconstruction due to its high-quality novel view synthesis and rapid rendering capabilities, positioning it as a valuable tool for a broad spectrum of applications. In particular, a GS-based representation, 2DGS, has shown potential for image fitting. In our work, we present \textbf{L}arge \textbf{I}mages are \textbf{G}aussians (\textbf{LIG}), which delves deeper into the application of 2DGS for image representations, addressing the challenge of fitting large images with 2DGS in the situation of numerous Gaussian points, through two distinct modifications: 1) we adopt a variant of representation and optimization strategy, facilitating the fitting of a large number of Gaussian points; 2) we propose a Level-of-Gaussian approach for reconstructing both coarse low-frequency initialization and fine high-frequency details. Consequently, we successfully represent large images as Gaussian points and achieve high-quality large image representation, demonstrating its efficacy across various types of large images. Code is available at {\href{https://github.com/HKU-MedAI/LIG}{https://github.com/HKU-MedAI/LIG}}.
abstract_ch: 虽然隐式神经表示（INRs）在图像表示方面取得了显著的成功，但它们常常受到大量训练内存和缓慢解码速度的限制。最近，高斯斑点化（GS）因其高质量的新视角合成能力和快速渲染能力，在三维重建领域中崭露头角，成为广泛应用场景中的一个有价值的工具。特别是，基于GS的表示方法2DGS显示出在图像拟合方面的潜力。在我们的工作中，我们提出了**大图像是高斯点**（LIG），深入探讨了2DGS在图像表示中的应用，并通过两种不同的修改解决了在大量高斯点的情况下使用2DGS进行图像拟合的挑战：1）我们采用了一种表示和优化策略的变体，有助于拟合大量的高斯点；2）我们提出了一种高斯层级（Level-of-Gaussian）方法，用于重建粗略的低频初始化和精细的高频细节。因此，我们成功地将大图像表示为高斯点，并实现了高质量的大图像表示，展示了其在各种类型大图像上的有效性。代码可在[https://github.com/HKU-MedAI/LIG](https://github.com/HKU-MedAI/LIG) 获取。

title: Leveraging Consistent Spatio-Temporal Correspondence for Robust Visual Odometry
title_ch: 利用一致的空间-时间对应关系实现稳健的视觉里程计
authors: Zhaoxing Zhang;Junda Cheng;Gangwei Xu;Xiaoxiang Wang;Can Zhang;Xin Yang;
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology;
abstract: Recent approaches to VO have significantly improved performance by using deep networks to predict optical flow between video frames. However, existing methods still suffer from noisy and inconsistent flow matching, making it difficult to handle challenging scenarios and long-sequence estimation. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Spatio-Temporal Visual Odometry (STVO), a novel deep network architecture that effectively leverages inherent spatio-temporal cues to enhance the accuracy and consistency of multi-frame flow matching. With more accurate and consistent flow matching, STVO can achieve better pose estimation through the bundle adjustment (BA). Specifically, STVO introduces two innovative components: 1) the Temporal Propagation Module that utilizes multi-frame information to extract and propagate temporal cues across adjacent frames, maintaining temporal consistency; 2) the Spatial Activation Module that utilizes geometric priors from the depth maps to enhance spatial consistency while filtering out excessive noise and incorrect matches. Our STVO achieves state-of-the-art performance on TUM-RGBD, EuRoc MAV, ETH3D and KITTI Odometry benchmarks. Notably, it improves accuracy by 77.8% on ETH3D benchmark and 38.9% on KITTI Odometry benchmark over the previous best methods.
abstract_ch: 近年来，视觉里程计（VO）的方法通过使用深度网络在视频帧之间预测光学流取得了显著的进步。然而，现有方法仍然面临着嘈杂和不一致的流匹配问题，这使得处理具有挑战性的场景和长序列估计变得困难。为克服这些挑战，我们引入了时空视觉里程计（STVO），这是一种新颖的深度网络架构，有效地利用内在的时空线索来增强多帧流匹配的准确性和一致性。通过更准确和一致的流匹配，STVO可以在束调整（BA）过程中实现更好的姿态估计。具体来说，STVO引入了两个创新组件：1）时间传播模块，该模块利用多帧信息提取并传播相邻帧之间的时序线索，保持时序一致性；2）空间激活模块，该模块利用深度图中的几何先验增强空间一致性，同时过滤掉过多噪声和错误匹配。我们的STVO在TUM-RGBD、EuRoc MAV、ETH3D和KITTI里程计基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，与之前的最佳方法相比，它在ETH3D基准测试上的准确性提高了77.8%，在KITTI里程计基准测试上的准确性提高了38.9%。

title: Local Conditional Controlling for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
title_ch: 局部条件控制对文本到图像扩散模型的影响
authors: Yibo Zhao;Liang Peng;Yang Yang;Zekai Luo;Hengjia Li;Yao Chen;Zheng Yang;Xiaofei He;Wei Zhao;Qinglin Lu;Wei Liu;Boxi Wu;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;Fabu Inc;Xidian University;Tencent;
abstract: Diffusion models have exhibited impressive prowess in the text-to-image task. Recent methods add image-level structure controls, e.g., edge and depth maps, to manipulate the generation process together with text prompts to obtain desired images. This controlling process is globally operated on the entire image, which limits the flexibility of control regions. In this paper, we explore a novel and practical task setting: local control. It focuses on controlling specific local region according to user-defined image conditions, while the remaining regions are only conditioned by the original text prompt. However, it is non-trivial to achieve local conditional controlling. The naive manner of directly adding local conditions may lead to the local control dominance problem, which forces the model to focus on the controlled region and neglect object generation in other regions. To mitigate this problem, we propose Regional Discriminate Loss to update the noised latents, aiming at enhanced object generation in non-control regions. Furthermore, the proposed Focused Token Response suppresses weaker attention scores which lack the strongest response to enhance object distinction and reduce duplication. Lastly, we adopt Feature Mask Constraint to reduce quality degradation in images caused by information differences across the local control region. All proposed strategies are operated at the inference stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can synthesize high-quality images aligned with the text prompt under local control conditions.
abstract_ch: 扩散模型在文本到图像任务中展现了令人印象深刻的性能。最近的方法增加了图像级别的结构控制，例如边缘图和深度图，这些控制可以与文本提示一起操作生成过程，以获得所需图像。这一控制过程是在整个图像上全局进行的，限制了控制区域的灵活性。在本文中，我们探索了一个新颖且实用的任务设置：局部控制。它侧重于根据用户定义的图像条件控制特定的局部区域，而其余区域仅由原始文本提示进行条件化。然而，实现局部条件控制并不简单。直接添加局部条件的简单方法可能导致局部控制主导问题，迫使模型专注于受控区域并忽略其他区域的对象生成。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种区域判别损失（Regional Discriminate Loss）来更新噪声潜在变量，旨在增强非控制区域的对象生成。此外，我们提出的聚焦令牌响应（Focused Token Response）抑制那些缺乏最强响应的较弱注意力分数，从而增强对象的区别并减少重复现象。最后，我们采用特征掩码约束（Feature Mask Constraint）来减少由于局部控制区域信息差异引起的照片质量下降。所有提出的策略都在推理阶段进行操作。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法可以在局部控制条件下合成高质量的图像，使其与文本提示保持一致。

title: Low-Light Image Enhancement via Generative Perceptual Priors
title_ch: 低光环境图像增强通过生成感知先验
authors: Han Zhou;Wei Dong;Xiaohong Liu;Yulun Zhang;Guangtao Zhai;Jun Chen;
affiliations: McMaster University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;
abstract: Although significant progress has been made in enhancing visibility, retrieving texture details, and mitigating noise in Low-Light (LL) images, the challenge persists in applying current Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) methods to real-world scenarios, primarily due to the diverse illumination conditions encountered. Furthermore, the quest for generating enhancements that are visually realistic and attractive remains an underexplored realm. In response to these challenges, we introduce a novel \textbf{LLIE} framework with the guidance of \textbf{G}enerative \textbf{P}erceptual \textbf{P}riors (\textbf{GPP-LLIE}) derived from vision-language models (VLMs). Specifically, we first propose a pipeline that guides VLMs to assess multiple visual attributes of the LL image and quantify the assessment to output the global and local perceptual priors. Subsequently, to incorporate these generative perceptual priors to benefit LLIE, we introduce a transformer-based backbone in the diffusion process, and develop a new layer normalization (\textit{\textbf{GPP-LN}}) and an attention mechanism (\textit{\textbf{LPP-Attn}}) guided by global and local perceptual priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model outperforms current SOTA methods on paired LL datasets and exhibits superior generalization on real-world data. The code is released at \url{https://github.com/LowLevelAI/GPP-LLIE}.
abstract_ch: 尽管在提高低光（LL）图像的可见性、恢复纹理细节以及减轻噪声方面取得了显著进展，但将当前的低光图像增强（LLIE）方法应用于实际场景仍然面临着挑战，主要是由于遇到的各种照明条件不同。此外，生成既视觉上逼真又具有吸引力的增强图像仍然是一个未被充分探索的领域。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的LLIE框架，该框架受到来自视觉语言模型（VLMs）的生成感知先验（GPP-LLIE）的指导。具体来说，我们首先提出了一种管道，引导VLMs评估低光图像的多种视觉属性，并量化这些评估以输出全局和局部感知先验。随后，为了使这些生成感知先验能够对LLIE产生益处，我们在扩散过程中引入了一个基于变压器的骨干网络，并开发了一种由全局和局部感知先验引导的新层归一化（GPP-LN）和注意力机制（LPP-Attn）。大量实验表明，我们的模型在配对的低光数据集上优于当前的SOTA方法，并且在真实世界数据上的泛化能力更出色。代码已发布在<https://github.com/LowLevelAI/GPP-LLIE>。

title: MagicNaming: Consistent Identity Generation by Finding a “Name Space” in T2I Diffusion Models
title_ch: MagicNaming：通过在T2I扩散模型中找到“命名空间”实现一致的身份生成
authors: Jing Zhao;Heliang Zheng;Chaoyue Wang;Long Lan;Wanrong Huang;Yuhua Tang;
affiliations: National University of Defense Technology;University of Science and Technology of China;University of Sydney;
abstract: Large-scale text-to-image diffusion models, (e.g., DALL-E, SDXL) are capable of generating famous persons by simply referring to their names. Is it possible to make such models generate generic identities as simple as the famous ones, e.g., just use a name? In this paper, we explore the existence of a "Name Space", where any point in the space corresponds to a specific identity. Fortunately, we find some clues in the feature space spanned by text embedding of celebrities' names. Specifically, we first extract the embeddings of celebrities' names in the Laion5B dataset with the text encoder of diffusion models. Such embeddings are used as supervision to learn an encoder that can predict the name (actually an embedding) of a given face image. We experimentally find that such name embeddings work well in promising the generated image with good identity consistency. Note that like the names of celebrities, our predicted name embeddings are disentangled from the semantics of text inputs, making the original generation capability of text-to-image models well-preserved. Moreover, by simply plugging such name embeddings, all variants (e.g., from Civitai) derived from the same base model (i.e., SDXL) readily become identity-aware text-to-image models. Project homepage: \url{https://magicfusion.github.io/MagicNaming/}.
abstract_ch: 大规模的文字到图像扩散模型（例如DALL-E、SDXL）可以通过简单地引用名字生成著名人物的图像。是否有可能使这样的模型生成与著名人物一样简单的通用身份？在本文中，我们探索了“名称空间”的存在性，在这个空间中，任何一点都对应一个特定的身份。幸运的是，我们在由名人名字的文本嵌入构成的功能空间中找到了一些线索。具体来说，我们首先使用扩散模型的文本编码器从Laion5B数据集中提取名人名字的嵌入。这些嵌入被用作监督信号来学习一个编码器，该编码器可以预测给定面部图像的名字（实际上是嵌入）。实验结果显示，这样的名字嵌入能够很好地保证生成图像的身份一致性。需要注意的是，就像名人的名字一样，我们预测的名字嵌入与文本输入的语义是分离的，从而很好地保留了文字到图像模型原有的生成能力。此外，通过简单地插入此类名字嵌入，所有源自同一基础模型（即SDXL）的变体（例如来自Civitai的版本）都可以立即变成具有身份感知能力的文字到图像模型。项目主页：[https://magicfusion.github.io/MagicNaming/](https://magicfusion.github.io/MagicNaming/)。

title_ch: 感知与匹配相结合：通过适用的语义融合增强图像特征匹配

title: Mesh Watermark Removal Attack and Mitigation: A Novel Perspective of Function Space
title_ch: 网格水印去除攻击与缓解：函数空间的新视角
authors: Xingyu Zhu;Guanhui Ye;Chengdong Dong;Xiapu Luo;Shiyao Zhang;Xuetao Wei;
affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology;Hong Kong Polytechnic University;
abstract: Mesh watermark embeds secret messages in 3D meshes and decodes the message from watermarked meshes for ownership verification. Current watermarking methods directly hide secret messages in vertex and face sets of meshes. However, mesh is a discrete representation that uses vertex and face sets to describe a continuous signal, which can be discretized in other discrete representations with different vertex and face sets. This raises the question of whether the watermark can still be verified on the different discrete representations of the watermarked mesh. We conduct this research in an attack-then-defense manner by proposing a novel function space mesh watermark removal attack FuncEvade and then mitigating it through function space mesh watermarking FuncMark. In detail, FuncEvade generates a different discrete representation of a watermarked mesh by extracting it from the signed distance function of the watermarked mesh. We observe that the generated mesh can evade ALL previous watermarking methods. FuncMark mitigates FuncEvade by watermarking signed distance function through message-guided deformation. Such deformation can survive isosurfacing and thus be inherited by the extracted meshes for further watermark decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FuncEvade achieves 100% evasion rate among all previous watermarking methods while achieving only 0.3% evasion rate on FuncMark. Besides, our FuncMark performs similarly on other metrics compared to state-of-the-art mesh watermarking methods.
abstract_ch: 网格水印将秘密信息嵌入到3D网格中，并从带有水印的网格中解码信息以进行所有权验证。当前的水印方法直接将秘密信息隐藏在网格的顶点集和面集中。然而，网格是一种离散表示，使用顶点集和面集来描述连续信号，这些信号可以在其他不同的离散表示中被离散化。这引发了一个问题：是否可以在带有水印的网格的不同离散表示中仍然验证水印。我们通过一种攻击-防御的研究方式来进行这项研究，首先提出了一个新的函数空间网格水印移除攻击FuncEvade，然后通过函数空间网格水印方法FuncMark对其进行缓解。具体而言，FuncEvade通过从带有水印的网格的符号距离函数中提取出一个不同的离散表示的网格来生成一个不同的离散表示。我们观察到，生成的网格可以逃避所有之前的方法。而FuncMark则通过消息引导的变形对符号距离函数进行水印处理，这种变形可以在等值面生成过程中存活下来，并被提取出的网格继承，以便进一步的水印解码。大量实验表明，FuncEvade在所有之前的方法中实现了100%的逃避率，而在FuncMark中仅实现了0.3%的逃避率。此外，我们的FuncMark在其他指标上与最先进的网格水印方法表现相似。

title: Mesoscopic Insights: Orchestrating Multi-Scale & Hybrid Architecture for Image Manipulation Localization
title_ch: 微观洞察： orchestrating 多尺度与混合架构进行图像操纵定位
authors: Xuekang Zhu;Xiaochen Ma;Lei Su;Zhuohang Jiang;Bo Du;Xiwen Wang;Zeyu Lei;Wentao Feng;Chi-Man Pun;Ji-Zhe Zhou;
affiliations: Sichuan University;Engineering Research Center of Machine Learning and Industry Intelligence;Hong Kong Polytechnic University;University of Macau;
abstract: The mesoscopic level serves as a bridge between the macroscopic and microscopic worlds, addressing gaps overlooked by both. Image manipulation localization (IML), a crucial technique to pursue truth from fake images, has long relied on low-level (microscopic-level) traces. However, in practice, most tampering aims to deceive the audience by altering image semantics. As a result, manipulation commonly occurs at the object level (macroscopic level), which is equally important as microscopic traces. Therefore, integrating these two levels into the mesoscopic level presents a new perspective for IML research. Inspired by this, our paper explores how to simultaneously construct mesoscopic representations of micro and macro information for IML and introduces the Mesorch architecture to orchestrate both. Specifically, this architecture i) combines Transformers and CNNs in parallel, with Transformers extracting macro information and CNNs capturing micro details, and ii) explores across different scales, assessing micro and macro information seamlessly. Additionally, based on the Mesorch architecture, the paper introduces two baseline models aimed at solving IML tasks through mesoscopic representation. Extensive experiments across four datasets have demonstrated that our models surpass the current state-of-the-art in terms of performance, computational complexity, and robustness.
abstract_ch: 介观水平位于宏观和微观世界之间，弥补了两者忽视的空白。图像操纵定位（IML），作为一种关键的技术，用于从虚假图像中追求真相，长期以来主要依赖于低层次（微观层面）的痕迹。然而，在实践中，大多数篡改行为旨在通过改变图像语义来欺骗观众。因此，图像篡改通常发生在对象层面（介观层面），这一层面同样重要，与微观痕迹相当。由此，将这两者整合到介观层面为IML研究提供了新的视角。受到这一启发，我们的论文探讨了如何同时构建微和宏观信息的介观表示，并引入了Mesorch架构以协调这两种信息。具体而言，该架构i）并行结合Transformer和CNN，Transformer提取宏观信息，CNN捕捉微观细节；ii）在不同尺度上进行探索，无缝评估微和宏观信息。此外，基于Mesorch架构，论文还引入了两个基线模型，旨在通过介观表示解决IML任务。在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的模型在性能、计算复杂度和鲁棒性方面均超越了当前最先进的技术。

title: Mitigating Feature Gap for Adversarial Robustness by Feature Disentanglement
title_ch: 通过特征解耦缓解对抗鲁棒性差距
authors: Nuoyan Zhou;Dawei Zhou;Decheng Liu;Nannan Wang;Xinbo Gao;
affiliations: Xidian University;Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications;
abstract: Adversarial fine-tuning methods enhance adversarial robustness via fine-tuning the pre-trained model in an adversarial training manner. However, we identify that some specific latent features of adversarial samples are confused by adversarial perturbation and lead to an unexpectedly increasing gap between features in the last hidden layer of natural and adversarial samples. To address this issue, we propose a disentanglement-based approach to explicitly model and further remove the specific latent features. We introduce a feature disentangler to separate out the specific latent features from the features of the adversarial samples, thereby boosting robustness by eliminating the specific latent features. Besides, we align clean features in the pre-trained model with features of adversarial samples in the fine-tuned model, to benefit from the intrinsic features of natural samples. Empirical evaluations on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach surpasses existing adversarial fine-tuning methods and adversarial training baselines.
abstract_ch: 对抗性微调方法通过以对抗训练的方式微调预训练模型来增强对抗性鲁棒性。然而，我们发现一些特定的潜在特征在对抗扰动的影响下变得混淆，并导致自然样本和对抗样本在最后一隐藏层中的特征差距意外地增大。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种解纠缠为基础的方法，以明确建模并进一步去除这些特定的潜在特征。我们引入了一个特征解纠缠器，用于从对抗样本的特征中分离出特定的潜在特征，从而通过消除这些特定的潜在特征来提升鲁棒性。此外，我们还在微调模型中对干净特征与对抗样本的特征进行对齐，以便利用自然样本的固有特征。在三个基准数据集上的实证评估表明，我们的方法超越了现有的对抗性微调方法和对抗性训练基线。

title: MTGA: Multi-View Temporal Granularity Aligned Aggregation for Event-Based Lip-Reading
title_ch: MTGA：基于事件的唇读多视图时间粒度对齐聚合
authors: Wenhao Zhang;Jun Wang;Yong Luo;Lei Yu;Wei Yu;Zheng He;Jialie Shen;
affiliations: Wuhan University;City, University of London;
abstract: Lip-reading is to utilize the visual information of the speaker's lip movements to recognize words and sentences. Existing event-based lip-reading solutions integrate different frame rate branches to learn spatio-temporal features of varying granularities. However, aggregating events into event frames inevitably leads to the loss of fine-grained temporal information within frames. To remedy this drawback, we propose a novel framework termed Multi-view Temporal Granularity aligned Aggregation (MTGA). Specifically, we first present a novel event representation method, namely time-segmented voxel graph list, where the most significant local voxels are temporally connected into a graph list. Then we design a spatio-temporal fusion module based on temporal granularity alignment, where the global spatial features extracted from event frames, together with the local relative spatial and temporal features contained in voxel graph list are effectively aligned and integrated. Finally, we design a temporal aggregation module that incorporates positional encoding, which enables the capture of local absolute spatial and global temporal information. Experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms both the event-based and video-based lip-reading counterparts.
abstract_ch: 唇读是指利用说话者嘴唇运动的视觉信息来识别单词和句子。现有的基于事件的唇读解决方案整合了不同帧率分支以学习不同粒度的空间-时间特征。然而，将事件聚合到事件帧中不可避免地会导致帧内细微的时间信息丢失。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的框架，称为多视图空间-时间粒度对齐聚合（MTGA）。具体来说，我们首先提出了一种新的事件表示方法，即时间分割体素图列表，其中最重要的局部体素在时间上连接成一个图列表。然后，我们设计了一个基于时间粒度对齐的空间-时间融合模块，该模块将从事件帧中提取的全局空间特征与体素图列表中包含的局部相对空间和时间特征有效对齐并集成。最后，我们设计了一个时间聚合模块，该模块结合了位置编码，从而能够捕捉局部绝对空间信息和全局时间信息。实验表明，我们的方法在基于事件和基于视频的唇读对手中表现更优。

title: MUC: Mixture of Uncalibrated Cameras for Robust 3D Human Body Reconstruction
title_ch: MUC：未校准相机的混合用于稳健的人体三维重建
authors: Yitao Zhu;Sheng Wang;Mengjie Xu;Zixu Zhuang;Zhixin Wang;Kaidong Wang;Han Zhang;Qian Wang;
affiliations: ShanghaiTech University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Shanghai United Imaging Intelligence Co., Ltd.;Shanghai Clinical Research and Trial Center;
abstract: Multiple cameras can provide comprehensive multi-view video coverage of a person. Fusing this multi-view data is crucial for tasks like behavioral analysis, although it traditionally requires camera calibration, a process that is often complex. Moreover, previous studies have overlooked the challenges posed by self-occlusion under multiple views and the continuity of human body shape estimation. In this study, we introduce a method to reconstruct the 3D human body from multiple uncalibrated camera views. Initially, we utilize a pre-trained human body encoder to process each camera view individually, enabling the reconstruction of human body models and parameters for each view along with predicted camera positions. Rather than merely averaging the models across views, we develop a neural network trained to assign weights to individual views for all human body joints, based on the estimated distribution of joint distances from each camera. Additionally, we focus on the mesh surface of the human body for dynamic fusion, allowing for the seamless integration of facial expressions and body shape into a unified human body model. Our method has shown excellent performance in reconstructing the human body on two public datasets, advancing beyond previous work from the SMPL model to the SMPL-X model. This extension incorporates more complex hand poses and facial expressions, enhancing the detail and accuracy of the reconstructions. Crucially, it supports the flexible ad-hoc deployment of any number of cameras, offering significant potential for various applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/AbsterZhu/MUC.
abstract_ch: 多摄像头可以提供全面的多视角视频覆盖一个人。融合这些多视角数据对于行为分析等任务至关重要，尽管传统上这需要进行摄像头校准，一个过程往往非常复杂。此外，先前的研究忽略了多视角下自我遮挡带来的挑战以及人体姿态连续估计的问题。在本研究中，我们提出了一种方法来从多个未校准的摄像头视角重建三维人体模型。首先，我们利用预训练的人体编码器分别处理每个摄像头视角，从而实现对人体模型和参数的逐视角重建，并预测摄像头位置。我们不仅简单地对各个视角的人体模型取平均值，还开发了一个神经网络，该网络根据每个摄像头估计出的关节距离分布为所有人体关节分配权重。另外，我们专注于人体网格表面进行动态融合，允许面部表情和身体形状无缝整合到统一的人体模型中。我们的方法在两个公开数据集上展示了出色的性能，超越了之前基于SMPL模型的工作，扩展到了更复杂的SMPL-X模型。这一扩展包含了更复杂的手部姿势和面部表情，提高了重建的细节和准确性。最重要的是，它支持任何数量摄像头的灵活即用部署，具有广泛的应用潜力。我们的代码可在https://github.com/AbsterZhu/MUC获取。

title: Multi-concept Model Immunization through Differentiable Model Merging
title_ch: 多概念模型通过可微模型合并的免疫化
authors: Amber Yijia Zheng;Raymond A. Yeh;
affiliations: Purdue University;
abstract: Model immunization is an emerging direction that aims to mitigate the potential risk of misuse associated with open-sourced models and advancing adaptation methods. The idea is to make the released models' weights difficult to fine-tune on certain harmful applications, hence the name ``immunized''. Recent work on model immunization focuses on the single-concept setting. However, models need to be immunized against multiple concepts in real-world situations. To address this gap, we propose an immunization algorithm that, simultaneously, learns a single ``difficult initialization'' for adaptation methods over a set of concepts. We achieve this by incorporating a differentiable merging layer that combines a set of model weights adapted over multiple concepts. In our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-concept immunization by generalizing prior work's experiment setup of re-learning and personalization adaptation to multiple concepts.
abstract_ch: 模型免疫是一个新兴的方向，旨在减轻与开源模型相关的潜在滥用风险，并推进适应方法的发展。其核心思想是使发布的模型权重在某些有害应用上难以进一步调整，因此得名“免疫”。最近关于模型免疫的研究主要集中在单一概念设置上。然而，在现实世界中，模型需要针对多种概念进行免疫。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了一种免疫算法，该算法同时为一组概念学习一个单一的“困难初始化”用于适应方法。我们通过引入一个可微合并层来实现这一点，该层可以结合多个概念适应后的模型权重。在我们的实验中，我们通过将先前工作的再学习和个人化适应实验设置推广到多种概念，展示了多概念免疫的有效性。

title: Multi-scale Activation, Refinement, and Aggregation: Exploring Diverse Cues for Fine-Grained Bird Recognition
title_ch: 多尺度激活、细化和聚合：探索多种线索进行细粒度鸟类识别
authors: Zhicheng Zhang;Hao Tang;Jinhui Tang;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology;Hong Kong Polytechnic University;
abstract: Given the critical role of birds in ecosystems, Fine-Grained Bird Recognition (FGBR) has gained increasing attention, particularly in distinguishing birds within similar subcategories. Although Vision Transformer (ViT)-based methods often outperform Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based methods in FGBR, recent studies reveal that the limited receptive field of plain ViT model hinders representational richness and makes them vulnerable to scale variance. Thus, enhancing the multi-scale capabilities of existing ViT-based models to overcome this bottleneck in FGBR is a worthwhile pursuit. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for FGBR, namely Multi-scale Diverse Cues Modeling (MDCM), which explores diverse cues at different scales across various stages of a multi-scale Vision Transformer (MS-ViT) in an "Activation-Selection-Aggregation" paradigm. Specifically, we first propose a multi-scale cue activation module to ensure the discriminative cues learned at different stage are mutually different. Subsequently, a multi-scale token selection mechanism is proposed to remove redundant noise and highlight discriminative, scale-specific cues at each stage. Finally, the selected tokens from each stage are independently utilized for bird recognition, and the recognition results from multiple stages are adaptively fused through a multi-scale dynamic aggregation mechanism for final model decisions. Both qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed MDCM, which outperforms CNN- and ViT-based models on several widely-used FGBR benchmarks.
abstract_ch: 鉴于鸟类在生态系统中的关键作用，精细粒度鸟类识别（Fine-Grained Bird Recognition, FGBR）逐渐引起了广泛关注，尤其是在区分相似子类别中的鸟类时。尽管基于视觉变换器（Vision Transformer, ViT）的方法通常在FGBR中优于基于卷积神经网络（Convolutional Neural Network, CNN）的方法，但最近的研究揭示了基础ViT模型有限的感受野阻碍了其表征丰富性，并使其对尺度变化敏感。因此，增强现有ViT基模型的多尺度能力以克服FGBR中的这一瓶颈是一个值得追求的目标。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的FGBR框架，即多尺度多样线索建模（Multi-scale Diverse Cues Modeling, MDCM），该框架在多尺度视觉变换器（Multi-scale Vision Transformer, MS-ViT）的不同阶段探索不同尺度下的多样化线索，并采用“激活-选择-聚合”范式。具体而言，我们首先提出了一种多尺度线索激活模块，确保不同阶段学习到的判别线索相互区别。随后，我们提出了一种多尺度标记选择机制，以去除冗余噪声并突出每个阶段特有的、具有判别性的尺度特定线索。最后，来自每个阶段的选定标记独立用于鸟类识别，通过多尺度动态聚合机制将多个阶段的识别结果适当地融合，以做出最终模型决策。定性和定量结果均表明，我们提出的MDCM框架在多个广泛使用的FGBR基准测试上优于CNN和ViT基模型。

title: MultiBooth: Towards Generating All Your Concepts in an Image from Text
title_ch: MultiBooth：从文本生成图像中的所有概念
authors: Chenyang Zhu;Kai Li;Yue Ma;Chunming He;Xiu Li;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;Meta;Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;Duke University;
abstract: This paper introduces MultiBooth, a novel and efficient technique for multi-concept customization in image generation from text. Despite the significant advancements in customized generation methods, particularly with the success of diffusion models, existing methods often struggle with multi-concept scenarios due to low concept fidelity and high inference cost. MultiBooth addresses these issues by dividing the multi-concept generation process into two phases: a single-concept learning phase and a multi-concept integration phase. During the single-concept learning phase, we employ a multi-modal image encoder and an efficient concept encoding technique to learn a concise and discriminative representation for each concept. In the multi-concept integration phase, we use bounding boxes to define the generation area for each concept within the cross-attention map. This method enables the creation of individual concepts within their specified regions, thereby facilitating the formation of multi-concept images. This strategy not only improves concept fidelity but also reduces additional inference cost. MultiBooth surpasses various baselines in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, showcasing its superior performance and computational efficiency. Project Page: https://multibooth.github.io/
abstract_ch: 这篇论文介绍了MultiBooth，这是一种用于从文本生成图像中的多概念定制的新颖而高效的技巧。尽管在定制生成方法方面取得了显著进展，特别是在扩散模型的成功应用之后，现有方法往往难以处理多概念场景，因为它们在概念保真度和推理成本方面存在局限性。MultiBooth通过将多概念生成过程分为两个阶段来解决这些问题：单概念学习阶段和多概念集成阶段。在单概念学习阶段，我们采用多模态图像编码器和高效的概念编码技术，为每个概念学习一个简洁且具有区分性的表示。在多概念集成阶段，我们使用边界框在交叉注意力图中定义每个概念的生成区域。这种方法使得可以在指定区域内创建个别概念，从而促进多概念图像的形成。这种策略不仅提高了概念保真度，还降低了额外的推理成本。在定性和定量评估中，MultiBooth均超越了各种基线方法，展示了其优越的性能和计算效率。项目页面：https://multibooth.github.io/

title: Multimodal Class-aware Semantic Enhancement Network for Audio-Visual Video Parsing
title_ch: 多模态类意识语义增强网络在音频-视觉视频解析中的应用
authors: Pengcheng Zhao;Jinxing Zhou;Yang Zhao;Dan Guo;Yanxiang Chen;
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology;
abstract: The Audio-Visual Video Parsing task aims to recognize and temporally localize all events occurring in either the audio or visual stream, or both. Capturing accurate event semantics for each audio/visual segment is vital. Prior works directly utilize the extracted holistic audio and visual features for intra- and cross-modal temporal interactions. However, each segment may contain multiple events, resulting in semantically mixed holistic features that can lead to semantic interference during intra- or cross-modal interactions: the event semantics of one segment may incorporate semantics of unrelated events from other segments. To address this issue, our method begins with a Class-Aware Feature Decoupling (CAFD) module, which explicitly decouples the semantically mixed features into distinct class-wise features, including multiple event-specific features and a dedicated background feature. The decoupled class-wise features enable our model to selectively aggregate useful semantics for each segment from clearly matched classes contained in other segments, preventing semantic interference from irrelevant classes. Specifically, we further design a Fine-Grained Semantic Enhancement module for encoding intra- and cross-modal relations. It comprises a Segment-wise Event Co-occurrence Modeling (SECM) block and a Local-Global Semantic Fusion (LGSF) block. The SECM exploits inter-class dependencies of concurrent events within the same timestamp with the aid of a new event co-occurrence loss. The LGSF further enhances the event semantics of each segment by incorporating relevant semantics from more informative global video features. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed modules and loss functions, resulting in a new state-of-the-art parsing performance.
abstract_ch: 音频视频解析任务旨在识别并定位发生在音频或视觉流（或两者）中的所有事件。准确捕捉每个音频/视觉片段的事件语义至关重要。以往的工作直接利用提取的整体音频和视觉特征来进行跨模态的时间交互。然而，每个片段可能包含多个事件，导致整体特征在跨模态交互时出现语义混杂：一个片段的事件语义可能会包含来自其他片段的无关事件的语义。为解决这一问题，我们的方法首先采用了一个Class-Aware Feature Decoupling（CAFD）模块，该模块明确地将语义混杂的特征分解为不同的类别级特征，包括多个事件特定特征和一个专门的背景特征。解耦后的类别级特征使我们的模型能够从其他片段中明确匹配的类别中选择性地聚合有用语义，从而防止无关类别的语义干扰。具体而言，我们还设计了一个Fine-Grained Semantic Enhancement模块来编码跨模态关系。该模块由Segment-wise Event Co-occurrence Modeling（SECM）块和Local-Global Semantic Fusion（LGSF）块组成。SECM通过一种新的事件共现损失来利用同一时间戳内并发事件的跨类别依赖关系。LGSF进一步通过整合更具信息量的全局视频特征的相关语义来增强每个片段的事件语义。广泛的实验验证了所提出模块和损失函数的有效性，从而实现了音频视频解析的新最佳性能。

title: Point Cloud Mamba: Point Cloud Learning via State Space Model
title_ch: 点云蟒蛇：基于状态空间模型的点云学习
authors: Tao Zhang;Haobo Yuan;Lu Qi;Jiangning Zhang;Qianyu Zhou;Shunping Ji;Shuicheng Yan;Xiangtai Li;
affiliations: Wuhan University;Skywork AI;Tencent;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Nanyang Technological University;
abstract: Recently, state space models have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities and linear computational complexity in contrast to transformers. This research focuses on applying such architecture to more efficiently and effectively model point cloud data globally with linear computational complexity. In particular, for the first time, we demonstrate that Mamba-based point cloud methods can outperform previous methods based on transformer or multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs). To enable Mamba to process 3-D point cloud data more effectively, we propose a novel Consistent Traverse Serialization method to convert point clouds into 1-D point sequences while ensuring that neighboring points in the sequence are also spatially adjacent. Consistent Traverse Serialization yields six variants by permuting the order of \textit{x}, \textit{y}, and \textit{z} coordinates, and the synergistic use of these variants aids Mamba in comprehensively observing point cloud data. Furthermore, to assist Mamba in handling point sequences with different orders more effectively, we introduce point prompts to inform Mamba of the sequence's arrangement rules. Finally, we propose positional encoding based on spatial coordinate mapping to inject positional information into point cloud sequences more effectively. Point Cloud Mamba surpasses the state-of-the-art (SOTA) point-based method PointNeXt and achieves new SOTA performance on the ScanObjectNN, ModelNet40, ShapeNetPart, and S3DIS datasets. It is worth mentioning that when using a more powerful local feature extraction module, our PCM achieves 79.6 mIoU on S3DIS, significantly surpassing the previous SOTA models, DeLA and PTv3, by 5.5 mIoU and 4.9 mIoU, respectively.
abstract_ch: 最近，状态空间模型在全局建模能力上表现出色，并且具有与变压器相比线性计算复杂度的特点。本研究旨在利用这种架构更高效地以线性计算复杂度建模点云数据。特别是，我们首次证明基于Mamba的方法可以超越基于变压器或多层感知机（MLPs）的先前方法。为了使Mamba更有效地处理3D点云数据，我们提出了一种新颖的一致遍历序列化方法，将点云转换为一维点序列，同时确保序列中的相邻点也在空间上相邻。一致遍历序列化通过交换x、y和z坐标顺序产生六种变体，这些变体的协同使用帮助Mamba全面观察点云数据。此外，为了帮助Mamba更好地处理具有不同顺序的点序列，我们引入了点提示来告知Mamba序列的排列规则。最后，我们提出了基于空间坐标映射的位置编码方法，以更有效地将位置信息注入点云序列。Point Cloud Mamba超越了当前最先进的基于点的方法PointNeXt，并在ScanObjectNN、ModelNet40、ShapeNetPart和S3DIS数据集上实现了新的最佳性能。值得一提的是，在使用更强大的局部特征提取模块时，我们的PCM在S3DIS上的mIoU达到79.6，分别显著超越了之前的最佳模型DeLA和PTv3的74.1 mIoU和74.7 mIoU。

title: PointCFormer: A Relation-Based Progressive Feature Extraction Network for Point Cloud Completion
title_ch: PointCFormer：一种基于关系的渐进式特征提取网络用于点云完成
authors: Yi Zhong;Weize Quan;Dong-Ming Yan;Jie Jiang;Yingmei Wei;
affiliations: National University of Defense Technology;Chinese Academy of Sciences;University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;
abstract: Point cloud completion aims to reconstruct the complete 3D shape from incomplete point clouds, and it is crucial for tasks such as 3D object detection and segmentation. Despite the continuous advances in point cloud analysis techniques, feature extraction methods are still confronted with apparent limitations. The sparse sampling of point clouds, used as inputs in most methods, often results in a certain loss of global structure information. Meanwhile, traditional local feature extraction methods usually struggle to capture the intricate geometric details. To overcome these drawbacks, we introduce PointCFormer, a transformer framework optimized for robust global retention and precise local detail capture in point cloud completion. This framework embraces several key advantages. First, we propose a relation-based local feature extraction method to perceive local delicate geometry characteristics. This approach establishes a fine-grained relationship metric between the target point and its k-nearest neighbors, quantifying each neighboring point's contribution to the target point's local features. Secondly, we introduce a progressive feature extractor that integrates our local feature perception method with self-attention. Starting with a denser sampling of points as input, it iteratively queries long-distance global dependencies and local neighborhood relationships. This extractor maintains enhanced global structure and refined local details, without generating substantial computational overhead. Additionally, we develop a correction module after generating point proxies in the latent space to reintroduce denser information from the input points, enhancing the representation capability of the point proxies. PointCFormer demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on several widely used benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zyyyyy0926/PointCFormer_Plus_Pytorch.
abstract_ch: 点云完成的目标是从不完整的点云数据中重建完整的三维形状，这对于三维物体检测和分割等任务至关重要。尽管点云分析技术不断进步，特征提取方法仍然面临明显的局限性。大多数方法使用的稀疏采样点云作为输入，常常导致全局结构信息的丢失。同时，传统的局部特征提取方法通常难以捕捉复杂的几何细节。为克服这些缺点，我们引入了PointCFormer，这是一种专门优化用于点云完成中的稳健全局保留和精确局部细节捕捉的变压器框架。该框架具有几个关键优势。首先，我们提出了一种基于关系的局部特征提取方法，以感知局部精细的几何特性。这种方法在目标点与其k个最近邻点之间建立了一个细粒度的关系度量，量化每个邻近点对目标点局部特征的贡献。其次，我们引入了一种渐进式特征提取器，将我们的局部特征感知方法与自我注意力机制相结合。该提取器从密集采样的点作为输入开始，逐步查询长距离的全局依赖性和局部邻域关系。这种提取器能够保持增强的全局结构和细化的局部细节，而不产生显著的计算开销。此外，我们在生成潜空间中的点代理后开发了一个校正模块，以重新引入来自输入点的更密集的信息，从而增强点代理的表现能力。PointCFormer在多个广泛使用的基准测试中展示了最先进的性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Zyyyyy0926/PointCFormer_Plus_Pytorch获取。

title: Polarization Guided Mask-Free Shadow Removal
title_ch: 偏振引导无掩膜阴影去除

title: Pose Magic: Efficient and Temporally Consistent Human Pose Estimation with a Hybrid Mamba-GCN Network
title_ch: Pose Magic：一种结合Mamba-GCN网络的高效且 temporally一致的人体姿态估计方法
authors: Xinyi Zhang;Qiqi Bao;Qinpeng Cui;Wenming Yang;Qingmin Liao;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;Zhejiang University of Science & Technology;
abstract: Current state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in 3D Human Pose Estimation (HPE) are primarily based on Transformers. However, existing Transformer-based 3D HPE backbones often encounter a trade-off between accuracy and computational efficiency. To resolve the above dilemma, in this work, we leverage recent advances in state space models and utilize Mamba for high-quality and efficient long-range modeling. Nonetheless, Mamba still faces challenges in precisely exploiting local dependencies between joints. To address these issues, we propose a new attention-free hybrid spatiotemporal architecture named Hybrid Mamba-GCN (Pose Magic). This architecture introduces local enhancement with GCN by capturing relationships between neighboring joints, thus producing new representations to complement Mamba's outputs. By adaptively fusing representations from Mamba and GCN, Pose Magic demonstrates superior capability in learning the underlying 3D structure. To meet the requirements of real-time inference, we also provide a fully causal version. Extensive experiments show that Pose Magic achieves new SOTA results ($\downarrow 0.9 mm$) while saving $74.1\%$ FLOPs. In addition, Pose Magic exhibits optimal motion consistency and the ability to generalize to unseen sequence lengths.
abstract_ch: 当前在三维人体姿态估计（3D HPE）领域的最先进（SOTA）方法主要基于Transformer。然而，现有的基于Transformer的3D HPE骨干网络往往在准确性和计算效率之间面临权衡。为了解决上述困境，我们在本文中利用了状态空间模型的最新进展，并采用Mamba进行高质量和高效的长距离建模。尽管如此，Mamba仍然面临精确利用关节间局部依赖性的挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新的无注意力混合时空架构——Hybrid Mamba-GCN（Pose Magic）。该架构通过捕获相邻关节之间的关系引入局部增强，从而生成新的表示来补充Mamba的输出。通过自适应地融合Mamba和GCN的表示，Pose Magic展示了在学习潜在的3D结构方面更强的能力。为了满足实时推理的要求，我们还提供了一个完全因果版本。广泛实验表明，Pose Magic在保持$\downarrow 0.9 \text{ mm}$误差的同时节省了74.1%的FLOPs。此外，Pose Magic还表现出最优的运动一致性以及对未见过的序列长度的良好泛化能力。

title: Position-Aware Guided Point Cloud Completion with CLIP Model
title_ch: 基于位置感知的引导点云完成模型（CLIP模型）
authors: Feng Zhou;Qi Zhang;Ju Dai;Lei Li;Qing Fan;Junliang Xing;
affiliations: North China University of Technology;Pengcheng Laboratory;University of Copenhagen;University of Washington;Skywork AI;Tsinghua University;
abstract: Point cloud completion aims to recover partial geometric and topological shapes caused by equipment defects or limited viewpoints. Current methods either solely rely on the 3D coordinates of the point cloud to complete it or incorporate additional images with well-calibrated intrinsic parameters to guide the geometric estimation of the missing parts. Although these methods have achieved excellent performance by directly predicting the location of complete points, the extracted features lack fine-grained information regarding the location of the missing area. To address this issue, we propose a rapid and efficient method to expand an unimodal framework into a multimodal framework. This approach incorporates a position-aware module designed to enhance the spatial information of the missing parts through a weighted map learning mechanism. In addition, we establish a Point-Text-Image triplet corpus PCI-TI and MVP-TI based on the existing unimodal point cloud completion dataset and use the pre-trained vision-language model CLIP to provide richer detail information for 3D shapes, thereby enhancing performance. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art point cloud completion methods.
abstract_ch: 点云完成的目标是恢复由设备缺陷或有限视角导致的部分几何和拓扑形状。当前的方法要么仅依赖点云的三维坐标来完成点云，要么结合具有良好校准内在参数的额外图像来指导缺失部分的几何估计。尽管这些方法通过直接预测完整点的位置取得了卓越的性能，但提取的特征缺乏关于缺失区域位置的细粒度信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种快速且高效的方法，将单模态框架扩展为多模态框架。该方法引入了一个位置感知模块，通过加权地图学习机制增强缺失部分的空间信息。此外，我们基于现有的单模态点云完成数据集建立了包含点-文本-图像三元组的PCI-TI和MVP-TI语料库，并利用预训练的视觉-语言模型CLIP提供更丰富的细节信息，以增强3D形状的表现力。广泛的定量和定性实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的点云完成方法。

title: Pragmatist: Multiview Conditional Diffusion Models for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction from Unposed Sparse Views
title_ch: 实用主义者：基于未配对稀疏视角的高保真3D重建的多视图条件扩散模型
authors: Songchun Zhang;Chunhui Zhao;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;
abstract: Inferring 3D structures from sparse, unposed observations is challenging due to its unconstrained nature. Recent methods propose to predict implicit representations directly from unposed inputs in a data-driven manner, achieving promising results. However, these methods do not utilize geometric priors and cannot hallucinate the appearance of unseen regions, thus making it challenging to reconstruct fine geometric and textural details. To tackle this challenge, our key idea is to reformulate this ill-posed problem as conditional novel view synthesis, aiming to generate complete observations from limited input views to facilitate reconstruction. With complete observations, the poses of the input views can be easily recovered and further used to optimize the reconstructed object. To this end, we propose a novel pipeline Pragmatist. First, we generate a complete observation of the object via a multiview conditional diffusion model. Then, we use a feed-forward large reconstruction model to obtain the reconstructed mesh. To further improve the reconstruction quality, we recover the poses of input views by inverting the obtained 3D representations and further optimize the texture using detailed input views. Unlike previous approaches, our pipeline improves reconstruction by efficiently leveraging unposed inputs and generative priors, circumventing the direct resolution of highly ill-posed problems. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves promising performance in several benchmarks.
abstract_ch: 从稀疏且未姿态校准的观测中推断出3D结构是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为这种任务缺乏约束。最近的方法提出了一种直接从未姿态校准的输入中预测隐式表示的方案，并以数据驱动的方式实现，取得了令人瞩目的成果。然而，这些方法并未利用几何先验，也无法想象未观察到区域的外观，因此在重建精细的几何和纹理细节方面存在困难。为了解决这一挑战，我们的核心想法是将这个问题重新表述为条件新颖视图合成，目标是从有限的输入视角生成完整的观测，以促进重建。通过完整的观测，可以轻松恢复输入视角的姿态，并进一步优化重建对象。为此，我们提出了一种新的管道Pragmatist。首先，我们通过多视角条件扩散模型生成对象的完整观测。然后，使用前馈的大规模重建模型获得重建网格。为了进一步提高重建质量，我们通过反转获得的3D表示来恢复输入视角的姿态，并使用详细的输入视角进一步优化纹理。与之前的approaches不同，我们的管道通过高效利用未姿态校准的输入和生成先验来改进重建，从而绕过了直接解决高度病态问题的难点。大量实验表明，我们的方法在多个基准测试中表现出色。

title: Rethinking Pseudo-Label Guided Learning for Weakly Supervised Temporal Action Localization from the Perspective of Noise Correction
title_ch: 从噪声校正的角度重新思考伪标签引导的弱监督时空动作定位学习
authors: Quan Zhang;Yuxin Qi;Xi Tang;Rui Yuan;Xi Lin;Ke Zhang;Chun Yuan;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Shanghai Key Laboratory of Integrated Administration Technologies for Information Security;Soochow University;
abstract: Pseudo-label learning methods have been widely applied in weakly-supervised temporal action localization. Existing works directly utilize weakly-supervised base model to generate instance-level pseudo-labels for training the fully-supervised detection head. We argue that the noise in pseudo-labels would interfere with the learning of fully-supervised detection head, leading to significant performance leakage. Issues with noisy labels include:(1) inaccurate boundary localization; (2) undetected short action clips; (3) multiple adjacent segments incorrectly detected as one segment. To target these issues, we introduce a two-stage noisy label learning strategy to harness every potential useful signal in noisy labels. First, we propose a frame-level pseudo-label generation model with a context-aware denoising algorithm to refine the boundaries. Second, we introduce an online-revised teacher-student framework with a missing instance compensation module and an ambiguous instance correction module to solve the short-action-missing and many-to-one problems. Besides, we apply a high-quality pseudo-label mining loss in our online-revised teacher-student framework to add different weights to the noisy labels to train more effectively. Our model outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method in detection accuracy and inference speed greatly upon the THUMOS14 and ActivityNet v1.2 benchmarks.
abstract_ch: 伪标签学习方法在弱监督时空动作定位中得到了广泛应用。现有工作直接利用弱监督基础模型生成实例级伪标签用于训练全监督检测头部。我们认为伪标签中的噪声会干扰全监督检测头部的学习，导致显著的性能损失。噪声标签存在的问题包括：(1) 不准确的边界定位；(2) 漏检短动作片段；(3) 错误地将多个相邻片段合并为一个片段。为了应对这些问题，我们引入了一种两阶段的噪声标签学习策略，以充分利用噪声标签中的潜在有用信号。首先，我们提出了一种具有上下文感知去噪算法的帧级伪标签生成模型，以细化边界。其次，我们引入了一种在线修订的教师-学生框架，并包含了一个缺失实例补偿模块和一个模糊实例修正模块，以解决短动作缺失和多对一的问题。此外，我们在在线修订的教师-学生框架中应用了高质量的伪标签挖掘损失，为噪声标签分配不同的权重，以更有效地进行训练。我们的模型在THUMOS14和ActivityNet v1.2基准上的检测精度和推理速度上显著优于之前的最佳方法。

title: RhythmMamba: Fast, Lightweight, and Accurate Remote Physiological Measurement
title_ch: RhythmMamba：快速、轻量级且准确的远程生理测量
authors: Bochao Zou;Zizheng Guo;Xiaocheng Hu;Huimin Ma;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology Beijing;China Academy of Electronics and Information Technology;
abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is a method for non-contact measurement of physiological signals from facial videos, holding great potential in various applications such as healthcare, affective computing, and anti-spoofing. Existing deep learning methods struggle to address two core issues of rPPG simultaneously: understanding the periodic pattern of rPPG among long contexts and addressing large spatiotemporal redundancy in video segments. These represent a trade-off between computational complexity and the ability to capture long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce RhythmMamba, a state space model-based method that captures long-range dependencies while maintaining linear complexity. By viewing rPPG as a time series task through the proposed frame stem, the periodic variations in pulse waves are modeled as state transitions. Additionally, we design multi-temporal constraint and frequency domain feed-forward, both aligned with the characteristics of rPPG time series, to improve the learning capacity of Mamba for rPPG signals. Extensive experiments show that RhythmMamba achieves state-of-the-art performance with 319% throughput and 23% peak GPU memory. The codes are available at https://github.com/zizheng-guo/RhythmMamba.
abstract_ch: 远程光电流图(rPPG)是一种通过面部视频非接触测量生理信号的方法，具有在医疗保健、情感计算和防伪等多种应用中的巨大潜力。现有的深度学习方法难以同时解决rPPG的两个核心问题：理解长上下文中的rPPG周期性模式以及处理视频片段中的大量时空冗余。这些问题代表了计算复杂性和捕捉长距离依赖性的权衡。在本文中，我们介绍了一种基于状态空间模型的方法——RhythmMamba，该方法能够在保持线性复杂度的同时捕捉长距离依赖性。通过提出的帧干（frame stem）将rPPG视为时间序列任务，脉搏波的周期性变化被建模为状态转换。此外，我们设计了多时空约束和频域前向传递，这两种方法都与rPPG时间序列的特点相契合，以提高Mamba对rPPG信号的学习能力。广泛的实验表明，RhythmMamba在吞吐量和峰值GPU内存方面均达到了最先进的性能，分别提高了319%和23%。代码可在https://github.com/zizheng-guo/RhythmMamba获取。

title: RP-PGD: Boosting Segmentation Robustness with a Region-and-Prototype Based Adversarial Attack
title_ch: RP-PGD：基于区域和原型的对抗攻击以提升分割鲁棒性
authors: Yuxuan Zhang;Zhenbo Shi;Shuchang Wang;Wei Yang;Shaowei Wang;Yinxing Xue;
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China;Laboratory for Advanced Computing and Intelligence Engineering;Guangzhou University;

title: SceneX: Procedural Controllable Large-Scale Scene Generation
title_ch: SceneX：程序可控的大规模场景生成
authors: Mengqi Zhou;Yuxi Wang;Jun Hou;Shougao Zhang;Yiwei Li;Chuanchen Luo;Junran Peng;Zhaoxiang Zhang;
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences;Chinese Academy of Sciences;State Key Laboratory of Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems;New Laboratory of Pattern Recognition;Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics;China University of Geosciences;Shandong University;University of Science and Technology Beijing;
abstract: Developing comprehensive explicit world models is crucial for understanding and simulating real-world scenarios. Recently, Procedural Controllable Generation (PCG) has gained significant attention in large-scale scene generation by enabling the creation of scalable, high-quality assets. However, PCG faces challenges such as limited modular diversity, high expertise requirements, and challenges in managing the diverse elements and structures in complex scenes. In this paper, we introduce a large-scale scene generation framework, SceneX, which can automatically produce high-quality procedural models according to designers' textual descriptions. Specifically, the proposed method comprises two components, PCGHub and PCGPlanner. The former encompasses an extensive collection of accessible procedural assets and thousands of hand-craft API documents to perform as a standard protocol for PCG controller. The latter aims to generate executable actions for Blender to produce controllable and precise 3D assets guided by the user's instructions. Extensive experiments demonstrated the capability of our method in controllable large-scale scene generation, including nature scenes and unbounded cities, as well as scene editing such as asset placement and season translation.
abstract_ch: 构建全面明确的世界模型对于理解和模拟现实世界场景至关重要。最近，过程可控生成（PCG）在大规模场景生成方面引起了广泛关注，因为它能够创建可扩展且高质量的资产。然而，PCG面临着模块多样性有限、高专业技能要求以及在复杂场景中管理多样元素和结构的挑战。在本文中，我们介绍了一种大规模场景生成框架——SceneX，它可以自动根据设计师的文字描述生成高质量的过程性模型。具体来说，提出的方法包括两个组成部分：PCGHub和PCGPlanner。前者包含了一个广泛的过程性资产集合和数千份手工编写的API文档，用作PCG控制器的标准协议。后者旨在生成可执行的动作，指导Blender生成受用户指令控制且精确的3D资产。广泛的实验展示了该方法在可控的大规模场景生成中的能力，包括自然场景和无边界城市，以及场景编辑，如资产放置和季节转换。

title: Seg2Box: 3D Object Detection by Point-Wise Semantics Supervision
title_ch: Seg2Box：基于点wise语义监督的3D物体检测
authors: Maoji Zheng;Ziyu Xu;Qiming Xia;Hai Wu;Chenglu Wen;Cheng Wang;
affiliations: Xiamen University;
abstract: LiDAR-based 3D object detection and semantic segmentation are critical tasks in 3D scene understanding. Traditional detection and segmentation methods supervise their models through bounding box labels and semantic mask labels. However, these two independent labels inherently contain significant redundancy. This paper aims to eliminate the redundancy by supervising 3D object detection using only semantic labels. However, the challenge arises due to the incomplete geometry structure and boundary ambiguity of point-cloud instances, leading to inaccurate pseudo labels and poor detection results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel method, named Seg2Box. We first introduce a Multi-Frame Multi-Scale Clustering (MFMS-C) module, which leverages the spatio-temporal consistency of point clouds to generate accurate box-level pseudo-labels. Additionally, the Semantic?Guiding Iterative-Mining Self-Training (SGIM-ST) module is proposed to enhance the performance by progressively refining the pseudo-labels and mining the instances without generating pseudo-labels. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes Dataset show that our method significantly outperforms other competitive methods by 23.7\% and 10.3\% in mAP, respectively. The results demonstrate the great label-efficient potential and advancement of our method.
abstract_ch: 基于LiDAR的3D物体检测和语义分割是三维场景理解中的关键任务。传统的方法通过边界框标签和语义掩码标签监督其模型。然而，这两种独立的标签本质上包含了大量的冗余信息。本文旨在通过仅使用语义标签来消除这种冗余，监督3D物体检测。但这一挑战源于点云实例的不完整几何结构和边界模糊性，导致生成的伪标签不准确且检测结果较差。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为Seg2Box的新方法。首先，我们引入了一个多帧多尺度聚类（MFMS-C）模块，该模块利用点云的空间-时间一致性生成准确的盒状伪标签。此外，我们还提出了一个语义引导迭代挖掘自训练（SGIM-ST）模块，通过逐步细化伪标签并挖掘实例，而不生成新的伪标签，来增强性能。在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes Dataset上的实验表明，我们的方法分别在mAP指标上比其他竞争方法高出23.7%和10.3%，展示了我们的方法在标签效率方面的巨大潜力和进步。

title: SGDiff: Scene Graph Guided Diffusion Model for Image Collaborative SegCaptioning
title_ch: SGDiff：场景图引导的扩散模型用于图像协作分割字幕生成
authors: Xu Zhang;Jin Yuan;Hanwang Zhang;Guojin Zhong;Yongsheng Zang;Jiacheng Lin;Zhiyong Li;
affiliations: Hunan University;Nanyang Technological University;
abstract: Controllable image semantic understanding tasks, such as captioning or segmentation, necessitate users to input a prompt (e.g., text or bounding boxes) to predict a unique outcome, presenting challenges such as high-cost prompt input or limited information output. This paper introduces a new task ``Image Collaborative Segmentation and Captioning'' (SegCaptioning), which aims to translate a straightforward prompt, like a bounding box around an object, into diverse semantic interpretations represented by (caption, masks) pairs, allowing flexible result selection by users. This task poses significant challenges, including accurately capturing a user's intention from a minimal prompt while simultaneously predicting multiple semantically aligned caption words and masks. Technically, we propose a novel Scene Graph Guided Diffusion Model that leverages structured scene graph features for correlated mask-caption prediction. Initially, we introduce a Prompt-Centric Scene Graph Adaptor to map a user's prompt to a scene graph, effectively capturing his intention. Subsequently, we employ a diffusion process incorporating a Scene Graph Guided Bimodal Transformer to predict correlated caption-mask pairs by uncovering intricate correlations between them. To ensure accurate alignment, we design a Multi-Entities Contrastive Learning loss to explicitly align visual and textual entities by considering inter-modal similarity, resulting in well-aligned caption-mask pairs. Extensive experiments conducted on two datasets demonstrate that SGDiff achieves superior performance in SegCaptioning, yielding promising results for both captioning and segmentation tasks with minimal prompt input.
abstract_ch: 可控图像语义理解任务，如描述生成或分割，需要用户输入提示（例如，文本或边界框）以预测唯一的输出，这带来了诸如高成本提示输入或有限的信息输出等挑战。本文介绍了一种新的任务“图像协作分割与描述生成”（SegCaptioning），该任务旨在将简单的提示（例如，围绕对象的边界框）转化为由（描述，掩码）对表示的多种语义解释，从而允许用户灵活地选择结果。这项任务提出了显著的挑战，包括从最小的提示准确捕捉用户意图的同时，还能够预测多个语义上一致的描述词和掩码。技术上，我们提出了一种新颖的场景图引导扩散模型，该模型利用结构化的场景图特征进行相关的掩码-描述词预测。首先，我们引入了一个以提示为中心的场景图适配器，将用户的提示映射到场景图，有效地捕捉其意图。随后，我们采用一个结合了场景图引导双模态变换器的扩散过程，通过揭示描述词和掩码之间的复杂关联来预测相关的描述词-掩码对。为了确保准确对齐，我们设计了一种多实体对比学习损失，通过考虑跨模态相似性显式地对齐视觉和文本实体，从而产生良好的描述词-掩码对。在两个数据集上的广泛实验表明，SGDiff在SegCaptioning任务中取得了优越的表现，即使使用最少的提示输入也能为描述生成和分割任务提供令人鼓舞的结果。

title: SlerpFace: Face Template Protection via Spherical Linear Interpolation
title_ch: SlerpFace：基于球形线性插值的面部模板保护
authors: Zhizhou Zhong;Yuxi Mi;Yuge Huang;Jianqing Xu;Guodong Mu;Shouhong Ding;Jingyun Zhang;Rizen Guo;Yunsheng Wu;Shuigeng Zhou;
affiliations: Fudan University;Tencent;
abstract: Contemporary face recognition systems use feature templates extracted from face images to identify persons. To enhance privacy, face template protection techniques are widely employed to conceal sensitive identity and appearance information stored in the template. This paper identifies an emerging privacy attack form utilizing diffusion models that could nullify prior protection. The attack can synthesize high-quality, identity-preserving face images from templates, revealing persons' appearance. Based on studies of the diffusion model's generative capability, this paper proposes a defense by rotating templates to a noise-like distribution. This is achieved efficiently by spherically and linearly interpolating templates on their located hypersphere. This paper further proposes to group-wisely divide and drop out templates' feature dimensions, to enhance the irreversibility of rotated templates. The proposed techniques are concretized as a novel face template protection technique, SlerpFace. Extensive experiments show that SlerpFace provides satisfactory recognition accuracy and comprehensive protection against inversion and other attack forms, superior to prior arts.
abstract_ch: 当代人脸识别系统使用从面部图像中提取的特征模板来识别人员。为了增强隐私保护，广泛采用了面部模板保护技术以隐藏存储在模板中的敏感身份和外观信息。本文识别了一种新兴的隐私攻击形式，利用扩散模型可能无效化先前的保护措施。该攻击可以从模板合成为高质量、保持身份一致的面部图像，揭示人员的外观。基于对扩散模型生成能力的研究，本文提出了一种通过将模板旋转到噪声似分布来进行防御的方法。这种旋转可以通过在其所在超球面上进行球形和线性插值高效实现。此外，本文还提出了按组划分和丢弃模板的特征维度，以增强旋转后模板的不可逆性。所提出的技术被具体化为一种新颖的面部模板保护技术——SlerpFace。广泛的实验表明，SlerpFace 提供了令人满意的识别精度，并且全面地抵御了反转及其他攻击形式，优于以往的方法。

title: Stable-Hair: Real-World Hair Transfer via Diffusion Model
title_ch: 稳定头发：基于扩散模型的现实世界毛发转移
authors: Yuxuan Zhang;Qing Zhang;Yiren Song;Jichao Zhang;Hao Tang;Jiaming Liu;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;Shenyang Institute of Automation;National University of Singapore;Ocean University of China;Peking University;Tiamat AI;
abstract: Current hair transfer methods struggle to handle diverse and intricate hairstyles, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel diffusion-based hair transfer framework, named \textit{Stable-Hair}, which robustly transfers a wide range of real-world hairstyles to user-provided faces for virtual hair try-on. To achieve this goal, our Stable-Hair framework is designed as a two-stage pipeline. In the first stage, we train a Bald Converter alongside stable diffusion to remove hair from the user-provided face images, resulting in bald images. In the second stage, we specifically designed a Hair Extractor and a Latent IdentityNet to transfer the target hairstyle with highly detailed and high-fidelity to the bald image. The Hair Extractor is trained to encode reference images with the desired hairstyles, while the Latent IdentityNet ensures consistency in identity and background. To minimize color deviations between source images and transfer results, we introduce a novel Latent ControlNet architecture, which functions as both the Bald Converter and Latent IdentityNet. After training on our curated triplet dataset, our method accurately transfers highly detailed and high-fidelity hairstyles to the source images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing hair transfer methods. Project page: \textcolor{red}{\url{https://xiaojiu-z.github.io/Stable-Hair.github.io/}}
abstract_ch: 当前的头发移植方法难以处理多样且复杂的发型，限制了它们在实际场景中的应用。在这篇论文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的头发移植框架，名为“Stable-Hair”，该框架能够稳健地将多种真实世界的发型转移到用户提供的面部图像上，实现虚拟试发。为了实现这一目标，我们的Stable-Hair框架设计为两阶段管道。在第一阶段，我们训练了一个秃头转换器与稳定的扩散模型一起使用，以去除用户提供的面部图像上的头发，生成秃头图像。在第二阶段，我们专门设计了一个发型提取器和一个潜在身份网络，将目标发型以高细节和高保真度转移到秃头图像上。发型提取器被训练用于编码包含所需发型的参考图像，而潜在身份网络则确保身份和背景的一致性。为了最小化源图像与移植结果之间的颜色偏差，我们引入了一种新的潜在控制网络架构（Latent ControlNet），该架构既作为秃头转换器又作为潜在身份网络。经过我们精心策划的三重数据集训练后，我们的方法能够准确地将高细节和高保真度的发型移植到源图像上。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在与现有头发移植方法的比较中达到了最先进的性能。项目页面：[https://xiaojiu-z.github.io/Stable-Hair.github.io/](https://xiaojiu-z.github.io/Stable-Hair.github.io/)

title: TAMER: Tree-Aware Transformer for Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
title_ch: TAMER: 一种考虑树结构的手写数学表达式识别变换器
authors: Jianhua Zhu;Wenqi Zhao;Yu Li;Xingjian Hu;Liangcai Gao;
affiliations: Peking University;
abstract: Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition (HMER) has extensive applications in automated grading and office automation. However, existing sequence-based decoding methods, which directly predict $\LaTeX$ sequences, struggle to understand and model the inherent tree structure of $\LaTeX$ and often fail to ensure syntactic correctness in the decoded results. To address these challenges, we propose a novel model named TAMER (Tree-Aware Transformer) for handwritten mathematical expression recognition. TAMER introduces an innovative Tree-aware Module while maintaining the flexibility and efficient training of Transformer. TAMER combines the advantages of both sequence decoding and tree decoding models by jointly optimizing sequence prediction and tree structure prediction tasks, which enhances the model's understanding and generalization of complex mathematical expression structures. During inference, TAMER employs a Tree Structure Prediction Scoring Mechanism to improve the structural validity of the generated $\LaTeX$ sequences. Experimental results on CROHME datasets demonstrate that TAMER outperforms traditional sequence decoding and tree decoding models, especially in handling complex mathematical structures, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.
abstract_ch: 手写数学表达式识别（HMER）在自动化评分和办公自动化领域有着广泛的应用。然而，现有的基于序列的解码方法直接预测$\LaTeX$序列，难以理解和建模$\LaTeX$固有的树结构，并且经常无法保证解码结果的语法正确性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为TAMER（Tree-Aware Transformer）的新模型，用于手写数学表达式识别。TAMER引入了一个创新的树意识模块，同时保持了Transformer的灵活性和高效的训练特性。TAMER通过联合优化序列预测和树结构预测任务，结合了序列解码和树解码模型的优点，从而增强了模型对复杂数学表达式结构的理解和泛化能力。在推断过程中，TAMER采用了一种树结构预测评分机制，以提高生成的$\LaTeX$序列的结构性有效性。实验结果表明，TAMER在处理复杂数学结构方面优于传统的序列解码和树解码模型，并实现了目前最先进的（SOTA）性能。
