title: Cycle3D: High-quality and Consistent Image-to-3D Generation via Generation-Reconstruction Cycle
title_ch: Cycle3D：通过生成-重建循环实现的高质量一致的图像到3D生成
authors: Zhenyu Tang;Junwu Zhang;Xinhua Cheng;Wangbo Yu;Chaoran Feng;Yatian Pang;Bin Lin;Li Yuan;
affiliations: Peking University;National University of Singapore;
abstract: Recent 3D large reconstruction models typically employ a two-stage process, including first generate multi-view images by a multi-view diffusion model, and then utilize a feed-forward model to reconstruct images to 3D content.However, multi-view diffusion models often produce low-quality and inconsistent images, adversely affecting the quality of the final 3D reconstruction. To address this issue, we propose a unified 3D generation framework called Cycle3D, which cyclically utilizes a 2D diffusion-based generation module and a feed-forward 3D reconstruction module during the multi-step diffusion process. Concretely, 2D diffusion model is applied for generating high-quality texture, and the reconstruction model guarantees multi-view consistency.Moreover, 2D diffusion model can further control the generated content and inject reference-view information for unseen views, thereby enhancing the diversity and texture consistency of 3D generation during the denoising process. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior ability of our method to create 3D content with high-quality and consistency compared with state-of-the-art baselines.
abstract_ch: 近年来，典型的三维大规模重建模型通常采用两阶段过程，首先是通过多视图扩散模型生成多视角图像，然后使用前馈模型将图像重构为三维内容。然而，多视图扩散模型往往会产生低质量且不一致的图像，从而负面影响最终的三维重建质量。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为Cycle3D的统一三维生成框架，在多步扩散过程中循环利用基于二维扩散的生成模块和前馈三维重建模块。具体而言，二维扩散模型用于生成高质量的纹理，而重建模型则确保多视角的一致性。此外，二维扩散模型还可以进一步控制生成的内容，并向未见过的视角注入参考视图信息，从而在去噪过程中增强三维生成的多样性和纹理一致性。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在创建高质量且一致的三维内容方面优于最先进的基线方法。

title: Diversifying Query: Region-Guided Transformer for Temporal Sentence Grounding
title_ch: 多样化查询：基于区域的时序句子定位变换器
authors: Xiaolong Sun;Liushuai Shi;Le Wang;Sanping Zhou;Kun Xia;Yabing Wang;Gang Hua;
affiliations: Xi'an Jiao Tong University;Dolby Laboratories;
abstract: Temporal sentence grounding is a challenging task that aims to localize the moment spans relevant to a language description. Although recent DETR-based models have achieved notable progress by leveraging multiple learnable moment queries, they suffer from overlapped and redundant proposals, leading to inaccurate predictions. We attribute this limitation to the lack of task-related guidance for the learnable queries to serve a specific mode. Furthermore, the complex solution space generated by variable and open-vocabulary language descriptions complicates optimization, making it harder for learnable queries to distinguish each other adaptively. To tackle this limitation, we present a Region-Guided TRansformer (RGTR) for temporal sentence grounding, which diversifies moment queries to eliminate overlapped and redundant predictions. Instead of using learnable queries, RGTR adopts a set of anchor pairs as moment queries to introduce explicit regional guidance. Each anchor pair takes charge of moment prediction for a specific temporal region, which reduces the optimization difficulty and ensures the diversity of the final predictions. In addition, we design an IoU-aware scoring head to improve proposal quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RGTR, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on QVHighlights, Charades-STA and TACoS datasets. Codes are available at https://github.com/TensorsSun/RGTR
abstract_ch: 时间句法接地是一个具有挑战性的任务，旨在定位与语言描述相关的时刻片段。尽管最近基于DETR的模型通过利用多个可学习的时刻查询取得了显著进展，但它们仍然受到重叠和冗余提案的影响，导致预测不准确。我们将其局限性归因于缺乏针对可学习查询的任务相关指导，使其能够服务于特定模式。此外，由变量和开放式词汇语言描述生成的复杂解空间增加了优化难度，使得可学习查询难以适应地区分彼此。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一个区域引导变换器（RGTR）用于时间句法接地，该方法通过多样化时刻查询来消除重叠和冗余的预测。RGTR 不使用可学习的查询，而是采用一组锚点对作为时刻查询，引入显式的区域指导。每个锚点对负责特定时间区域的时刻预测，这降低了优化难度并确保了最终预测的多样性。此外，我们设计了一个IoU感知的得分头以提高提案质量。广泛实验表明，RGTR 的有效性，在QVHighlights、Charades-STA 和 TACoS 数据集上优于最先进的方法。代码可在 https://github.com/TensorsSun/RGTR 获取。

title: DrivingForward: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scene Reconstruction from Flexible Surround-view Input
title_ch: DrivingForward：基于灵活 surround-view 输入的前向3D高斯点绘制方法在驾驶场景重构中的应用
authors: Qijian Tian;Xin Tan;Yuan Xie;Lizhuang Ma;
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;East China Normal University;
abstract: We propose DrivingForward, a feed-forward Gaussian Splatting model that reconstructs driving scenes from flexible surround-view input. Driving scene images from vehicle-mounted cameras are typically sparse, with limited overlap, and the movement of the vehicle further complicates the acquisition of camera extrinsics. To tackle these challenges and achieve real-time reconstruction, we jointly train a pose network, a depth network, and a Gaussian network to predict the Gaussian primitives that represent the driving scenes. The pose network and depth network determine the position of the Gaussian primitives in a self-supervised manner, without using depth ground truth and camera extrinsics during training. The Gaussian network independently predicts primitive parameters from each input image, including covariance, opacity, and spherical harmonics coefficients. At the inference stage, our model can achieve feed-forward reconstruction from flexible multi-frame surround-view input. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset show that our model outperforms existing state-of-the-art feed-forward and scene-optimized reconstruction methods in terms of reconstruction.
abstract_ch: 我们提出了一种名为DrivingForward的前馈高斯点云模型，用于从灵活的周围视图输入中重建驾驶场景。车辆安装的摄像头拍摄的驾驶场景图像通常较为稀疏，重叠有限，并且车辆的移动进一步复杂化了相机外参的获取。为应对这些挑战并实现实时重建，我们联合训练了一个姿态网络、一个深度网络和一个高斯网络，以预测代表驾驶场景的高斯原语。姿态网络和深度网络以自监督的方式确定高斯原语的位置，在训练过程中不使用深度ground truth和相机外参。高斯网络独立地从每个输入图像中预测原语参数，包括协方差、透明度和球谐系数。在推理阶段，我们的模型可以从灵活的多帧周围视图输入中实现前馈重建。实验表明，与现有的前馈和场景优化重建方法相比，我们的模型在重建方面表现更优。

title: Dual Conditioned Motion Diffusion for Pose-Based Video Anomaly Detection
title_ch: 基于姿态的视频异常检测中的双重条件运动扩散
authors: Hongsong Wang;Andi Xu;Pinle Ding;Jie Gui;
affiliations: Southeast University;Purple Mountain Laboratories;
abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) is essential for computer vision research. Existing VAD methods utilize either reconstruction-based or prediction-based frameworks. The former excels at detecting irregular patterns or structures, whereas the latter is capable of spotting abnormal deviations or trends. We address pose-based video anomaly detection and introduce a novel framework called Dual Conditioned Motion Diffusion (DCMD), which enjoys the advantages of both approaches. The DCMD integrates conditioned motion and conditioned embedding to comprehensively utilize the pose characteristics and latent semantics of observed movements, respectively. In the reverse diffusion process, a motion transformer is proposed to capture potential correlations from multi-layered characteristics within the spectrum space of human motion. To enhance the discriminability between normal and abnormal instances, we design a novel United Association Discrepancy (UAD) regularization that primarily relies on a Gaussian kernel-based time association and a self-attention-based global association. Finally, a mask completion strategy is introduced during the inference stage of the reverse diffusion process to enhance the utilization of conditioned motion for the prediction branch of anomaly detection. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that our method dramatically outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits superior generalization performance.
abstract_ch: 视频异常检测（VAD）对于计算机视觉研究至关重要。现有的VAD方法主要利用重建基或预测基框架。前者擅长检测不规则模式或结构，而后者则能够识别异常偏差或趋势。我们针对基于姿态的视频异常检测，并引入了一个名为双条件运动扩散（DCMD）的新框架，该框架结合了上述两种方法的优点。DCMD将条件运动与条件嵌入相结合，分别全面利用观察到的运动的姿态特征和潜在语义。在逆向扩散过程中，提出了一种运动变换器来捕捉人类运动频谱空间内多层特征之间的潜在关联。为了增强正常和异常实例之间的可区分性，我们设计了一种新颖的联合关联正则化（UAD），主要依赖于高斯核基于的时间关联和自注意力基于的全局关联。最后，在逆向扩散过程的推理阶段引入了一种掩码填充策略，以增强条件运动在异常检测预测分支中的利用。在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法显著优于最先进的方法，并展现出更出色的泛化性能。

title: Dual-branch Graph Feature Learning for NLOS Imaging
title_ch: 非视距成像中的双支图特征学习
authors: Xiongfei Su;Tianyi Zhu;Lina Liu;Zheng Chen;Yulun Zhang;Siyuan Li;Juntian Ye;Feihu Xu;Xin Yuan;
affiliations: Zhejiang University;China Mobile;Westlake University;Shanghai Jiao Tong University;University of Science and Technology of China;
abstract: The domain of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging is advancing rapidly, offering the capability to reveal occluded scenes that are not directly visible. However, contemporary NLOS systems face several significant challenges: (1) The computational and storage requirements are profound due to the inherent three-dimensional grid data structure, which restricts practical application. (2) The simultaneous reconstruction of albedo and depth information requires a delicate balance using hyperparameters in the loss function, rendering the concurrent reconstruction of texture and depth information difficult. This paper introduces the innovative methodology, \xnet, which integrates an albedo-focused reconstruction branch dedicated to albedo information recovery and a depth-focused reconstruction branch that extracts geometrical structure, to overcome these obstacles. The dual-branch framework segregates content delivery to the respective reconstructions, thereby enhancing the quality of the retrieved data. To our knowledge, we are the first to employ the GNN as a fundamental component to transform dense NLOS grid data into sparse structural features for efficient reconstruction. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method attains the highest level of performance among existing methods across synthetic and real data. https://github.com/Nicholassu/DG-NLOS.
abstract_ch: 非视距（NLOS）成像领域正在迅速发展，提供了揭示被遮挡场景的能力，这些场景无法直接看到。然而，当前的NLOS系统面临几个重大挑战：（1）由于固有的三维网格数据结构，计算和存储需求巨大，这限制了其实用应用。（2）同时重建反射率和深度信息需要在损失函数中的超参数之间进行微妙的平衡，使得同时重建纹理和深度信息变得困难。本文介绍了一种创新方法——\xnet，该方法整合了一个专注于反射率信息恢复的重建分支和一个提取几何结构的深度信息重建分支，以克服这些障碍。双分支框架将内容分别输送到各自的重建中，从而提高检索数据的质量。据我们所知，我们是首次将GNN作为基本组件来转换密集的NLOS网格数据为稀疏结构特征，以实现高效的重建。全面的实验表明，在合成和真实数据方面，我们的方法在现有方法中达到了最高的性能。https://github.com/Nicholassu/DG-NLOS。

title: Efficient Self-Supervised Video Hashing with Selective State Spaces
title_ch: 高效的选择性状态空间自监督视频哈希
authors: Jinpeng Wang;Niu Lian;Jun Li;Yuting Wang;Yan Feng;Bin Chen;Yongbing Zhang;Shu-Tao Xia;
affiliations: Tsinghua University;Harbin Institute of Technology;Meituan;Pengcheng Laboratory;
abstract: Self-supervised video hashing (SSVH) is a practical task in video indexing and retrieval. Although Transformers are predominant in SSVH for their impressive temporal modeling capabilities, they often suffer from computational and memory inefficiencies. Drawing inspiration from Mamba, an advanced state-space model, we explore its potential in SSVH to achieve a better balance between efficacy and efficiency. We introduce S5VH, a Mamba-based video hashing model with an improved self-supervised learning paradigm. Specifically, we design bidirectional Mamba layers for both the encoder and decoder, which are effective and efficient in capturing temporal relationships thanks to the data-dependent selective scanning mechanism with linear complexity. In our learning strategy, we transform global semantics in the feature space into semantically consistent and discriminative hash centers, followed by a center alignment loss as a global learning signal. Our self-local-global (SLG) paradigm significantly improves learning efficiency, leading to faster and better convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate S5VH's improvements over state-of-the-art methods, superior transferability, and scalable advantages in inference efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/gimpong/AAAI25-S5VH.
abstract_ch: 自监督视频哈希（SSVH）是一项在视频索引和检索中的实用任务。尽管Transformer在SSVH中因其出色的时序建模能力而占据主导地位，但它们往往受到计算和内存效率低下的困扰。受Mamba这一先进的状态空间模型启发，我们探索了它在SSVH中的潜力，以实现效果和效率之间的更好平衡。我们引入了S5VH，这是一种基于Mamba的视频哈希模型，具有改进的自监督学习范式。具体而言，我们在编码器和解码器中设计了双向Mamba层，这些层通过依赖数据的选择性扫描机制和线性复杂度有效地捕捉时序关系。在我们的学习策略中，我们将特征空间中的全局语义转换为语义上一致且具有区分性的哈希中心，随后使用中心对齐损失作为全局学习信号。我们提出的局部-全局（SLG）范式显著提高了学习效率，从而实现了更快更好的收敛。广泛实验表明，S5VH在最先进的方法上有所改进，具有更好的迁移性能，并且在推理效率方面具有可扩展的优势。代码可在https://github.com/gimpong/AAAI25-S5VH获取。

title: EigenSR: Eigenimage-Bridged Pre-Trained RGB Learners for Single Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution
title_ch: EigenSR：基于特征图像桥接的预训练RGB学习器在单张高光谱图像超分辨率中的应用
authors: Xi Su;Xiangfei Shen;Mingyang Wan;Jing Nie;Lihui Chen;Haijun Liu;Xichuan Zhou;
affiliations: Chongqing University;
abstract: Single hyperspectral image super-resolution (single-HSI-SR) aims to improve the resolution of a single input low-resolution HSI. Due to the bottleneck of data scarcity, the development of single-HSI-SR lags far behind that of RGB natural images. In recent years, research on RGB SR has shown that models pre-trained on large-scale benchmark datasets can greatly improve performance on unseen data, which may stand as a remedy for HSI. But how can we transfer the pre-trained RGB model to HSI, to overcome the data-scarcity bottleneck? Because of the significant difference in the channels between the pre-trained RGB model and the HSI, the model cannot focus on the correlation along the spectral dimension, thus limiting its ability to utilize on HSI. Inspired by the HSI spatial-spectral decoupling, we propose a new framework that first fine-tunes the pre-trained model with the spatial components (known as eigenimages), and then infers on unseen HSI using an iterative spectral regularization (ISR) to maintain the spectral correlation. The advantages of our method lie in: 1) we effectively inject the spatial texture processing capabilities of the pre-trained RGB model into HSI while keeping spectral fidelity, 2) learning in the spectral-decorrelated domain can improve the generalizability to spectral-agnostic data, and 3) our inference in the eigenimage domain naturally exploits the spectral low-rank property of HSI, thereby reducing the complexity. This work bridges the gap between pre-trained RGB models and HSI via eigenimages, addressing the issue of limited HSI training data, hence the name EigenSR. Extensive experiments show that EigenSR outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in both spatial and spectral metrics.
abstract_ch: 单谱线超分辨率（single-HSI-SR）旨在提高单个输入低分辨率HSI的分辨率。由于数据稀缺性的瓶颈，单HSI-SR的发展远远落后于RGB自然图像的超分辨率发展。近年来，RGB超分辨率的研究表明，预训练于大规模基准数据集上的模型可以在未见过的数据上显著提升性能，这可能为HSI提供一种解决方案。但如何将预训练的RGB模型转移到HSI，以克服数据稀缺性瓶颈呢？由于预训练的RGB模型与HSI之间的通道存在显著差异，该模型无法关注光谱维度上的相关性，从而限制了其在HSI上的应用能力。受HSI空间-光谱解耦的启发，我们提出了一种新的框架：首先使用空间成分（称为特征影像）微调预训练模型，然后通过迭代光谱正则化（ISR）对未见过的HSI进行推理，以保持光谱相关性。我们的方法具有以下优势：1）我们有效地将预训练RGB模型的空间纹理处理能力注入到HSI中，同时保持光谱保真度；2）在光谱解耦域中的学习可以提高对光谱无关数据的一般化能力；3）我们在特征影像域中的推理自然地利用了HSI的光谱低秩特性，从而降低了复杂度。本工作通过特征影像弥合了预训练RGB模型与HSI之间的差距，解决了HSI训练数据有限的问题，因此命名为EigenSR。广泛实验表明，EigenSR在空间和光谱指标上均优于现有最先进的（SOTA）方法。

title: EMControl: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Expectation-Maximization
title_ch: EMControl：通过期望最大化为文本到图像扩散模型添加条件控制
authors: He Wang;Longquan Dai;Jinhui Tang;
affiliations: Nanjing University of Science and Technology;

title: Empowering LLMs with Pseudo-Untrimmed Videos for Audio-Visual Temporal Understanding
title_ch: 利用伪未剪辑视频增强LLMs的音视频时序理解能力
authors: Yunlong Tang;Daiki Shimada;Jing Bi;Mingqian Feng;Hang Hua;Chenliang Xu;
affiliations: University of Rochester;Sony Group Corporation;
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language and multimodal domains. By fine-tuning multimodal LLMs with temporal annotations from well-annotated datasets, e.g., dense video captioning datasets, their temporal understanding capacity in video-language tasks can be obtained. However, there is a notable lack of untrimmed audio-visual video datasets with precise temporal annotations for events. This deficiency hinders LLMs from learning the alignment between time, audio-visual events, and text tokens, thus impairing their ability to temporally localize audio-visual events in videos. To address this gap, we introduce PU-VALOR, a comprehensive audio-visual dataset comprising over 114,000 pseudo-untrimmed videos with detailed temporal annotations. PU-VALOR is derived from the large-scale but coarse-annotated audio-visual dataset VALOR, through a subtle method involving event-based video clustering, random temporal scaling, and permutation. By fine-tuning a multimodal LLM on PU-VALOR, we developed AVicuna, a model capable of aligning audio-visual events with temporal intervals and corresponding text tokens. AVicuna excels in temporal localization and time-aware dialogue capabilities. Our experiments demonstrate that AVicuna effectively handles temporal understanding in audio-visual videos and achieves state-of-the-art performance on open-ended video QA, audio-visual QA, and audio-visual event dense localization tasks.
abstract_ch: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在自然语言和多模态领域展现出了卓越的能力。通过使用密集视频字幕等高质量标注数据集的时间标注对多模态LLMs进行微调，可以提升它们在视频语言任务中的时间理解能力。然而，精确标注事件的时间音频-视觉未剪辑视频数据集相对匮乏。这一不足阻碍了LLMs学习时间、音频-视觉事件与文本标记之间的对齐，从而影响其在视频中定位音频-视觉事件的能力。为解决这一问题，我们引入了PU-VALOR，这是一个包含超过114,000个伪未剪辑视频并附有详细时间标注的综合音频-视觉数据集。PU-VALOR是从大规模但粗略标注的音频-视觉数据集VALOR中通过基于事件的视频聚类、随机时间缩放和排列等微妙方法衍生出来的。通过在PU-VALOR上微调一个多模态LLM，我们开发出了AVicuna模型，该模型能够将音频-视觉事件与时间间隔及相应的文本标记对齐。AVicuna在时间定位和时间感知对话能力方面表现出色。我们的实验表明，AVicuna有效地处理了音频-视觉视频中的时间理解，并在开放性视频问答、音频-视觉问答以及音频-视觉事件密集定位任务中达到了最先进的性能。

title: Enhancing Noise-Robust Losses for Large-Scale Noisy Data Learning
title_ch: 增强抗噪损失函数以应对大规模 noisy 数据学习
authors: Max Staats;Matthias Thamm;Bernd Rosenow;
affiliations: ScaDS.AI;Universität Leipzig;
abstract: Large annotated datasets inevitably contain noisy labels, which poses a major challenge for training deep neural networks as they easily memorize the labels. Noise-robust loss functions have emerged as a notable strategy to counteract this issue, but it remains challenging to create a robust loss function which is not susceptible to underfitting. Through a quantitative approach, this paper explores the limited overlap between the network output at initialization and regions of non-vanishing gradients of bounded loss functions in the initial learning phase. Using these insights, we address underfitting of several noise robust losses with a novel method denoted as logit bias, which adds a real number $ε$ to the logit at the position of the correct class. The logit bias enables these losses to achieve state-of-the-art results, even on datasets like WebVision, consisting of over a million images from 1000 classes. In addition, we demonstrate that our method can be used to determine optimal parameters for several loss functions -- without having to train networks. Remarkably, our method determines the hyperparameters based on the number of classes, resulting in loss functions which require zero dataset or noise-dependent parameters.
abstract_ch: 大型标注数据集不可避免地包含噪声标签，这为训练深度神经网络带来了重大挑战，因为网络容易记住这些标签。噪声鲁棒损失函数已经成为了应对这一问题的一个显著策略，但仍然难以创建一个既不过于脆弱也不易导致欠拟合的鲁棒损失函数。通过定量方法，本文探讨了网络初始化输出与有界损失函数初始学习阶段非消失梯度区域之间的有限重叠。基于这些洞察，我们提出了一种新颖的方法——logit偏置，该方法在正确类别的位置向logit添加一个实数ε。logit偏置使这些损失函数能够达到最先进的性能，即使是在包含超过一百万张图像和1000个类别的WebVision数据集中也是如此。此外，我们展示了该方法可以用来确定几种损失函数的最佳参数——无需重新训练网络。令人惊讶的是，我们的方法根据类别数量来确定超参数，从而使得损失函数不需要依赖数据集或噪声的参数。

title: ERL-MPP: Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning with Multi-head Puzzle Perception for Solving Large-scale Jigsaw Puzzles of Eroded Gaps
title_ch: 进化强化学习与多头拼图感知相结合的方法：解决侵蚀缝隙的大规模拼图问题
authors: Xingke Song;Xiaoying Yang;Chenglin Yao;Jianfeng Ren;Ruibin Bai;Xin Chen;Xudong Jiang;
affiliations: University of Nottingham Ningbo China;University of Nottingham;Nanyang Technological University;
abstract: Solving jigsaw puzzles has been extensively studied. While most existing models focus on solving either small-scale puzzles or puzzles with no gap between fragments, solving large-scale puzzles with gaps presents distinctive challenges in both image understanding and combinatorial optimization. To tackle these challenges, we propose a framework of Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning with Multi-head Puzzle Perception (ERL-MPP) to derive a better set of swapping actions for solving the puzzles. Specifically, to tackle the challenges of perceiving the puzzle with gaps, a Multi-head Puzzle Perception Network (MPPN) with a shared encoder is designed, where multiple puzzlet heads comprehensively perceive the local assembly status, and a discriminator head provides a global assessment of the puzzle. To explore the large swapping action space efficiently, an Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning (EvoRL) agent is designed, where an actor recommends a set of suitable swapping actions from a large action space based on the perceived puzzle status, a critic updates the actor using the estimated rewards and the puzzle status, and an evaluator coupled with evolutionary strategies evolves the actions aligning with the historical assembly experience. The proposed ERL-MPP is comprehensively evaluated on the JPLEG-5 dataset with large gaps and the MIT dataset with large-scale puzzles. It significantly outperforms all state-of-the-art models on both datasets.
abstract_ch: 拼图游戏的研究已经非常广泛。尽管大多数现有模型专注于解决小型拼图或无碎片间隙的拼图，但在解决大型拼图时，尤其是存在间隙的情况下，图像理解和组合优化都面临着独特的挑战。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种进化强化学习与多头拼图感知框架（ERL-MPP），以获得更好的交换动作集来解决拼图问题。具体而言，为了应对存在间隙的拼图感知挑战，设计了一个具有共享编码器的多头拼图感知网络（MPPN），其中多个拼图头全面感知局部装配状态，并且一个判别器头提供拼图的整体评估。为了高效探索庞大的交换动作空间，设计了一个进化强化学习（EvoRL）代理，该代理基于感知到的拼图状态推荐一组合适的交换动作，使用估计奖励和拼图状态更新演员，并结合进化策略的评估器根据历史装配经验进化动作。所提出的ERL-MPP在JPLEG-5数据集（具有大间隙的拼图）和MIT数据集（大型拼图）上进行了全面评估，显著优于两个数据集上的所有现有最佳模型。

title: Eve: Efficient Multimodal Vision Language Models with Elastic Visual Experts
title_ch: Eve: 高效多模态视觉语言模型与弹性视觉专家
authors: Miao Rang;Zhenni Bi;Chuanjian Liu;Yehui Tang;Kai Han;Yunhe Wang;
affiliations: Huawei;
abstract: Multimodal vision language models (VLMs) have made significant progress with the support of continuously increasing model sizes and data volumes. Running VLMs on edge devices has become a challenge for their widespread application. There are several efficient VLM efforts, but they often sacrifice linguistic capabilities to enhance multimodal abilities, or require extensive training. To address this quandary,we introduce the innovative framework of Efficient Vision Language Models with Elastic Visual Experts (Eve). By strategically incorporating adaptable visual expertise at multiple stages of training, Eve strikes a balance between preserving linguistic abilities and augmenting multimodal capabilities. This balanced approach results in a versatile model with only 1.8B parameters that delivers significant improvements in both multimodal and linguistic tasks. Notably, in configurations below 3B parameters, Eve distinctly outperforms in language benchmarks and achieves state-of-the-art results 68.87% in VLM Benchmarks. Additionally, its multimodal accuracy outstrips that of the larger 7B LLaVA-1.5 model. Our code is available at https://github.com/rangmiao/Eve.
abstract_ch: 多模态视觉语言模型（VLMs）在模型规模和数据量不断增大的支持下取得了显著进展。但在边缘设备上运行VLMs已成为其广泛应用的一大挑战。虽然存在一些高效的VLM努力，但它们往往为了增强多模态能力而牺牲了语言能力，或者需要大量的训练。为了解决这一困境，我们引入了Efficient Vision Language Models with Elastic Visual Experts（Eve）这一创新框架。通过在训练的不同阶段战略性地融入可适应的视觉专长，Eve能够在保持语言能力的同时增强多模态能力。这种平衡的方法使得Eve成为一个只有1.8亿参数的多功能模型，在多模态和语言任务上都取得了显著的改进。值得注意的是，在参数量低于3B的情况下，Eve在语言基准测试中的表现明显优于其他模型，并在VLM基准测试中达到了68.87%的最佳结果。此外，它的多模态准确性甚至超过了更大规模的7B LLaVA-1.5模型。我们的代码可在https://github.com/rangmiao/Eve获取。

title: Explicit Relational Reasoning Network for Scene Text Detection
title_ch: 显式关系推理网络在场景文本检测中的应用
authors: Yuchen Su;Zhineng Chen;Yongkun Du;Zhilong Ji;Kai Hu;Jinfeng Bai;Xieping Gao;
affiliations: Fudan University;Tomorrow Advancing Life;Xiangtan University;Hunan Normal University;
abstract: Connected component (CC) is a proper text shape representation that aligns with human reading intuition. However, CC-based text detection methods have recently faced a developmental bottleneck that their time-consuming post-processing is difficult to eliminate. To address this issue, we introduce an explicit relational reasoning network (ERRNet) to elegantly model the component relationships without post-processing. Concretely, we first represent each text instance as multiple ordered text components, and then treat these components as objects in sequential movement. In this way, scene text detection can be innovatively viewed as a tracking problem. From this perspective, we design an end-to-end tracking decoder to achieve a CC-based method dispensing with post-processing entirely. Additionally, we observe that there is an inconsistency between classification confidence and localization quality, so we propose a Polygon Monte-Carlo method to quickly and accurately evaluate the localization quality. Based on this, we introduce a position-supervised classification loss to guide the task-aligned learning of ERRNet. Experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our ERRNet. It consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while holding highly competitive inference speed.
abstract_ch: 连通组件（CC）是一种符合人类阅读直觉的适当文本形状表示。然而，基于连通组件的文字检测方法最近面临着一个发展瓶颈，即耗时的后处理步骤难以消除。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一个显式的关系推理网络（ERRNet），以优雅地建模各个组件之间的关系，而无需进行后处理。具体而言，我们首先将每个文字实例表示为多个有序的文字组件，然后将这些组件视为在序列移动中的对象。这样一来，场景文字检测可以创新地被视为一个跟踪问题。从这个角度来看，我们设计了一个端到端的跟踪解码器，以实现完全无后处理的基于连通组件的方法。此外，我们观察到分类置信度与定位质量之间存在不一致，因此提出了一种多边形蒙特卡洛方法来快速准确地评估定位质量。基于此，我们引入了位置监督分类损失，以引导ERRNet的任务对齐学习。在具有挑战性的基准测试上的实验表明，我们的ERRNet非常有效。它在保持高度竞争的推理速度的同时，始终能够达到最先进的准确性。

title: Explore In-Context Segmentation via Latent Diffusion Models
title_ch: 通过潜扩散模型探索上下文分割
authors: Chaoyang Wang;Xiangtai Li;Henghui Ding;Lu Qi;Jiangning Zhang;Yunhai Tong;Chen Change Loy;Shuicheng Yan;
affiliations: Peking University;Skywork AI;Nanyang Technological University;Fudan University;Wuhan University;Zhejiang University;
abstract: In-context segmentation has drawn increasing attention with the advent of vision foundation models. Its goal is to segment objects using given reference images. Most existing approaches adopt metric learning or masked image modeling to build the correlation between visual prompts and input image queries. This work approaches the problem from a fresh perspective - unlocking the capability of the latent diffusion model (LDM) for in-context segmentation and investigating different design choices. Specifically, we examine the problem from three angles: instruction extraction, output alignment, and meta-architectures. We design a two-stage masking strategy to prevent interfering information from leaking into the instructions. In addition, we propose an augmented pseudo-masking target to ensure the model predicts without forgetting the original images. Moreover, we build a new and fair in-context segmentation benchmark that covers both image and video datasets. Experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating comparable or even stronger results than previous specialist or visual foundation models. We hope our work inspires others to rethink the unification of segmentation and generation.
abstract_ch: 随着视觉基础模型的出现，上下文分割逐渐引起了越来越多的关注。其目标是使用给定的参考图像来分割物体。目前大多数方法采用度量学习或掩蔽图像建模来建立视觉提示与输入图像查询之间的关联。本工作从一个全新的角度来解决这个问题——解锁潜在扩散模型（LDM）进行上下文分割的能力，并探讨不同的设计选择。具体来说，我们从三个角度审视问题：指令提取、输出对齐和元架构。我们设计了一种两阶段的掩蔽策略，以防止干扰信息泄露到指令中。此外，我们提出了一种增强的伪掩蔽目标，以确保模型在预测时不忘记原始图像。同时，我们构建了一个新的公平的上下文分割基准，该基准涵盖了图像和视频数据集。实验验证了我们方法的有效性，显示出与之前的专业分割模型或视觉基础模型相当甚至更优的结果。我们希望我们的工作能够启发其他人重新思考分割与生成的统一。

title: Fast Omni-Directional Image Super-Resolution: Adapting the Implicit Image Function with Pixel and Semantic-Wise Spherical Geometric Priors
title_ch: 快速全向图像超分辨率：利用像素和语义层面球几何先验适应隐式图像函数
authors: Xuelin Shen;Yitong Wang;Silin Zheng;Kang Xiao;Wenhan Yang;Xu Wang;
affiliations: Guangdong Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Economy;Shenzhen University;Pengcheng Laboratory;
abstract: In the context of Omni-Directional Image (ODI) Super-Resolution (SR), the unique challenge arises from the non-uniform oversampling characteristics caused by EquiRectangular Projection (ERP). Considerable efforts in designing complex spherical convolutions or polyhedron reprojection offer significant performance improvements but at the expense of cumbersome processing procedures and slower inference speeds. Under these circumstances, this paper proposes a new ODI-SR model characterized by its capacity to perform Fast and Arbitrary-scale ODI-SR processes, denoted as FAOR. The key innovation lies in adapting the implicit image function from the planar image domain to the ERP image domain by incorporating spherical geometric priors at both the latent representation and image reconstruction stages, in a low-overhead manner. Specifically, at the latent representation stage, we adopt a pair of pixel-wise and semantic-wise sphere-to-planar distortion maps to perform affine transformations on the latent representation, thereby incorporating it with spherical properties. Moreover, during the image reconstruction stage, we introduce a geodesic-based resampling strategy, aligning the implicit image function with spherical geometrics without introducing additional parameters. As a result, the proposed FAOR outperforms the state-of-the-art ODI-SR models with a much faster inference speed. Extensive experimental results and ablation studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of our design.
abstract_ch: 在全景图像超分辨率（ODI-SR）的上下文中，Omni-Directional Image（ODI）超分辨率（SR）的独特挑战源自等角投影（ERP）引起的非均匀过采样特性。设计复杂的球面卷积或多面体重新投影虽然能带来显著的性能提升，但会增加繁琐的处理程序并导致推理速度变慢。鉴于此，本文提出了一种新的FAOR（Fast and Arbitrary-scale ODI-SR）模型，该模型具备快速且任意尺度处理ODI-SR过程的能力。其关键创新在于通过引入球面几何先验，在低开销的情况下将隐式图像函数从平面图像域转换到ERP图像域，在潜特征表示阶段和图像重建阶段均融入了球面属性。具体而言，在潜特征表示阶段，我们采用像素级和语义级的球面到平面失真图对潜特征进行仿射变换，从而赋予其球面特性。此外，在图像重建阶段，我们引入基于测地线的重采样策略，使隐式图像函数与球面几何保持一致，而无需引入额外参数。因此，所提出的FAOR在推理速度上远快于现有的先进ODI-SR模型，并且实验结果和消融研究充分证明了其设计的有效性。

title: Improving Integrated Gradient-based Transferable Adversarial Examples by Refining the Integration Path
title_ch: 通过细化集成路径改进基于集成梯度的可转移对抗样本
authors: Yuchen Ren;Zhengyu Zhao;Chenhao Lin;Bo Yang;Lu Zhou;Zhe Liu;Chao Shen;
affiliations: Xi'an Jiao Tong University;Information Engineering University;Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics;Zhejiang Lab;
abstract: Transferable adversarial examples are known to cause threats in practical, black-box attack scenarios. A notable approach to improving transferability is using integrated gradients (IG), originally developed for model interpretability. In this paper, we find that existing IG-based attacks have limited transferability due to their naive adoption of IG in model interpretability. To address this limitation, we focus on the IG integration path and refine it in three aspects: multiplicity, monotonicity, and diversity, supported by theoretical analyses. We propose the Multiple Monotonic Diversified Integrated Gradients (MuMoDIG) attack, which can generate highly transferable adversarial examples on different CNN and ViT models and defenses. Experiments validate that MuMoDIG outperforms the latest IG-based attack by up to 37.3\% and other state-of-the-art attacks by 8.4\%. In general, our study reveals that migrating established techniques to improve transferability may require non-trivial efforts. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/RYC-98/MuMoDIG}.
abstract_ch: 可转移的对抗样本在实际的黑盒攻击场景中已知会造成威胁。一种提高可转移性的显著方法是使用集成梯度（IG），最初它是为模型可解释性而开发的。在本文中，我们发现现有的基于IG的攻击由于其在模型可解释性中简单采用IG的方式，具有有限的可转移性。为了应对这一局限性，我们专注于IG的集成路径，并在三个方面对其进行改进：多样性、单调性和多重性，这得到了理论分析的支持。我们提出了多重单调多样化集成梯度（MuMoDIG）攻击，该攻击可以在不同的CNN和ViT模型及防御措施上生成高度可转移的对抗样本。实验验证表明，MuMoDIG相比于最新的基于IG的攻击性能提高了37.3%，相比于其他最先进的攻击则提高了8.4%。总的来说，我们的研究揭示了迁移成熟技术以提高可转移性可能需要非平凡的努力。代码可在https://github.com/RYC-98/MuMoDIG获取。

title_ch: JoVALE：利用音频视觉和语言上下文检测视频中的人类动作

affiliations: Hanyang University;Seoul National University;
abstract: Video Action Detection (VAD) entails localizing and categorizing action instances within videos, which inherently consist of diverse information sources such as audio, visual cues, and surrounding scene contexts. Leveraging this multi-modal information effectively for VAD poses a significant challenge, as the model must identify action-relevant cues with precision. In this study, we introduce a novel multi-modal VAD architecture, referred to as the Joint Actor-centric Visual, Audio, Language Encoder (JoVALE). JoVALE is the first VAD method to integrate audio and visual features with scene descriptive context sourced from large-capacity image captioning models. At the heart of JoVALE is the actor-centric aggregation of audio, visual, and scene descriptive information, enabling adaptive integration of crucial features for recognizing each actor's actions. We have developed a Transformer-based architecture, the Actor-centric Multi-modal Fusion Network, specifically designed to capture the dynamic interactions among actors and their multi-modal contexts. Our evaluation on three prominent VAD benchmarks, including AVA, UCF101-24, and JHMDB51-21, demonstrates that incorporating multi-modal information significantly enhances performance, setting new state-of-the-art performances in the field.
abstract_ch: 视频动作检测（VAD）涉及在视频中定位和分类动作实例，这些视频本身包含了多样化的信息来源，如音频、视觉线索以及周围的场景上下文。有效地利用这种多模态信息进行VAD是一项重大挑战，因为模型必须以精确的方式识别与动作相关的关键线索。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的多模态VAD架构，称为联合演员中心的视觉、音频、语言编码器（JoVALE）。JoVALE是首个将音频和视觉特征与源自大规模图像描述模型的场景描述性上下文相结合的VAD方法。JoVALE的核心在于以演员为中心的信息聚合，包括音频、视觉和场景描述性信息，这使得模型能够适应性地整合关键特征，以便于识别每个演员的动作。我们开发了一种基于Transformer的架构，即演员中心的多模态融合网络，专门用于捕捉演员之间的动态交互及其多模态上下文。我们在三个著名的VAD基准测试集上进行了评估，包括AVA、UCF101-24和JHMDB51-21，结果显示，结合多模态信息显著提升了性能，在该领域设立了新的最佳表现。
